Pokemon Journeys Season 2: Mew's Adventue in the Orange Islands

by PinkiePieSweets

Summary

Join Mew and her friends as they now travel to the Orange Island to compete in the Orange League. They meet new friends gain new Pokemon, battle against Team Rocket, and travel through different islands on the ocean blue. And they'll also gain a new traveling companion.

Chapter 1: Episode 1: Birds of a Feathers Flock Into a Battle

Mew and her friends have begun their next journey. The destination of their journey is to go to Valencia Island to retrieve a mysterious Pokeball from Professor Oak's friend, Professor Ivy. Question is, how are they going to get there? Luckily, Brock is reading the guide book as everyone decides to have lunch.

Brock looks at it and says, "Look at all that ocean! Look at all that sand! And think of all those pretty girls. Well, now we have to figure out how to get to Valencia Island."

"I don't care how we get there, as long as we get there fast. I want as much time in the sun as possible. I gotta work on my tan," Misty says.

"Yeah. It sounds like a ton of fun," Mew says.

"Really fun," Tomo says.

Then Mew begins to wonder, "It's kind of strange. I've never heard of a Pokeball that's unable to be teleported from the teleporter before."

"Me either. That Pokeball must be very rare and mysterious," Misty says.

Mew turns to Brock, "So Brock, what's the best way to get to Valencia Island."

"Well, according to the guide book. The guide book says that if you go by blimp, it takes less than a day," Brock says.

"A blimp? What's a blimp?" Mew asks.

"I guess you've never heard or read one before?" Misty asks.

"Nope," Mew says.

"I never heard of one, either," Tomo says.

Then Brock says, "It's a flying vehicle that has been lifted into the air and flies people to their destination. They are sometimes used for sports and other events."

"Sounds cool. And using a blimp can help us get to Valencia Island faster," Mew says.

Misty looks at the guide book, "According to the book, the nearest airport that has blimps is just outside of Vermilion City."

"So we'll have to travel past Viridian City, Pewter City, and Cerulean City in order to get there," Mew says.

Then Brock has an idea, "Hey Misty, maybe you and I can stop by and visit our families while traveling to Vermilion City."

"What a great idea. Plus, you can introduce Tomo to your family," Misty says.

"Sounds nice. I like to see how your families are doing," Mew says.

"Well then, we should get going after having lunch," Brock says.

"Sounds good," Mew and the others reply.

Unknown to Mew and her friends, Team Rocket are climbing a tree distance away with their binoculars to get a good view to find Mew and her friends.

"Remind me again, why are we climbing up a tree?" Meowth asks, hanging on to a branch.

"Because, we know those twerps are going to be coming this way. We'll be able to spot them from up here," Jessie says, sitting on a thick branch.

James climbs up as well as he looks around, "I don't know Jessie. This forest seems a little too quiet."

"Well, it will make sure the twerps don't see us," Jessie says.

Suddenly, Jessie feels something poking her back.

Jessie turns to James, "Will you cut that out?"

"I didn't do anything," James replies.

Suddenly, Meowth screams, "I think we picked the wrong time to climb up this tree!"

The three turn their heads to their surprise. They see the tree is full of Pidgey and Pidgeotto. And there is one specific one that is bigger than the others. All of them letting out cries in concern, or fear. Like they're scared of something.

"What's going on?" Jessie wonders.

Jessie then climbs up and pokes her head further up the tree, suddenly, she finds herself being attacked by some Spearows.

Jessie screams in pain, "You're giving me a migraine!"

Jessie looks up and screams to see a whole flock of Spearow flying towards her. They move to reveal their leader, a large Fearow, flying in the rear and dashes forward.

A little time later after lunch, Mew and her friends continue their journey to get to the airport outside of Vermilion City, to get to Valencia Island. As they walk through this part of the forest, Mew senses something's wrong.

"This forest seems very quiet," Tomo says.

"It sure is," Misty says.

"You're right. This is the forest where usually Pidgey and Pidgeotto live. This is also where my Pidgeotto lived with his brothers and sisters before traveling with me," Mew says.

"So then, why is it quiet now?" Brock wonders.

Suddenly, Pikachu senses something, and looks up to spot the flock of Spearow and their leader, Fearow.

Pikachu cries out, "Pika?" (What the?)

Everyone looks up to see the flock of Spearow and the large Fearow flying down towards them. The Spearow dives down towards them, causing the group to duck their heads just in time.

"Those are Spearow!" Mew says, shocked.

Eevee soon notices, "Eevee Eevee!" (And they're not alone!)

The group quickly turn around to see the Fearow and everyone quickly gets down to the ground in the nick of time, more like too close for comfort.

Mew looks up and questions, "Was that a Fearow?"

She brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Fearow, the Beak Pokémon. The evolved form of Spearow. A Normal and Flying Type. Its large powerful wings allow it to fly for an entire day. The crushing power of its beak is tremendous."

"If we stick around here much longer, we'll find out how tremendous it is!" Misty panics.

"But why would a Fearow be attacking us?" Mew wonders.

She soon gasps in realization, "Unless it's.."

Mew's mind flashbacks to the day Pikachu, Eevee, and herself are on their journey. As they travel, they meet Poliwag who is being chased by a Spearow, and Mew quickly has Pikachu use Thunderbolt to chase it away. Only after that, it calls out the rest of it's flock and begins to chase after them.

Mew soon realizes, "That Spearow that chased Poliwag must have evolved."

"Wait, what?" Brock asks.

"To put it shortly, when Poliwrath was Poliwag, it was being chased by a Spearow, but Pikachu, Eevee, and I chased Poliwag, but the Spearow called out it's friends and chased us," Mew says.

"I remember. You had to take my bike to avoid them, but you said that Pikachu was able to use a powerful Thunderbolt attack to chase them away," Misty says.

"So you're saying that the Fearow that was attacking us now, is the same one that attacked Poliwrath when it was a Poliwag?" Tomo asks.

"I'm sure that's the same one," Mew says.

Then Brock looks up, "Talk about holding a grudge."

Soon the Fearow flies back around and towards Mew and her friends. Before they can have a chance to escape, the Fearow grabs Mew and flies her away. Pikachu and Eevee quickly grab on to her.

Everyone cries out, "MEW!"

Soon, Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee find themselves being carried into the air. They soon find themselves very high up.

Mew calls out, "Pikachu, Thunder Shock, now!"

Pikachu then does just that, and shocks them all, including Fearow. As a result, Fearow drops all three of them down and they fall into the trees.

The group cries out, "MEW!

Somewhere in the trees Mew along with Pikachu, and Eevee find themselves on the tree branch.

Mew turns to her Pokemon and asks, "Are you all okay?"

"Pika Pika," (I'm okay.) Pikachu says.

"Eevee," (I'm good.) Eevee says.

"We're okay too," A familiar voice says.

Mew looks around to find herself in the same tree as Team Rocket.

"Hey, what are you three guys doing up here?" Mew asks.

"We're stuck because that Fearow and those Spearow don't get along with these Pidgey and Pidgeotto," Jessie explains.

She soon notices an entire flock of Pidgey and Pidgeotto.

"You see, the second we try to leave this tree, we'll be caught up in some kind of big birdbrained battle," James says.

Then Meowth shouts, "We can't sit here forever!"

Up above, the Spearow flock in a circle, and Fearow is flying past them from a lower level. Mew looks up to see the flying Pokemon. Mew then looks at the flock to see them feeling uneasy. Just then, a few Pidgey, and Pidgotto, and a larger Pidgeotto fly up to Mew.

The large Pidgeotto says, "Pidge Pidge Pidgeotto?" (Mew, is that you?)

"Oh hi Pidgeotto, it's good to see you. So I'm guessing you're having problems with those Spearow and that Fearow," Mew says.

"Otto Pidgeotto Pidge Pidge Pidgeotto Pdige Pidgey," (That's right. They've been chasing us, and attacking us so we had to hide here.) The large Pidgeotto says.

Then says, "Pidgeotto Pdigeotto Pidge Pidgeotto." (I tried to fight that Fearow, but it's pretty strong, and aggressive."

"That was very brave of you to protect the flock. Don't worry, I'll find a way to help you guys deal with those Separow and Fearow. To tell you the truth, the Fearow has a grudge against Me, Eevee, and Pikachu," Mew says.

"Pidgeotto?" (What for?) Large Pidgeotto asks.

"Long story short, we got on it's bad side when we were trying to help a Poliwag that was changing. The Poliwag is with us now, and has evolved into Poliwrath," Mew explains.

Suddenly, they hear Brock's voice, "Hey, Mew!"

Mew looks down to see Brock, Tomo, Misty, and the other Pokemon,

"Are you okay?!" Tomo calls out.

Then Misty says, "What are you doing up in that tree?"

Mew calls out, "We're fine, but Fearow and the Spearow are gonna attack the Pidgey and Pidgeotto if we try to leave this tree!"

"But we have to get to Valencia Island!" Misty says.

"I know that, but I'm not gonna leave these Pidgey and Pidgeotto here to get attacked! This is my Pidgeotto flock! His borthers and sister's need help! Not to mention that Fearow is going to chase after us if we try to leave!" Mew says.

"Then what are you going to do?" Jessie questions.

"If we work together, I think we can help the Pidgey and Pidgeotto escape," Mew says.

"Sounds like you have a plan!" Jessie says.

Then Meowth says, Don't trust her!

"If the twerp can get us down from this tree, let's help her," Jessie says.

"I want to help the Pokémon, but I think it's more important to get you guys out of this tree first," Meowth says.

Team Rocket nods their heads

Then Jessie "So what's the plan?

Then Mew, "Sorry to do this guys."

Mew then starts jumping on the branch up and down, starting to shake it. That causes Team Rocket to fall down the tree and land on the ground.

Meowth screams, "I just knew I'd be the fall guy!"

Once they land on the ground, the Spearow flock divebombs towards them with the Fearow not far behind. Team Rocket are forced to retreat with the Fearow and Spearows pecking at them.

"They never catch a break, do they?" Misty questions.

"Not really," Brock says.

"Not by a long shot," Tomo says.

Up in the tree, Mew says, "Alright, that worked perfectly."

Then turns to the Pokemon, "Pidgey, Pidgeotto, now's your chance to get away."

Then brings out her Pokeball, "And I think we can use a little help."

She lets out her Pokeball, and Mew's Pidgeotto comes out.

The Larger Pidgeotto is very happy to see Mew's Pidgeotto, his little brother. Both Pidgeotto land on the same branch and are very happy to see each other.

The Larger Pidgeotto turns to the flock and informs them, "Alright everyone, we need to fly away fast before the Fearow and Spearow come back. Let's hurry while we have the chance."

The flock agrees and begins to fly away from the tree.

"Pidgeotto's brother is doing a great job!" Mew says.

"Pika!" (Sure is!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee," (Doing great.) Eevee says.

As Pidgeotto and his brother are flying away with the flock, the Fearow is soon coming in from behind with it's own flock. Pidgeotto and it's brother notice the Fearow behind them.

Mew panics, "They're back!"

Pidgeotto and his older brother breah from the flock and begin to fly towards Fearow. Just then, Fearow dashes towards them.

Mew calls out, "Watch out!"

Pidgeotto and his older brother quickly move out of the way. Fearow then makes a U-turn and begins to black back towards them. Pidgeotto and his older brother continue to doge the attack.

Mew calls out, "Quick guys, use Gust!"

With that, Pidgeotto and his brother begin to use their Gust Attack. Fearow feels the strong wind and is being pushed back, but the Fearow is proven to be strong and continues to speed towards them. Pidgeotto and his older brother continue to dodge their attacks. However, Fearow is too fast for them. Soon, Fearow is able to strike at Pidgeotto. It then U-Turn and then strikes at his older brother. Soon, the two fall out of the sky and crash to the ground.

Mew hurries up to them, "Pidgeotto, are you both alright?"

Mew kneels down to the ground to check up on them.

Just then, the Fearow begin to chase after the flock of Pidgey and Pidgeotto. Soon, Mew's Pidgeotto and big brother struggle to get up while the others snow up.

"Pidgeotto, you did your best, maybe you're just too hurt to help them now. You both need to rest," Mew says.

However, both of them struggle to get up.

"Pidgeotto?" Mew says, confused.

When they both stand up, they both let out a battle cry. Soon, they both begin to glow. Mew, Pikachu and Eevee are surprised. Misty, Brock, and Tomo arrive on the scene and are shocked to see what is happening.

Brock confirms, "Both Pidgeotto are evolving!"

As soon as both glows fade, both of the Pidgeotto are an avian Pokémon with large wings, sharp talons, and a short, hooked beak. Its glossy plumage is mostly brown with cream-colored underparts and flight feathers. Its head has a decorated crest that is nearly as long as its body. The center feathers of its crest are yellow, while the outer feathers are red. The fan-like feathers of its tail are red or brown. Its beak and legs are pink, and there are three forward-facing toes and one backward-facing toe on each foot. Behind each eye is an angular black marking. Only the older brother is a larger version.

"Pidgeot!" Mew says, excited.

Mew brings out her Pokedex, and Dexter says, "Pidgeot, the Bird Pokemon, and the evolved form of Pidgeotto. A Normal and Flying Type. It can fly at twice the speed of sound at an altitude of nearly one mile."

Mew's Pidgeot motions to Mew.

"Are you asking me to come with you?" Mew asks.

Pidgeot nods his head.

"Well, I'm ready to battle Fearow if you are, Pidgeot!" Mew says, excited.

Then turns to her friends, "Pikachu. Eevee. Let's go!"

Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee quickly climb on Pidgeot's back.

"Ready for takeoff!" Mew calls out.

"Pika!/Eev!" (Roger!) Pikachu and Eevee say.

Pidgeot and his brother let out a cry and fly in the air where Fearow is. Soon, Fearow notices and flies back towards the.

"Alright, Pidgeot, Gust attack, now!" Mew calls out.

Soon, Mew's Pidgeot and Big Brother Pidgeot perform Gust and strike Fearow hard.

Nice work, guys now let's try your Quick Attack!" Mew calls out.

Both Pidgeot speed towards Fearow and are both able to strike at Fearow at the same time. Even harder than the Guest attack. Then, they both turn around to finish the battle.

Then Mew says, "Now, let's finish off that Fearow! Are you ready, Pikachu, Eevee?"

"Pika!Eevee!" ("Ready!") Pikachu and Eevee answer.

They soon jump on Pidgeot's head. Then they jump down and land on Fearow causing it to turn around.

"Okay, Pikachu, Eevee, use your Thunderbolt, now!" Mew calls out.

Both Pikachu and Eevee then perform Thunderbolt at the same time, which gives Fearow a major shock.

Mew notices, "That was great, Pikachu! Your Thunderbolt weakened it!"

"Pikachu." (It sure did.) Pikachu says.

Then Eevee says, "Eevee Eevee!" (Let's catch it!)"

However, FEarow is able to regain it's focus and turns around towards them with the same altitude.

"Uh oh. I think Fearow still has a lot of fight in it. And I don't think it's going to back down," Mew says.

Fearow then plans to make its next move. But before it could attack them, Older Brother Pidgeot lets out a cry, and summons the entire flock of Pidgey and Pidgeotto flock and lead them into the battle. With that, Older Brother signals them to follow. With that, Older Brother Pidgeot enters the battle. Mew's Pidgeot, Pidgeotto, and Pidgey follow from behind. Soon, they all begin to strike at Fearow with full force. Soon, Pidgeot, the big brother, the flock of Pidgey and Pidgeotto face Fearow

"Looks like your big brother is in charge, right Pidgeot?" Mew asks.

Both Pidgeot nod their heads in reply.

Then Older Brother Pidgeot let out a cry for an attack, but Fearow quickly retreats with it's tail between it's wings.

Mew waves goodbye, "So long, Fearow! I guess that'll teach you to pick on other Pokémon!"

Soon, Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee begin laughing. Everyone watches as Fearow flies away from the fight.

Later in the sunset, Mew and her friends, along with Pidgeot, are looking at Older Brother Pidgeot and the flock.

Older Brother Pidgeot says, "Pidgeot Pdigeot. Pidgeot Pidge Pidge Pidgeot." (Thank you for the help everyone. Those Spearow and that Fearow have been bothering us for weeks.)

"It's no trouble. After all you're my Pidgeot's family, and you are all friends. We help each other when you need it," Mew says.

Older Brother Pidgeot walks to his brother and says, "Pidge Pidgeot, Pidge Pidgie Pidgeot Pidgeot Pidge Pidge. Pidgeot Pidge Pidge," (And little brother, I'm so proud of how strong you've become. I also have a present for you.)

Older brother Pidgeot digs into its right wings, and brings out something in his beak. Then places it on the ground for Mew's Pidgeot.

Pidgeot takes the object and passes it to Mew.

Mew looks to see the object is a round stone that is orange on the outside, the inside is red and light yellow mark. Misty and the others look to see the stone.

"Oh my, it's beautiful," Misty says.

"That's a Pidgeotite," Brock says..

"Pidgeotite?" Tomo says, confused.

"It is a Mega Stone that can allow Pidgeot to Mega Evolve," Mew says.

"That means Pidgeot can Mega Evolve someday, right?" Misty asks.

"Right," Mew happily says.

Then turns to Older Brother Pidgeot, "Thank you."

Even Mew's Pidgeot says, "Pidgeot" (Thank you.)

Older Brother Pidgeot smiles. Then the two brothers nuzzle against each other with smiles. Glad to see each other again.

Soon enough, Mew and her friends say goodbye to Older Brother Pidgeot, along with the Pidgey and Pidgotto. Mew and her friends continue on their journey to Valencia Island to pick up the mysterious Pokeball from Professor Ivy for Professor Oak.

Meanwhile, in the Pallet Town forest, Team Rocket is still being chased by the Spearow flock

They continue to run as they scream, "Team Rocket's blasting off again!"

Chapter 2: Episode 2: Rockin at the Pewter Gym

Mew and her friends continue their journey to Vermilion City and then to Valencia Island to pick up the mysterious Pokeball from Professor Ivy. Mew and her friends continue to walk until they reach the next destination of their journey, Pewter City. Brock's home town.

"So Brock, we're almost to Pewter City. Are you excited to see your brothers and sisters again?" Mew asks.

"I am. It will be nice to see them again, and I do like to see how my dad is doing at the gym," Brock says.

Tomo says, "So Brock, Mew told me that you used to be the Pewter City Gym Leader?"

"That's right. I was actually the first gym that Mew battled. Mew and I battled hard, and she won the gym battle at the end," Brock says.

"Yeah. and it's also when Poliwag evolved into Poliwhirl," Mew says.

"That sounds cool," Tomo says, interested.

Then asks, "Do you think I can battle in a Pokemon Gym someday?"

"I'm sure you can. You just need to wait two more years and you'll be able to get your first Pokemon, and your Pokedex," Misty says.

Tomo sighs, "That sounds like forever. I already got plenty of Pokemon."

"And since you live with Pokemon like Mew, you must know some of the Pokemon's moves," Misty says.

Then says, "But while on a Pokemon Journey, there is still a lot for you to learn about being a trainer."

"Okay," Tomo says.

Mew then ruffles Tomo's, "I'm sure you'll be a great trainer someday. And we can talk to the professor about you becoming a trainer too. I'm sure he'll let you go with no trouble."

"Yea!" Tomo says, excited.

Mew and her friends continue to make their way to Pewter City to get to the Pewter Gym. Unknown to them, Team Rocket is spying on them from the bushes close by.

"There they are," Jessie says.

"And the twerps said they're going to be at Pewter City," James says.

"Yeah. So we can use that to steal Pikachu, along with that Eevee, and the Pokemon from the Gym," Meowth says.

"But how do we plan on stealing the Pokemon without them noticing?" James questions.

Then Jessie has an idea, "I think I know how we can infiltrate the Gym."

Jessie soon makes a sinister look on her face.

Sometime later, Mew and her friends arrive at the Pewter City Gym. Brock opens the door and walks inside, Mew and the others follow after.

Inside the house, Brock calls out, "I'm home!"

Suddenly, all the siblings call out, "Hey, it's Brock!"

They all run to Brock and give their big brother a big hug.

Brock happily says to them by name, "Hi Forrest. Salvadore. Yolanda. Tommy. Cindy. Suzie, Timmy, Billy and Tilly. How are you all doing?"

"Fine," The siblings answer happily, and get in line.

"Hey guys, it's great to see you," Mew says.

"Hi Mew," Yolanda says.

"And you too, Misty," Tommy says.

"Hi Tommy," Misty says.

Soon, the twins walk to Tomo and say, "Hi."

"Hello. I'm Tomo," Tomo says.

Then Cindy asks, "So Brock, how have you been doing?"

"I'm doing fine, Cindy. How are things going at home?" Brock replies.

"Things are doing great. Dad has been having a lot of Gym battles, and he's been training us with his Pokemon," Forrest says.

"And we've doing what we can to help dad around the house," Yolanda says.

"That's good to hear," Brock says.

Then asks, "Where is dad?"

"He's in the gym filling the holes on the battlefield," Timmy says.

"What happened?" Misty asks.

"Well, the recent trainer he battled has a Sandshrew that used Dig a lot," Cidny says.

Tommy laughs and says, "It made the battlefield look like swiss cheese."

A little while later, Forrest and the other siblings escort Brock and the others through the hall that leads them to the gym's battlefield. The door opens and they arrive to see the battlefield is indeed covered with many holes in the ground.

"Wow. That's a lot of holes," Misty says.

"There's a lot of holes on the battlefield," Mew says.

"No kidding," Brock says.

Soon they notice Flint digging some dirt from the bag and filling up the hole. Once the hole is full, he pats the dirt down with the shovel.

Brock calls out, "Hey dad!"

Flint turns his head to see Borck and says, "Hi Brock, you're back!"

"Yeah. We came here for a visit," Brock says.

"It's glad to see you," Flint says.

Then says to the others, "And it's good to see you again Mew. You too, Misty."

Then Tomo notices, "And who is this?"

"This is Tomo. He's been traveling with us since we met him at the Pokemon Preserve," Brock introduces Tomo to his dad.

"Hi," Tomo happily says.

"So what brings you to Pewter City?" Flint asks.

"We're on our way to Valencia Island to meet up with Professor Ivy to pick up a mysterious Pokeball," Mew says.

"A mysterious Pokeball?" Flint says, interested.

"Apparently, this Pokemon is unable to be transported like a normal Pokeball so Professor Oak asked us if we can pick it up," Misty says.

"And while on the way, we decided to visit here while traveling," Brock says.

Forrest says, "We're glad to hear that."

"And congratulations on winning the league Mew," Yolanda says.

Mew smiles and says, "Thank you."

"You were amazing in your battle and that Mega Charizard was awesome," Timmy says.

Flint laughs and says, "Yeah. You really did put off amazing feet. The kids couldn't stop talking about it."

"Wouldn't blame them. Mew was awesome with her battle," Tomo says.

"And she's the youngest trainer to ever win the Pokemon League," Suzie says.

"She's amazing," Cindy says.

The twins happily say, "Amazing."

Mew laughs with a smile.

Brock turns to his dad, "So dad, do you need some help?"

"I got this. You all just got here and it sounds like you have a journey ahead of you," Flint says.

"We don't mind helping," Mew says, picking up the shovel.

"Pika Pika," (We can help!) Pikachu says

"Eevee," (Sure can.) Eevee replies.

"Yeah. We can help," Tomo says.

Skwovet and Meloetta nod their heads in reply.

"Well okay. I could use a hand, and I suspect you want to help anyway," Flint says.

"And while you do that, I can go fix us some lunch." Brock says.

The siblings cheer, "Yay!"

Then Timmy asks, "Hey Brock, can we play with the Pokemon you caught?"

"Sure," Brock says.

Outside of the gym, Brock throws his Pokeballs and calls out, "Come on out!"

Some of the Pokeballs open and his Pokemon Geodude, Onix, Zubat, Rhyhorn, Sandile, Dwebble,, Rockruff, Grookey, Hippopotas, Pansage, Seedot, Aron, Rhydon, Vulpix and little Winter, the Alolan Vulpix. The kids are amazed and begin to get close and have fun with the other Pokemon. The Pokemon are delighted to play with the kids. Misty stays out with Togepi and Pichu as they watch the children play.

In the kitchen, Brock is already working on making lunch for everyone in the house. He chopped some vegetables, placed some bread in the oven, and cooked some of the vegetables and other ingredients in it.

In the gym, Mew, Tomo, Pikachu, Eevee, Meloetta and Skwovet are helping Flint fix up the gym. Flint, Mew and Tomo fill up the holes while Pikachu, Eevee, Meloetta, and Skwovet pat the dirt on the ground.

Sometime later, Brock made lunch for everyone. Everyone arrives to see a wide spread of food on the table.

The siblings cheer, "We're starving!"

With that, the kids begin to chow down on the food. Flint, Mew, and the others, including Brock join them.

"I swear Brock, you have to be the best chef in the world," Salvadore says.

"The food tastes great," Cindy says.

"Glad you like it because there's seconds," Brock says.

The children cheer, "Yay!"

Everyone continues to eat their food. As they eat, they begin to have conversations, especially about Mew and her friends' journey.

"Really? That is so cool!" Yolanda replies.

"Yeah. The Pokemon Race was great. Of course, Rapidash was really great, and really beat Dodrio," Mew says.

"And Dario. I hope that will teach him a lesson about cheating," Misty says.

"Hope so. Otherwise Rapidash is going to give him and Dodrio another hard kick," Mew says, and chuckles.

Suzie looks at Togepi and Pichu, "Those Pokemon are really cute."

"Thanks. Togepi and Pichu are very cute," Misty says.

Cindy says, "Pichu looks a lot like Pikachu."

"It's no surprise. Pichu is actually the pre-evolved form of Pikachu," Brock says.

"Aww, it's so cute. So that means it will become a Pikachu someday," Cindy replies.

"Yeah. Maybe someday," Misty says.

Tomo asks Flint, "So Flint, you were the gym leader before Brock?"

"That's right. I was the gym leader until Brock became the gym leader when I left. When I decided to come back, I let Brock follow his dream of being a Pokemon Breeder and took over the gym again," Flint explains.

"Oh," Tomo replies.

"So Brock, what's this mysterious Pokeball you're supposed to bring back?" Forrest asks.

"We're not really sure, but for some reason, it's unable to be teleported like a normal Pokeball so we need to head to Valencia Island to pick it up," Brock says.

"We've been rather curious about this mysterious Pokeball, so is Professor Oak," Mew says.

"And that's why he asked us to go pick it up, so he can study it. Hopefully we'll be able to learn something about it," Misty says.

"Sounds like you got some mystery that needs figuring out," Flint says.

"We sure do," Mew says.

"So Flint, do you think I can see the kinds of battles you do at your gym?" Tomo asks.

"I don't see why not, but I will need to have a challenger before I have to battle," Flint answers.

"Oh," Tomo replies.

Outside of the gym, James and Meowth are sticking their heads out of the bushes as they see Jessie in some kind of disguise.

"Jessie, are you sure this is going to work?" James asks.

"Yeah. This idea seems sketchy if you ask me, especially since you're using some of James' Pokemon," Mewoth says.

"I don't see what the problem is. This plan is foolproof, while I get them distracted, you can sneak in and take the Pokeballs from the gym, and swipe Pikachu and Eevee from the twerpette," Jessie says.

"We just hope the rest of the twerps won't spot us," James says.

"Or the siblings of the tall twerp," Meowth says.

In the gym, after having lunch, Tomo and the kids are looking with excitement to see the gym fixed up and the large battlefield with a rocky landscape.

"The gym looks great, especially since it's all fixed up," Flint says.

Tomo turns to Mew, "So you really battled Brock here?"

"Sure did. And Brock really put up a great battle," Mew says.

"You did a great job yourself, Mew. You did win after all," Brock says.

"That's true," Mew says.

"Yeah. And it was Poliwhirl who helped you win the match in the end," Misty says.

"I have to agree on that," Forrest says.

Suddenly, the door of the gym opens and someone steps inside. Unknown to the group is Jessie, but she is wearing a white t-shirt with a red vest on, black cargo pants, and red and white sneakers. She is also wearing a green hat backwards and her long hair covered to look like bangs.

"Yo, which one of you is the Pewter City Gym Leader? " Jessie says.

Flint steps forward, "That will be me. So might you be?

"I'm Jess from Viridian City and I'm here to challenge you to a gym battle," Jessie says, using a fake name.

"A gym battle?" Flint replies.

"That's right. I've trained my Pokemon and I want to compete to earn my first Pokemon badge and compete in the Pokemon League," Jessie says with a confident expression.

"Alright," Flint says with a nod.

Tomo says interested, "Wow. Looks like I got to see the battle taking place here after all."

"Yeah. What are the odds," Misty says.

Mew says to herself, "Why does this girl look so familiar?"

Peeking through the window, James and Meowth are watching and see the plan is working.

"That was easy," James says.

"Now comes the hard part, sneaking in, grabbing the Pokeballs, Pikachu, and Eevee," Meowth says.

In the gym, Flint and Jess, A.K.A Jessie are standing at opposite ends of the battlefield. Mew, her friends, Brock and his siblings are watching from the catwalk. Forrest is down below, acting as a referee.

"Alright, today's battle is going to be Flint the Pewter City Gym Leader vs the challenger, Jess of Viridian City. Each trainer can use up to two Pokemon, and the winner will be decided when both Pokemon from either side are unable to begin," Forrest announces.

Flint brings out his Pokeball and calls out, "Alright, go Golem!"

"Go Victreebel!" Jessie calls out.

With that, Golem appears on Flint's side, while Victreebel appears from Jessie's side.

"A Victreebel," Tomo says.

Mew brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Victreebel, the Flycatcher Pokemon and the final evolved form of Bellsprout. A Grass and Poison Type. It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honey-like scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything."

"That trainer sure made a good choice. Grass Pokemon do have the advantage against a Ground and Rock type like Golem," Mew says.

"True, but my dad's Golem is strong, especially from a lot of battles with Grass Type and Water Types," Tommy says.

"Yeah. I'm sure dad can handle it," Brock says.

Jessie makes the forest move, "Victreebel, use Razor Lead!"

Victreebel then performs Razor Leaf and heads towards Golem.

Flint calls out, "Golem, use Harden!"

Golem then performs a Harden that repels the Razor Leaf.

Then Jessie calls out, "Use Vine Whip!"

Victreebel then throws a Vine Whip.

Flint calls out, "Use Rollout!"

Golem then performs Rollout. Then with the Vine Whip, Golem ends up riding on it as a ramp. Then Victreebel flings Golem into the air.

Then Flint calls out, "Use Rock Throw!"

Golem then performs Rock Throw and is able to strike at Victreebel with full force, causing it to be knocked out. However, Victreebel is able to get up.

"Alright, now It's time to be serious," Jessie says, sounding angry.

Then calls out, "Alright Victreebel, use Poison Powder!"

Victreebel then begins to spray Poison Powder across the battlefield.

"Golem, look out," Flint calls out.

Golem quickly dodges out of the Poison Powder's way.

Meanwhile, James and Meowth watch from the window to see Jessie battling against Flint.

Jessie is worried about his Victreebel, "I really hope Jessie doesn't push Victreebel hard."

"While Jessie is battling, we can steal the Pokeballs from the gym," Meowth says.

"Right," Meowth says.

With that, James and Meowth begin to sneak around the gym and soon find a window. James checks and is able to open the window with no trouble. Then, James and Meowth are able to sneak inside the room.

Back in the gym, Jessie is still battling with Flint.

"Victreebel, use Razor Leaf!" Jessie calls out.

Victreebel uses Razor Leaf.

Flint calls out, "Golem, use Stone Edge!"

Golem then slams to the ground and uses Stone Edge. Glowing stones rise from the ground, and are able to knock Victreebel out.

Forrest calls out, "Victrebell is unable to battle."

Jessie growls in frustration and returns it to the Pokeball, "Return."

On the catwalk, Misty says, "That was a rough battle."

"Yeah. Now the other trainer has one more Pokemon," Brock says.

Mew says to the others, "You know, that challenger looks very familiar. Same with the Victreebel."

"How so?" Misty asks.

"I'm not sure, but she looks very familiar, especially with the name," Mew says.

"Now that you mention it. She does look familiar," Tomo agrees.

Just then, Jessie throws her Pokeball and calls out, "Go Lickitung!"

With that, Lickitung comes out of its Pokeball and onto the battlefield.

Flint then calls out, "Golem, use Rollout!"

Golem then performs Rollout.

But Jessie calls out, "Lickitung, give it a big lick!"

Lickitung then lets out it's big toughness and is able to use it's tongue for Golem to get on and tosses it in the air. Then with its tongue, it gives Golem a bit lick. Soon, Golem falls to the ground and is soon knocked out.

"Golem is unable to battle," Forrest calls out.

"That was fast," Misty says.

"That Lickitung has one mean lick," Tomo says.

"Now they both only have one Pokemon left," Yolanda says.

"And I say it's time for dad to use his strong Pokemon for this one," Tommy says.

"Yeah!" Billy and Tilly happily say.

Flint brings out his Pokeball and calls out, "Go Rhydon!"

With that, Rhydon comes out of the Pokeball. Excluding Brock and some of the siblings, everyone else is surprised. Jessie becomes a little shocked and terrified to see this as well. The Rhydon is two times as big as a normal Rhydon.

"Wow! That Rhyon is huge!" Tomo says, surprised.

"It is. I'm not sure how Lickitung is going to handle that," Brock says.

Mew says, "That Likcitung looks familiar too."

Jessie tries to remain calm in her thoughts, "Alright, stay calm. You just have to battle long enough for James and Meowth to steal the Pokeballs."

Meanwhile, James and Meowth are able to sneak into the hall of the gym and find the room where the Pokeballs are. Soon, they are filling up their bags with the Gym's Pokeballs.

"This is too easy," James says, excited.

"Yeah. And soon, we'll have all the Pokemon from this gym," Meowth says.

"And we'll be able to get that Pikachu and the Eevee as well," James says.

Meowth picks the bag up and says, "There. I think that's all of them."

"Let's go," James says.

With that, James and Meowth decide to leave before anyone notices.

Meanwhile at the Battlefield, Jessie calls out, "Lickitung, use your Warp Attack!"

Lickitung then begins to use it's long tongue to wrap around Rhydon by its arms.

"Rhydon, pull it's tongue!" Flint calls out.

Rhydon then pulls Lickitung by the tongue. Lickitung tries to hang on, but is dragged away.

"Use, Horn Attack!" Flint calls out.

Rhydon then strikes Lickitung with the Horn Attack and sends it towards the field.

Then Flint calls out, "Now use Take Down!"

Rhydon then performs Take Down and it sends Lickitung flying towards Jessie. Jessie panics and Lickitung is sent flying towards her. Soon, the Pokemon collides with its trainer, and she is sent flying towards the door.

Outside, James and Meowth are able to reach the front of the gym and still have the bags of Pokeballs in their hands.

"Now, we just need to get Pikachu and Eevee and we'll be out of here," James says.

"We just need to figure out how to get them from the twerpette," Meowth says.

Suddenly, the door flings open with Jessie and Lickitung flying out of them. James and Meowth panic as Jessie and Lickitung crash at them and they all fall to the ground, spilling the Pokeballs.

Just then, the doors open to reveal Mew and her friends, Brock and his family, out.

"There she is," Mew says.

"That Rhydon sure knocked them down," Misty says.

But soon, the group gasps in shock. They see Meowth and James crushed by Jessie that has her hat fallen out and Lickitung. What's more, some of the Pokeballs scattered on the floor.

Dizzy, Jessie sits up and asks, "Did I win the match?"

Mew and her friends asks, shocked.

"It's Jessie from Team Rocket!" Misty exclaims.

"I knew she looked familiar!" Mew declares.

Soon, Meowth and James sit up.

"What just hit us, a comet?" Meowth asks, dizzy.

Dazed James says, "At least we got the Pokeballs from the gym."

"Pokeballs?" Tomo says, confused.

Forrest asks, shocked, "Brock, look there!"

Everyone looks to see the Pokeballs have scattered on the ground from the two large bags.

"Those are the Gym's Pokeballs!" Brock says, shocked.

"So that's what's going on! They were trying to steal the Pokeballs!" Mew says, angrily.

Soon, Team Rocket shakes off to see Mew and her friends and are very displeased. They quickly stand up and begin the motto.

Jessie:

Prepare for trouble!

James:

Make it double!

Soon, Jessie takes off her disguise to reveal herself in her real outfit.

Jessie:

To protect the world from devastation!

James:

To unite all peoples within our nation.

Jessie:

To denounce the evils of truth and love!

James:

To extend our reach to the stars above.

Jessie:

Jessie!

James:

James!

Jessie:

Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light!

James:

Surrender now, or prepare to fight.

Meowth:

Meowth! That's right!

"Team Rocket!" Mew and her friends exclaim.

"So this was a plan to steal the Pokemon from the Pewter Gym!" Mew says.

"That's right, and while I lost the match, we won a bunch of Pokeballs!" Jessie says with pride.

"And we'll get your Pikachu and Eevee soon enough!" James says.

Mew quickly brings out her Pokeball, "We're not going to let you take the Pokeballs."

Then throws it as she calls out, "Meditate!"

With that, both her Pokemon come out of their Pokeballs.

"Meditate, use Psychic!" Mew calls out.

Meditate then uses Psychic to stop Team Rocket in their tracks.

"What's happening?!" Jessie exclaims.

"I can't move!" James panics.

"It's petrifying!" Meowth panics as well.

Meditate then uses its Psychic powers to scoop up the bags and put the Pokeballs in the bags. Then floats them back to Flint and Forrest.

Then Mew calls out, "Alright Pikachu and Eevee, use Thunderbolt!"

Pikachu and Eevee then use Thunderbolt and give Team Rocket a shock, and then they are sent flying as the attack explodes.

Team Rocket screams, "Team Rocket's blasting off again!"

After that, Mew and her friends help Flint, Brock, and the others put the Pokeballs back where they are, and to clean up what mess they made.

"Thanks for stopping Team Rocket, Mew," Brock says.

"It's no problem," Mew says, and puts the Pokeballs back on the shelf.

"Those guys never seem to learn their lesson," Misty says.

"You can say that again," Tomo says.

After finishing putting the Pokeballs back, Mew and her friends are ready to continue their journey.

"It was great you came to visit Brock," Forrest says.

"We hope you'll come back to visit soon," Yolanda says.

Then Billy and Tilly asks, "Pease?"

"I'll be sure to visit them when I'm around. I hope to see you all soon," Brock says.

Then Timmy asks, "So you don't mind leaving some young Pokemon here?"

"I don't mind, you kids can train them with dad," Brock says.

"Thanks Brock," The siblings say.

Soon, Mew and her friends take their leave. Flint and the kids wave and say goodbye as Mew and her friends wave goodbye and leave Pewter City. Now, Mew and her friends continue on their journey to get to Valencia Island and retrieve the mysterious Pokeball for Professor Oak.

Chapter 3: Episode 3: The Monstrous Pokemon of Cerulean Cave

Continuing their journey to Vermilion City to get to Valencia Island, Mew and her friends are heading to Cerulean City. Mew and her friends continue to walk down the trail to get to Cerulean City, and to see the Cerulean Gym.

Mew turns to Misty, "So Misty, are you happy to see your sisters again?"

"Yeah. It's been a while since I was home, and I can check on how my Pokemon are doing," Misty says.

"Well then, it's best we hurry. The sooner we get to the gym, the sooner we can see your sisters and your Pokemon," Mew says.

"Yeah. I like to see the gym again," Tomo says.

Misty turns to Pichu, "So Pichu, are you ready to meet my sisters?"

"Pichu," (Sure am.) Pichu happily says.

Sometime later, Mew and her friends arrive at the city, walk down the street. There, they begin to hear whispers that sound concerning. What's more, the atmosphere seems off to them.

Mew turns to her friends, "Hey guys, is it just me, or are you detecting some uncertainty here."

"You're right. Everyone seems rather on edge," Brock says.

"I wonder what's wrong," Tomo replies.

Mew and her friends continue to walk down the street and look to see many whispers.

Just then, a group of people caught their attention.

A female trainer asks, "Really? Is it really true?"

"I heard from two Pokemon trainers that they've seen a powerful and dangerous Pokemon in the Cerulean Cave," A male trainer says.

Then another male trainer says, "And I heard that it's guarding some treasures in the cave, and any trainer that tries to take the Pokemon attacks them."

Then they hear another group of female trainers, "I heard that it also stopped some poachers who were trying to take the treasure."

"I heard the Pokemon was an escaped lab experiment that went wrong," Another trainer says.

A male trainer says, "I heard the Pokemon is a newly undiscovered Pokemon, and that it's Powerful and dangerous."

As the whispers and rumors continue, Mew and her friends are able to hear it.

"A mysterious and powerful Pokemon?" Mew says, curiously.

"In the Cerulean Caves?" Misty replies.

Tomo asks Misty, "Have you ever heard of it before?"

"No. This is the first I've heard of it," Misty says.

"I wonder what's going on," Brock says.

Mew turns to Misty, "Do you think your sisters' know about this?"

"I'm not sure. We can go to the gym and ask them," Misty says.

Wasting no time, Mew and her friends arrive at the Cerulean Gym, where they are happily greeted by Misty's sisters, Daisy, Violet, and Lily.

They all happily say, "Hi Misty!"

"Hi Daisy. Violet. Lily. How are you doing at the gym?" Misty replies.

"We've been doing great. We've had so many battles and so many water ballets going on lately and all the Pokemon are going spectacular," Daisy says.

Then Violet says, "And Mew, we like to congratulate you on your win at the Pokemon League. You did great."

"And it's great to see you too, Tomo. you too, Brock," Lily says.

"It's great to see you too," Brock says.

"Hi," Tomo says.

Daisy soon notices Pichu, "And who is this sweetie?"

"This is Pichu. I got little Pichu when it was an egg," Misty says.

Violet says, "It's adorable."

"And cute," Daisy says.

Then Lily happily waves to Pichu, "Hi cutie."

"Pichu," (Hello) Pichu happily says.

Just then, Mew asks, "Hey guys, have you heard any uh, stories about a powerful and dangerous Pokemon in the Cerulean Cave."

"So you heard the rumors?" Violet asks.

"We heard about it on the way here," Tomo says.

"And we were wondering if you know anything about it," Brock says.

The three siblings look at each other and nod their heads.

Then Daisy says, "Come inside and we'll explain."

Mew and her friends nod their heads and follow the three inside the gym. In the dining room, Mew and her friends are in the room with Misty's sisters with some tea and snacks for themselves and the Pokemon.

"It happened a few weeks ago. There were these two trainers that decided to explore the cave to find Pokemon to catch," Daisy explains.

Then Violet says, "But they end up meeting monstrous and powerful Pokemon. The trainers tried to catch it, but the Pokemon, like, overpowered them. They weren't badly hurt, but they quickly left the cave before anything else could happen."

"Then two poachers who heard of the Pokemon tried to capture it, but not only were they overpowered, but dropped in front of the police station. They claimed to see the Pokemon and that it had some round shiny orbs in some of the crystallized stalactites," Lily adds.

"It's like, causing a bit of an uproar that a few trainers even tried to capture this Pokemon, but no luck," Daisy says.

"And many of their Pokemon ended up at the Pokemon Center, Violet says.

Mew and the others are surprised to hear it.

"That must have been some strong Pokemon," Misty says.

Tomo asks, "What kind of Pokemon was it?"

"No one knows. Not even the Pokedex can identify it," Daisy says.

"Do you have anything about this Pokemon? The type of moves it uses, or what kind of type of Pokemon it is,." Brock asks.

"Well, they said that the Pokemon used Barrier, Psychic, and Confusion," Lily says.

"That's right. Many suspect it to be a Psychic Type," Violet says.

Mew thinks a bit and says, "Well, if it is a Pokemon, maybe I can talk to it."

Misty turns to Mew in shock "What?! You want to talk to it?!"

"Maybe the Pokemon feels threatened and is scaring everyone away to avoid being captured. If we talk to it, maybe we can figure out why it's here and if it needs help," Mew says.

"I agree," Tomo says.

"And if it is a new type of Pokemon, then it's important that no harm will come to it," Brock says.

Misty sighs, "Alright, we'll go to the cave."

Suddenly, she feels someone tapping on her leg. She looks down to see her Slowpoke.

Misty says, "Hi Slowpoke. How are you doing?"

"Slowpoke," (Doing fine.) Slowpoke answers.

"Slowpoke says he's doing fine," Mew answers.

Then Slowpoke says, "Slowpoke, Slowpoke." (Mind if I come along.)

Then rubs his head. against Misty's leg.

Daisy giggles and says, "Misty, I think Slowpoke wants to come with you."

"You do?" Misty asks, looking at Slowpoke.

"Slowpoke," (I do.) Slowpoke answers with a nod.

Misty smiles and picks up Slowpoke, "Well then, I'm happy you can come along."

"Slowpoke," (Alright.) Slowpoke says, slowly.

Mew giggles, "Well if that's settled, I think it's time we head to Cerulean Cave to find this Mysterious Pokemon."

"You're right. I know how to get to the cave from here," Misty says.

Soon enough, Mew and her friends are heading to Cerulean Cave, following Misty's lead. Not long, they are walking over a bridge and Misty turns to her left. Mew and the others turn their heads to see the entrance to the cave.

"So this is Cerulean Cave?" Tomo asks.

"Yes. The Pokemon must be inside," Misty says.

"Come on, the sooner we find the Pokemon, the better," Mew says.

Mew and the others head towards the cave. They use Squirtle, Staryu, Warturtle to help get across the river and get to the cave's entrance.

"Alright guys, let's go," Mew says.

Everyone nods their heads and begins to enter the cave to find the mysterious Pokemon.

Meanwhile, somewhere far away from the Kanto Region, and somewhere in the cave, someone senses a disturbance.

A familiar male voice says, "There is a strong sense of psychic energy, similar to mind. I must investigate."

The figure opens its eyes to reveal a bright blue glow. With that, it decides to leave in order figure out the source of the strange psychic energy,

Not long, Mew and her friends have entered Cerulean Cave. They walk down the trail to find the mysterious Pokemon in the cave. They soon see glowing light blue stalagmite and stalactites. They also see many different Pokemon in the cave and as long as Mew and the others don't bother them, the Pokemon will leave them alone.

"This place is beautiful," Mew says.

"It sure is. My sisters and I haven't been here for a long time, but it's nice to come back here," Misty says.

"So you've been here before?" Tomo asks.

"Yes. If I remember correctly, we should be coming across a large river," Misty says.

The group looks ahead to see a river up ahead.

"Looks like there is one," Brock says.

"Yes. I have to suspect that the mysterious Pokemon is deep inside the cave. There are different river banks, cavers, and Pokemon, so we'll need to be careful," Misty says.

"Well then, it's time our Pokemon assist us in our search," Mew says.

Then calls out, "Go Squirtle!"

"Go Staryu!" Tomo calls out.

Then Misty calls out, "Tentacruel, I choose you!"

Squirtle, Staryu, and Tentacruel are materialized from the Pokeballs. The group soon travel across the large rivers to reach a different part of the cave. They also had to walk some of the ways, and soon arrive at a large chasm.

Mew calls out Charizard, Aerodactyl, Pidgeot, and Beedrill. Soon, the group rides on the flying Pokemon across the chasm and through the caves. After long travels, they soon come across another part of the river. They release their Water Pokemon again, and ride them deeper into the cave.

After a long journey into the cave, Mew and the others have come across a small rocky island in the middle of a large lake. The island has large rocky stalactites and boulders around it. There are also light blue glowing crystals on a part of the rocky island.

Mew says, "We should stop here. Maybe the mysterious Pokemon is there."

Mew and the others land at the small rocky island and return their Pokemon to their Pokeballs.

"I have to admit, I've never been to this part of the cave," Misty says.

"This place looks cool," Tomo says.

Brock looks around, "I wonder if this Mysterious Pokemon is even here."

"Or the treasure the people in the city are talking about," Mew says.

Pikachu, Eevee, Meloetta, and Skwovet also begin to look around. Meloetta floats a little higher up to search for the crystals. Soon enough, Meloetta finds some of the crystalized stalactites. Meloetta squints her eyes to notice something inside of the Crystal.

Meloetta calls out, "Loetta! Mel Mel Meloetta!" (Tomo! I think I found something!)

Tomo rushes to Meloetta and asks, "What is it?"

"Loetta, Meloetta!" (Look, inside the crystal!) Meloetta says, pointing to the crystal.

Tomo walks to the crystal to notice a glowing object inside of it. The object is a glowing orange color orb with blue, red, and a bit of dark purple inside of it, in a twisting.

"Hey guys, look what Meloetta found!" Tomo calls out.

Everyone, including the Pokemon rush over.

"It's beautiful," Misty says, amazed.

"It's amazing," Mew says.

Brock says, "And looks very familiar."

Mew looks at the orb closely and soon realizes, "It's a Mega Stone!"

Brock says, "You're right, but this one looks different than the ones Mew and Tomo have."

Mew then brings out a book and looks at it's pages.

"What did you get there?" Misty asks.

"It's a small booklet about Mega Evolution by Professor Sycamore in the Kalos Region. He specializes in Mega Evolution, and even has pictures of some of the known Mega Stones," Mew says, looking at the pages of the book.

Then finds it, "Here it is, this one if a Luarionite."

"Lucarionite?" Tomo says, interested.

"It's used to help Lucario Mega Evolve," Mew says.

"It can help Riolu Mega Evolve when it evolves into Lucario," Brock says.

Just then, Pikachu calls out, "Pika pi! Pika Pika Pika!" (Mew! There's another one here!)

Mew rushes to where Pikachu is. She looks inside to see another stone in the crystal. It's a lightish purple with purple, gray, black, and purple on the inside.

Mew looks in the book and says, "This one is an Aerodactylite. It can help my Aerodactyl Mega Evolve."

Then Eevee says, "Eevee Eev!" (Here too!)

Mew looks to see Eevee has found two more in the same crystal. The one on the left is light blue with orange and gray on the inside. The one next to it is a peach color with a bit of a dark pink, light yellow, and light pink on the inside.

Mew looks in the book, "The one in the left is a Swampertite used to help Swampert Mega Evolve, and the other is a Slowbroite for Slowbro's Mega Evolution."

"Really? So Mudkip and Slowpoke can mega evolve when they evolve?" Mist asks, interested.

"Yeah," Mew answers.

Then Brock says, "There are three more in this one?"

Back with Mew and her friends they soon enter Cerulean Cave, and immediately find the treasure, which were mega stones, then take the stones which they believe would be appropriate for the pokemon they have.

They see a grayish and light blue orb with light gray and gray in the middle. Along with a light yellow orb with gray, black, and pal brown on the inside. Lastly, there is a lightish blue gray with grayish black and yellow on the inside of the gem.

Mew looks over and says, "The gray one is an Aggronite. The light yellow is a Kangaskhanite, and the one with black and yellow is a Beedrillite."

"Skwovet Skwovet!" (There are four more here!) Skwovet calls out.

Mew then looks at where Tomo and Skwovet are. There is a bluish green color orb with green, light pink, and a little darker pink on the inside. The one next to it, is light ivory or gray color with blue, brown and light blue on the inside. The third one is bright yellow along with blue, red, and a little bit of purple on the inside. The last one white with light yellow along with light brown, and peach color.

Mew says, "This is a Venusaurite, Blastoisinite, an Alakazite, and a Gyaradosite. They can help Venusaur, Blastoise, Gyarados, and Alakazam Mega Evolve."

"Wow. So some of our Pokemon can Mega Evolve using the stones," Tomo says.

"It's amazing," Misty says, interested.

"Togeprii!" (Amazing!) Togepi happily says.

"Pichu Pichu!" (Really amazing!) Pichu happily says.

Soon, the group gathers together to talk about the treasures that they're able to find.

Brock says, "So the treasure that everyone has been talking about are…"

"Right. They're Mega Stones," Mew says.

"But where is the Mysterious Pokemon? The one that's supposed to be guarding the treasures," Misty wonders.

"Yeah. There's supposed to be a mysterious Pokemon but we don't see any," Tomo says.

Misty looks around, "There doesn't seem to be anyone here."

As Mew and the others begin to wonder about the mysterious Pokemon. Something begins to approach from behind. Just then, Pikachu and Eevee's ears begin moving to sense something is sneaking behind him. The two Pokemon turn around and are surprised to see what's behind them.

Mew asks, "What is it, Pikachu? Eevee?"

"Pika Pika!" (Look there!) Pikachu calls out.

Mew and the others look behind them and are surprised to see a familiar Pokemon that is floating towards them with glowing purple color eyes.

"I… I don't believe it," Brock says, shocked.

"This is shocking," Misty says.

"It's…" Tomo says.

"Mewtwo…" Mew says, surprised.

Mew and the others are shocked to see Mewtwo floating towards them.

Misty turns to Brock, "Wow. I never thought we would see Mewtwo here."

"I wonder if Mewtwo is the mysterious Pokemon that everyone is talking about," Brock says.

Then Tomo asks, "But what is Mewtwo doing here? And where are the Clone Pokemon?"

Mew listens to the group and is just as curious as they are.

Mew turns to Metwo and asks, "Um hi, Mewtwo... What are you doing here?"

Mewtwo doesn't say a word to them. Then gives them a glare with glowing purple eyes, causing the group to flinch in fear.

"I don't think Mewtwo is glad about us being here," Brock says.

Just then, Mewtwo raises its hand and creates a Shadow Ball.

"Look out!" Mew calls out.

Then Mewtwo throws the Shadow Ball at them. Mew and the others quickly move out of the way as the attack flies past them and it hits the water.

"That was close," Tomo says.

Misty panics, "Here it comes again!"

Everyone begins to run away as Mewtwo begins to throw multiple Shadow Balls at them. Mew and the others run in different directions as the powerful Pokemon continues to attack them. Luckily, they are able to find different hiding spots behind the large boulders on the island.

Misty screams, "Why is Mewtwo attacking us?!"

"I don't know, but there's something strange about it," Brock says.

"I think Brock's right. Does this Mewtwo look kind of… smaller?" Mew questions.

Tomo looks to see the Pokemon. Then Mewtwo begins to throw a Swift Attack at them.

"I think you're right. That Mewtwo looks kind of smaller than the one at New Island," Tomo says.

"But there can't be another Mewtwo! The Mewtwo we knew left from New Island months ago and we haven't seen it since!" Misty cries out.

Then ducks as a Shadow Ball flies over the large boulder she is hiding.

"I don't know, but we have to do something before Mewtwo crushes us!" Mew says.

"You're not thinking about battling it?!" Misty exclaims.

"We don't have much of a choice," Mew says.

Then tell the others, "While I distract it, you three get the Water Pokemon and make a run for it."

Then turns to Pikachu and Eevee, "Let's go!"

"Pika! Eev!" (Right!) Pikachu and Eevee say.

Mew hurries out with Pikachu and Eevee close behind.

Misty exclaims, "MEW! ARE YOU CRAZY?!"

Mew then comes out and sees Mewtwo.

"Alright Pikachu. Eevee. Let's do this," Mew says.

Pikachu and Eevee agree and get in front of Mew to battle. Mewtwo then begins to throw a Shadow Ball at them.

Mew calls out, "Eevee, use Protect!"

Eevee then uses Protect to repel the Shadow Ball.

"Alright Pikachu, use Thunderbolt!" Mew calls out.

Pikachu quickly gets in front and performs a Thunderbolt. Just then, Mewtwo performs a Barrier around itself, and has the Thunderbolt bounce back at them.

"Get down!" Mew calls out, and drops to the ground.

Eevee and Pikachu do the same as the Thunderbolt flies past over them and hits the ground close to where the others hide. Misty and the others quickly hide from behind the large boulders. Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee quickly get up to see Mewtwo is now performing Swift Attack.

Mew calls out, "Pikachu. Eevee. Dodge by using Quick Attack!"

Pikachu and Eevee quickly use Quick Attack and dodge the Swift Attack. Soon, they both charge at Mewtwo.

Then Mew calls out, "Now, Double Iron Tail!"

With that, Pikachu and Eevee jump in the air and perform Iron Tail and attempt to strike at Mewtwo at the same time. Just then, Mewtwo performs Psychic that stops them in their tracks. Then uses it's psychic powers to throw Pikachu and Eevee. Mew quickly jumps and catches them both.

Mew looks down and asks, "Are you both okay?"

Pikachu and Eevee nod their heads in reply. They soon look ahead and notice Mwtwo is about to use its next move. It begins to use it's Psybeam attack at Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee with full force.

Brock and Tomo exclaim, "MEW!"

"WATCH OUT!" Misty cries out.

Mew quickly turns around holding Pikachu and Eevee in her arms to take on the attack to protect them. Just then, something flies through the cave towards where Mew is and ends up using a Barrier to protect them. Misty and the others become shocked to see who has protected them. Mew continues to hold Pikachu and Eevee, waiting for an attack that has never come. Mew lossens the embrace as she and her Pokemon look at each other. They soon turn to see someone very familiar.

What she sees is Mewtwo that has a Barrier up and prevents the blast of the Psybeam. She soon looks to notice the Mewtwo that has attacked them, the smaller version.

Just then, the Mewtwo that has protected Mew turns to see her and says, "Are you alright, Mew?"

"Mewtwo…" Mew says, rather shocked.

She then slowly answers, "I'm… okay… but how… how there can there be a…"

"Another one of my kind" Mewtwo confirms.

Mew slowly nods her head in reply.

"Mew!" Misty calls out.

Mew turns to see Misty and the others hurrying to her.

"Are you okay?" Tomo asks.

"We're okay, and rather…" Mew says, and turns to the Mewtwo in front of her, "Surprised."

Mewtwo turns to see Mew's friends and says, "I didn't expect to meet you again here of all places."

"But, if you're the Mewtwo we met on New Island…" Misty says, shocked.

Then Brock looks at the other Mewtwo, "Then where did this Mewtwo come from?"

Mewtwo says, "I'll explain to you all, after we dealt with him." Then turns to the Guardian Mewtwo.

Just then, the Guardian Mewtwo begins to glow, catching their attention. Soon, when the flash disappears, it's shape has completely changed. The Guardian Mewtwo is smaller and lighter, losing its long tail and the tube behind its neck. However, it grows a long, purple appendage with a curled tip from the back of its head that is similar to its previous form's tail. On its head, it has two pointed, backward-curving spikes and a half-ring structure connecting to the base of each and crossing over the top of its head. Its eyes are now red and slightly larger. The digits on its hands and feet are now purple and more bulbous and the middle toe is longer than the others. A bumpy ridge similar to a sternum replaces the breastplate structure on its chest, but this form is still largely smoother than the other two.

This shocked Mew and her friends.

"What is that?" Tomo asks, shocked.

"Did that Mewtwo just Mega Evolved?" Mew wonders.

"I think we're in big trouble," Misty says, worried.

"It looks like we have no choice, but to battle it," Mew says.

Then Misty says holding her Pokeball, "And we'll help you."

"That's right. We can't let you do this on your own," Brock says.

Then Tomo says, "We'll help you too."

"Loetta!" (We'll help, too!) Meloetta says.

Mew smiles and nods her head, "Then let's do this."

Mewtwo just then uses it's Psychic abilities to free all the Mega Stones from the cave. Then levitates the Stones to Mew and her friends. Mew is given a Beedrillite, Aerodactylite, Gyaradosite, Blastoisinite, and Venusaurite. Brock is given an Aggronite. Misty has the Swampertite and Slowbronite. Finally, Tomo takes the Kangaskhanite, Lucarionite and Alakazite.

Mewtwo turns to Mew and Tomo, "I suspect you two have Pokemon that can Mega Evolve with those Stones. I Believe we can use them to even the odds."

Mew nods her head, "Right."

Then calls out, "Aerodactyl! Charizard! Pidgeot! Beedrill! Gyarados! Gengar! Come on out!"

Then Tomo calls out, "Go, Mama Kangaskhan!

"Tentacruel! Golduck! Staryu! Jigglypuff! I choose you!" Misty calls out.

Then Brock calls out, "Onix! Machoke! Vulpix! Go!"

With that, all of Mew and her friend's Pokemon come out to battle. Mew then takes out her Key Stone along with the Mega Stones for Pidgeot and Gengar and Mewtwo levitates the Mega Stones to the Pokemon that are out, and is able to use them. Each of them have a Mega Stone levitating to them.

Mew then calls out, "Alright everyone, it's time to go beyond Evolution!"

Then touches her Key Stone as it glows. The Mega Stones soon glow as each Pokemon takes the position of one.

Then calls out, "Mega Evolve! With that, all of her Pokemon out begin to Mega Evolve.

With that, Charizard and the other Pokemon Begin to Mega evolve. The Guardian Mewtwo of the cave watches to see all the Pokemon begin to Mega Evolve.
