Chapter 4: Episode 4: Cerulean Cave's Mega Evolution Battle

While arriving at Cerulean City, Mew and her friends have heard about a mysteriously strong Pokemon in Cerulean Cave, even from Misty's sisters. With that, they decide to investigate. After traveling deep in the cave, they find that the treasures are Mega Stones. Then, they end up meeting a Mewtwo that ends up attacking them. Before the Mewtwo can attack them, they end up meeting the Mewtwo they knew from New Island. With Mewtwo's help, Mew has the Mega Stones and is able to use them to help her Pokemon begin to Mega Evolve.

Now in the cave, Mew calls out, "Mega Evolve!"

Soon, Charizard is the first to Mega Evolve and transform to a new form. Soon, all of Mew's other Pokemon begin to Mega Evolve too.

When Aerodactyl Mega Evolves, its eyes turn green and its body begins to turn to stone, which some researchers believe was its original appearance before fossilization. It grows larger and sprouts jagged black spikes all over its body: five spikes at the wrist joint of each wing replacing its hands, three small spikes along its tail, one spike on each ear, and a long spike on its chin. The spike on its back and its rear talons have also become black and stony. Rocky plates cover its eyebrows and the corners of its jaw. Similar stone ornaments are present on its chest on its torso: two small ridges flanking a longer ridge.

Next Beedrill gains more defined features. The antennae are shorter and T-shaped. Its eyes become longer and sleeker. It now has three pairs of wings; the uppermost pair is larger with a black trim along the top. Its stingers become longer and larger, resembling lances. Additional conical, black-and-yellow stingers with white tips take the place of its legs. Its abdomen becomes larger, grooved and is attached to its thorax by a black structure. A similar black structure connects its head and thorax. The stinger on its abdomen is now a pale yellow, and it now has black stripes over its entire body.

Then Gengar. Now a portion of its body sinks into the ground and its arms and tail lengthen. The lower portions turn a more reddish-purple, and a third eye appears on its forehead. This new unblinking eye is oval, yellow, and allows it to see into other dimensions.[2] The spikes on Mega Gengar's back are more numerous and pointed, and additional spikes appear on its hands and tail. Its ears are now considerably longer and tilt backward.

Next is Gyarados, it becomes bulkier. The fins on its cheeks become longer and gain a yellow tint. Its crest is larger and black, and its barbels also gain considerable length. A large spike extends downward underneath its chin, and it now has a black underside with a red stripe around the edges. The yellow spots along its body are replaced by raised red scales. Two large yellow fins with blue spines appear on its back. Most of the other fins along its back disappear, replaced by two rows of blue spikes. There are now four yellowish, spiky fins near its tail: two on its back and two on its underside.

And finally Pidgeot, it develops a larger body and longer, broader wings. Its wingtips and tail feathers are tipped with cyan, and its cream coloring is now white. Its eyes turn magenta and its pupils turn white. Mega Pidgeot has an even more elaborate crest on its head, with a streamer-like magenta plume extending from a mane of yellow feathers. A magenta feather projects from the front of its crest and there is a single magenta highlight on the left side.

Soon, all of Mew's Pokemon she has out have Mega Evolved. Misty and the others are amazed.

"So cool!" Tomo shouts excitedly.

"All of Mew's Pokemon Mega Evolved," Misty says, astonished.

"I'm not too surprised. After all, Mew has strong bonds with her Pokemon, so I wouldn't be surprised if she's able to help them reach new heights," Brock says.

Mew calls out, "Alright everyone, the only way we're going to defeat Mewtwo is if we work together."

"You got it, sis," Tomo says.

Just then, the Guardian Mewtwo begins to use Psybeam.

"Everyone, dodge!" Mew calls out.

With that, the Pokemon including Mew and her friends move out of the way as the Guardian Mewtwo is using an even powerful Psybeam to attack them.

Then Mew calls out, Charizard, use Air Slash! Gyarados, use Water Pulse!"

Both Mega Charizard and Mega Gyarados perform their attacks. The Mega Guardian Mewtwo quickly dodges and uses Agility Attack to dodge away from the attack.

Misty calls out, "Tenacruel, Goldduck, use Hydro Pump! Staryu, use Water Gun!"

Tentacruel and Golduck perform Hydro Pump and Staryu uses Water Gun.

The Mega Guardian Mewtwo uses a Barrier to protect itself. Then, it bounces the attack at Misty's Pokemon, sending them crashing to the ground. Knocking them out instantly.

Misty calls out, "Tentacruel, Golduck, Staryu, return now!"

Then returns them to their Pokeballs.

Then Brock calls out, "Onix, use Rock Slide!"

Onix then performs Rock Slide and is able to strike at Mewtwo, which causes a bit of damage.

Then Mew calls out, "Pidgeot, use Aerial Ace!"

Soon Pidgeot uses Aerial Ace and strikes at Mewtwo, causing it a lot of damage. Suddenly, Guardian Mewtwo then heals itself and is back to perfect health.

Brock notices, "It used Recover!"

"Didn't know it can use that attack," Mew says.

Then Brock calls out, "Vulpix, use Fire Spin! Machoke, use Vacuum Wave!"

Vupix then takes a deep breath and performs Fire Spin while Machoke uses Vacuum Wave. Mega Guardian Mew Two then flies in the air, and is able to use Swift Attack to counter the Fire Spin Attack.

Misty calls out, "Jigglypuff, use Hyper Voice!"

"Mama Kangaskhan, use Hyper Beam!" Tomo calls out.

"Gengar, use Dark Pulse! Aerodactyl, Wing Attack!" Mew calls out.

Mega Gengar performs Dark Pulse while Mega Aerodactyl uses Wing Attack. Mama Kangaskhan performs Hyper Beam and Jigglypuff uses Hyper Voice. All the attacks fly towards the Guardian Mega Mewtwo, but the Mewtwo quickly uses its Psychic to dodge and even repel the attacks. Then it strikes at Jigglypuff, Onix, Vulpix, and Machoke with it's Psybeam Attack. And all of them are knocked out.

Brock calls them back into their Pokeballs, "Return."

"Return Jigglypuff!" Misty calls it back into the Pokeball.

Misty turns to see the Mega Evolved Pokemon, "That Mewtwo is strong."

"It may be strong, but we don't plan on giving up," Mew says.

Then calls out, "Gyarados, use Water Pulse! Pidgeot, use Gust Attack!"

Mega Gyarados and Mega Pidgeot then perform their attacks. Guardian Mewtwo flies out of the way.

But then Mewtwo uses Shadow Ball at the Guardian as it tries to dodge, and pushes it back to the ground. Guardian Mewtwo struggles to get up.

Mew brings out her Pokeball, "Let's see if this is enough!"

"Go Pokeball!" Then throws her Pokeball at the Guardian Mewtwo.

Guardian Mewtwo is pulled inside. The Pokeball shakes at least twice, but then the Pokeball bursts out, shattering and Guardian Mewtwo is free again.

"Looks like Mewtwo is still strong enough to fight," Tomo says.

"Then we'll have to battle it more," Mew says.

Then calls out, "Charizard, use Fire Blast!"

Charizard then flaunches a Fire Blast as Mewtwo also uses Psybeam at the Guardian Mega Mewtwo. Both of the attacks are able to strike at the Guardian Mewtwo.

"Gengar, use Dark Pulse!" Mew calls out.

Then Tomo calls out, "Mama Kangaskhan, use Last Resort!"

Mega Gengar uses Dark Pulse and Kangaskhan uses Last Resort and are able to strike at the Mega Guardian Mewtwo. The Mega Mewtwo then uses Recover again, and heals itself.

Then Mew calls out, "Gyarados, use Hurricane!"

Mega Gyarados then performs Hurricane with full force and is able to Strike at the Mega Guardian Mewtwo.

"Beedrill, use Poison Jab!" Mew calls out.

Beedrill speeds fast and is able to strike at Poison Jab at the Mega evolved Mewtwo. Just then, the Mega Mewtwo uses Swift on them. Mewtwo then uses Barrier to block the attack.

Then Mew calls out, "Charizard, use Swift as well!"

Mega Charizard then performs Swift as well. Mega Guardian Mewtwo quickly uses Agility to dodge the attack.

Then Mew calls out, "Pidgeot, use Air Slash!"

Mega Pidgeot then performs Air Slash that is able to strike at Mega Guardian Mewtwo with full force.

Then Mew calls out, "Charizard, use Slash!"

Mega Charizard then performs Slash at Mega Guardian Mewtwo.

Mewtwo then turns to Mew and says, "Mew, allow me to finish this."

"You go for it!" Mew says.

Then calls out, "Charixard, dodge, Mewtwo is coming your way!"

Hearing his trainer, Mega Charizard then moves out of the way. Then Mewtwo speeds to the Guardian Mega Mewtwo and is able to perform a strong Psychic Attack. That pushes the Guardian Mewtwo back and it slams to one of the large boulders hard.

"Wow. that's a powerful attack," Misty says.

"Yeah. That was PsyStrike," Brock says.

"Now that's an attack," Tomo says.

The group looks to see Mega Guardian Mewtwo revert back to its normal state. The Mewtwo is on the verge of collapsing and isn't able to stand any longer.

Mew quickly brings out her Pokeball, "It's now or never!"

Then throws her Pokeball, "Go Pokeball!"

The Pokeball spins and flies towards the Guardian Mewtwo. Then the Pokeball taps it on the head, and is pulled into the Pokeball. Mew and her friends watch patiently to see the Pokeball shake as the button on the Pokeball beeps and flickers red. Soon, it stops. But then, it begins to move and flicker again some more. Finally, it comes to a stop, the blinker stops, and the Pokeball lets out a click.

Everyone sighs in relief.

"Alright sis, you caught Mewtwo!" Tomo cheers.

"Well, the newer Mewtwo anyway," Misty says.

Mew walks over and picks up the Pokeball. She looks to see the Pokeball that Mewtwo is now inside.

"That was really close, but at least we were able to catch it," Mew says.

Soon, all of Mew's Pokemon are able to revert back to their original forms and the Mega Stones, excluding Charizard's have been levitated by the original Mewtwo's powers and levitated to Mew for her to take in her other hand.

Mew turns to Mewtwo, "Thank goodness that you were able to help us Mewtwo."

"Yeah. It was really close. You really helped us out of that mess," Misty says.

Then Brock asks, "But what are you doing here?"

"Yeah. We don't know where you went after you left New Island," Tomo says.

"I've sensed a familiar psychic energy coming from the cave and decided to find the source. Little did I suspect that I'm not the only artificial Pokemon after all," Mewtwo says.

Then turns to Mew, "And never expected to find you all here."

"We kind of heard about the mysterious Pokemon guarding some treasure and decided to see what it is. We didn't expect to find another one like you over here," Mew says.

"And that Mewtwo acted kind of aggressive as you did, in a way," Misty says, nervously.

Brock then says, "Still, I wonder where that other Mewtwo came from. I didn't remember seeing it on New Island."

"I have to believe that whoever created him might have created another version of me in case I didn't make it," Mewtwo says.

"So it's like a backup copy," Misty says.

"Probably. I might have to assume that when I was with Giovanni for my 'training,' this Mewtwo might have been asleep from all this. It might have woken up, escaped, and decided to take refuge in the caves," Mewtwo says.

"And it must have remained in the cave and scared anyone who tries to come here," Brock suspects.

"It sounds kind of lonely," Misty says.

"That kind of possibility can't be ruled out," Mew says.

She then looks at the Pokeball, "Maybe he can tell us the answer."

Misty becomes worried, "Uh, are you really going to let it out?"

"Don't worry, maybe Mewtwo can help calm it down," Mew says.

Mew then turns to Mewtwo and nods his head in reply.

"Alright Mewtwo, time to come out," Mew says, and opens the Pokeball.

With that, the younger Mewtwo is able to stand and shakes his head in reply. The younger Mewtwo then looks around to notice the original Mewtwo, Mew and her friends, including the Pokemon, are looking at it with confused looks. The younger Mewtwo quickly gets back and about to use a Shadow Ball.

But the original Mewtwo says, "Enough of this senseless fighting. You must still be worn out from the battle."

The younger Mewtwo looks at the original one to see that its words are true. Finally, the younger Mewtwo cancels the Shadow Ball and calms down, much to the other's relief.

Mew walks over and asks, "So how are you feeling? Are you feeling okay?"

The younger Mewtwo turns his head a little.

"Where did you come from? How did you get here?" Mew questions.

The younger Mewtwo looks at Mew and senses something, honest in her eyes.

Finally, the younger Mewtwo answers, "I… I came from somewhere, far away."

This makes the group a little surprised.

"So it can talk," Misty says.

Then Brock says, "It's telepathy."

It's a good start. I'm glad that we can talk without any more confrontations," Mew says.

Then asks, "So where are you from?"

"I'm… I'm not entirely sure. I came from somewhere, far away. I've sent most of my life asleep. Hearing voices. Saying that I'm like a backup in case the other didn't make it. Said that the experiments have failed multiple times, and so far one of them still survived, and so have I. The voices continue that if things went well, I would have also lived and would have been considered a 'younger sibling' of the first one," The Younger Mewtwo says.

"Younger sibling?" Tomo says, confused.

"In other words, if this Mewtwo survived with the other one, they'll be considered siblings," Brock says.

Mew happily says, "More like brothers. He sounds like a boy too, and he looks exactly like him, except a little younger."

"So then, how did he end up in Cerulean Cave?" Misty wonders.

Mew turns to the younger Mewtwo, "So how did you?"

"It was sometime ago. I woke up due to a strong Psychic energy, and heard screams, panicking, all sorts of noise. Then, a man who was badly injured reached me, and saw I was awake. He then said that they wanted to create the strongest Pokemon… and they succeeded. And now, we ended up with two. He then pressed the buttons and I was let free," Mewtwo explains.

He then says, "For his final word, he told me to leave, live my own life, leave before it's too late. And before he left, he gave me this strange stone."

"A stone?" Misty says, curious.

The Younger Mewtwo shows the other the stone. It's glowing, and round. It's light gray with different shades of purple in it.

"It's a Mega Stone," Brock says.

"So that's how you Mega Evolved," Mew says.

"Yes. He said that he had two of them made. He gave this one to me. He calls it a Mewtwonite Y," Younger Mewtwo says, looking at the stone

Then explains, "And that's what I did. I left and traveled around to see so many things I never experienced, but was… scared… Then I found this cave and made it my home. These stones have always been here for as long as I remember. I was living peacefully, until humans showed up and tried to battle me. I defeat them of course. And more came and I defeated them all."

Hearing it, Mew and the others are starting to understand the situation.

"So that's what happened," The Original Mewtwo says.

"You know something about it?" Tomo asks.

"Yes. This Mewtwo was to act as a backup in case I didn't survive. When I destroyed the lab, the scientist who was in charge of my creation must have sent him free, and he found his way to the cave until humans found him," The Original Mewtwo explains.

"That makes sense, but now what?" Misty asks.

Mew walks to the younger Mewtwo and asks, "Mewtwo, what do you wanna do? I know that I caught you, but I want you to make your own choice. I want you to choose the life that you want. You can either stay with me and my friends and we can travel. You can also be with your brother and go to where he and the other Clone Pokemon live. Or… you can live your own life and make new friends and adventure. Either way, I want you to have a choice on how you want to live your life." then has the Pokeball out to it.

The Younger Mewtwo begins to think for a bit, and looks at Mew, her friends, the original Mewtwo, and thinks some more. The Younger Mewtwo thinks a bit more and has made his decision. The younger Mewtwo approaches Mew, taps on the Pokeball, and goes inside with no problem.

Mew calmly smiles and looks at the Pokeball, "I guess this is your choice."

Then the Pokeball nods its head in reply.

"Looks like Mewtwo is going to be part of the group for now on," Misty says.

"Yeah. We got a new friend," Tomo happily says.

Just then, the original Mewtwo turns to Mew and says, "Well then, I have no doubt that you will take better care of my younger brother. I know you will not make the same mistake the man did."

Then turns away and says in thought, "The man I thought was my partner."

"Don't worry, I'll take good care of him. Do you think we'll see you again?" Mew replies.

"Maybe someday, our paths will cross again," Mewtwo says.

He then presents something to Mew and gives it to her. Mew looks at her hand to see the stone is another Mega Stone. It has a light gray with a pale purple and a blue color.

"It's a Mega Stone," Mew says, surprised.

"Indeed. It's called a Mewtwonite X. Giovanni gave it to me for another part of my training, to use Mega Evolution. It might be useful on your journey," Mewtwo says.

"Thanks Mewtwo," Mew says.

Mewtwo then uses its Psychic energy to fly in the air.

Mew calls out, "Don't worry, I'll take good care of him."

Misty waves, "Bye."

"Hope to see you again!" Tomo calls out.

"See you around!" Brock says.

The Pokemon waves goodbye as well. Mewtwo simply nods his head and flies out of the opening in the cave and leaves to where all the Clone Pokemon are. Mew and the others begin to wonder if they'll meet him again.

After that, Mew and her friends leave Cerulean Cave and find themselves in the bright sun. It's a long journey to leave the cave, but they are out now, and are going to continue their journey. On the outskirts of Cerulean City, Mew and her friends meet up with Misty's sisters to say their goodbyes.

"So you were able to figure out the mysterious Pokemon?" Daisy asks.

"And you caught it?" Violet asks, surprised.

"Yeah. We decided to stay with me for now on. I hope I'll be able to take care of him," Mew says, looking at her Pokeball.

"And I'm sure it will be in good care," Brock says.

Then Misty turns to her sisters, "We're going to get going, but maybe we'll see each other sometimes."

"Kay," the three sisters answer.

Soon, Mew and her friends begin to head off on their journey as they say and wave goodbye to Misty's sisters. Misty's sister send their farewells as well. At the end of their adventure of Cerulean Cave, they end up with a new friend and gain Mega Stones. Now, they're continuing their Pokemon Journey to Valencia Island.

Chapter 5: Episode 5: A Scare in the Air

Mew and her friends have reached Vermilion City, and are soon going to make their way to Valencia Island to meet Professor Ivy. First, they decide to go to a Poke Mart because they're a little low on supplies, and to have snacks for the trip. They're able to find the stuff they need and leave the store.

Mew wonders, "Do you think we got everything?"

"I'm sure we did. We got a few extra proteins, and first aid, and we got some snacks," Misty says.

"Yep. That's about it. Now we just need to find the blimp that will get us to Valencia Island," Brock says.

Tomo then says, "I still wonder what's so special about this Mysterious Pokeball."

"Well, we won't know until we get there," Mew says.

"You're right," Tomo says.

Suddenly, they hear someone shout, "And we have another big winner!"

The group turns their heads to notice two men with a table and they're doing a raffle drawing, and are handing someone their prize.

One of them calls out, "Congratulations, ma'am!

The second vendor says, "Here's a set of beautiful refrigerator magnets."

Then the first one says, "Just bring your register receipt and take a chance!"

"You could win our grand prize blimp trip to beautiful Valencia Island! Hurry, hurry!" The second vendor happily says.

"Did he say blimp?" Brock asks, interested.

"A raffle drawing?" Tomo adds.

"And the grand prize is a trip to Valencia Island," Misty adds.

"Maybe we should try? Who knows, we might actually win," Mew says.

"You really don't think you're gonna win that free trip, do you?" Misty asks.

"Maybe I will, maybe I won't. I won't know until I give it a chance," Mew says.

Misty thinks a bit and says, "I guess you're right. It wouldn't hurt to try, and you might win something too. And if you're really lucky, we can get a free trip to Valencia Island."

Mew walks over and asks, "Excuse me sirs, can I give it a try?"

"Sure miss, just show us your receipt and take a spin," The vendor says.

Mew does just that and is given a chance to play. Mew spins the wheel and then spins it again. Soon, a bright yellow ball comes out.

Just then, one of the vendors rings the bell and calls out, "She won!"

"It's our grand prize round trip blimp flight to Valencia Island for a party for free!" The other calls out.

Just then, Misty and Brock fall over in surprise and disbelief.

Mew giggles and says, "Well, I guess that's just how the Golem rolls."

"Pikachu," (I guess so.) Pikachu says.

"Eevee Eevee," (At least we can get to Valencia Island faster,) Eevee says.

Meanwhile, somewhere in the woods, Team Rocket: Jessie, James, and Meowth are setting some kind of device up as Mewoth sings a song. Just then, they receive a call from

Meowth asks, "Did you call us, sir?"

The boss answers, "Meowth, Jessie, and James. Effective immediately, you three are being transferred to Team Rocket's Dirigible Division."

"The Blimp Brigade?" James and Jessie say, confused.

"Really?" Meowth asks.

"The Blimp Brigade, as you put it, serves a unique and important purpose in our organization. Only special operatives are chosen for this duty," Giovanni answers.

Soon, Team Rocket are in tears.

"Oh, boss," James says, happily.

"You have no idea how honored we are!" Jessie says.

Remember," Giovanni says, and pets his Persian, "I'm counting on you. Don't let me down."

Soon, the call ends, and Team Rocket are still in tears.

"Thank you!" Jessie happily says.

"What a tremendous honor!" James says.

Meowth wipes the tears from his eyes, "The boss really likes us after all!"

Then Jessie says determinedly, "Alright! Let's show the boss that we're as valuable as he thinks we are!"

"Right!" The boys agree.

Back in Team Rocket Headquarters, Giovanni says, "The only duty those three simpletons are fit for is the Blunder Brigade. I haven't had any repairs done to those old blimps for decades. They're completely unfit to fly. About the only thing I have maintained on those blimps are their insurance policies." He lets out a chuckle as his Persian meows.

Meanwhile, Mew and her friends have arrived at the airfield just outside of Vermilion City. Soon enough, they also see the blimp, and they are surprised.

"I never saw a blimp this close," Mew says, a little surprised.

Then Brock says, "It's bigger than I thought it'd be!"

"It looks kinda old and beat up. You think it's okay to fly?" Misty says.

"I'm not sure. But you're right. It does look rather old and such," Mew says.

"Do you think it's the blimp that can take us to the island?" Tomo asks.

Just then, two of the airfield employees show up and walk to Mew and the others.

The first employee asks, "You're not here for a blimp ride, are you?"

"Um we are. We won round-trip tickets to Valencia Island on the blimp," Mew answers.

The employees look very shocked.

One employee says, "You kids are brave!"

The other asks, "How much you getting paid?"

"Getting paid?" Brock says, confused.

"What do you mean?" Mew asks.

"Yeah. What are you two talking about?" Tomo adds.

Then Misty asks, "Is there something about that blimp we oughta know?"

The two employees look at each other and decide to tell them.

The employee with the blue hat says, "Look. That blimp's so dangerous everybody says it's haunted by a gang of ghosts. I wouldn't fly on that thing if you paid me a million bucks."

The group of friends become very uneasy about going on the blimp.

Suddenly, two familiar figures come up, "Attention, please!"

They surprise the gang as the two people that look like flight attendants push the employees out of the way.

The man says, "Please have your tickets ready!"

"Passengers may now begin boarding," The woman says.

"Uh, but what about the ghosts?" Mew asks.

"What ghosts, mam?" The man asks.

"Those guys told us that a whole bunch of ghosts live in there," Mist answers.

"Oh, they must've been from a rival blimp line," The man says, and pushes Mew and Tomo to the blimp, "Come on, now. It's boarding time!"

Then the woman does the same with Misty and Brock, "Please have your carry-on luggage ready for inspection."

The gang are being pushed to the blimp as Meowth stands behind a building nearby. As it turns out, the two flight attendants are Jessie and James in disguise. In other words, this is another Team Rocket trap.

"The boss must've put us on this detail cause he knew those kids were coming out here to take a blimp ride. Heh! We'll really take them for a ride," Mewoth says with a grin.

Soon enough, Jessie and James, the disguised flight attendants, are pushing the group into the blimps, and or walking up the stairs.

"Right this way, watch your step," James says,

"But, don't you want to see our tickets?" Mew asks.

"Don't worry, we're upgrading you to first class, anyway," James says.

"Get set for takeoff, everyone!" Jessie says.

Then the hatch to the blimp closes.

Just then, two Pokemon begin to run towards where the Blimp are and are playing.

One of them is a cream-colored bipedal Pokémon with red markings. It has a dot-like nose, and a cream-colored plus sign in the middle of its circular red cheeks. It has long, flat ears that are mostly red. Its limbs are stubby and digitless, and it has red front paws. Its short tail is tipped with a red plus sign.

The other is also a cream-colored bipedal Pokémon but with blue markings. It has a dot-like nose, and a cream-colored minus sign in the middle of its circular blue cheeks. It has long, flat ears that are mostly blue. Its limbs are stubby and digitless, and it has blue front paws. Its short tail is tipped with a blue minus sign.

They are running and playing with smiles on their faces, Until the Pokemon with the red marking accidentally pushes at the switch, letting out some water, and both of them get soaked. Soon, the blimp begins to take off. Before the two Pokemon can do anything, their feet get tangled in the rope and are getting carried away as the blimp takes off.

Inside the Blimp, Mew and her friends reach the dining room and so far, the place actually looks well, worse for wear on the inside.

"Hey! I thought they said this was first class!" Mew says, surprised by the condition of the room.

"This looks like last class to me!" Misty says.

Suddenly, everyone begins to hear creaking.

"Did anyone else hear that?" Tomo asks.

"You're right, it looks like the floor is gonna colla…" Mew states, but the floor collapses from under her and finds her legs dangling on the underside of the blimp.

Mew screams, "Hey! Why's the blimp flying over the ocean?!"

Then looks up, "You gotta help me up.

Misty calls out, "Mew, grab my hand!"

"We gotcha!" Brock says.

Mew takes Brock and Misty's hand, and they both pull to help get Mew out of the hole.

Mew heavily breathes, "Thanks for saving me, guys."

"That was a close one," Brock says.

"I think going on this blimp was a bad idea," Tomo says.

Just then, Jessie walks in and says, "I see you're all relaxing."

"Buzz off!" Misty screams.

That makes Jessie irritated.

Then James comes in ,"Ladies and gentlemen, dinner is now served!"

"Pika Pika!" (It's dinner time!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee Eevee!" (Good I'm hungry!) Eevee happily says.

Meloetta, Skwovet, Togepi, and Pichu agree.

Soon, Mew and the others are sitting down to dinner.

"This soup is ice cold," Brock says.

"It's an old eskimo recipe," James nervously says.

"Eskimo?" Brock says, confused.

"Yes, our chef.." James begins, but Jessie smacks him in the face with a plate.

"Ow!" James yelps.

Jessie sheepishly laughs.

Just then, the blimp begins to tilt over, causing everyone to lose their balance, except the ones who are sitting.

"Hey, what's going on here?" Mew asks.

"And what kind of pilot's flying this thing anyway?" Misty adds.

"Good questions," Jessie and James reply.

Soon, it's revealed that Meowth is in the kitchen cooking and not flying the blimp in the cockpit.

"You're asking me who's flying the big bag of gas?" Meowth questions.

Jessie and James who have asked the question nod their heads.

"Well, don't look at me. I'm just slaving over a hot stove trying to keep passengers happy," Meowth says, continuing cooking.

This makes Jessie and James concerned and answer they don't want to hear.

James soon realizes, "If, it's not you.."

"That means we haven't had a pilot since we took off," Jessie says.

Then Meowth says, "The blimp's flying itself."

Soon, Team Rocket realizes the situation, panic and rush to the cockpit of the blimp to see no one is there.

"Nobody home!" Meowth cries out.

"Well, one of us has to steer," Jessie says.

They soon point to one another, and they soon realize something. None of them knows how to pilot a blimp.

James cries out, "I don't know how!"

"I can't even fly a kite!" Jessie panics.

"We just gotta follow the instructions in this manual. I'll check under 'no pilot'," Meowth says, finding a book and deciding to look through it.

Soon, the blimp begins to tilt forward.

Meowth says, "The manual says you can't keep a blimp from wobbling all over the place unless you got ballast. The blimp has a big tank of water up front and one in back. If you let water out of one tank, that end rises up cause it gets lighter."

"Very interesting, just make the front go up," Jessie says, feeling squished.

"There's a lever that lets the water out," Meowth says.

James gets up to see the two levers, then pulls down one of them ,"Here goes."

The water pours out. Unknown to them, the two Pokemon who are still dangling on the rock get soaked, and are not pleased. They soon are able to free themselves.

Inside the blimp, the blimp levels back in balance to Team Rocket's relief. But short lived when it begins to tilt back the other way.

Meowth screams, "That's too much! Let some out of the back!"

James does so, but the blimp soon tilts forward.

Meowth calls out, "Now you let TOO MUCH out of the back!"

"I'm doing the best I can!" James says, continue to balance the blimp.

Soon, the blimp begins to go back and forth.

"Pour out of the front! Not that much!" Meowth screams.

The blimp continues to go back and forth and in the dining room, Mew and the others are being pushed back and forth as well. Finally, the blimp is level off and is in balance.

"We're finally on the level!" James says.

"I feel seasick," Jessie says, feeling sick.

"Don't you mean blimp-sick?" Meowth says.

James looks up and notices something wrong, "Look! We're heading into a huge storm cloud!"

"What'll we do?!" Jessie asks.

Meowth looks at the book, "Quick, let some water out of the front tank! Maybe we can fly above it!"

When James tries, the water is not coming out. The two Pokemon wait for the water to come out, but notice none are coming out. Soon, they begin to climb the rope up the blimp and hopefully make it inside. They soon jump into the water tank

James notices it too, "The lever doesn't seem to be working! The front tank must be empty!"

"But that storm! We've got to think of something, fast!"

"Our only hope is an emergency landing! All we gotta do is hit that button there!" Meowth says, and points to the emergency landing button.

"What does that do?" Jessie asks.

"When you push that button, all the gas gets let out of the blimp and we land in the ocean," Meowth answers.

"We can't do that! The boss is counting on us, and if we fail, we'll be dropped out of the Blimp Brigade for good!" Jessie says.

"We can't mess this mission up! They'll take back my Blimp Brigade uniform!" James panics.

"As long as we capture Pikachu, the boss won't care if we sink this stupid blimp or not," Jessie says.

James likes the idea, "You're right, Jessie! And then we'll be heroes!"

Soon, Jessie begins to sing and James feels happy about it.

Meowth then says to himself, "These two are acting screwier than usual. Maybe the blimp gas is getting to them."

Meanwhile, in the dining room, Mew and the others are recovering from their rocky ride.

Mew sits up and asks, "Is everybody alright here?"

"I guess so," Misty says.

Then looks down in her hands, "How are you feeling.. Huh?" But notices that she has a Darma doll.

She panics and tosses the doll away.

"Misty, what's wrong?" Mew asks.

"Togepi and Pichu disappeared!" Misty panics.

"They're gone!" Brock exclaims in shock.

Finding out they're gone, Mew and her friends begin to search around the blimp for the two missing Pokemon.

Mew calls out, "Hey, Togepi?! Pichu?!"

"Togepi?! Pichu?!" Misty calls out.

"Come on out, Togepi?!" Brock calls out.

Tomo calls out, "Pichu!"

"Pi Pi Pi!" (Togepi!) Pikachu calls out.

"Eevee Eevee!" (Pichu!) Eevee calls out.

"Meloetta!" (Togepi!) Meloetta calls out.

"Skwovet!" (Pichu!) Skwovet calls out.

Misty searches in the pantry, "Togepi!"

Brock looks in the chimney, "Pichu!"

Tomo looks in the garbage can, "Togepi!"

Then Mew looks in one of the rooms, "Pichu!"

Unknown to Mew and her friends, the two little Pokemon are exploring around the blimp. They look around and find a good place to explore. Seeing Mew and her friends, the two decide to follow them. Unaware, the blimp is getting closer to the storm.

Somewhere in the blimp, Mew climbs up the ladder into the structural area of the blimp.

"What would Togepi and Pichu be doing in a creepy place like this," Mew questions.

":It's the only place on the blimp we haven't looked yet," Brock says.

Misty calls out, "Togepi?! Pichu?! Are you here?!

"Togepi?!" Mew calls out.

Then Tomo calls out, "Pichu!"

"Come on out!" Brock adds.

Then Misty calls out, "Pretty please?!"

Soon, Mew and her friends continue to walk down the hall of the structural part of the blimp, and become spooked when something runs past them.

"Hey, did you guys see that?!" Mew asks, surprised.

"Maybe it was Togepi or Pichu," Brock suggests.

Misty calls out, "Togepi! Pichu!"

The group then follows whatever they see. Soon they find themselves not knowing where they went off to.

"Where are they? Mew wonders.

"They couldn't have gone far," Brock says.

Soon, they see something approaching them. Something glowing.

"Look down there!" Tomo calls out.

"What is that?" Brock wonders.

"I don't know, but I'm not like this," Mw says, and remembers what the two employees had said about the blimp being haunted.

"It looks like this blimp really is haunted!" Brock panics.

The group panics and runs away in fright to see the glowing objects.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket are looking around the same place, but on the catwalk.

"There's no place left to look, Jess, "James says.

"I know, James. It's like those kids vanished into thin air," Jessie says.

"Maybe they're invisible like all the ghosts in here," Meowth says with sarcasm.

Jessie furiously grabs Meowth by his mouth, "I've had just about enough of your big Poke-mouth, mister! If you want to be invisible, just tell me! Well?! Do you?!"

Meowth screams, "Knock it off! Quit it! Cut it out, I was kidding!"

Just then, Meowth sees the same glowing sparkling objects.

"Meowth? You look like you've seen a ghost.

"I did! It's there, right behind you!" Meowth panics.

"There's a ghost?" Jessie asks.

"Right behind us?" James adds.

They turn around to see the two glowing objects, causing them to scream in fright and run away in fear. Soon, coming out of the darkness are the two Pokemon. Soon the blimp is flying right into the storm as Mew and her friends recuperate from what they've seen.

"Alright I have enough of this! I say we get off of this creepy thing!" Mew says, finally having enough of this trip.

"We can't get off! We're a mile high!" Brock says.

"Well, even if we could, I'm not leaving without Togepi and Pichu! I'll battle ghosts or anybody else I have to!" Misty says.

Suddenly, they hear a familiar voice, "That's our cue!"

Jessie:

Prepare for trouble!

The group turns their heads to see Jessie and James on the ladder.

James:

Make it double!

Before they can continue, the blimp rocks again, causing Meowth to fall on Jessie, which she falls on to James. Then all three fall down to the kids' level. Then they quickly get up to continue.

Jessie:

To protect the world from devastation.

James:

To unite all peoples within our nation.

Jessie:

To denounce the evils of truth and love.

James:

To extend our reach to the stars above.

Jessie:

Jessie.

James:

James.

Jessie:

Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light.

James:

Surrender now, or prepare to fight.

Meowth:

Meowth! That's fright!

"Team Rocket!" Mew says, annoyed.

"We have more important things to worry about now, so go away!" Misty shouts.

"We're not giving up as easy as you think, and we're not going!" James denies.

"And you're not going anywhere, either," Jessie

"You're trapped this time, and nobody's leaving this balloon until we get what we want. Now hand over that Pikachu!" Mewoth says.

"No way!" Mew denies.

"Then let's make this transaction.." James says, holding his Pokeball.

Then Jessie says, "A bit more exciting. Arbok!" And throws her Pokeball.

Hames does the same, "Weezing, showtime!"

Mew worriedly says, "Uh, I don't think this is a good idea."

But Jessie calls out, "Alright, Arbok use your Bite attack!"

Arbok then coils the structure of the blimp ready to attack.

"Eevee use, Iron Tail!" Mew calls out.

Eevee performs Iron Tail and swats Arbok off the ladder

Brock throws his Pokeball and calls out, "Go, Geodude!"

Geodude comes out of its Pokeball. Soon, both Geodude and Weezing are through clashes with Tackle attack. Geodude then grabs Weezing and tosses him through the canvas of the blimp, making a hole in it. Soon, Weezing returns to the blimp, making another hole. That creates a bigger tear into the blimp. Soon, the entire blimp is starting to come apart.

"Look! The storm's gonna tear the whole blimp apart!" Brock cries out.

Just as the blimp is falling apart, they notice the two little Pokemon, Pichu and Togepi are walking on the metal structure of the blimp.

Misty panics, "Togepi! Pichu!"

Then hurry after them!" Togepi! Pichu! Get down!"

The others hurry after them to get the little ones down. Just then, James and Jessie begin sulking about their failure.

Jessie and James sulk and say, "Looks like Team Rocket's messing up again."

"We can't let them get away!" Meowth shouts.

Meanwhile, Mew and the others reach the little ones' location.

Misty calls out, "Togepi!

"Pichu!" Mew calls out.

Then Misty calls out, "Togepi, Pichu, please come down here, right now!"

But the two Pokemon are having too much fun to listen to

Just then, Tomo takes out his Pokeball, "I got an idea!"

Then throws it, "Go Shuppet!"

With that, Shuppet comes out of the Pokeball.

Tomo calls out, "Shuppet, use Psychic to rescue Togepi and Pichu!"

Shuppet performs the Psychic attack and begins to levitate Pichu and Togepi down from the metal structure and towards Mew and the others. Meanwhile, Team Rocket is watching the rescue mission.

"They're too busy worrying about Togepi to worry about us, "Jessie says.

"Now's our chance. If one of us could walk across that beam, we can sneak up on Pikachu from behind," James says.

"But look at how high up that beam is, James," Jessie says.

"And it's a long way down!" James says, looking down.

"This is a job for, Meowth!" Meowth says, and begins to climb along the path of the steel structure like they're monkey bars.

Meowth continues, "Watch and wonder, as I display an array of feline agility and cat-like mobility."

"That little guy certainly has a lot of guts, doesn't he?" Jessie says.

Then James says, "Guts, but not brains."

Soon, the blimp flies out of the storm and the light of the sun blinds Meowth.

"The light!" Meowth panics and shields his eyes.

That makes Meowth almost lose his grip.

James and Jessie call out, "Hang on tight!"

Meowth screams, "HEEEEEELP! Get me a ladder! Get me a trampoline! Get me a parachute!"

"Scaredy cat," Jessie comments.

Then James says, "So much for guts."

Back to Mew and her friends, Shupper has Togepi and Pichu levitated right back to Misty, and the girl takes the two baby Pokemon into her arms.

Misty hugs them, "Togepi. Pichu. You both had me worried. Don't disappear like that again."

Just then, the blimp rocks a bump, causing Team Rocket to lose their balance and falls off the blimp. Meowth quickly grabs the cloth and some tears off. Soon, Meowth is able to use the cloth as a parachute.

James happily says, "A parachute!"

"You're a genius, Meowth!" Jessie says.

Team Rocket are gently floating down as Meowth holds on to the parachute as they descend to the ocean below.

Back in the blimp, Misty hugs Togepi and Pichu, and is very glad that they're safe.

Just then, they hear footsteps and turn their heads to see the two Pokemon.

"What are they?" Tomo asks.

"They're cute," Misty says.

"They're Plusle and Minun," Brocks says.

Mew brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Plusle, the Cheering Pokemon. An Electric Type. Plusle always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this Pokémon shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy."

Then Dexter says, "Minun, the Cheering Pokemon. An Electric Type. Minun loves to cheer on its partner in battle. It gives off sparks from its body while it is doing so. If its partner is in trouble, this Pokémon gives off increasing amounts of sparks."

"So they're like Cheerleaders," Misty says.

Mew says, "They must have snuck into the blimp somehow."

Soon, the two Pokemon cheer and let out sparks on their paws as they cheer.

Suddenly, they begin to hear hissing sounds, and look to see the gas tank in the blimp has sprung a leak.

"What's that?" Misty asks.

"The gas is starting to leak from those tanks!" Mew says, shock.

Then Brock says, "We have to land this blimp, fast!"

"Right! What's our plan?" Tomo asks.

"I have an idea. If we let some of our Pokemon out, we can steer the blimp with it with the weight," Mew says.

"You got it!" Brock says.

Then says, "We should use our smaller Pokemon. Pokemon like Onix might put on too much weight."

Brock says, "I'll head to the cockpit and try to steer the blimp."

"I'll go too," Misty says.

"Tomo and I will try to steer the blimp from here," Mew says.

With that, Brock releases Zubat, Geodude, Vulpix, Winter. Mew releases Squirtle, Bulbasaur, Glaceon and Cinderace. Misty releases Staryu, Sobble, and Oddish. Tomo releases Growlithe, Abra, and Buneary.

The group acts fast as the blimp is close to an island that has an airfield.

Brock and Misty are at the cockpit as Brock takes the wheel.

Brock says, "I can try to land on that island if they can get the nose down.

Misty talks through the speaker, "Okay, guys, move all of the Pokémon to the front of the blimp!"

"Alright everyone, walk to the blimp. We need to have the nose forward just right," Mew says to Tomo and the Pokemon.

Mew and the others head to the front nice and slow. Soon, the blimp begins to tilt forward a bit, as they walk, the blimp tilts forward more.

Brock turns to Misty with a nod.

Misty calls out through the speaker, "Alright everyone, we're good."

Mew and the others stop to see the blimp is making its way to shore. Soon, the blimp lands on the island, skids on the ground, and crashes on the island.

Just then the intercom announces, "Welcome, visitors, to Valencia Island. We hope you enjoy your stay in our tropical paradise.

Hearing the announcement, Brock says, "Misty, we landed on Valencia Island!"

"No way!" Misty says, by surprise.

Meanwhile, Mew, Tomo, and the Pokemon are a bit dazed from the crash.

Mew asks, "Hey, guys. Are you okay?"

Mew, Tomo and the Pokemon begin laughing. Soon, Plusle and Minun rubs Mews cheeks with glee. Mew giggles.

Mew then asks, "Hey Plusle, Minun, you two want to come with us?

Plusle and Minun nod their heads with glee.

Mew and the others smile and end up with new friends.

Despite Team Rocket's worst efforts, Mew and her friends are able to land on Valencia Island. Now, they plan to head to Professor Ivy's lab to retrieve the mysterious Pokeball for Professor Oak.

Chapter 6: Episode 6: Pokeball Peril

After their little adventure on the ramshackle airship and having to deal with Team Rocket, Mew and her friends walk out of the airship and are very glad to be back on ground floor. Not only that, but Mew caught herself two new Pokemons: Plusle and Minun. Still, they have an errand to do for Professor Oak. And so, they're now walking on the trail in the hot sun of Valencia Island to find Professor Ivy's lab to pick up the mysterious Pokball.

Mew happily sighs and says, "What a beautiful place."

"Yeah. The weather is perfect," Misty says.

"Maybe we should take a little swim," Tomo suggests.

But Brock says, "We can have fun after we get that Pokéball."

"Okay," Tomo replies with a nod.

Soon, the group stops on the hill, to see the city up ahead.

"So, where is Professor Ivy's laboratory, anyway?" Misty wonders.

"I'm afraid I don't," Brock says.

"Me neither," Mew and Tomo say.

Even the Pokemon shake their heads in reply.

Misty sighs and says, "I guess we'll just have to find it."

Soon, Pikachu notices something, "Pi? Pika Pi! ("Huh? Mew!")

Mew and the others turn to see a building that seems rather different. It has green walls, with red designs, and a strange looking roof.

"That looks like a Pokemon Center," Mew says.

The group heads over and walks inside.

Misty calls out, "Anybody here?"

"I wonder if there are Nurse Joys in the Orange Islands," Brock replies.

Right on cue, Nurse Joy and Chansey arrive to greet them.

Nurse Joy says, "Welcome to the Pokémon Center."

"Some things never change," Mew comments.

Brock is the first to come up to her and holds her hand, "It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance. Are you related to any of the other Nurse Joys?"

"I'm the second cousin of the sister-in-law of the Joy in Saffron City. Have you ever been to Saffron City?" Nurse Joy answers.

"Oh, yes. It's beautiful, like you are," Brock says.

Misty then grabs Brock by the ear, "Looks like you need to cool down a little, Brock." And drags him away.

Mew steps forward, "Um Nurse Joy, we were hoping to ask for directions. Can you tell us how to get to Professor Ivy's lab?"

"Oh, it's very easy. You go straight out of the Pokémon Center, make the first left, and it's the big white building at the end of Bay View Road," Nurse Joy explains, and points to the trail.

"Thank you," Mew says.

Sometime later, after following Nurse Joy's instruction, Mew and her friends arrive at a large white building with a red roof on the top; it also has a balcony. The group then walks inside to find the scientist.

Mew calls out, "Professor Ivy?!"

"Hello?! Is anybody home?!" Misty calls out.

However, no one answers, and so far, no one seems to be here.

"The place looks empty," Tomo says.

Suddenly, a secret door that is on the floor flings open, starting Mew, the others, and the Pokemon.

Soon, a girl wearing an orange and green shirt, with dark brown hair and glasses appears out of the door.

The girl says, "Hi."

Then another girl with a pink shirt and red flowers, wears glasses and has light brown hair comes out, "What are you doing here?"

Then the last one with pigtails, lighter brown hair, wearing a green shirt and glasses comes out, "Who are you?"

The group calms down to see the three girls.

Brock says, "Uh, hello there. We came here to see Professor Ivy."

"Yeah, Professor Oak from Pallet Town sent us to pick up something," Mew says.

The girl with the orange shirt says, "If you want the Professor.."

"She's in the bay," The girl with the pink shirt says.

Then the girl with the green shirt says, "Working with the Pokémon."

They all three say, "We'll take you to her right now."

"Thank you, and who might you be?" Mew replies.

The girl with the orange shirt says, "I'm Charity."

The girl with the pink shirt says, "I'm Faith."

Then the girl with the green shirt says, "And I'm Hope."

A little time later, the three girls escort the group to the bay to find the professor. Soon, a Gyarados rises from the water. This causes the group to panic.

"A Gyarados!" Misty panics.

Suddenly, they see a woman with short dark purple plum hair, brown eyes, and wearing a blue swimsuit.

She pets the Gyarados and says, "Very good, Gyarados!"

Then a Poliwhirl and Cloyster come out.

The woman says, "I think you're all looking better and stronger every single day!"

The group is amazed to see how tamed Gyarados is with her.

"Amazing," Mew says.

"Really cool," Tomo says.

Dazed, Brock says, "I wish she'd train me…"

Just then, Charity calls out, "Professor!"

Hope continues, "Some friends of Professor Oak are here to.."

Finally Faith, "See you!"

The woman known as Professor Ivy turns to see them. And soon, she surprises everyone by riding on her Gyarados. With that, she jumps off the Gyarados as they reach shore. Then Charity throws Ivy's lab coat. Professor Ivy catches it, and lands on the rocks with her lab coat on.

The female professor says, "Pleased to meet you. I'm Professor Ivy."

Everyone is astonished to see what has taken place while Brock is love struck.

She then walks to Mew and says, "It's a pleasure to the trainer who won the Indigo Pokemon League. Mew, correct?"

The three girls are surprised to hear this, they haven't realized that Mew is the champion from the Indigo Plateau Pokemon League.

"Um yes. It's nice to meet you. My friends and I are here to pick up something for Professor Oak," Mew says.

Professor Ivy nods her head.

After that, everyone returns to the lab and Mew and her friends explain to them why they're here.

"Well, there's the Pokéball," Professor Ivy says.

The group looks to see that this Pokeball is very different. It's gold on the top and it's silver on the bottom. And it looks like it has some initials engraved on it.

A little surprised, Mew says "Wow! Sure is different."

"I never saw one like that before," Misty says.

"Pikachu/Eevee" (Me neither.) Pikachu and Eevee reply.

Meloetta, Skwovet, Togepi, and Pichu are curious about the Pokeball themselves.

Then Brock asks, "Why is it all gold and silver?"

"We haven't been able to discover the reason for that or very much else about the Pokéball, I'm afraid,"

Soon, Mew notices the symbol on the Pokeball, "G.S? What does that mean?"

Professor Ivy looks at it and says, "So you noticed. If you look closely, you can see the letters G S."

"I see it," Mew says.

"We don't know what G.S stands for. So we decided to call it a GS Ball," Professor Ivy says.

"A GS Ball," Mew replies, staring at the Pokeball.

Brock turns to Professor Ivy, "We heard you can't transport it."

Professor Ivy turns to the girls, "Would you demonstrate?"

Charity walks to the control and presses the button for the Pokeball to be teleported, but after that, the Pokeball remains. Mew and the others are a little surprised.

Professor Ivy says, "Naturally, we've tried to open it."

The girls nod their heads in reply.

Then Professor Ivy explains, "We've tried buzz saws, hammers, crowbars, hacksaws, power drills, and lasers! We've tried everything, but this Pokéball has us stumped!"

The girls nod their heads.

The Mew and the others turn to the Pokeball as Pikachu and the Pokemon look at it curiously.

"That is one stubborn Pokeball," Mew says.

"Yeah," Tomo replies with a nod.

Then the hatch opens and Professor Ivy picks it up as she says, "I wish I could've uncovered the secrets of this Pokéball myself, but if anyone can solve its mysteries, your friend, Professor Oak, can."

Then present the ball to Mew, "Here it is, Mew. Make sure you get it to him safely."

"Right!" Mew says, taking the Pokeball.

Meanwhile, back in Pallet Town, Professor Oak is busy studying the vitals of a Magikarp. Suddenly, he receives a call.

He picks up the phone and says, "Hello. Professor Oak speaking."

"Hello professor, it's me, Mew," Mew says.

Recognizing the voice the professor happily saus, "Mew! Are you and the others there already?

"Yep, and Professor Ivy gave me the mysterious Pokeball for you," Mew says.

And presents it to Professor Oak.

Curious, Professor Oak asks, "Is that it?"

"Yeah. The Pokeball is gold on the top and silver on the bottom. And it has the letters GS engraved on the top. It's called the GS ball because of it," Mew says.

"A GS Ball?" Professor Oak says, confused.

The Professor Ivy answers, "I chose the name, Professor."

"Ah, Professor Ivy!" Professor Oak happily replies.

Soon, on the screen it shows Mew with Professor Ivy.

"It's good to talk to you, Professor Oak," Professor Ivy replies.

Then Professor Oak says, "Well, I recently read your preliminary report in Pokémon Researchers Monthly on Pokémon adapted variation as a function of regional distribution, and I found it quite persuasive."

"Oh, thank you. And I think your article on challenges facing anthro-Pokémon global dehabitation was absolutely fascinating!" Professor Ivy says.

Mew then asks, "Uh, is this gonna take much longer?"

Then Professor Ivy says, "Oh, sorry. I get carried away sometimes. I certainly hope you can solve the mystery of this Pokéball, Professor."

"Well, I'll see what I can do," Professor Oak says.

Then Mew takes the phone and says, "We'll see you soon, Professor Oak!"

"Alright, Mew! You and the others take care and thank you!" Professor Oak says.

Soon, the phone hangs up.

Now Professor Oak is very interested in the GS Ball, "How terribly exciting."

Back at Valencia Island, Mew and her friends are in the forest that is actually part of Professor Ivy's lab.

"So this is all part of your laboratory?" Brock asks.

"Yes, we need all this space for all the Pokémon. We breed and study so many of them," Professor Ivy says.

Brock is fascinated by it and begins to look around.

Just then, Misty approaches a gigantic flower.

Misty is amazed, "Just look at all these gigantic flowers!"

Just then, the flower begins to move, startling Misty. To Misty's surprise, the giant flower is a Vileplume.

"It's a Vileplume!" Brock says, amazed.

"And this one has a different color than the one I've seen back in Kanto," Mew says.

Just then, Hope & Charity hurry over with the cart of food bowls, "It's time for dinner!"

"Hey, I guess you make the food yourself," Brock says.

"Yes, we've created recipes for each type of Pokémon," Professor Ivy says.

Soon, all the Pokemon begin to come out. Including Paras, both male and female Nidoran, a Weepinbell, and a Raticate.

Tomo says, amazed, "Hey, look! All these Pokémon look a little bit different than they usually do!"

"Yeah, you're right!" Misty says.

"Why is that, Professor?" Brock asks.

"If you stop and think about it, it's not surprising, really," Professor Ivy says.

"It isn't?" Brock questions.

Professor Ivy gets out a bowl of Pokemon food and places it down for the Nidoran, and says, "This island's tropical climate is very different from the one where you live. Naturally, the different environment creates differences in the Pokémon that we've raised here. I'm now collecting water and studying how environment causes variation in all our Pokémon."

Brock asks, surprised, "You don't mean you've bred and raised all the Pokémon on this island, do you?!"

"Yes. I've dedicated myself to them and I couldn't be happier," Professor Ivy says.

Brock looks at Professor Ivy with admiration. Meanwhile, one of the girls feeds Gyarados it's dinner. Brock can't help but admire Professor Ivy.

"Professor? I'd love to see all the different kinds of water Pokémon you have here," Misty says.

"Hey! I wonder if there's a tropical island type Pikachu? Like with Wave," Mew says.

Soon, the group looks to see their Pokemon eating the food.

Ben: That, my young student, is a good question.

Mew becomes surprised, "Pikachu! Eevee! That's not yours!"

"Meloetta! Skwovet! Those are for the other Pokemon!" Tomo says.

Then Misty says, "Pichu! Togepi! Put that back!"

Professor Ivy laughs and says, "There's plenty."

Just then, Faith walks over and says, "Professor Ivy, look!"

They look to see a tropical Butterfree, gripping onto a tree, and it's not looking well.

"We've got to think of something," Professor Ivy says.

Mew and the others walk over.

Brock asks, "What's the matter?"

"That little Butterfree hasn't eaten a thing in days." Professor Ivy says.

Then turns to Charity, "The different nutrients haven't worked?"

"No, and we've tried five combinations," Charity answers, and passes Professor Ivy the clipboard.

Professor Ivy looks at the clipboard, "The ingredients include all the essential nutrients. I just don't understand it!"

Soon, Mew and Brock each decide to have a taste of the Pokemon food. Soon, they see the problem.

"You thinking what I'm thinking Brock?" Mew asks.

"Sure am," Brock says.

Then they both hurry off.

"Brock? Mew?" Misty calls out.

"We'll be right back!" Brock says.

Later, Brock and Mew return and are creating something for Butterfree.

Faith asks, "What are you doing?"

"We've found out that when a Pokémon decides to eat something, the most important thing isn't how nutritious the food is," Brock says.

The kids soon become confused.

Then Mew says, "They care about the taste. Pokémon like food that tastes good to them."

"Well, flavor is a factor. But how can you determine what flavors each Pokémon likes?" Professor Ivy replies.

"Only from experience," Brock says.

Mew notices, "I think it's ready."

"Now then, let's see what happens," Brock says, and sprinkles the stuff on Butterfree's food. Soon enough, Butterfree immediately catches the scent, flies to the ground, and begins chowing down like it hasn't eaten in weeks.

The two girls say, amazed, "Wow!"

"That's simply amazing!" Professor Ivy says, astonished.

"I had a Butterfree and he always likes sweet things," Mew says.

Then Brock says, "So if you just add some mashed up berries to their food, they'll eat it up every time.

The three girls are surprised.

Then Professor Ivy says, "I'm embarrassed to call myself a Pokémon researcher when you're the one who seems to know a lot more about Pokémon feeding habits."

"Well, I know a lot about Pokemon, but Brock knows tons of stuff about Pokémon, Professor. He's gonna be the world's greatest breeder." Mew says.

Brock is embarrassed.

"Ah, a breeder," Professor Ivy replies.

Soon, Charity and Faith gather around Mew and Brock in excitement.

Charity asks with excitement, "Will you teach us all about the different flavors the Pokemon like in their food?"

Faith is the same, "Please guys, please?!"

Just then Hope walks over and says, ""Hey, come on, you guys! We have to decide who gets stuck cooking dinner tonight."

"Cooking?" Brock says, confused.

Sometime later, everyone arrives in Professor Ivy's living quarters, and to Mew and her friends' shock, they find the place a GIGANTIC mess. Papers, books, and boxes are all over the place, the laundry is piling up in the laundry room, the dishes are dirty and piled up, and the trash hasn't been taken out.

Misty sarcastically says, "Nice place."

Professor Ivy explains, "We just got so wrapped up in our Pokémon research that we stopped cleaning the house and started calling it.."

"Our little dump!" The three girls conclude.

"Dumps are a lot cleaner!" Mew comments.

Suddenly, they notice Brock is acting weird and says to himself, "Floors to be swept, clothes to be washed, cooking, mopping, polishing, cleaning!"

With that, Brock gets into his cleaning gear, "This is just like home! Leave it to Super Brock!"

With that, Brock soon starts cleaning, washing, and cooking up a storm. Professor Ivy and the girls are very impressed.

Professor Ivy says, "Brock is a great cleaner!"

"Polisher," Faith adds.

Hope says, "Vacuumer."

"Duster," Charity adds.

"He's a good cook," Misty adds.

"And a great breeder," Mew says.

"Brock is amazing," Tomo says.

Soon, the entire place is clean as a whistle, and dinner has been served.

Professor Ivy happily, " Let's thank Brock!"

"Later! Let's eat!" The girls call out.

With that, Professor Ivy and the girls begin chowing down.

"The Pokémon eat quieter than they do," Mew comets.

Brock sees them eating and has him thinking, "Just like, my family."

The Pokemon are happily eating the food as well.

After dinner, later in the night, while everyone is asleep, Professor Ivy, along with Hope and Faith, are studying some of the Vileplume as they march into the night.

"Are you getting this?" Professor Ivy asks.

"es, it's all on tape," Faith answers.

Just then, Mew and Brock walk over."

"Professor," Brock says.

Professor Ivy turns to see them, "Brock, Mew. I thought you two would be asleep by now."

"We thought you might like a midnight snack," Brock says, bringing out a basket of rice cakes.

"How thoughtful," Professor Ivy says, and eats one of the cakes.

Then Mew asks, "What are you doing here?"

"We're performing a new study of the Vileplume. They're nocturnal Pokémon, and at night, they all come out to spray their pollen to prevent other Pokémon from entering their territory," Professor Ivy says. Just then, the girls notice something.

Faith calls out, "Here comes a Raticate!"

Indeed, they see a Raticate getting into the path of the Vileplume's pollen and is starting to get affected by it.

"Look out!" Professor Ivy calls out and hurries over.

Mew rushes towards it. As Mew and Professor Ivy hurry to rescue Raticate, they both end up breathing into the pollen.

"Professor! Mew!" Brock says in a panic.

Mew and Professor Ivy are able to get Raticate out of it's way, but all three are affected by the pollen.

"Professor, Mew, are you okay?!" Brock asks, worried.

"We're… we're okay…" Mew says.

Then Professor Ivy says, "Save the Raticate."

Brock nods his head.

Then Professor Ivy calls out, "Contact the Pokémon Center, immediately!"

"Yes, ma'am!" The girls quickly answer.

Soon enough, everyone arrives at the Pokemon Center where Mew, Professor Ivy, and the Raticat have been treated.

"I'm glad they woke us up," Tomo says, tired.

"Good thing we didn't sleep through this," Misty says, feeling sleepy.

Professor Ivy and Mew are laying in the beds as Nurse Joy tucks Raticate in. Pikachu and Eevee are with Mew's side and relieved to see she and professor Ivy are okay.

Nurse Joy turns to Professor Ivy, "Professor Ivy, you should know how dangerous it is to jump out in front of Vileplume when they're spraying their pollen like that!"

"How is the Raticate?" Professor Ivy asks, sitting up.

"Because you and Mew got it away from the pollen so fast, it'll be just fine," Nurse Joy says.

"Oh, good," Ivy says in relief, and lays back down in bed.

The three assistants rush over.

"We were so worried about you," Hope says.

"I didn't mean to scare you, girls," Professor Ivy says.

"Please don't do something like that again," Faith says.

"Oh, I won't," Professor Ivy says.

"That's what you said last time," Charity says.

"I'll try to mean it this time," Professor Ivy says.

Soon, the professor and the girls begin laughing.

Mew smiles and says, "We're glad Raticate is okay."

"Are you feeling okay, Mew? You can be so reckless," Misty says.

"I'm sorry," Mew says.

Tomo says, "We're glad that you're okay."

"Thank you," Mew says.

The next day, Mew and her friends are ready to depart back to Pallet Town.

"Well, we gotta go, Professor," Mew says.

"We have to get the GS Ball to Professor Oak," Misty says.

"And we had a great time," Tomo says.

"Well, come and visit any time," Professor Ivy says.

Soon, Mew and the others notice someone is missing.

Misty looks around and asks, "Hey, where's Brock?"

"I haven't seen him, Misty," Mew says.

"Where is Brock?" Tomo wonders.

Soon, they see Onix rolling right through the room with wooden boards in its mouth.

"Onix?" Mew says, confused.

Soon, they see Brock coming through with Geodude carrying some more wood, and Brock is holding a tool box.

Brock says, "Let's move it, guys!"

This makes the group confused

Mew calls out, "Hey Brock…"

"What's he doing?" Mew wonders.

Eevee turns to Pikachu, "Eevee Eevee.?" (Do you have any idea?)

"Pikachu." (I don't know.) Pikachu says.

Outside, Brock seems to be hammering some wood on the roof as the others watch.

Then Professor Ivy says, "It seems. It seems Brock has decided to stay with us."

That catches Mew and the others by surprise.

Brock turns around and calls out, "Okay! That roof shouldn't leak anymore, now!"

"That's wonderful, Brock!" Professor Ivy calls out.

"He's great!" Charity happily says.

Then Hope says, "It's like we were adrift at sea until Brock came along."

"That's true," Professor Ivy says.

Mew then calls out, "Hey, Brock! Are you really staying here?!"

"This ship needs a captain," Brock says.

"Loetta?" (Captain?) Meloetta says, confused.

"Skwovet," (No clue) Skwovet says.

Brock climbs down the ladder as he says, "If I stay here, I'll get to learn more and more about Pokemon every day."

Butterfree then lands on Brock's arm.

Brock gives it a scratch under the chin and says, "And I think these guys may need me a lot more than you guys do."

Mew smiles and says, "I understand. After all this is part of your dream to become a Pokemon Breeder."

Then says, "Well, then. I guess, this is goodbye." And waves her hand out.

Soon, Brock takes Mew's hand and asks, "Friends to the end. Right, Mew?"

"Right," Mew replies.

Misty and Tomo smile and understand that Brock decides to stay. Soon, the group begins to depart, and the friends wave goodbye to Brock.

"Bye, Brock!" Misty calls out.

"Goodbye!" Mew says.

"Bye!" Tomo says.

Brock waves goodbye and says, "Thank you, guys! And just make sure you don't forget me, will you?!"

All of Brock's Pokemon also wish the gang a farewell. Mew and the others begin to depart as they wave goodbye to Brock. Professor Ivy and the girls also give their regards as well.

After that, Mew and the others are now walking down the path to get back to Pallet Town

"It's gonna be very weird without having Brock around," Misty says.

"Yeah, I know. I wish he was coming back for us," Mew says.

"Yeah. I'm going to miss Brock," Tomo says.

Just then, Misty realizes, "Now that you mention it, how are we gonna get back?"

"I still got our blimp tickets, but uh…" Mew says, feeling reluctant.

Then turns to the others, "Are you all feeling brave enough to go on another trip on a blimp."

"No way, not after what we've been through," Misty denies.

"Yeah, the blimp was in really bad shape, the food was bad, and they didn't show a movie," Tomo says.

"Not to mention it was part of Team Rocket's trap," Mew says.

"Eevee!" (You said it!) Eevee says.

"Pika Pika?" (But what now) Pikachu wonders.

Mew then brings out the guide book and reads it, "Here it is, there's actually another way to get back to Pallet Town."

Misty and Tomo look at the guide book, "According to the guide book there's a ferry boat that can take us to Tangelo Island, and there is a ship that can get us to Pallet Town."

"Then let's go," Tomo says.

"Right," Mew says.

Sometime later, Mew and her friends are able to find the ferry boat, and luckily, there is one that is just about to depart to Tangelo Island. After getting on the ferry boat, Mew and her friends relax on the boat and watch the ocean ahead. They can't wait to reach their next destination before reaching Pallet Town.
