Chapter 7: Episode 7: The Lost Lapras

Last time, Mew and her friends arrived at Valencia Island to pick up a mysterious Pokeball called the GS ball for Professor Oak from Professor Ivy. After getting the GS ball, Brock decides to stay and work at Professor Ivy's lab. So Mew and the others decide to head back home, and not wanting to take another Blimp trip, Mew and the others are on the ferry boat for a detour, an island called Tangelo Island.

On the ferryboat they are on, it begins to arrive at Tangelo Island, their destination. Mew and her friends, and Pokemon look to see the island.

"There it is," Mew says.

"So this is Tangelo Island. It's very pretty," Misty says.

"And it looks cool. I wonder if this place has a Pokemon Center," Tomo says.

"I wouldn't be surprised if it is," Mew says.

Misty says, "The ferry is going to dock, so we should head down."

"Right," Mew says.

As soon as the ferry dock, Mew and her friends walk down the stairs, where they're greeted by two hula girls.

One of them says, "Welcome to Tangelo Island and to Pokemon Park!"

"The Pokémon vacation destination!" Another Hula girl says.

Soon, the two girls begin to put flower necklaces around the their neck

Then one places lei around Pikachu's neck, "Here's one for you, too,"

They also do the same to the other Pokemon.

Meloetta sniffs the flower and says, "Melo Meloetta." (They're very fresh and tropical.)

Skwovet begins to nibble on his.

Soon, the P.A says "The Tangelo Island Chamber of Commerce welcomes one and all to the Pokémon Park, the world's first Pokémon theme park."

"A theme park?" Mew and the others say, surprised.

Even the Pokemon are surprised.

Soon, Mew and the others begin to explore the town.

"Well, guys, looks like we picked a fun island to go to," Misty says.

"This place looks really cool," Tomo says.

"I agree. It's a great place for us to rest, have some fun, and to get some tasty food," Mew says.

Right on cue, Togepi and Pichu's stomachs begin growling.

Misty notices it, "You two are hungry aren't you?"

"Yeah. I'm getting hungry too," Tomo says.

Meloetta and Skwovet nod their heads in reply.

"Well then, we should go find somewhere to eat," Mew says.

Suddenly, Pikachu and Eevee sense something.

Mew looks at them and asks, "What's up guys?"

Suddenly, they begin to hear a cry.

Misty notices, "Look!"

Soon, they see a large sea Pokémon that resembles a plesiosaur. It has a blue hide with darker blue spots and a cream-colored underside. It has large brown eyes, a short horn on its forehead, and tightly curled ears. It has a long neck and four flippers. The foremost flippers are larger than the hind. On its back is a heavy, gray shell covered in blunt knobs. It looks like it's been beached and it's surrounded by three guys.

"It's a Lapras!" Tomo says.

Mew notices the scared look on Lapras' face and says, "I sense trouble."

She jumps over the fence and lands on the sand to see what's going on.

Meanwhile, the three guys are acting like bullies to the Lapras.

One of them shouts, "Come on!"

The one sitting on Lapras' shell says, "Get up and get moving, you stupid lump!"

"You better listen, or else!" The third guy says, and is about to beat Lapras with a stick.

Lapras closes its eyes fearing the worst, but isn't being hurt. Lapras opens its eyes and is shocked to see Mew using her arm as a shield as the man has the stick against him.

Mew angrily says, "Give me that stupid stick." and takes it away from the guy.

She then runs to the shore and throws the stick in the ocean.

Mew marches over to the three and demands, "You bullies, quit picking on that Lapras! And how dare you try to beat it like that!"

That's when Misty and the others arrive.

"I bet it never did anything to hurt you!" Misty says.

"Yeah. Leave it alone!" Tomo says.

"Loetta!" (That's right!) Meloetta says.

"Skwovet!" (Back off!) Skwovet says.

Then Pikachu says, "Pika Pika!" (Go take a hike!)

"Eevee!" (Or else) Eevee adds.

Lapras looks over to see the group of strangers, especially Mew, the girl with the teal hair, is trying to defend it. It even sees Mew have taken a beating from one of them.

The one with the sunglasses sitting on Lapras questions, "Who asked your opinion?"

"Yeah, this is none of your business!" The guy with the blue shirt says.

"We don't need any little brats like you telling us how to handle our Pokémon!" The guy with the green hair says.

"Yeah, we're getting ready for our big Pokémon battle against the Orange Crew, so get lost!" The man with the blue shirt.

Mew angrily says, "I can't believe you three are Pokémon trainers!"

"I don't know who the Orange Crew is, but I doubt they'll let you compete if they know you treat Pokemon like this, especially for picking on an innocent baby," Mew angrily says.

The one with the red shirt brings out his Pokeball, "This'll teach you to butt into our business, kids. Ha! Go!" Then throws his Pokeball.

The other two do the same, "Go!"

Out of the Pokeballs are Spearow, Hitmonchan, and a Beedrill.

The one with the red shirt says, "Spearow, let's show these guys what a real Pokémon battle looks like."

"Beedrill, let's get buzzing!" the one with the blue shirt and white bandana says.

The one with the green hair says, "Let's knock em out, Hitmonchan!

"They don't scare us! Right, Pikachu? Eevee?" Mew says.

Pikachu and Eevee agree.

"Get inside where it's safe," Misty says, putting Togepi and Pichu in her backpack.

Soon the three Pokemon charge.

Then Mew calls out, "Alright, Pikachu! Eevee!"

Pikachu and Eevee charge into battle, but someone halts it, "Hold it!"

Everyone turns to see the one who interferes with the battle is a boy that looks like he's a few years older than Mew. The man has dark green hair and brown eyes. He is wearing a short-sleeved, green shirt with a darker green border on it, dark red shorts, a headband which was colored salmon, white socks, an orange backpack, and tennis shoes colored purple and bright orange, with white soles.

"This should only take a second," The stranger says.

He measures and examines the Pokemon from the three bullies.

He starts with Spearow, "The feathers on your Spearow indicate it's not getting enough vitamins and it could stand to lose a few pounds."

Then turns to Beedrill, "The coloring on this Beedrill is pretty poor."

Then turn to Hitmonchan, "And it's obvious this Hitmoncham isn't getting enough exercise. Yeah, just as I suspected."

Mew and her friends are baffled to see the strange observing and sketching the Pokemon.

"Pika Pika?" (Who is this guy?) Pikachu asks.

"Eevee Eevee," (I have no idea.) Eevee replies.

The stranger says, "It's easy to see that these Pokémon are pitifully underdeveloped."

"What do you mean 'underdeveloped'?" The trainer with the red shirt questions.

Then the one with the blue shirt questions, "Who made you the expert?"

Then the stranger approaches Pikachu, "But this Pikachu looks just perfect. You can tell because its coat's so shiny."

"Pika?" (It is?) Pikachu says, confused.

Then the stranger turns to Eevee, "And this Eevee is just as perfect as Pikachu. It's fur is clean, soft, and shiny."

Eevee blushes a bit.

Then the kid picks up Pikachu and places him on the log. Soon, the boy begins to sketch it.

"I just want to make a quick sketch. Now hold still," The boy says, and begins drawing it.

Pikachu is very confused about what the boy is doing.

He then says, "It looks like your Pikachu's electric sacs are in super shape. Really strong."

Then he has an idea, "Hey! Why don't I measure Pikachu's power levels with my voltage meter right now?"

He brings out a voltmeter and holds the rods close to Pikachu's cheeks, "Okay. Now show me a Thunder Shock."

"Pi?" (Huh?) Pikachu says, confused.

Soon, the three punks realize that they are being ignored.

The one with the blue shirt says, "We can't let these creeps ignore us!"

"Let's go, guys!" The one with the red shirt says,

The one with the orange shirt says, "It's battle time!"

With that, the three Pokemon begin charging towards the boy.

Tomo calls out, "Watch out!"

Then Mew calls out, "Pikachu! Eevee! Thunderbolt!"

With that, Pikachu and Eevee join forces and give them an extra big and powerful attack, shocking everyone with their attack.

The boy holding the device weakly says, "That was pretty good."

The three trainers are shocked to see their Pokemon including themselves have been fried.

"Alright, are you three are going to leave or we're going to have to make you," Mew says.

Seeing there is no match for them, they all retreat, so does their Pokemon.

"And that's that," Mew says.

"Pikachu," (That's right.) Pikachu says.

Eevee says, "Eevee Eevee!" (They deserve it!)

Mew then hurries to Laparas and kneels to it, "Are you okay, sweetie? Did those mean boys scare you?"

The little Lapras nods its head in reply, nervously. In truth, it doesn't know if it can trust humans, even if they defend it, but it notices the bad bruise on Mew's arm. That made it remember that Mew saved it from being abused. It then looks at Mew with some truth in her eyes.

"Here little guy, maybe this can help you feel better," Mew says, and presents a kind of medicine to Lapras.

Lapras is reluctant, but seeing Mew's kind smile, it decides to open its mouth. Allowing Mew to spray a bit of the medicine in Lapra's mouth, and it begins to eat it. Mew then gently pets Lapras, calming it down a little, and begins to have more trust in Mew. Mew, Tomo, the Pokemon, and the boy hurry over.

"Is Lapras' okay?" Misty asks.

"I think Lapras is going to be fine, but he was hurt, scared, and upset," Mew says.

Then the boy says, "I'll go find Nurse Joy and get help."

"Okay. Thank you," Mew says.

Then the boy hurries off to find Nurse Joy.

Sometime later, the group arrives at the Pokemon Center with the little Laparas so it can feel better.

Misty asks, "How is Lapras doing, Nurse Joy?"

"There weren't any serious injuries. Lapras will be just fine after a good rest," Nurse Joy says.

"That's good news," Misty says.

Then everyone turns to see Lapras in a pool outside the center and appears to be sleeping. Of course, Mew has also been treated from the bruise she receives from the boy with the stick.

But Nurse Joy says, "But there is a problem. That Lapras is afraid of having any kind of contact with people at all. I only managed to treat it when Mew was close next to it."

"No wonder, after the way those guys on the beach were treating it," Misty says.

"Yeah. Those guys are mean," Tomo says.

"That's too bad, especially since it's just an infant," Tracy says.

Mew then wonders, "I wonder why a baby Lapras was on the beach alone, and away from it's pod."

"Well, big schools of Lapras pass by the island this time every year. This one must have gotten separated from its group, maybe during that last big storm we had," The boy says.

"Sounds like you know a lot about Pokémon," Tomo says.

"Well, you learn a lot from being a Pokémon Watcher," The boy says.

"A Pokémon Watcher?" The group replies, curiously.

"What is that?" Mew asks.

"Pokémon Watchers travel the world. They go looking for all kinds of Pokémon so they can observe and study their characteristics and abilities. They even search for new and undiscovered Pokémon," Nurse Joy explains.

"Cool," Tomo says.

"So that's why you were taking all those notes about Pikachu and the other Pokémon," Misty says.

"Yeah. My name is Tracy," The boy introduces himself.

"I'm Misty, and this is Togepi, and Pichu. It's nice to meet you," Misty says, holding the Pokemon.

"Nice to meet you too," Tracy says.

"I'm Tomo, and these are my friends, Meloetta and Skwovet," Tomo says.

"And I'm Mew, and these are my buddies, Pikachu and Eevee," Mew says.

Hearing her name makes Tracy asks, "Mew? You wouldn't happen to be the Mew, the youngest trainer to win the Pokemon League in the Kanto Region?"

"Um yeah. You know about me?" Mew asks, confused.

"Yeah. I think it's amazing the way you battle, the way you battle with your Charizard is amazing," Tracy says.

"I… I didn't think anyone out here would know about me," Mew says, feeling embarrassed.

"Well, I'm not surprised, you're the first Pokemon trainer to win the Pokemon League at your age," Tracy says.

"Wow Mew, it sounds like you're becoming famous," Misty says.

"Yeah. That sounds cool," Tomo says.

"I guess," Mew says, embarrassed.

Then Mew has an idea, "Hey, what do you say all of us try getting that Lapras back with its friends where it belongs?"

"Sounds great," Misty agrees.

"Count me in!" Tracy says.

"Let's do this," Tomo says.

Unknown to Mew and her friends, Team Rocket is able to find them on the island and see them through the window.

"Our losing streak's about to end," Meowth says.

James says, I think our luck must finally be turning. We're so close to grabbing a really rare Pokémon."

"Success is just one step away," Jessie says.

Suddenly, three trainers, each carrying a Pokemon rush into the center as they trample James.

One of the boys says, "Nurse Joy, my Sandshrew got scratched while we were training by accident."

"And my Voltorb is kinda tired, so maybe it could stay here for a day, maybe?" The girl trainer says.

Then the other male says, "Please, nurse. My Starmie needs a checkup cause I want to challenge the Orange Crew."

"Well, let's have a good look at them," Nurse Joy says.

"The Orange Crew?" Tomo says.

"I think I remember where I heard that from," Mew says.

"You're right. Those three guys on the beach said something about battling the Orange Crew, too," Misty says.

"You're right," Mew says.

"I wonder what it's all about," Tomo replies.

Then Tracy explains, "The Orange Crew is what everybody here calls this group of gym leaders from the islands of the Orange Archipelago."

"Gym leaders?" Misty says, confused.

Soon, they notice a poster for the orange league, "Trainers can't compete in the Orange League until they battle everybody in the Orange Crew.

"Whoa. I didn't know there was a Pokémon League here in the Orange Islands," Mew says.

"Well, it sounds like you have to be a pretty good trainer to get into the Orange League," Misty says.

Tomo turns to Mew, "Hey Mew, maybe you should enter the Orange League. You did great in the Kanto League, and I'll bet you'll do great on the Orange Island too."

"As much as I like to, but we promise Professor Oak to get the GS ball back to him," Mew says.

"She's right. I think Mew will do great at the Orange League, but we need to get the GS ball back to Professor Oak," Misty says.

Interested, Tracy asks, "Did you say Professor Oak?"

"Maybe we can talk to him and see what he thinks," Mew says.

"Yeah. Let's go ask him," Tomo says.

Tracy asks again, "THE Professor Oak?"

Soon, the group rings the professor and he picks up

The professor says, "Hi, Mew! Hello, Misty. Hello, Tomo."

"Hi Professor Oak. We still got the GS ball, and we're gonna bring it back to you real soon."

"That's great, but where are you calling from?" Professor Oak asks.

"From Tangelo Island," Mew answers.

"Tangelo Island, huh? Then I suppose you heard about the Orange League then," Professor Oak says.

"Yeah. I did. I want to know if I can compete in it, but I know I need to deliver you the GS ball," Mew says.

"Well Mew, I think you should give it a try. Of course, I'm very eager to take a look at that GS Ball, but it's also important for you to get in some rigorous training during your journey," Professor Oak says.

"Thank you, Professor," Mew says.

"Good luck, Mew," Professor Oak.

Mew ends the call, and soon Tracy has become ecstatic, "WOW! I can't believe I know some people who know my hero, Professor Oak!"

"What's the big deal about knowing Professor Oak?" Tomo asks.

"Yeah, he's a really nice guy, but.." Misty says.

But Tracy interrupts, "Every watcher knows Professor Oak is one of the greatest Pokémon experts on the whole entire planet!"

"We knew Professor Oak was smart, but I didn't know he was famous, too," Mew says.

"Okay! You just got yourself a new traveling buddy!" Tracy says, excited.

The group becomes baffled and surprised.

"See, if I stick with you, I'll finally get the chance to meet my hero, Professor Oak," Tacey says.

But Misty says, "Hey! You just can't invite yourself!"

Mew giggles and says, "I don't mind at all, Tracy. You can come with us."

"Yeah. The more the merrier," Tomo replies.

Just then, Nurse Joy comes in, "Good news, Lapras is awake and doing fine."

Mew and the others smile to hear the news.

The group looks outside to see Lapras is swimming a little in the pool. Lapras seems to be alright, but still a little nervous. It turns its head to see the human that defends it, then has it's sight set on Mew.

With that, Lapras begins to call out to her, making Mew confused.

"What's Lapras doing?" Misty wonders.

"Lapras is calling out to me," Mew says.

Mew then hurries outside and walks to the edge of the pool. Lapras is happy to see Mew that swims up to her without any trouble.

Mew pets Lapras and says, "You're doing a lot better now."

Lapras calls out, "Laaaaap." (I am.)

Then it becomes sad.

"Are you okay, Lapras?" Mew asks.

Lapras lowers his head and begins to shed tears in sadness. Misty and the others gently walk towards it and notice it crying.

Lapras sadly calls out "Laaapras. Laaaprass." (Mommy. Mommy)

Misty asks, "What's wrong? Why is Lapras sad?"

"Poor little baby. He wants his mommy," Mew says.

Then turns to Lapras and asks, "You got separated from your mom during the storm, huh."

Lapras nods his head and says, "Lapras Laaap, Lapras Laap Lapras Lapras Laaap." (Yes, my mother was trying to call out to me, but I was too far away. And the waves were too rough for me to reach her and my pod.)

Mew turns to her friends, "This little Lapras was separated from his pod and his mother during that storm Tacey just told us about."

"Oh," Tomo replies.

"He was probably lost until he washed up on the beach, where those three found it," Mew says.

"That sounds about right," Misty says.

Mew then turns to Lapras, "Don't worry Lapras, my friends and I have a solution."

Lapras perks up, "Laap?" (Really?)

"Yeah. I've decided to compete in the Orange Island League and we'll be traveling all over the Orange Island. Maybe while we're traveling, we can find your pod and your mother. Since they travel and migrate, we might be able to meet up with them," Mew says.

This makes Lapras have hope and begins to smile.

Then Mew asks, "What do you say, Lapras? You wanna go on the journey with us?"

Lapras thinks about it a bit and soon answers with a nod.

"Glad to have you on board. All we have to do is get you into that truck and get you to the ocean. Then we can begin traveling around Orange Island," Mew says.

Suddenly, something fires into the water and creates a blanket of smoke.

Mew gasps, "Lapras!"

"Oh no!" Misty says.

"What's happening?!" Tracey asks.

"Trouble. That's what," Tomo says.

Soon, two familiar laughter and figures appear through the smoke.

Jessie:

Prepare for trouble!

James: (stifles)

Make it, double!

Mew grits her teeth and says, "Not them again.

Jessie:

To protect the world from devastation.

James:

To unite all peoples within our nation.

Jessie:

To denounce the evils of truth and love.

James:

To extend our reach to the stars above.

Soon, the smoke clears.

Jessie:

Jessie.

James:

James.

Jessie:

Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light.

James:

Surrender now, or prepare to fight.

Soon, it's revealed that Team Rocket has baby Lapras tied on the truck and standing on its shell. Then Meowth jumps on it.

Meowth:

Meowth. That's right.

Lapras is feeling scared about this.

"Wait till the boss gets a load of this little baby!" Meowth says, excited

Seeing the talking Meowth has Tracy excited, "Wow! I can't believe it! A Meowth that can speak human language!"

He then dashes to Meowth with a microphone and a recorder.

Tracey says, "Testing, one, two, three. Meowth, can you please say something for the Pokémon Watcher Archive?" The points to Meowth with the microphone.

"What should I say?" Meowth asks.

"Maybe you can answer a few questions," Tracey says, excited.

"Well, I usually don't do interviews unless they've been cleared through my talent agent," Meowth says, embarrassed.

Then Jessie steps on Meowth, "Keep it up and you're going to need a travel agent."

"Can't you see we're busy?" James says, annoyed.

Then Jessie asks, "Who are you, anyway?"

"Oh, sorry. My name's Tracey. I'm a Pokémon Watcher," Tracey answers.

"Okay, if you're a Pokémon Watcher, then you won't mind stepping aside and watching us steal this Lapras," Jessie says, still stepping on Meowth.

Tomo angrily says, "You're not gonna steal anything!"

"Let go of Lapras or else!" Mew demands.

Just then, James throws his Pokeball, "Weezing, Smog attack!"

Weezing comes out of its Pokeball and uses its attack to blind everyone, allowing Team Rocket to escape with Lapras.

Mew rushes over and angrily says, "Those crooks!"

"Guys, we can't let them get away!" Misty says.

"We can't catch them on foot," Mew says.

"I know another way we can track them!" Tracy says, holding out a Pokeball.

Tracey then throws it and calls out, "Venonat, I choose you!"

Soon Venonat is out of the Pokeball.

Tracey turns to Venonat and says, "Use your Radar Eye to track that truck!"

Venonat uses its rader to pinpoint their location.

Venonat jumps up and down and says, "Venonat! Venonat! (I've got them! Follow me!) Then runs off.

"Venonat got their location," Mew says.

"Let's go!" Tracey says.

"Right!" Tomo says.

Meanwhile, up ahead, Team Rocket is riding down the road with Lapras tied up in the back.

"The boss ain't expecting this!" Meowth says.

"Just wait till we drop this Lapras in his lap!" James says.

Soon, Lapras begins to cry out for help.

Jessie turns it's head around and shouts, "Hey! Keep it down, you big baby!"

Suddenly, they hear Mew's voice, "There they go! Come on!"

Jessie looks to see Mew and the others are in pursuit on bicycles.

"The twerp!" Jessie says annoyed.

Lapras lets out a cry in relief to see Mew and the others are trying to save him.

Jessie turns to James, "Step on it, James, and fast!"

"Hang on!" James says, and speeds the truck.

Mew pedals faster and is catching up to Lapras.

"Don't worry, Lapras! I'll save you!" Mew says.

Lapras continues to cry out for Mew. Seeing how close she is. Mew gets on the handlebars and jumps from them to get to Lapras. Pikachu and Eevee tag along because they're hanging on to Mew.

Mew turns to Lapras with a smile, "It's okay, Lapras. We're gonna get out of this, somehow."

"Pika Pika!" (You can count on it!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee Eevee!" (We'll save you!") Eevee says.

Lapras feels a little better as Mew climbs up Lapras's back and onto the roof of the truck. That catches Team Rocket's attention.

Soon, Mew climbs in through the window, "Stop this truck!"

The truck soon begins to go down hill as the others stop to rest from exhaustion. In the truck, Mew, Eevee, and Pikachu are fighting against Team Rocket. Soon, Pikachu gives them an electric shock. Feeling dazed, James accidently leans his elbow on a button, disconnecting the trailer from the truck. Soon, the trailer begins to go faster and bumps into the truck a few times. Mew and the others escape through the passenger door. Jessie turns to see Mew, Pikachu and Eevee, hanging onto Lapras' leg.

"Hang on, Lapras! I think we're unhooked!" Mew says.

In the truck, James and Meowth are panicking. Jessie soon looks ahead and begins to panic to see they are heading to a ramp at the edge of the cliff.

Jessie screams, "Stop! Stop! Stop!"

James slams on the break and the truck and trailer are coming to a stop. But then, the truck is pushed off and is sent flying.

"Team Rocket's flipping out again!" Team Rocket screams.

Mew and the Pokemon are relieved to see this over. But suddenly the trailer begins to go backwards with Mew and the others on it.

Soon Pikachu calls out, "Pika Pika!" (We're heading for a cliff!)

Mew quickly climbs to the side and quickly pulls as hard as she can, so the trailer is able to make a sharp turn.

Just then, Eevee cries out, "Eevee Eevee!" (There's another cliff ahead!)

Mew and the others turn to see the other cliff. Mew tries to pull on the trailer, but isn't sure if she's gonna make it.

Soon, Tracy and the others from the far are trying to find Mew and the Pokemon.

Using his binoculars, Tracey has found them, "Oh no! They're heading straight for a cliff!"

"We gotta make it turn!" Mew shouts, struggling to pull.

Pikachu and Eevee try to help make the trailer turn, but to no avail.

"Come on!" Mew says, struggling.

Just then, the trailer flies off the cliff, throwing Mew and the Pokemon off. Soon, Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee are able to grab on to Lapras.

"We're gonna be okay! We'll just stick together, right, Lapras?" Mew says.

Lapras lets out a cry and is actually glad.

Mew looks down and says, "Hang on guys, looks like we're going for a swim!"

Soon, they all dive into the water.

Later on, Tracey, Misty, and Tomo search for Mew.

Tracey calls out, "Mew!"

"Where are you?!" Misty calls out.

Tomo calls out, "Mew!"

Tracey turns to Venonat, "You're sure they're around here, you two?"

"Venonat. Venonat. Venonat! Venonat!" (Positive. They're around here. There they are! On the water!) Venonat says.

Tomo translated, "Venonat said that it's saw them on the water."

Tracey turns to see something coming to them, "What's that?"

"Venonat! Venonat! Venonat! Venonat! Venonat! Venonat!" (It's Lapras! And Mew! And Pikachu! And Eevee!)

Indeed, Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee are riding on Lapras to shore.

Mew calls out, "Hey!"

"Eevee!" (Hi guys!) Eevee says.

"Pikachu!" (Ahoy!) Pikachu says.

"It's Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee! They made it okay!" Misty says, relieved.

"Lapras, too! Way to go!" Tracey says.

Mew then hugs Lapras and Lapras nuzzles her.

The next day, Pikachu, Eevee, Togepi, Pichu, Meloetta, and Skwovet are sliding down Lapras like a slide, as Mew and the others talk to Nurse Joy.

"So, Mew, it looks like Lapras has decided it wants to go with you," Nurse Joy replies.

"That's right, Nurse Joy. We're gonna travel around the Orange Islands and try to find its friends and family," Mew says.

"I'm sure you'll treat it very well," Nurse Joy says.

"Don't worry, we will," Mew says.

Then Tracey says, "And I'll be with them to help out, too!"

Soon, the group climbs on Lapras and begins to sail off to start their adventures on the Orange Islands.

Nurse Joy waves goodbye, "Goodbye! Take care now!"

Mew and her friends ride on Lapras to begin their journey on the Orange Island and battle the Orange Crew to qualify for the Orange League Competition. They'll have some adventures and excitement, and of course, they'll need to make sure not to lose the GS ball. What's more, they also have a new traveling companion with them.

Chapter 8: Episode 8: Fit to be Tide

Today, Mew and her friends are on a new adventure. Exploring the Orange Islands as Mew set out to qualify for the Pokemon League. The group of friends are riding on Lapras in the middle of the ocean under the nice bright sky. Lapras continues to swim and is really enjoying it.

"I think Lapras is having fun," Misty says.

"Yeah, and even with all of us riding, Lapras have really good speed," Tracey says.

"Come on, Mew! You can beat her!" Misty calls out.

"You go, sis!" Tomo calls out.

Senta calls out, "Don't let her win!"

Mew and Cissy continue to race the Pokemon. Mew and Lapras are determined. Cissy and Blastoise continue to hang on. And soon enough, they speed past the finish line and it shows that Lapras is the victor. Everyone is surprised. Soon, Lapras comes to a screeching halt on the shore, and Mew is pushed forward on the back of Lapras' head.

Mew laughs and says, "We did it, Lapras! We won!"

Just then, Pikachu calls out, "Pika Pi!" (Mew!)

Eevee happily says, "Eevee!" (Mew!)

Mew turns to see Pikachu and Eevee hurry over and run over as they climb on her shoulders.

"Pikachu! Eevee!" Mew happily says.

She laughs and says, "I guess we won it."

Cissy walks over and says, "Well, it was a great race. And it was pretty smart of you to use Lapras' Ice Beam to freeze the water."

"Yeah, that was the coolest!" Senta agrees.

Mew climbs down from Lapra and lands on the beach.

Cissy approaches Mew, "I can see why you won the Indigo League, and I bet you'll both do pretty well in the Orange League, too. This is the Coral-Eye badge of the Mikan gym, proof that you won your match."

Then presents the badge to Mew. Mew takes the badge to see that this badge is shaped like a pink tellins shell with a small blue gemstone on it.

"It looks like a shell," Mew says, amazed.

"Yes. All the badges from the Orange League gyms are shells," Cissy says.

"Thanks Cissy," Mew says.

Then turns to her Pokemon, "Look guys, we won the Coral-Eye Badge."

"Pi Pikachu!" (That's Badge number one!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee Eevee!" (And we need three more to go!) Eevee says.

"That was great Mew!" Tracey says.

"Yeah, but she didn't do it by herself. Right, Lapras?" Misty replies, turning to Lapras.

Lapras nods his head.

Tomo laughs, "Even Mew knows that."

Later in the evening, Mew and her friends are now riding on Lapras to another part of their journey.

Misty looks at the badge and says, "I wish I had a cool badge like that. I should've challenged her myself."

"I think you can do it, but you have to be tough to beat Cissy," Mew says.

Misty giggles, "You're right about that, she is tough.

"Glad to see that we're all happy that we got to see such a great trainer in action," Tracey says.

Misty looks and sees Tracey is sketching Cissy on her Blastoise.

"I thought you were supposed to be a Pokémon Watcher," Misty points out.

Tracey soon realizes what Misty means, "Oh yeah."

Soon everyone begins laughing.

And so, Mew has won her first Orange Island Badge and are on their way to another part of their journey. Mew has to wonder what new opponents she'll meet, what kind of gym leader and challenges are there? And how tough will it be? Right now, Mew and her friends will continue on their adventure through Orange Island.

Chapter 9: Episode 9: Pokemon Re-Volt

After the victory over the Mikan gym leader, Mew and the others continue to sail on the ocean blue witty Lapras as they relax. Of course, Mew is also planning on finding her next Orange League Challenge. While riding, Mew and Tracey chat as everyone relaxes.

"Really? So you and Tomo can understand Pokemon and were raised by them?" Tracey asks, surprised.

"Um yeah. Tomo lived in the Pokemon Preservation area with a herd of Kangaskhan before he and his mom traveled with us. As for me, I was raised by Zeraora in the forest just outside of Pallet Town," Mew says.

"I see. So that's why you call that Zeraora papa during the finals, he's the Pokemon that raised you," Tracey says.

"Right," Mew says.

"I sure like to meet him," Tracey says.

"I'm sure you will," Mew says.

Tomo turns to Mew and asks, "Hey guys, when are we gonna eat?"

Tracey looks through his binoculars, "Well, there's Mandarin Island, straight ahead."

"Mandarin Island?" Mew asks.

Mew then brings out her own binoculars from her bag, "Let me see!"

Mew observes it to see the island up ahead, but mainly sees tall buildings, "It doesn't look like an island."

Misty takes the binoculars and looks through it.

Seeing the view, Misty says, "It looks more like a bunch of giant buildings floating in the ocean."

"Mandarin Island's a huge city with skyscrapers and theaters and all kinds of neat stuff," Tracey says.

Misty sighs, "Well it sure doesn't seem like a tropical island."

"I suppose you're right Misty, but it might still be fun to go to and we can get something to eat," Mew says.

The Pokemon happily agrees.

Meanwhile, in a dark room with multiple blue screens, two familiar faces are looking at the screens which are really monitors.

A familiar female voice says, "Well, look who's come to visit."

They look at one of the monitors to see Mew and her friends riding to Lapras on to town.

"It's that kid with the Pikachu and Eevee," The familiar man says.

"I think it's payback time," The familiar woman says.

Soon, Mew and her friends have reached the docks of Mandarin Island.

"Return, Lapras. You deserve a rest," Mew says, and calls Lapras to his Pokeball.

As they are able to head to town, they soon hear the sound of trouble.

Someone cries out, "Voltorb! Don't come any closer!"

They turn their heads to see two trainers walking back from their own Pokemon. Four Magnemite, a Grimer, and a Voltorb.

Another voice calls out, "Magnemite, just get back in your Pokéball."

Soon, the Magnemite attacks the trainers.

"Looks like trouble," Tracey says.

"Let's go and find out," Mew says.

"Pika." (Gotcha.) Pikachu says.

Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee hurry to the trainers to see if they can help. Suddenly, something within Pikachu and Eevee's minds snaps and they both stop in their places. Mew stops to sense something off.

"Huh? What was…" Mew wonders.

Then turn to Pikachu and Eevee, "Hey guys, did you feel that?"

But notice the two aren't saying anything, "Uh guys?"

"What's the matter?" Tomo adds.

"Why are you stopping?" Misty adds.

Suddenly, Pikachu and Eevee turn their heads and show foul moods on their faces.

"Uh guys?" Mew says, confused.

Suddenly, Togepi and Pichu forcefully leap out of Misty's arms, Meloetta and Skwovet rush over and they all turn to their trainers with the same foul expression.

Misty grows worried, "Togepi! Pichu!"

"Meloetta! Skwovet!" Tomo says, shocked.

"Is there something wrong?" Mew asks.

Suddenly, Pikachu lets out an electric attack, pushing everyone back and they fall on the dock.

Mew quickly gets up, "Pikachu!"

Mew suddenly feels a strange presence again.

Mew turns to see Pikachu, Eevee, and the other Pokemon turning away.

"Pikachu! Eevee!" Mew cries out.

But before she can reach them, the four Magnemite circle around Mew.

"What's going…" Mew asks, but the Magnemite shocks her.

The three trainers exclaim, "What's happening?!"

Mew struggles to break free from the shock attack and continues to call out, "Pikachu! Eevee!"

But the two Pokemon ignore her.

Mew continues to struggle and call out, "Pi, ka, chu! Eee,vee!"

Just then, Voltorb rolls in front of Mew and uses Explosion, pushing Mew back and lands on the ground. The others hurry over and help her up.

"Ash, we better get out of here!" Tracey says.

Mew struggles and says, "They're, gone."

Indeed, all the Pokemon have disappeared during the Explosion attack.

One of the trainers says, "My Voltorb is gone! Voltorb!"

Another calls out, "Magnemite! Where are you?! Come back!"

Mew stands up and calls out, "Eevee! Pikachu!"

Soon, they hear a police siren, and on the motorbike is Officer Jenny.

Arriving on the scene, Jenny asks, "What just happened?!"

"Officer Jenny," Mew says as she and the others rush over.

"Togepi and Pichu were acting really weird and then there was an explosion and now they're gone," Misty says.

"Same with Meloetta and Skwovet!" Tomo says.

"So are Pikachu and Eevee! You gotta find them, Officer Jenny!" Mew panics.

"Just settle down!" Jenny replies.

Then Tracey says, "Along with our Pokémon, some other Pokémon disappeared, too!"

"In the past few days, we've had reports of Pokémon that have stopped obeying their trainers. And in some cases, even attack them, and then vanish!" Jenny explains.

Suddenly, a Gastly appears, startling the four trainers.

Jenny pushes Gastly away from her view and says, "Gastly, we're discussing official police business here."

Gastly just laughs in reply.

Soon, Mew and the others arrive at the Police Station and are on the phone with Professor Oak.

"This problem will take some thinking," Professor Oak says.

"I know what you mean. I really want to find Pikachu and Eevee, but I'm baffled on what happened," Mew says.

"Yes, but we need to find out where to look for them, and to find out what cause this strange behavior to begin with," Professor Oak says.

Mew thinks a bit and says, "I don't know if it helps, but I sensed some strange energy in the air before Pikachu and Eevee got into a foul mood. And they were fine before we got on the island. If I have to guess, I saw they didn't become like that naturally."

"I'm afraid you're right Mew. it sounds to me like some outside force is controlling their behavior," Professor Oak says.

Jenny asks, "Do you think maybe it could be some kind of psychic attack, Professor?"

"A psychic attack?" Professor Oak asks.

Just then, Gastly appears in front of the monitor.

"Gastly?" Professor Oak says, surprised.

Jenny struggles to push Gastly out of the way, "Since Gastly hasn't been affected like the other Pokémon, and because ghost Pokémon are strong against psychic types, I think a psychic attack is behind all of this. That's why I'm going to use this Gastly here to start searching for the missing Pokémon, Professor Oak." Finally able to lift it over her head.

"I see. Good idea," Professor Oak says.

Mew says, "That would explain the strange presence I've sensed."

"We're gonna do everything we can to solve this mystery and return the Pokémon to their rightful trainers," Jenny says.

"I'm sure you will," Professor Oak says.

Then Mew says, "We're going to help, too, Professor!"

"Good luck, everyone," Professor Oak says, and the call ends.

"I just can't believe that a Pokémon's doing this all by itself," Tracey says.

"I think you're right. Someone is obviously using a Psychic Pokemon for their dirty work," Mew says.

"But who? Who would do this to the Pokemon?" Tomo asks.

"That's the million dollar questions," Tracey says.

Mew sadly sighs, "I've never seen Pikachu and Eevee act like this before."

"Yeah. Meloetta and Skwovet were never like this," Tomo says.

"The way Togepi and Pichu looked at me was just horrible. Something terrible must be wrong with them. We've just got to find them. We've just got to," Soon Misty breaks down in tears.

"Officer Jenny, if we can find the Pokémon that's using its psychic attack, I just know we'll find the other Pokémon!" Mew says.

Then brings out her Pokeballs, "I know who can help us!"

Then calls out, "Gastly, Haunter, Genger, I choose you!"

With that, the three Ghost Pokemon come out of their Pokeballs.

"Wow. You got Ghost Pokemon too," Tracey says.

"Yeah. They are crazy with pranks, but they're willing to help us," Mew says.

Mew turns to the three, "Hey guys, we can really use your help. Some of our friends, including Pikachu and Eevee, are being controlled by a Psychic Pokemon, can you help us search for them?"

The three happily nod their heads in reply.

"Now then, let's head to the streets and begin searching," Jenny says.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket arrives at the city themselves.

"There it is. The Big Orange," Jessie says.

"Can we go on a guided tour, Jess?" James asks.

But Meowth says, "We ain't here to see the sights!"

And scratches them both on the face, "We're here to catch that Pikachu, so let's hurry up and catch it!"

Jessie becomes furious, "I'll teach you!"

Mewoth is about to fight back, but suddenly, his mind snaps and soon becomes dazed like the other Pokemon. Instead of attacking, Meowth runs off, puzzling Team Rocket. Soon, they chase after him.

James calls out, "Meowth, wait for us!

"Get back here, Meowth!" Jessie shouts.

Meowth continues to run as James and Meowth give chase. Soon, they arrive towards a building with a satellite dish, halfway across town.

Jessie calls out, "Meowth, what are you doing?"

"Not so fast, Meowth!" James shouts.

Jessie screams, "Stop!"

Then James shouts, "Wait up!"

Soon, Meowth enters a hole in the wall and disappears, making James and Jessie stop.

Jessie looks at the building and asks, "Hey, Jess. Look there! What is this place?"

In the building, Meowth slides to the end of the tunnel, and soon meets the two familiars who are the masterminds behind the Pokemon's change of behavior."

Meowth stands and says, "I am here to serve you."

"A talking Meowth?" The woman questions.

Then the man questions, "Could it be?"

Revealing to be Cassidy and Butch from Team Rocket.

Soon, Jessie and James come tumbling down the same tunnel Meowth has, and hit the ground.

"That was, unpleasant," James says, in pain.

Cassidy and Butch comments, "Our old friends."

Hearing the voices, Jessie and James are startled to see them.

"Cassidy?" Jessie comments.

"And Botch!" James adds.

Hearing that comment, Butch angrily says, "Ugh! The name is Butch!"

Jessie stands up with James and says, "There's only room for one Team Rocket!"

"Then prepare for trouble!" Butch says.

"You're the ones who should prepare for trouble!" Jessie angrily says.

"You two don't even know how to say the motto!" Cassidy says angrily.

Then James says, "You just made your trouble double!"

"I'm the one who has the next line!" Butch angrily shouts.

And soon, the two Team Rocket groups are arguing through the motto.

Jessie:

To protect the world from devastation!

Cassidy:

To infect the world with devastation!

James:

To unite all peoples within our nation!

Butch:

To blight all peoples in every nation!

Jessie:

To denounce the evils of truth and love!

Cassidy:

The GOODNESS of truth and love!

James:

Reach to the stars above!

Butch:

WRATH to the stars above!

Jessie:

Jessie!

Cassidy:

Cassidy!

James:

James!

Butch:

Butch!

Jessie:

Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light!

Cassidy:

Team Rocket, circling Earth all day and night!

James:

Surrender now, or prepare to fight!

Butch:

Surrender to us now, or you'll surely lose the fight!

Soon, Jessie and James feel winded for fighting motto with motto.

Then Jessie glares at Cassidy, "We say it just as good as you do!"

"So Jessie, rumor has it that you're being kicked off Team Rocket," Cassidy says.

That leaves James and Jessie stunned and shocked.

Then Cassidy clarifies, "It's just a rumor, of course. It's not official yet."

James rushes to Cassidy and asks in tears, "Did you hear rumors about me?"

Then Jessie pulls him away ,"I'll bet she's the one who started the rumor. I thought you two were still in jail.

"The boss came down to the station himself and bailed us out," Butch says.

James is in shock, "He paid? In person?"

"The boss never does anything like that for us," Jessie says, shocked.

"We're on the same team, but in different leagues," Cassidey says.

Then Meowth runs to Cassidey and rubs his face against her leg, leaving Jessie and James in shock.

James cries out, "Meowth! Don't forget who your real friends are!"

"Meowth isn't the only new friend we made here," Butch says, and points to the right, "See?"

Soon the spotlight goes on, revealing the several Pokemon, including Mew and the others' friends. Among them are: a Primeape, an Electabuzz, a Jolteon, the Voltorb from earlier, a Starmie, a Poliwag, a Vaporeon, a Wartortle, the Magnemite from earlier, a Vulpix, the Grimer from earlier, a Mankey, a Flareon, a Magikarp, and a Kingler.

Cassidey chuckles, "You wouldn't know how to catch that many Pokémon in a million years."

"But I know how we can catch that many Pokémon right now. We'll steal em from them!" Jessie says.

"Right!" James says.

Jessie calls out her Pokemon, "Go, Arbok! Go, Lickitung!"

James does the same, "Go, Weezing! Go, Victreebel!"

All the Pokemon come out, and Victreebel chomps on James' head again.

James muffles in a panic, "Don't attack me! Attack them!"

Butch chuckles and snaps his fingers, lowering a Drowzee attached to a machine down to the ground, puzzling Jessie and James.

"A Drowzee?" Jessie says, confused.

Then Butch commands, "Do it, Drowzee!"

Drowzee commences and begins to perform it's attack, much to Jessie and James confusion, unknown that their Pokemon are starting to fall under its power.

"What's it doing?" James asks.

"Who cares what it's doing?" Jessie angrily says.

Then turns to the Pokemon, "Go and get those two out of our way so we can steal the Pokémon!

However, none of the Pokemon are responding.

"They're not moving a muscle!" James says, shocked.

Jessie shouts at them, "Do what I tell you!"

All four of them begin to attack, but they're the targets.

Then Cassidey says, "Using brute strength to steal Pokémon is so unimaginative. We've created a way that's much more creative and effective."

"This device amplifies Drowzee's hypnotic rays and broadcasts it through a parabolic antennae on the roof," Butch adds.

"Drowzee's controlling the Pokémon," Jessie concludes.

"So now that both of you know our little secret, I think it's time to say goodbye!" Butch says.

Cassidy commands, "Arbok, Lickitung.."

Butch does the same, "Weezing, Victreebel.."

"You too, Meowth.." Cassidey adds.

Then they both say, "Get rid of them!"

With that, all five of the Pokemon charge to attack the terrified Team Rocket.

Later on, Jessie soon wakes up to find herself surrounded by Jenny, Mew, Tomo, the two Gastly, Gengar, and Haunter.

Jessie quickly puts up in a panic, "It's a nightmare!

"Sorry, it's real!" Tomo says with a chuckle.

Meanwhile, Misty is treating James' arm, and feels the pain from it.

James screams, "Don't be so rough, will you?"

But Misty shoots a glare at him.

"Never mind, I'll be quiet," James says, defeated.

Misty touches James arms, "Okay, you're all set." making James feel the pain.

"I think, that hurt," Tracey says.

Jessie asks, "How did James and I get here?"

"The two Gastly found you both lying in the street and you were unconscious," Mew says.

Then Jenny says, "I wonder if there's a connection between the Pokémon acting strange and disappearing and these two showing up."

"What happened to guys and what happened to Mewoth?" Mew asks.

James sadly admits, "Meowth is gone. And they've taken all of our other Pokemon, too!"

"Who's they?" Tomo asks.

"You mean, your Pokémon were taken, too?" Tracey adds.

Jessie breaks down in tears, "What's going to happen to them?"

Me turns to the others, "I think they're telling the truth."

Mew and the others can tell that Team Rocket are devastated that their Pokemon has been taken from them.

Then Jenny asks, "Who took them? Just tell me."

Jessie stands up and says, "Helping the police would blemish my perfect criminal record. James, let's go."

"Right," James replies.

"Thanks for the help," Jessie says.

Then the two start to walk out

"How can you walk away?! You're even lower than I thought you were!" Misty asks, shocked.

"If you know something, please, tell us," Tracey says.

Jenny calls out to them, "Wait! I know you're upset about losing your Pokémon, and that's just the way all the other trainers feel about losing theirs!"

Mew rushes in front of Team Rocket, "Believe me, me and the others know what it's like. Something bad has happened to Pikachu and Eevee, and all the other Pokemon who were lived by their trainers. And you're not going to leave until you tell us what you know! " Soon, Mew begins to tear up as well.

Jessie turns to James, "What do you think?"

"It couldn't hurt to help them this once," James answers.

Then Jessie says, "But only this once."

"I knew you guys would come through!" Mew happily says.

With that, they decide to set a plan into motion. Team Rocket soon lead the group to the location where Butch and Cassidy are at. Soon, the camera spots Jessie and James who are giving a friendly greeting. Cassidy and Butch notice them.

"I can't believe they're back!" Butch says, surprised.

Jessie happily says, "Hello there!"

"We've brought a little peace offering!" James says.

Then Jessie says, "We've turned over a new leaf and we want to help you and fellow Team Rocket members should."

"And to prove there're no hard feelings, we brought you something that might come in handy," James says.

Then pulls the blanket to reveal that there are actual Pokeballs in the cart.

"What do you think?" Butch asks.

"I think we could use the Pokéballs," Cassidy says.

With that, the doors open allowing Jessie and James to enter the room to greet the masterminds of the Pokemon revolt.

"So what brought about this sudden change of heart?" Cassidy asks.

"We decided we'd like to be friends," Jessie happily says.

James holds a white flag and says, "Let's call a truce so we can all be one, big, happy Team Rocket."

"This isn't like you two," Cassidy says, looking suspicious.

"Well, maybe that's because there are more than just the two of us, now!" Jessie says.

"That's right!" James says.

With that, Jessie and James push the cart towards them. Cassidy and Butch are surprised to see the cart rolling towards them. With that, the gang song along with Officer Jenny jump out of the cart. Then they all land on the ground.

Jenny points her finger at them and says, "You're under arrest, you Pokémon thieves!"

"Give me back my Pikachu and Eevee!" Mew shouts.

Then Misty says, "Yeah! Give me back my Togepi and Pichu!"

"And my Meloetta and Skwovet!" Tomo adds.

"It's all over, guys!" Tracey says.

Suddenly, Mew, Misty and Tomo are surprised to see who they are.

"It's Cassidy!" Misty says.

"And Butch!" Mew says, shocked.

Tracey turns to the girls, "You know them?"

"They're a different group of Team Rocket we dealt with before," Mew says.

Then turns to Mew, "Alright, hand over the Pokemon or things are going to get rough."

"Well, let's see if the Pokémon agree with that, shall we?" Butch says.

With that, Cassidy and Butch move out of the way, and the lights come on to reveal the Pokemon, Mew, Tomo, and Misty's friends are among them.

Mew says, shocked, "Pikachu! Eevee!"

"Togepi! Pichu!" Misty says, shocked.

"Meloetta! Skwovet!" Tomo says, stunned.

Soon Tracey notices another, "Who's that Pokemon?"

Mew sees it and says, "It's a Drowzee."

Mew then brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Drowzee, the Hypnosis Pokémon. A Psychic Type. It is said to feed on the dreams of its opponents. It is also known for its powerful Psychic attack.

"I thought that feeling was familiar. Cassidy and Butch have been using Drowzee to control the Pokemon.

Butch says to Jessie and James, "I guess you couldn't cut it as criminals, so you're working with the law."

"That's what we wanted you to think! We're only using her because she puts up a good looking front," Jessie says.

Officer Jenny nearly stumbles in disbelief.

Mew says to the villains, "You can't treat our Pokémon like this! They're our friends!"

Just then, Cassidy commands, "Drowzee, get ready to command his friends to attack!"

With that, Drowzee then uses its Psychic powers to make the Pokemon eyes glow red and prepare to attack.

Jenny calls out, "Go, Gastly!"

"Gengar! Haunter! Gastly!" Mew calls out.

With that, the three friends appear.

Cassidy then commands, "Do it, Drowzee!"

Drowzee then begins to use it's Psychic Attack on the four ghost Pokemon to control them, but that one back fires.

"Oh no!" Butch says, shocked.

Jenny calls out, "Use your Psywave!"

Gastly then performs the attack.

Then Cassidy commands, "Psychic power!

Drowzee manages to block the attack much to Jenny's shock.

Then Cassidy commands, "Have them attack!"

With that, Drowzee sends in the Pokemon to attack.

"Wow! I never knew Drowzee could use its psychic powers to do that!" Tracey says, surprised.

"They're ganging up and aiming their attacks!" Misty panics.

With that, all of the Pokemon begin to fire their attacks at once, and all together, turned into a massive beam of elements, head right towards Mew and the others. Just then, Genger, Haunter, and Gastly stand in front of Mew and the others. Together, they are able to perform a powerful protect attack and repel the attack with full force. Haunter and Gastly end up being pushed back, and struggle to remain a float, but Gengar keeps going.

"Gengar!" Mew cries out.

Genger then uses all of his might to push all the attacks back with full force, much to everyone's surprise. Gengar almost collapses, but Mew is able to catch him.

"Gengar, are you alright?" Mew asks.

Gengar is able to lift himself up and is still ready to fight.

"Are you sure?" Mew asks.

Gengar nods his head in reply/ Suddenly, his eyes glow and make something leaving her bag. It's the Gengarite Mega Stone, along with Mew's Keystone. Gengar takes the Gengarite stone while placing the Keystone on Mew's wrist.

"Are you saying…?" Mew asks.

Gengar answers, "Gengar Gengar." (Yes, we can do it.)

Mew nods her head, "Of course we can."

"I don't know what you're planning, but it appears your little friendship is over," Cassidy says.

"We'll see about that. My friendship with my Pokemon is stronger than you know. We all have special bonds within us," Mew says.

Mew lifts her wrist with the keystone up and it begins to glow. Soon, Gengar's Mega Stone begins to glow as well.

"What is that glow?!" Cassidy asks, shocked.

"Are those stones I think they are?!" Butch panics.

Tracy then asks, "Is that what I think it is…"

"Yeah. the strong bond Mew has with her Pokemon," Misty says.

Mew then taps her keystone and calls out, "Now Gengar… Mega Evolve!"

With that, the Megastone fuses with Gengar as he begins to Mega evolve. Haunter and the two Gastly are amazed to see Gengar evolving even further.

Now, Gengar has become Mega Gengar, a portion of its body sinks into the ground and its arms and tail lengthen. The lower portions turn a more reddish-purple, and a third eye appears on its forehead. This new unblinking eye is oval, yellow, and allows it to see into other dimensions. The spikes on his back are more numerous and pointed, and additional spikes appear on its hands and tail. Its ears are now considerably longer and tilt backward.

"Let's do this Gengar!" Mew calls out.

"Gengar!" (Let's!) Gengar says.

Cassidy calls out, "Drowzee has all the Pokemon attack Gengar at once!"

With that, Gengar uses its Psychic powers to command the Pokemon to perform all their attacks to create one large beam once more.

Mew calls out, "Gengar, use Night Shade!"

Mega Gengar then begins to use the attack that strikes directly at the large beam of energy. Soon, Mega Gengar's attack counters the Pokemon, causing the wind of it to push the Pokemon back a bit.

Cassidy then calls out, "Drowzee, use Psybeam!"

With that, Drowzee begins to perform Psybeam and aims it at Mega Gengar.

"Gengar, use Zap Cannon!" Mew calls out.

Mega Gengar then performs Zap Cannon which is an Electric Type. Both of the attacks collide, but Zap Cannon takes it, and strikes at the base of the machine, causing it to get electricuted.

Cassidy and Butch scream, "No!"

The machine soon begins to short circuit and explode. Soon, the machine is destroyed, and Drowzee has taken damages from the explosion. As a result, Drowzee collapses and falls unconscious. When that happens, Drowzee loses power of his attack, and all the Pokemon snap out of the trance. They all look around and can't remember what happened.

Misty is the first to rush over, "Togepi! Pichu!"

Pichu and Togpei happily turn to see Misty and hurry to Misty. Togepi and Pichu jump into her arms and give them a hug.

"Thank goodness you're both back to normal," Misty happily says.

Meloetta and Skwovet hurry to Tomo and they hug him.

"You guys are alright," Tomo happily says.

Meowth and the rest of Team Rocket's Pokemon are back to normal as well.

Meowth looks around with a confused expression, "Hey! What?! Who?! What?! Where?! What?! What's going on?"

Then Jessie and James walk to them.

"As long as you're back, everything's fine," Jessie says.

Mew turns to Mega Gengar, "You were great, Gengar."

"Geng!" (Thanks!) Gengar says.

Just then, Pikachu calls out, "Pika pi!" (Mew!)

"Eevee!" (Mew!) Eevee valls out.

Mew looks to see Pikachu and Eevee running towards her with glee.

Mew hugs them, "I'm glad you two are back. I miss you."

Jenny then calls you, "Alright, everybody. Let's clear out before there's more trouble, on the double!"

But Cassidy calls out, "Nobody goes anywhere!"

Cassidy and Buthc prepare to fight back.

But James calls out, "Weezing, SmokeScreen attack!"

Weezing then performs the attack, making Cassidy and Butch cough in pain and unable to see. That gives everyone enough time to escape outside.

Jenny and Mew call out, "Gastly, break down that gate!"

With that, both Gastly easily destroy the gate so Jenny can lead the other Pokemon out.

Jenny says, "Come on! Let's go! Back to your trainers!"

With that, all the Pokemon are able to escape.

"Is that all of them?" Tomo asks.

"Yep, all the Pokémon are free," Mew says.

"That wasn't too bad, twerp. Same for your friends," Jessie says.

Mew gives them a thumbs up in reply.

They suddenly hear Butch's voice, "his isn't over!"

Everyone looks up to see Butch, Cassidy, and Drowzee on the roof.

"We still have a score to settle! Don't we, Jessie?" Cassidy says.

"Some people don't know when to quit. Alright, Cassidy, how are we battling?!" Jessie says.

"It looks like its two on two,"

"Make that three!" Mew says.

Piakchu agrees, "Pika!" (Bring it!)

"Eevee!" (Let's battle!) Eevee says.

Gengar, Haunter, and Gastly agree.

"What do you mean?" Jessie asks.

"hey can't get away with what they did to our Pokémon!" Mew says.

Jenny calls out, "Keep your guard up, everyone! Even with that machine destroyed, Drowzee's attacks are still very powerful."

Drowzee then prepares to attack.

Mew calls out, "Pikachu, Eevee Thunderbolt!"

Piakchu and Eevee prepare the attack, but Drowzee teleports itself away and reappears in front of them.

Jessie calls out, "Arbok, Bite attack!"

Arbork lunges forward for an attack, but Drowzee teleports away.

"We'll beat em," Jessie says.

"We will?" Mew asks.

James calls out, "Tackle, now!"

All the Pokemon charge to attack, but Cassidy commands, "Use your Mega Punch!"

Drowzee then performs the attack that sends Weezing, Lickitung, and Victreebell flying back towards the fence.

"Woah! It's really strong!" Tracey says, surprised.

"Yes, as the founders of Team Rocket's breeding center, we made this one with extra strong," Cassidy says.

Then Butch commands, "Drowzee, bounce your Hypnosis attack off of that antenna and we'll take control of all the Pokémon on the island!"

With that, Mew and her Pokemon rush to stop them.

Misty cries out, "Mew wait!"

"Don't, Mew!" Tracey calls out.

"Mew!" Tomo calls out.

"Too bad there's nothing you can do to stop us, little boy. Drowzee, use your Metronome!" Cassidy says.

Drowzee then begins to use the attack. Suddenly, Togpei begins to waves his little arms back and forth

"Metronome. Now just about anything can happen," Tracey says.

Mew calls out, "Stop it!"

"Gastly, keep us covered!" Jenny calls out.

Gastly along with the Pokemon and Mew charge at Drowzee performs Metronome and Togepi perform the same. Time is running out and there is no telling what's going to happen. Just then, Togpei stops moving his arms and they begin to glow, causing a massive explosion.

Later in the evening, at the wreckage, Cassidy and Butch have both been arrested.

"Now you're back where you belong," Jenny says, and closes the door to the police van.

As the van drives away, Cassidy and Buthc says, "Looks like we're carted off again!"

"Hope we don't see you again!" James calls out.

Then Jesse says, "I bet the boss won't bail them out this time!"

"I bet he does," Misty comments.

"Who care if he does or he doesn't? As long as our Pokémon are back," Mew happily says.

"Pikachu," (Agree.) Pikachu says.

Suddenly, Mew feels a tap on her leg, she looks down to see the Drowzee that has been beaten.

"Drowzee? What are you doing?" Mew asks.

Drowzee then uses it's Psychic abilities and gently floats one of Mew's Pokeballs to Mew. Mew holds the Pokeball with a confused look.

Mew asks, "Do you… want me to catch you?"

"Drowzee," (Yes) Drowzee replies with a nod.

Mew is surprised and asks, "Are you sure?"

"Drowzee," (I'm sure.) Drowzee answers with a nod.

Mew giggles and says, "I guess you decide you have enough of Cassidy and Butch."

Drowzee nods its head in reply.

"Alright Drowzee, you can come. I hope we can be friends," Mew says.

Mew then gently taps Drowzee with her Pokeball and it goes inside. In a matter of seconds, Mew is able to catch Drowzee.

The next day at the police station, Mew and her friends are getting an award for their heroic deeds to save the Pokemon.

"And so, on behalf of all the Pokémon trainers of Mandarin Island, I hereby present you with this certificate of distinguished achievement. You and your friends are now honorary citizens," Jenny says, handing Mew and her friends each a certificate."

"Thanks," Mew says.

"We also have a special award to present to Jessie and James. But they seem to have disappeared," Jenny says.

"That's too bad," Misty says.

"These people wanted to thank them," Tracey says.

Unknown to them, Jessie, James, and Meowth are watching from the building a short distance away.

"Imagine, accepting an award for doing something good," Jessie says.

Then James says, "Yes, but it would be nice to get congratulations for doing something right for a change."

"Wrong is where we belong! We've got a job to do, and it happens to be a bad one!" Jessie declares.

"Someday, we'll capture that Pikachu, just you wait and see!" Meowth agrees.

"Yo ho!" James cheers.

Later on, Mew and her friends are sailing out of the port on Lapras as they bid their farewells. Now, they are on the next part of their journey.

"It's kinda funny, but I was just thinking that the only time Jessie and James were on the winning side is when they sided with us," Tracey says.

"Hey, yeah!" Misty agrees.

"Yeah. They only win when they team up with us," Tomo says.

"I guess that proves even they can't lose them all," Mew says.

Soon, everyone begins laughing as they continue to sail across the sea for their next adventure on the Orange Islands.

Chapter 10: Episode 10: The Crystal Onix

Mew and her friends continue their journey on the sea of the Orange Island on Lapras on a bright and sunny day.

Mew asks, "You holding up okay, Lapras?"

Lapras replies with glee. Even Pikachu, Eevee, Togpei, Pichu, Meloetta, and Skwovet are happy.

Just then, Tracey notices something through his binoculars, "Hey, what's that?"

Everyone looks to notice a bottle is floating in the water. Lapras swims over and catches it in his mouth. He then picks it up from the waver and brings it to Mew.

Mew takes it and says, "Thank you, Lapras.

Mew looks at the bottle and notices, "Hmm, there's a paper inside. A message perhaps?"

"Probably a letter," Misty says.

Pikachu wonders, "Pika Pika?" (What does it say?)

"I'll open it and find out," Mew says.

Mew then opens the bottle, takes out the letter to unfold it.

"Somebody from one of the islands nearby must have thrown it in the ocean," Mew says.

"Let's see what it says," Mew says, opening the letter.

She then reads, "'If you know anything about a Pokémon called the Crystal Onix, let me know right away.' And it's signed, Marissa from Sunburst Island."

"The Crystal Onix?" Misty questions.

"Yeah, it's supposed to be an Onix made of glass crystal," Tracey says.

Tomo asks "Is it really real?"

"Who knows? But there are people who say they've seen it," Tracey says.

"I'd sure like to see it. Wouldn't you?" Mew replies.

"Pika Pika!" (Of course I would!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee Eevee," (I sure like to meet it.) Eevee replies.

Just then, Lapras let out a cry, saying, 'Land ho!"

Mew turns her head, "Hey, look!"

"There's Sunburst Island," Tracey says.

After arriving on the island, Mew and her friends decide to walk around the island to come across the marketplace. They are amazed to see so many different stands and their wares, especially many of them offer glassware of different varieties.

"Wow! Look at all the glass!" Misty says, amazed.

"Sunburst Island is famous for having all kinds of crystal and glass shops," Tracey says.

"Wow," Mew says, looking around.

They soon look through the nearby window.

"Lots of artists live there, and they make the glass right on the island. People travel from all over the world to buy it," Tracey explains.

"Cool," Misty says.

Mew and the others walk around and the Pokemon are amazed to see the wide varieties of glass and crystals.

"Wow, everything looks so shiny!" Tomo says.

"I'd really like to buy something," Misty says.

Pikachu and Eevee get in front of a glass vase like it's a funhouse mirror.

"Careful you two, you don't want to break it. You'll have to pay for it," Mew advises.

Pikachu and Eevee nod their heads and step back away from the vase. Soon, something catches Pikachu and Eevee's attention. They see a man and it appears he's talking to a young girl with pink hair, wearing a yellow blouse, red skirt, and brown shoes.

The man sounds displeased and questions the girl, "You're still keeping this crummy shop open? Haven't you gone out of business yet?"

"No sir," The girl answers.

Soon, Mew and the others notice what's happening.

Suddenly, the man says, "I don't see why you don't close up shop. You got no merchandise. Tell your big brother he should give up already, he ain't got no talent."

"Yes, he does. He's very good," The girl says in tears.

But the merchant says, "Come on, don't start crying on us."

Soon, Mew and her friends rush over.

"What's going on here?" Mew asks.

"Is there a problem?" Misty adds.

The man grows nervous, "What's it to you? You know her?"

"I may not know her, but that doesn't mean I'm not going to help her," Mew sternly says with her arms crossed.

"All I know is being next to them is killing my business. These kids today, sticking their noses where they don't belong," The merchant says as he walks back to his shop.

Mew kneels to the little girl and asks, "Are you okay?"

"Yeah," The little girl answers.

Then Misty asks, "You don't run this shop all by yourself, do you?"

The little girl shakes her head and says, "My big brother, Mateo, helps me out a lot."

"Well, that sounds nice," Mew says.

"Except now he feels real bad and doesn't want to make glass anymore," The girl sadly says.

"Pikachu," (That is strange.) Pikachu replies.

Misty then asks, "Why don't you tell us your name?"

"My name is Marissa," The little girl says.

"It's nice to meet you. I'm Misty," Misty says.

"I'm Tomo," Tomo says.

"I'm Tracey," Tracey says.

Mew then brings out the note, "I have to assume that you wrote this."

Marissa happily says, "I knew somebody would answer my letter! You have to tell me about the Crystal Onix! Please, tell me! Please!"

Mew admits in remorse, "Sorry Marissa, but we don't know anything about it."

"We're sorry," Misty says.

"Oh. I thought for sure you found it," Marissa says, sadly.

"Is there really such a thing as a Crystal Onix?" Tomo asks.

"Sure there is," Marissa answers with a nod.

"Maybe we should all have a little talk with your brother about this," Misty says.

Soon, Marissa introduces Mew and the others to her older brother Mateo. He's a young man with brown hair, a blue shirt, dark blue pants, and brown shoes.

Mateo looks down to her sister and asks, "Marissa, have you been bothering these people?"

"She's not bothering us. Is she, guys?" Misty replies.

"Not at all," Tomo says.

"We saw her needing some help and we came to her aid," Mew says.

"Pikachu," (But of course.) Piakchu says.

"Eevee," (She didn't bother us at all.) Eevee says.

"When we first came here, all the other glass stores had tons of stuff, but yours was practically empty. How come?" Mew replies.

"Well, you see…" Mateo says.

With that, he explains the story, "When my grandfather ran the store, it was full of glass and a big success. Grandpa was a really talented artist, and he made beautiful glass Pokémon sculptures everyday. I remember seeing a man who sold Pokémon sculptures last time I was here on Sunburst Island. I guess that was him. I tried my best to follow in his footsteps, but I just can't make anything good enough to sell in the store."

Soon, Mateo turns to show Mew and the others the glass sculptures that he made.

"But these are great. Did you make them, Mateo?" Mew replies.

"They all look just like the real Pokémon," Misty says.

"Yeah. They look really amazing," Tomo says.

"Maybe, but not to me. And compared to grandpa's, they're worthless!" Mateo says.

He then tosses the Poliwhirl statue to the ground and it shatters, shocking the group.

"What a waste," Misty says.

"Pikachu?" (Yeah, but why?) Pikachu says.

"Meloetta," (Poor Mataeo.) Melottea sadly says.

Then Tracey asks, "What's so bad about them, Mateo?"

"They don't have that soul, that sparkle, that inner fire. They look like statues. Grandpa's Pokémon looked like they might come alive at any second. If I could just find some kind of inspiration," Mateo says, distressed.

"What do you mean by that?" Mew asks.

"He needs that spark," Misty says.

"It's an idea or a feeling artists need to get. If they don't have it, it's tough to create anything good," Tracey says.

"It sure sounds important," Tomo says.

Mew then asks, "But, how can Mateo find the inspiration?"

"I know I could create sculptures like my grandfather if I could just capture the Crystal Onix," Mateo says.

Mew and the others become interested.

Then Mateo says, "Grandpa used to tell me that when he was a young artist, he saw the Crystal Onix and that's what inspired him."

"You mean he saw it for real?" Mew asks.

"Yeah. It was the most amazing thing he had ever seen," Mateo says.

Flashback:

When Mateo's grandfather was young, he tried to carve a statue. Suddenly, a crystalized Onix appeared before him. It's the most astonishing thing he had ever seen.

With that, Mateo's grandfather begins to make all kinds of statues.

"For the rest of his life, grandpa turned out one great sculpture after another," Mateo explains.

Flashback Ends:

"Wow. That's a pretty amazing story," Misty says.

"Take a look at this," Mateo says.

He then showed the group the sculpture of the Crystal Onix.

"That's my grandpa's sculpture of the Crystal Onix he saw," Mateo says.

Mew and the others are amazed.

"Grandpa used to say that whenever he needed some inspiration, all he had to do was think of that Crystal Onix. I've looked for it all over the island, hoping it would give me just the inspiration that I need, but I haven't found it anywhere," Mateo explains.

Misty turns to Marissa, "So that's the reason why you want to find the Crystal Onix so much, isn't it, Marissa?"

"Right," Misty says.

Misty then turns to the others, "What do you say we stay here and help him look for it, guys?"

"Let's do it," Tracey says.

"Yeah. Let's help Marissa. Besides, it's not polite to let a letter from a little girl go unanswered," Mew says.

"Yeah. Let's search for the Crystal Onix," Tomo says.

All the Pokemon happily agreed with smiles on their faces.

"Oh, thank you, very much!" Marissa happily says.

Meanwhile, Meowth of Team Rocket is looking at a very beautiful blue glass vase.

"Let's make shopping easy. We can avoid the checkout lines, if we pick out what we want and come back later and steal it," Meowth says.

James picks up a plate, "This plate is fit for a king!"

"And these glasses are fit for a queen!" Jessie says, holding some blue glasses.

Meowth shouts at them, "Aaarrgh! Will you two listen to me?!"

Jessie and James become startled and accidentally drops the plate and glass, thus breaking them, as they shatter on the floor.

The Store wonder walks in and is not pleased by the incident, "Hey! We got a rule around here — you break it, you bought it!"

Later on, Team Rocket is now having to work to pay off what they owe the store for the destroyed merchandise. The work they have to do is chop the wood at the back.

"Why do we have to suffer this indignity?" James asks, and has chopped the wood.

Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light.

Surrender now, or prepare to fight.

Meowth, that's right!

Chapter 11: Episode 11: In the Pink

Another bright and sunny day on the tropical seas of the Orange Island. Mew and her friends continue their journey to explore Orange Island with their friend Lapras. Their trip is proven to be a relaxing one as Tomo and most of the Pokemon are relaxing and feeling the ocean air. Mew is polishing the GS ball. Tracey is trying to get Togepi and Pichu to laugh.

Tracey wiggles his fingers as he says, "Coochie, coochie, coo! Peekaboo! Boo!"

Togepi smiles and happily chirps with glee. Pichu begins giggling in reply.

But soon, Tracey notices something off, and says, "It's kinda weird."

"What is? Oh, please don't tell me you think there's something wrong with Togepi," Misty asks in concern.

"No. Not wrong, exactly," Tacey answers.

Then says, "But, you'd think Togepi would have learned at least one attack by this time."

Misty kind of frowns at the statement and says, "I know what you mean, but it's not like I haven't tried to teach Togepi any attacks."

Flashback:

One time, Misty has a piece of wood wrapped in some cloth of some kind. She is mainly using it as a training target for togepi.

"Okay, Togepi. Just hit your head, like this. That's a Headbutt," Misty says, and gently taps her head on it.

Togepi then hugs the training target instead.

"Oh boy," Misty replies, lowering her head.

She stands up and says, "No, no! Not like that! Like this!"

She then slams her head on the target, knocking herself out in the process. Togepi ends up rubbing the bad bump she has received herself.

Flashback.

"I've tried to do my best," Misty replies, sadly.

But cheers up and gives Togepi a hug, "But nobody could have a better Pokémon than my Togepi."

"Togi Toge Toge," Togepi happily replies.

Then hugs Pichu, "And of course, Pichu is great too."

Pichu happily cheers, "Pichu!"

"Don't worry Misty, I'm sure Togepi will be able to learn an attack in due time. Besides, Togepi is still young so he should learn the basic moves like Growl or Pound," Mew says.

"What kind of attacks can Togepi learn?" Tomo asks.

"Well, Togepi is a Fairy Type so it would have some Fairy Type moves like Fairy Wind, Sweet Kiss, Charm, Baby-Doll Eyes, and if you train it well, it can learn moves like Draining Kiss and Moon Blast. Of course, it can use other moves like Ancient Power, Metronome, Double Edge, Last Resort, and other kinds of attacks. You could also teach Togepi to use other types of attacks, but that will have to wait until Togepi can learn to battle," Mew says.

"I suppose. I think I should also do the same for Pichu. Pichu does learn Thundershock, but well, it can use some work," Misty replies.

Suddenly, the waves begin to get a bit rougher.

"What's going on?!" Mew asks, in fright.

Tracey notices something up ahead, "It's not a current! It's a whirlpool! A big one!"

Mew calls out, "Lapras, get us away from here!"

"It's already got us!" Misty panics.

Soon enough, everyone gets pulled into the whirlpool with no hopes of escaping.

Time has passed, and Mew is able to wake up, washed up on an island of something.

Mew mumbles, "Pikachu? Eevee? Misty? Tomo?"

With that, the others get over Mew's vision for her to see.

"We're okay. Are you?" Misty asks.

"Pika Pi." (Mew.) Pikachu says in concern.

Eevee asks, "Eevee Eevee?" (Are you okay?)

"I'm okay," Mew answers, sitting up.

She looks around and asks, "Where are we?"

Suddenly, she hears Tracey reply, "Could it be?"

Everyone turns their heads to see Tracey looking around with his binoculars, observing the island.

"Shear cliffs? A giant whirlpool?" Tracey replies.

And soon says with excitement, "Alright! We're on Pinkan Island!"

"Where?" Tomo asks.

"Pinkan Island. It's this mysterious place that's surrounded by these humongous whirlpools! And with those giant cliffs, hardly anybody's ever explored it! So nobody knows what kind of Pokémon live on the island! I might be the first Pokémon Watcher to discover a whole new type of Pokémon! Come on, let's hurry!" Tracey says in excitement, and runs towards the cliffs.

"Hurry?" Mew asks.

"Hurry where?" Misty replies.

Tracey turns to the others, "Up these cliffs. I just gotta see the Pokémon!"

"Wait up!" Mew calls out.

Pikachu calls out, "Pika Pikachu!" (Don't go too far, Tracey!)

Mew quickly calls back Lapras, "Lapras, return!"

"Tracey, slow down! I'm coming with you!" Mew calls out, and follows Tracey

"Me three!" Tomo calls out.

Ben: We all are!"

"What is it?" Mew asks.

Mew brings out her Pokedex and it shows the Rhyhorn is gray, not pink.

Dexter says, "Rhyhorn, the Spikes Pokémon. A Ground and Rock Type. Rhyhorn is known for its physical power and its considerable offensive and defensive battle skills.

"The one in here sure isn't pink," Mew quietly says

Then climbs and walks over to observe the Pink Pokemon.

"Tracey, be careful. Rhyhorns will charge if you're not careful," Mew quietly says, concerned.

"Mew, don't worry, I'll be careful," Tracey says.

Tracey checks the wind with his finger, "Downwind is, that way."

Then crawls closer to the Rhyhorn without being discovered.

"Just stand still, Rhyhorn. And I will sketch a masterpiece," Tracey says.

With that, Tracey begins to sketch the Rhyhorn as quickly as he can. He brings out his binoculars that can judge the length and height of his subject.

Tracey mutters to himself, "It looks to be about 8 meters long, and one meter high."

Then moves closer, "And it's horn is 20 centimeters long."

"I don't think he should be getting that close," Tomo whispers.

As Tracey draws the picture, Mew and the others watch from a farther distance.

"But he's doing so well. I have to admit, he's amazing. It is his line of profession after all," Mew says.

She's right. He's a Pokémon Watcher, Ash. He knows a lot more than you and Mew. After all, you both had a different way of observing Pokemon," Misty says.

"Pika." (She's right.) Pikachu says.

"Eevee," (Tracey's really good.) Eevee relies.

Suddenly, Rhyhorn stops eating and begins to sniff a little.

Mew mutters, "I think Rhyhorn smells something."

Before it can react, a large pink Beedrill flies out of the tree and frightens the Rhyhorn. Causing it to move back, and soon, it ends up charging towards Tracey in fright.

Mew cries out, "Tracey, look out!"
