Chapter 12: Episode 12: Shell Shock!

Still under the sunny skies, balmy breezes, Mew and her friends continue to sail across the sea and probably heading towards another tropical island for their next adventure. And possibly find the next Orange Crew Gym Leader to battle.

Mew stretches her arms with a smile, "This is great!"

"Yeah, the skies are blue, the sun is warm, and Togepi, Pichu, and I are having a great time! Right?" Misty replies.

Togepi and Pichu happily answer with a reply.

"Yeah. It's great to go swimming," Tomo says.

Meloetta sits next to Tomo as she feels the wind in her face and hair.

"With the ocean temperature this high, I wouldn't be surprised if we saw lots of cool Pokémon swimming by," Tracey says, looking through his binoculars.

Suddenly, Tracey hears a sound and looks through his binoculars to see boats coming in their direction.

Tracey calls out, "Hey, look!"

Mew turns her head and calls out, "Look out!"

With that, the boat zooms right past then, splashing the water on them and getting them wet.

Misty shouts in anger, "Watch where you're going!"

"I wonder why they're in such a hurry," Tracey replies.

Tomo soon notices something ahead, "Maybe there."

Mew and the others look to see that the boats are speeding towards an island.

"It looks like they're headed to that island," Tracey says.

"Maybe we should go check it out," Mew replies.

Soon enough, Mew and the others reach the island's beach.

"Thanks for the ride, Lapras. You better rest for a while in your Pokéball," Mew says, and calls Lapras to his Pokeball.

Once Lapras is in his Pokeball, the group hear and turn to see a news crew. They see a woman with blue hair, pink shirt, ivory pants, and brown boots.

The news reporter says through the microphone in front of the camera, "Our exclusive report continues! I've just arrived on Fukuhara Island Four, which has recently become the object of so much speculation. Does this lush location, uninhabited by humans, hold the key that would unlock the secret to the extinct Pokémon? An archaeological team is about to begin their historic explorations. And we'll be with them if and when they solve the Kabuto mystery."

Then says to the camera crew, "And cut!"

"Nice job," The camera guy says.

Soon, the T.V crew walks away.

"Kabuto mystery?" Tracey says, interested.

"Historic exploration?" Misty says, confused.

"Fukuhara Island Four?" Tomo says, confused.

"Sounds like this could be interesting. Why don't we follow them and find out?" Mew says.

Everyone answers, "Yeah."

With that, Mew and the others follow the camera crew to a campsite. There, they see the reporter and the TV crew. Right now, they're filming the next scene.

The TV reporter says in front of the camera, "I'm here at the team's base of operations for this fossil hunt, and for a world television exclusive. A first look at the object that's triggered their investigation. Beneath the layers of silt and soil, are the fossilized remains of the long extinct Pokémon, Kabuto. Caught in a fisherman's net a week ago, experts working round the clock have determined that it was somehow dislodged from its ancient resting place on this island, and drifted into the international spotlight."

"I can't believe they found a real Kabuto fossil!" Tracey says, amazed.

Tomo then says, "If you want to see something just amazing, Mew has caught a real Kabuto."

"She did?" Tracey asks, surprised.

"Yeah. And an Omanyte, Aerodactyl, and she got a fossilized Lileep that we restored at Cinnabar Island," Tomo says," Tomo says.

"I'm impressed. Did you guys get a restored fossil Pokemon? I like to see them," Tracey asks, interested.

"Sure. We can show you to them later," Misty says.

"Still, I guess there aren't too many Kabuto fossils around, huh?" Mew says.

"Yeah, this is like a major find that Pokémon Archaeologists from all over are gonna want to study," Tracey says.

"Let's see what info Dexter has about them," Mew says, bringing out her Pokedex.

Dexter says, "Kabuto, the Shellfish Pokémon. A Rock and Water Type. Though this Pokémon is now believed to be extinct, it had a hard shell that protected its body and is believed to have been a powerful swimmer."

Then the reporter says, "Now, let's get an up close and personal perspective on this investigation from the director of the archaeological team."

She turns her head and asks, "Can we speak to you?"

The director steps out of the tent, and the director is Nurse Joy dressed in a safari outfit.

"Sure," Nurse Joy says.

Everyone becomes surprised, "Nurse Joy?"

Nurse Joy walks over and says, "One of the main reasons we've come here is to learn everything we can about the habitat of the extinct Pokémon, Kabuto. We'd also like to find out if there's any truth to the claims about Kabuto oil."

"Please, tell us what these startling claims are," The reporter replies.

"Well, legend has it that the oil from Kabuto shells not only brings good health, but it can make people live forever," Nurse Joy says.

"Live forever?!" Everyone says, surprised.

"Of course, we know that's impossible, but there could be some basis to the legend, and Kabuto oil may prove to be a great historic importance to medical science," Nurse Joy adds.

"Fascinating," The reporter replies.

Suddenly, Mew's Kabuto has let himself out of his Pokeball on his own.

"Kabuto!" Misty says, surprised.

Tracey is amazed, "Wow! A real live Kabuto, and it looks like you raised it well!"

"Thanks," Mew says.

Then kneels to Kabuto, "Hey Kabuto, you want to see a Kabuto fossil."

Kabuto doesn't answer and crawls over to the camera crew and the director. Then climbs up the table and looks at the fossil. That causes the crew by surprise.

The reporter says, surprised, "A real living Kabuto?! Amazing!"

"Kabuto!" Mew panics and rushes to him.

Mew picks Kabuto and calmly says, "You shouldn't do that, it's not polite."

"Oh, so is that Kabuto yours?" Nurse Joy asks.

"Um yeah. This little guy is mine," Mew says, sheepish.

Meanwhile, out in the ocean, Team Rocket is spying on Mew and her friends through the periscope in their submarine.

"I wonder what a TV crew could be doing with those twerps on that island," Jessie wonders.

"Just because you're wondering doesn't mean you should stop pedaling!" James says.

"Hey, if we hurry up an' catch Pikachu, maybe we could catch some face time on television, too," Meowth says with excitement.

Liking the idea, Jessie starts pedaling

Meanwhile, on the island, the expedition crew is prepared for their expedition.

"Okay! Is everybody ready?!" Nurse Joy asks.

Everyone confirm with excitement

"This dedicated band of explorers is beginning a torturous trek to find where the mysterious Kabuto fossil could have come from. And we'll be here to record every dramatic moment of their adventure," The reporter says.

With that, the expedition is underway. Mew and the others follow Nurse Joy with her team, and the TV crew into the forest.

Mew turns to Kabuto who is sitting on Mew's head, "You doing okay, Kabuto?"

Kabuto makes a happy sound, letting her know that he's okay. Pikachu and Eevee walk alongside her along with the others with interest in the expedition. As they walk through the forest, they are being stalked and followed by a mysterious figure.

The TV reporter says, "We're about to begin our climb along a treacherous mountain path, but these brave explorers seem incapable of fear."

With that, everyone begins to climb on the narrow edge, and Misty is scared stiff. However, they continue to climb on the narrow ledge. Meanwhile, far below on another ledge, Team Rocket is trekking as well, following Mew and her friends.

"James, you're lagging behind," James says.

Then Meowth says, "Yeah, walk a little faster, will ya?"

"That's easy for you to say," James whines because he's the only one who is carrying a heavy backpack.

"Well, nobody told you to bring that heavy backpack," Jessie says.

Then James talks back, "And nobody told you to bring that nasty attitude, either, but I'm stuck with both!"

Meanwhile, the Growlithe leading the way, senses something. Even

One of the members asks, ""What's the matter, Growlithe?

"What are we stopping for?" Nurse Joy asks.

Mew steps forward and says, "Growlithe senses something up ahead.

"Up ahead?" Nurse Joy questions.

She looks ahead to see a giant rock, "Oh, that's just a big rock."

Soon the rock starts to move and begins rolling down the hill towards the group.

"Run for it!" Mew calls out.

With that, everyone begins to run for it.

"We'll be okay, Togepi! Pichu! Get inside!" Misty says, and places the little ones in her backpack.

The reporter announces, "A giant boulder is bearing down on us as this group scrambles for survival!"

As the group runs from the mountain, the group has no idea that the figure that has followed them is the one responsible.

"We're gonna get squashed if we don't think fast!" Misty panics.

Then Mew calls out, "Nurse Joy! Try using the Machoke!"

"That's a great idea, Mew!" Nurse Joy says.

Then calls out, "Machoke, get in there and block that rock!"

The two Machoke turn around and stop the boulder with their strength, luckily, the boulder has come to a stop.

"Yes! A superpowered pair of Machoke have saved the day!" The reporter cheers.

The two Machoke picks up the boulder and tosses it into the abyss.

"Alright!" Tomo cheers.

"With the boulder cast safely aside, the team's rejoicing over the last minute miracle!" The reporter says.

On the ledge below, the boulder soon lands towards where Team Rocket are. Then sends James further down.

James screams, "This is gonna hurt!"

Jessie and Meowth can only watch as the boulder sends James down the mountain.

Meanwhile, up the mountain, the mysterious figure continues to stalk the archaeological team and the others, but Pkachu and Eevee senses its presence. Mew and Kabuto senses something as well. They turn their heads to see no one is there.

Mew whispers, "Hey guys, you get the feeling someone's following us, too, right?"

"Eevee Eevee," (We sure are.) Eevee says.

"Pika Pikachu," (I think we're not alone) Piakchu says.

Kabuto expresses his concern as well.

Mew whispers, "Let's keep an eye out."

The Pokemon agree and they all continue forward. The figure then comes out of his hiding place again. Soon, they come to an end of the ledge.

"This is it," The archaeological member says.

"Oh, wow!" Mew says,amazed.

Everyone is amazed by what they're seeing.

The reporter says, "We have finally reached our destination, a hidden bay here on the island's desolate northern shore, where experts believe the recently discovered Kabuto fossil may have come from. As you can see behind me, this team of explorers has already begun their painstaking work. Rhydon and the Machoke are assisting in the operation, but will any new Kabuto fossils be discovered here? All these dedicated scientists can do is work, watch, wait, and see."

With that, all the archaeologists, along with Mew and her friends begin to work on finding any more Kabuto fossils.

Misty says in exhaustion, "I never thought we would be digging fossils again."

"Yeah. I almost forgot that digging for fossils is hard work," Tomo says.

"You have to make sure you examine everything carefully, too," Tracy says, examining a fossil.

"Yeah, but it's all worth it!" Mew says.

Suddenly, without warning, rocks and boulders begin tumbling down the top of the rock wall.

Eevee senses something and calls out, "Eevee! Eevee Eevee! (Hey guys! I think we've got trouble!"

Everyone looks up to see the boulders are rolling down right towards them.

The noise attracts the attention of everyone at the camp.

`Hurry! Run for it!" Nurse Joy calls out.

The news reporter says, "This excavation is off to a rocky start, as a dozen or more giant boulders are raining down on this intrepid, but terrified group!"

Soon, the boulder heads right towards the TV crew.

Nurse Joy calls out, "Rhydon, Horn Drill that rock, now!"

With that, Rhydon leaps into action and uses Horn Drill to shatter the boulder to pieces.

The reporter cheers, "Amazing! For the second time today, a Pokémon saves the group from almost certain disaster!"

Rhydon lets out a victory roar.

"Nice work, Rhydon!" The reporter says.

Kater on, Mew and the others are investigating the area where the boulders used to be before they fell.

"Guys, I'm starting to think something strange is going on. This happened to us twice since we got here," Mew says.

Then Misty says, "I think you're right. What if maybe these accidents aren't really accidents and instead somebody out there who's trying to get rid of us?"

But Tracey says, "Come on, this island is deserted."

"Maybe you're right," Misty replies.

"I don't know, but me along with Pikachu, Eevee, and Kabuto sense that someone has been following us since we got here. Even the Growlithe senses something.

Suddenly, Pikachu sees the figure running away.

Pikachu calls out, "Pika!" (Hold it!)

"Pikachu wait!" Mew calls out and chases after him.

"Mew, wait!" Everyone calls out.

Pikachu, Eevee, and Mew hurry into the forest.

Soon, Eevee notices, "Eevee Eevee," (Mew, look up ahead!)

Mew looks ahead to see the figure running away as Pikachu and Eevee catch up.

"So, he's the one who's been dropping those rocks on us!" Mew says.

Mew says, "Pikachu, Eevee, follow him. I got an idea."

Pikachu and Eevee rush after the figure instantly as Mew goes a different way. Pikachu and Eevee continue to chase the figure's tail. Mew is running towards the figure.

She jumps out and shouts, "Gotcha!"

With that, Pikachu, Eevee, and Mew tackle the figure to the ground.

"Alright, you!" Mew says.

But before anything else, the figure stands up and sends the group off of him. Mew and the others look up to see the figure standing before them.

"What do you want with us?" Mew demands.

Just then, the sound of a man says, "Leave this island before it's too late."

Mew and the Pokemon look at the figure as he repeats himself, "Leave this island before it's too late."

"What?" Mew says, confused.

Just then, Mew hears Misty's voice, "Mew!"

Mew turns her head to see the others running towards them.

"Mew!" Tomo calls out.

"Hey, guys! Is everything okay?!" Tracey asks.

"Yeah, and the guy who's behind those rocks is right there!" Mew answers, standing up and points to the man.

"I'll tell you the same thing I told them! Get off this island!" The man says.

Just then, the man revealed to be somewhat of an elderly man, with slightly tan skin, gray hair, thick gray eyebrows. He is wearing a blue vest, light blue shirt, green shorts, and some kind of shell necklace,

"Are you the one who's responsible for all the accidents with those boulders?" Nurse Joy asks.

"You bet I am!" The man says.

Then the reporter says, "Now, a shocking revelation as this deranged old man claims responsibility for those brutal attacks."

The old man gets in front of the camera, "I'm not that old and I'm definitely not deranged! I'm just trying to do you people a big favor!"

"A big favor?!" The reporter says, shocked.

"You call those rocks favors?!" Mew questions, disapprove of the action.

"The only thing you've done is put our lives in danger!" Misty says.

"Who are you anyway?" Tomo adds.

"I am Umberto. And the claim of you putting your lives in danger, that's not true. I tried to scare you off to protect you from danger," The man says.

"Scare us off? That's a weird way of putting us," Mew says.

"To protect us?" Tracey questions.

Then Tomo asks, "From what kind of danger?"

"Tell us what you're talking about," Nurse Joy adds.

"I'll tell everybody," Umberto says.

He then takes the microphone from the reporter.

The reporter gets upset, "Hey! That's my job!"

Then Umberto announces, "Hear and heed the ancient prophecy! When the scavengers arrive, the moon will glow an angry red. The land itself will vanish, and be swallowed by the sea."

"Swallowed by the sea?" Tracey says, confused.

"What does that mean?" Tomo asks.

"If you disturb this island, you will bring about great harm!" Umberto says.

But Nurse Joy says, "But we didn't come here because we wanted to do any harm to the island, Umberto! We came here to study Kabuto fossils and that's all! We don't want to harm anything!"

Yet Umberto says, "You cannot disturb what lies here! Now go!"

Misty says, angrily, "Well, who are you to start blaming us for disturbing your precious island?! You're the one who's disturbing the island by rolling those boulders and causing those rock slides, mister!"

"She's got a point there. You could just talk to us," Mew says, shrugging her shoulders.

But Umberto shouts, "Quiet! Just stop arguing and get off Fukuhara Island!"

Just then, a member of the expedition team comes running as he calls out, "We found one! We found one! We've just found another Kabuto fossil!

"Let's see it!" Nurse Joy says.

"Alright!" Tomo happily cheers.

Everyone rushes over to see the fossils, but Umberto is not pleased for being ignored.

Later on, the group explores the cave where the fossil is sound. Soon enough, they are able to find the Kabuto fossil.

One of the team members says, "There it is! Right there!

"There's no doubt about it! This is a genuine Dome Fossil!" Nurse Joy says.

"Wow!" Mew says, amazed.

The reporter says, "As you've just seen, the team has actually discovered a Dome Fossil, exclusively on PXT!"

Soon, Tracey spots something, "Could this be a..?"

Then uses his magnifying glass to observe it, "Hey! I just found another one!"

Mew and the others rush over.

"This is a fossil, too! And this one! This is a really nice one, here!" Tracey says, looking around.

Nurse Joy says, "It looks like the walls of this cave are made of Dome Fossils!"

Everyone looks around to see that the walls are indeed made of Dome Fossils.

"They sure don't look like fossils," Tomo says.

Nurse Joy takes out one of the shells and says, "See? These may just look like rocks, but they're actually Kabuto shells."

"Wow. This is amazing!" Tomo says.

"Skwovet," (Amazing.) Skwovet says.

"Loetta," (Really amazing.) Meloetta says.

Soon, the news reporter says, "This underground graveyard grotto is actually a mega mausoleum! A monument constructed by these incredible, calcified Kabuto carcasses!"

Mew and Kabuto look around and for some strange reason, Mew is starting to have an uneasy feeling, especially Kabuto.

Suddenly, one of the archeologists says, "Okay, let's bring in Rhydon and start collecting!"

He rushes to go get Rhydon, but Umberto blocks his way.

Umberto warns them, "Stop! Disturbing this island will bring disaster!"

"We're not disturbing, we're collecting," The member says.

Suddenly, the cave starts to rumble and crack.

"The cave's caving in!" The member panics.

Nurse Joy screams, "Everybody out!"

With that, everyone begins to rush to the exit.

The reporter says, "Our exclusive report is taking yet another dramatic twist! What could it be this time?"

Soon, the smoke begins to clear a little, and enough to see two familiar figures, and hear a familiar motto, Team Rocket's motto.

Jessie:

Prepare for trouble!

James:

Make it double!

Jessie:

To protect the world from devastation!

James:

To unite all people within our nation!

Jessie:

To denounce the evils of truth and love!

James:

To extend our reach to the stars above!

Jessie:

Jessie!

James:

James!

Jessie:

Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light!

James:

Surrender now or prepare to fight!

Meowth:

Meowth! Dat's right!

"Them again!" Mew and the others call out.

Then Jessie says, "So sorry we can't stay and snipe, but we've got to haul away this beauteous bounty of Kabuto booty!"

"These'll make great doorstops at the boss' mansion!" Meowth says, holding the shell.

But Umberto gives them the same warning, "No! If you disturb the Kabuto, a great disaster will befall us all!"

"Really?" James questions.

Soon Team Rocket begins laughing.

Then Jessie says, ""We wouldn't take them without giving you something in return."

James pulls something from his back pocket, "Here, catch!"

Umberto catches the object. Thinking it's a bomb, he passes it to Tracey, who passes it to Nurse Joy, who passes it to Misty, who swats it away from her and into Tomo's hand, who passes it to Mew's hands.

Soon, Mew sees the fuse on the bomb.

"Mew, it's going to explode! Throw it away!" Misty calls out.

Mew quickly disposes the bomb just in the nick of time, but the blast causes the cave to cave in and more. Soon, the fossils on the walls and ceiling fall to the ground and Team Rocket snatches it with a net.

"Our behavior is simply aBOMBinable, isn't it?" Jessie says and laughs.

Then the reporter announces, "A trio of thieves has just escaped with a cache of Kabuto fossils right through the roof! And that's just where my numbers are gonna go when these reports start airing!"

"Don't you TV people care about anything but ratings?!" Misty questions.

Team Rocket's balloon begins to carry the fossils up into the air as they laugh in triumph.

"We won the shell game!" James says.

"Success at last!" Meowth says.

"Even that red moonlight can't stop us now!" Jessie says.

Mew hears what Jessie says and asks, "Wait, did she just say red moonlight?"

Soon, the light of the now bright red moon touches the Kabuto fossils, they begin to change color, and soon begin to move. Soon, Pikachu, Eevee, Kabuto, and even Mew notices something is off with the fossils in the cave. Soon fossils in the cave begin to change color and come to life as well, and everyone is starting to notice.

Tomo asks, "Do, fossils move?"

"No. Something's happening," Mew says.

Then Misty asks in fright, "What's happening?"

"The Kabuto fossils are returning to life," Mew says.

Tracey says, "He's right! The Kabuto fossils are coming back to life!"

"That's impossible!" Nurse Joy says, shocked.

The reporter says, shocked, "As incredible as it may seem, the ancient Kabuto fossils now appear to be alive!"

Just then, a Kabuto falls onto the camera, causing the cameraman to become startled and drips the camera. The camera falls to the ground and breaks, destroying the footage on it.

The reporter panics, "Everything we've shot is in there!"

Umberto calls out, "Run for it!"

With that, everyone begins to run as a wave of Kabuto charges towards them.

Misry screams, "From now on, I'm going to listen to all those ancient prophecies!"

"I think Team Rocket is going to learn that lesson as well," Mew says.

Speaking of Team Rocket, they find that the Kabuto fossils they collected are now coming to life and start attacking them.

Mewoth screams, "Hey! Get off of me, you selfish little shellfish!"

"Hey, that tickles!" James panics.

Soon one of the Kabuto pierces a hole in the balloon, throwing all of them on board to the ground or to the sea, as Team Rocket are blasting off.

Team Rocket screams, "We're blasting off again!"

Meanwhile, Mew and the others evacuate from the cave to find the other archaeological team.

Nurse Joy calls out, "Come on, we're leaving!"

The workers become puzzled.

"Leaving? Why? What's the matter?" One of them asks.

"We've got to get everyone off Fukuhara Island, immediately!" Nurse Joy says.

One of them asks, "I don't understand. Is something wrong?"

Soon, the island begins to rumble like an earthquake.

Mew calls out, "Ash: Hey, Joy! Look!"

Everyone looks to see Kabuto falling off the side of the cliff and into the ocean. It's like they're attached to the cliff.

"Are those, Kabuto?" Nurse Joy asks.

Soon, they see another cliff lose the Kabuto that's been holding it in place.

Nurse Joy realizes, "This whole island must have built up around the fossilized Kabuto!"

"Then that means.." Tracey says.

Soon Mew realizes and says, "The island is breaking apart!"

Everyone begins to panic.

One of the members panics, "Let's head for the boat and get out of here!"

But the other says, "We can't! The boat's too far away! There's nowhere we can run to!

Just then, Umberto calls out, "The forest! The prophecy says that when the sea comes to swallow you, flee to the forest, build rafts and save yourselves.

"Build rafts?" Mew questions.

Soon, Misty feels the water on her feet, "We're starting to sink!"

"Which means we don't have time," Mew says.

Then Umberto says, "To the forest!"

"It's our only hope! Come on! Nurse Joy says.

"Hurry!" Tomo calls out.

The reporter asks, "Have you seen my makeup kit?"

"I think it's on the boat," One of the news crew answers.

Under the light of the red moon, all of the Kabuto begin to leave the island. Meanwhile, Mew and the others call out their Pokemon along with Nurse Joy and their Team, everyone working together to build rafts to save themselves.

"This is even more exciting than my two part special report on Kadabra spoon removal!" The reporter says, excited.

The Island continues to break apart and begins to sink .Soon, the water comes towards everyone on the island.

Misty cries out, "The water's coming!"

"Get on the raft!" Umberto calls out.

Mew calls out, "Lapras! Squirtle! Wartortle! Gyarados, help us out!"

Then Misty calls out, "Goldeen! Staryu! Tirtouga!"

With that, all the Pokemon are let out of their Pokeballs.

"We need your help to pull the raft out to sea," Mew says.

Then throws the ropes and everyone have a rope to pull

Mew calls out, "Okay, let's go!"

With that, the Pokemon pulls the rafts along the wave for them to escape. As the waves come at them, it knocks down the trees in their way. The Pokemon hurry to get all the humans out of the island. Finally, they make it out to the open sea and safety.

"Wow! We made it!" Mew says, relieved.

Soon, Fukuhara Island 4 completely submerges and sinks into the water.

Soon, the group remembers the prophecy that Umberto explains to them as they see the Kabuto floating in the sea looking at the red moon in the dark night sky.

Tomo is the first to say it, "When the scavengers arrive.."

Then Mew, "The moon will glow an angry red.."

And Nurse Joy says, "The land itself will vanish, and be swallowed by the sea."

"Just like the prophecy," Misty replies.

Then Tracey says, "The Kabuto must have been lying dormant for centuries in their fossilized form until the light from the red moon awakened them."

"Maybe that Kabuto oil let's them live forever, after all," Nurse Joy says.

She then walks to Umberto and says in remorse, "All I can say is that I'm so very sorry that I didn't believe the prophecy and the warnings you gave us."

"I think it's best that the world never learns the Kabuto secret," The reporter says.

Then turns to the rest of the crew, "Right?"

"I think you're right. Thank you," Umberto says with a nod.

With that, the large herd of Kabuto begins to depart.

"Where do you think those Kabuto are going?" Misty wonders.

"They must be looking for a place where it's safe. A new home where they can rest in peace until they come alive again," Tracey says.

"Well, I hope they find a safe, new home," Mew says.

Pikachu, Eevee, and Kabuto agree on the idea.

Everyone watches as all the Kabuto leaves the sunken island to find a new home for them to live. And so, another mystery of the Pokemon world has been revealed, and is best to keep hidden from the world.

Chapter 14: Episode 14: Bye Bye Psyduck

Today, after traveling across the Orange Islands, Mew and her friends decide to take a break for a little rest and relaxation. Misty is splashing in the water with some of her Water Pokemon. Pikachu and Eevee, Meloetta and Skwovet. Togepi, Pichu, Golduck, and Psyduck, are riding on Lapras' back. Tracey and Tomo are relaxing in the sand. Mew is giving the mysterious GS ball a little polish.

Out in the water, Pikachu and the other Pokemon are having fun while Psyduck is sleeping on Laras' back and Golduck sits beside him. Suddenly, Psyduck slips into the water. Lapras ends up swimming away without realizing it. Psyduck continues to sleep while floating on the water, until he rolls over and sinks. Golduck jumps off and swims after him.

Moments later, the Pokemon begin to freak out, realizing that both Psyduck and Golduck are gone, and everyone begins to notice.

Tracey sits up and wonders, "What's going on?"

Then everyone rushes over.

"What's the matter, guys?" Mew asks.

When they arrive, Tracey notices, "Seems like something's missing, doesn't it?

"You're right, Tracey," Mew says.

Misty is the first to realize, "Oh no! My Psyduck and Golduck are gone!"

Meanwhile, there is a young girl with long blue, purple eyes, with a pink outfit in a boat fishing. She is with a Tentacruel who is swimming beside her.

The girl says, "It's awfully quiet today."

Just then, something begins to come up to the surface near the boat and the girl's tentacruel. The first is Psyduck who is in a panic because he can't really swim well. Luckily he is saved by Goldduck, much to his relief. The girl is confused by what she has witnessed.

Meanwhile, Mew and her friends have sent their Water Pokemon to search for Psyduck. So far, no luck.

Misty asks, "No sign of Psyduck? Or Golduck?"

The Pokemon answers. Misty and the Pokemon are worried.

"Don't feel bad, you all did the best you could," Mew says, and gets Lapras's Pokeball, "Lapras, take a rest!"

Then recalls Lapras to his Pokeball.

"I'm sure Psyduck and Goldduck are okay. They couldn't have gone too far," Mew says.

"But where could Psyduck and Golduck have gone off to?" Tomo wonders.

Suddenly, they hear a girl's voice, "Excuse me."

The group turns to see the young girl who's been fishing earlier.

The girl says, "You wouldn't be looking for this, would you?"

Then Tentacruel swims in with Psyduck in one of its tentacles while Golduck is on Tentacruel's head.

Everyone becomes shocked.

Misty speaks up, "Psyduck! Golduck!"

Everyone soon begins to notice that Psyduck's tail is glowing pink.

Later, the girl brings the two Pokemon to shore. Psyduck and Golduck are glad to be with Misty. Soon, the group are getting acquainted with each other.

Misty says to the girl, "Thanks a lot for finding Psyduck for me. These are my friends, Mew, Tracey, and Tomo. My name's Misty.

Then the girl introduces herself, "My name's Marina."

Then Marina kneels down to see Psyduck's pink tail.

Then says to Misty, "I'm not sure, but from the way its tail is glowing, I'd say your Psyduck's getting ready to evolve."

"Evolve?" Mew says, sounding unsure.

Then Marina says, "A Pokémon trainer told me. She said sometimes, before they evolve, a Psyduck's tail starts to glow pink, just like this is."

Misty turns to Psyduck, "So, are you ready to evolve, Psyduck?"

"duck?" (Evolve?) Psyduck says, confused.

"I guess Psyduck would evolve into a Golduck, right Mew?" Tomo asks, turning to Mew.

"That's right," Mew says.

She brings out her Pokedex, and Dexter says, "Golduck, the Duck Pokémon. The evolved form of Psyduck. A Water Type. Golduck is very adept at using its webbed at using its webbed hands and feet, making it the fastest swimming Pokémon of all."

"Wow. Golduck sounds like a really cool Pokémon, huh, Misty?" Tomo replies, turning to Misty.

Misty and Marina happily say, "Golduck is one of my very favorite Pokémon!"

Both girls gasp in surprise.

Then Misty says, "You sound like you know a lot about Water Pokémon, Marina.

"Well, that's because I'm a trainer and I specialize in training Water Pokémon," Marina says.

"Really? Me too!" Misty says, really amazed.

Marina happily says, "No way! Why didn't you say so?"

Then begins to happily express her love for Water Pokemon, "I just love the way water Pokémon can float and swim and dive and surf and squirt!""

"I know! I know! Don't you love the cute way they waddle around?" Misty happily says.

As they talk, the group look a bit dumbfounded.

"I guess they like talking about water Pokémon," Mew says.

"From my observations, I'd say that's true," Tracey replies.

The Pokemon agree.

"Here, look at these," Marina happily says.

She then brings out her small box, and opens it to reveal her lures, "I never buy my Pokémon lures, I always make them myself."

Then shows Misty her special fishing lure that looks just like her, "I make all my lures, too. And this is my most beautiful one!"

Then Marina happily says, "Maybe someday, I'll capture one of the legendary Pokémon."

"I'd love the chance to catch one of the dragon types that live in the ocean!" Misty happily says.

"You think we could do it?" Marina asks.

"I sure hope so," Misty says.

Just then, Misty says, "But there's one thing I don't understand."

"What?" Misty replies.

Then Marina asks, "How come your Psyduck doesn't know how to swim?"

Hearing the question, Misty begins to stammer and try to come up with a reason.

"I was wondering about that myself," Tomo says.

"Well Psyduck has always been a special case," Mew says.

"Let's watch and see how she gets herself out of this one," Tracey says.

After thinking, Misty laughs nervously and says, "Yeah, it sure is a rare Psyduck, like Mew said. Psyduck is kind of a special case."

"Special case?" Marina says, interested.

Mew steps forward and says, "Well, Psyduck's Water abilities are well, lately developed as they say, but he seems to have strong Psychic abilities when his headache becomes severe enough."

"I see," Marina says.

"Yeah, but my Golduck has been very helpful to Psyduck, and Golduck is a good teacher as of lately," Misty says.

"Sounds nice," Marina says.

Then she has an idea, "Hey Misty, why don't we have a Pokémon battle to see which one of us is the better trainer?"

"Okay, Marina!" Misty says, liking the idea.

Meanwhile, somewhere in the waves of floating Tentacools, Team Rocket's submarine appears to raise its periscope. Jessie is looking through the periscope to find Mew and her friends.

James asks, "No sign of those kids?"

Meowth angrily shouts, "Well I know I wouldn't have lost them! Why don't you let me steer for a change?!"

Jessie angrily gives Mewoth an evil eye, and smacks him on the cheek, causing him to spin her hair.

"Backseat driver," Jessie responds.

Then James says, "If we can't find Pikachu, maybe we can find someplace to have lunch."

Meowth stops spinning and holds his sore cheek, "Or at least some place with an ice pack."

Jessie growls in anger and turns to the you be quiet?! I'm sick of your complaining! I told you I'd find those brats, and I will!"

She then looks through the periscope again, and spots Mew and her friends, "Bingo! Twerps at twelve o'clock!"

Meanwhile, back on the shore, Misty and Marina are going to have a Pokemon battle.

Marina suggests, "How about a 3-on-3 match?"

"Okay!" Misty says.

"Wow, an all water Pokémon battle! I wanna make some sketches of this!" Tracey says.

"Go Misty!" Tomo calls out.

"Yeah. You can do it!" Mew calls out.

"Thanks guys! Now just watch and see what I can do!" Misty says.

"I wanna win this match, so I better start off with something really cool! So I choose you, Tentacruel!" Marina calls out.

With that, Tentacruel comes out of the water.

"And I'm gonna start off with a Pokémon that's as good as gold!" Misty says, holding her Pokeball.

She then throws the Pokeball as she calls out, "Goldeen!"

With that, Goldeen is out of her Pokeball and in the water.

Marina happily says, "Your Goldeen is such a sweetie!"

"Thank you!" Marina says.

"But just being cute doesn't mean it's gonna win this battle!" MArina says.

"Right," Misty says, and brings out a different Pokeball.

She then opens it and little Mudkip comes out.

Misty says to Mudkip, "Mudkip, I'm going to have a water Pokemon battle so I want you to watch."

"Mudkip," (Okay.)

"Aww, what a cute little Mudkip, I never seen one before," Marina happily says.

"I'm glad you like it. I want Mudkip to watch the match," Misty says.

"Great. Now let's start," Marina says.

Then calls out to her Pokemon, "Tentacruel, Wrap attack!"

Tentacruel extends its tentacles towards Goldeen.

Misty calls out, "Goldeen, use your Agility!"

Goldeen dodges the oncoming tentacles as she swims in the water.

Then Misry calls out, "Horn Attack, now!"

Goldeen charges with full force.

"Wow. Misty really seems to know how to handle her Pokémon," Tracey says, sketching in his sketchbook.

"She does, but I'm sorry on what Tnetacruel's next move is," Mew replies.

Misty says with confidence, "I'm gonna win this!"

Then, Goldeen's horn glows and then it leaps in for an attack.

But Marina says, "Don't bet on it, Misty! Tentacruel, Poison Sting!"

Tracey and Mew call out, "Look out!"

In the matter of seconds, Tentacruel's Poison Sting directly hits Goldeen.

Misty cries out, "Goldeen, no!"

"Perfect!" Marina cheers.

Goldeen then flashes into the water from the attack. Soon, it floats back to the surface, knocked out.

"Looks like Goldeen's out and Tentacruel wins!" Tracey says.

Just then, Marina says, "I think I probably forgot to mention that my real specialty is water Pokémon that have some characteristics of some other types of Pokémon, too!"

"I get it! Tentacruel is a water type and a poison type with abilities of both types!" Tracey understands.

"So it has an advantage in battle," Tomo replies.

"Tentacruel does, and it seems to have strong Poison Type Attacks," Mew says.

Misty asks her Pokemon, "Goldeen, are you okay?"

But Goldeen is knocked out.

She then brings out her Pokeball, "You did your best." And calls it back inside.

Then Misty brings out another Pokeball, "Now I choose you, Staryu!"

With that, Staryu comes out of its Pokeball.

Marina is ecstatic, "I just love Staryu!"

"I think Staryu is one of my most favorite Pokémon of all," Misty says.

"And yours really sparkles, Misty!" Marina says, excited.

"Do you think so? I wanted to keep Staryu looking good, so I polished it the other day!" Misty says.

Marina calls out, "You did a really great job!"

"I'm so glad you like it!" Misty happily says.

Mew calls out, "Are you two just gonna talk all day?!"

"Oh, alright," Misty replies.

Then calls out the first attack, "Staryu, Swift attack, now!"

Staryu then launches the first attack and directly hits Tentacruel before it can do anything, knocking it out instantly.

"Your Tentacruel's really strong, Marina, but it's too tired to fight off Staryu's Swift attack!" Misty says with pride

Marina says to her Tentacruel, "Nice work, Tentacruel, but you better take a rest."

Then Tentacruel swims off the battlefield.

"Now I think I'll use one of my strongest Pokémon!" Marina says and throws her Pokeball.

Soon, a Psyduck comes out of Marina's Pokeball, and flexes his muscles. Mew and the others are surprised.

"A Psyduck!" Mew says.

"Wow, that sure doesn't look like yours, Misty," Tomo says.

"Yeah. This Psyduck can be strong," Mew calls out.

"Yeah, I forgot how tough a Psyduck can be!" Tracey says.

Marina calls out to Misty, "I don't know how you used that rubbery Psyduck of yours, Misty, but now I'll show you how powerful a Psyduck can be if you train it the right way!"

A bit offended, Misty calls out, "Staryu, Water Gun!"

With that, Staryu sprays the attack towards Psyduck.

Then Marina calls out, "Psyduck, Confusion!"

Psyduck then uses its Confusion attack to deflect the water upward and back down at Staryu, knocking it out.

"Staryu!" Misty calls out.

Staryu rises from the surface, and its gem is flashing red. Which means, Staryu is unable to battle.

Misty brings out Staryu's Pokeball, "I think you better come back and take a rest." and calls Staryu back to its Pokeball.

"I guess Staryu isn't shining so brightly, now," Marina comments, making Misty Irritated.

Then Marina says, "Hey! Why don't we let our Psyduck battle?"

"Tracey's right!" Tomo says.

Misty looks at her Pokeball and says, "And Psyduck would become a Golduck. Yeah! Go, Psyduck!" And throws her Pokeball.

However, when the Pokeball opens, nothing is coming out and it falls into the water, leaving everyone confused.

"I guess that one was, empty, "Misty says, embarrassed.

Everyone falls over in disbelief.

Misty begins to sweat bullets, "Even great trainers make mistakes."

Then calls out, "Hey, Mew! Hurry up and throw me Psyduck's Pokéball!"

"Sure Misty!" Mew cays.

She then reaches into Misty's backpack to search for Psyduck's Pokeball. However, she suddenly remembers how many Pokeballs Misty has, and has trouble finding it.

Then Misty calls out, "If you can't tell, just throw me my backpack and I'll find it!"

"Okay," Mew says, and tosses Misty's backpack, "Catch!"

Misty reaches out for it, but she misses and it falls into the water.

"Mew!" Misty says, annoyed.

"Oops. Sorry, Misty," Mew replies.

Misty then reaches into the water, "I hope I can find it."

Misty soon grabs her backpack, but sees something has its head in it, shocking her and everyone else.

Marina asks, shocked, "Is that..?"

"No way!" Mew says, surprised.

"Pika?" (What is?) Pikachu questions.

"Toge?" (That thing?) Togepi replies.

Confused, Eevee wonders, "Eevee Eevee?" (Is that a head?)"

"Pichu?" (A head?) Pichu replies.

"Mudkip," (A head.) Mudkip replies, confused.

Misty pulls her backpack off and reveals that it's a Golduck inside it.

Misty and Marina shout in surprise, "It's, a Golduck!"

With that, Golduck exits the water with a flare.

Misty and Marina gushes over it, "Wow! Cutie!"

Soon Golduck starts posing around for Misty, Marina, and the others.

Misty lunches towards Golduck, "You're here!" and hugs Golduck, "And I can't believe you're mine!

"What a great Golduck! I've never seen a Golduck as great as that one!" Marina happily says.

"Everybody used to yell and say all kinds of bad things about Psyduck, but nobody's gonna say bad things now!" Misty happily says.

Then turns to Golduck, "Right, Golduck?"

Golduck gives Misty a thumbs up.

Tomo whispers to Mew, "The one who said most of those things was Misty."

Tracey whispers to Tomo, "Love is a complicated thing.

Tomo is confused.

Then Tracey says, "Obviously, Psyduck wanted to evolve for Misty because it loved her back."

"I just know now we're gonna make a great team, Golducky!" Misty happily cheers.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket continues to spy on Mew and her friends from a distance

Noticing Golduck, Jessie says, "There's a Pokémon I've never seen before."

"Great! We can grab Pikachu, and that one, too!" Meowth says.

"Yeah!" Jessie and James agree.

Soon, the Submarine begins to travel towards the battlefield.

Marina says, "This should be interesting." Then calls out the attack, "Go, Psyduck! Confusion!"

Marina's Psyduck uses Confusion and commands a tidal wave to rise and rush towards Golduck and Misty.

Golduck leaps, and using Confusion, it rides the wave away and back towards Psyduck and Marina.

Marina turns to her Psyduck, "Did you do that, Psyduck?"

This shocked Pikachu and Eevee," Pika?! Eev?! (What the?!)

Suddenly, Golduck hears a group of girls laughing, and Golduck hurries over to them instantly and shows off in front of them. The girls soon enjoy it.

Misty and the others turn to see Godluck holding on to Psyduck's webs and gently drags Psyduck along the water close to the shore as he kicks his legs. Then Misty turns to Marina and asks, "Hey Marina, is Psyduck still going to evolve to Golduck. You said Psyduck's glowing tail meant it was gonna evolve!"

Marina is practically sweating bullets and nervously laughs, making that it's not really true. Misty is not happy about it.

Marina walks to Misty and says, "You should be happy, Misty. This proves you really are a great water Pokémon trainer."

Later in the evening, Mew and her friends depart from the island as they wave goodbye to Marina.

Misty's Psyduck may not have evolved, but is able to win the match, despite the other Golduck not being hers. And Psyduck ends up getting a little training thanks to Golduck. And the most important thing is that Misty is a step closer from becoming a Water Pokemon Master.

Sailing on the ocean blue by Lapras, Mew and her friends continue their journey across the Orange Islands. Tomo, and the Pokemon relax on Lapras as Mew polishes the GS ball, Tracey is looking around the ocean with his binoculars, and Misty is playing with Togepi and Pichu.

Coming towards them at top speed, is Nurse Joy, padding a kayak towards their direction and speeds past them with Chansey behind holding a megaphone like a rowing instructor. Soon, the two speed right past Mew and the others.

And Eevee chuckles in reply.

Everyone is at shock to see this.

Magikarp resurfaces to thank Nurse Joy and expresses its feelings towards her.

Magikarp blushes as Nurse Joy blows it a kiss. Then dives down into the water.

Nurse Joy calls out, "Bye bye, now!"

Mew and the others are amazed by Nurse Joy's display.

Tracey heads to Nurse Joy and asks, "You and Chansey whizzed by us in a kayak before. Do you paddle from island to island and treat Pokémon?"

"We sure do," Nurse Joy answers.

And explains, "Lots of the Orange Islands are way too tiny to have their own Pokémon Centers, so my Chansey and I visit the smallest islands. And we both do whatever we can to help as many of the sick and injured Pokémon as we can find."

"I KNEW that was it!" Reacey says, amazed.

Then begins sketching a drawing, "I wanna make a quick sketch. I'll call this one; Nurse Joy, the Pokémon's Florence Nightingale."

"My name's Misty. I'm trying to learn everything I can about water Pokémon," Misty says.

"And I'm Mew. And I'm learning to be a great Pokemon trainer," Mew says.

Nurse Joy chuckles and says, "Sounds to me like Tomo has a healthy appetite. I have a clinic on this island, so why don't you come along and be my guest for lunch?"

"Good idea, Tracey," Misty agrees.

"Yeah," Tomo replies.

When her mind flashes back.

Flashback:

Little Nurse Joy picks up the Magikarp and takes her home. She tends it and takes care of it as it heals in a fish tank. Little Joy smiles, and the little Magikarp blushes.

Little Joy waves goodbye and says, "Bye-bye, Magikarp! I love you!"

Flashback:

Several years later, young Nurse Joy is sitting on a boat in the middle of the ocean with some of her Nurse Joy relatives. Little Nurse Joy is observing the fishes and she accidentally falls in, getting the others' attention. Just then, little Joy resurfaces on the back of a larger Magikarp.

Nurse Joy explains, "The Magikarp that saved me was the same one I helped."

Flashback Ends:

Then Nurse Joy explains, "That's when I decided to dedicate my life to Pokémon. Especially Pokémon who don't have trainers to love and care for them."

"Was the Magikarp we saw today the same one that you found?" Misty asks.

"That's right, and we've been good friends ever since that day," Nurse Joy answers.

Everyone is amazed to hear Nurse Joy's story.

"That's a great story, Nurse Joy," Misty says.

"You know what? That proves people and Pokémon can be friends for their whole lives," Tracey says.

Nurse Joy chuckles and says, "You're so right."

Later, outside the clinic, Nurse Joy and Chansey are going on another assignment, and the winds begin to change.

Concerned, Tracey asks, "Nurse Joy, you're not going back out again, are you?"

"I've got to make one more stop before I finish my rounds today," Nurse Joy says.

"Sorry, Nurse Joy. I guess I must've thrown you off your schedule," Tomo says.

"Oh, it happens all the time. When you're dealing with Pokémon, you have to expect the unexpected," Nurse Joy says.

"But at this time of year, you know what these kinds of winds can mean! You've been in the Orange Islands long enough to know when it blows like this, a hurricane's on its way!" Tracey says.

"A hurricane?!" Misty says, worried.

"It's just too risky to go out there again!" Tracey says.

"I know how dangerous it can get, Tracey, but there's a group of baby Seel out there who aren't doing too well, and they're counting on me to help them. I'll be back in just a little while," Nurse Joy says.

Nurse Joy and Chansey simply walk away.

Tracey calls out, "Nurse Joy, please! Please, just wait until the storm passes!"

However, Nurse Joy and Chansey are already paddling out to sea, leaving Mew and the others behind.

"There she goes," Tomo says.

"Maybe she'll be okay," Misty says, worried.

"I know Nurse Joy will be okay, but… the winds do look risky to be out right now," Mew says.

Tracey then grabs his kayak oar, and is ready to go after Nurse Joy and Chansey.

"Tracey, don't you get any ideas about chasing after Nurse Joy!" Mew says, concerned.

"It's too dangerous!" Misty says.

But Tracey says, "Look at that sky."

The group looks up at the clouds to see dark clouds are rolling in.

Then Tracey says, "And look at that sea."

Then look to see the waves are getting rough..

"If I let Nurse Joy go out there alone, I'd never forgive myself," Tracey says, and walks to his kayak.

"There he goes," Misty says.

Then Mew says, "Come on! We're going, too!"

"I knew she'd say that," Misty says.

Later, out at sea, Nurse Joy and Chansey rowing in the storm.

Suddenly, she hears a familiar voice, "AHOY!"

Nurse Joy turns back to see Mew and the others following her.

"Hey! Nurse, Joy!" Tracey calls out.

Nurse Joy is shocked, "What are you doing?!"

Soon, a big wave comes in from behind Mew and the others, and sends them flying and landing in the rough water. Soon, everyone resurfaces.

Nurse Joy calls out, "Are you all okay?!"

"Yeah!" Mew calls out.

"I think so!" Misty says.

Nurse Joy then calls out to the others, "Let out all your water Pokémon, quick! There's a little island nearby! Have them all follow me and I'll paddle there!"

"Okay!" Mew says, and brings out two of her Pokeballs.

She then calls out, "I choose you, Squirtle! Wartortle!"

With that, both of her turtle Pokemon come out of their Pokeballs.

Then Tracey calls out, "Go, Marill!"

Marill materializes out of the Pokeball.

Then Misty calls out, "Staryu, go!"

Staryu then comes out of its Pokeball. Psyduck materializes soon after. Squritle and Wartortle help Tomo and Mew along with Pikachu and Eevee stay afloat.

"Thanks, Squirtle. You too, Wartortle," Mew says to her Pokemon.

"Marill, I'm counting on you," Tracey says.

Psyduck begins to swim a little, but struggles to swim through the storm.

Misty shrugs her shoulders and helps Psyduck to Staryu.

"Why did you come out of your Pokeball? You're still learning how to swim," Misty questions.

Psyduck shrugs his shoulders and answers, "Psyduck." (Want to learn to swim.)

Soon enough, the hurricane has passed, and everyone is on an island Nurse Joy mentions. Mew and the others feel that they end up causing Nurse Joy some trouble.

"Well, I guess we caused more trouble than the storm," Misty says.

"Yeah, and instead of us saving Nurse Joy, she was the one who helped save us," Misty says.

Tracey turns to Nurse Joy and says, "I apologize, Nurse Joy."

"That's alright. You were only trying to help me. Why don't we all take a little rest, and then we can visit those baby Seel?" Nurse Joy replies.

Everyone agrees with the idea.

However, out in the ocean near the island, a periscope pops spots Mew and her friends. The periscope belongs to Team Rocket's submarine. Of course, Team Rocket decides to follow them again.

Seeing them, Jessie chuckles, "There's our Pikachu. Maybe we should launch a direct assault and grab it."

"Ain't that chancey?" Meowth asks.

"Yes, that's Chansey! We'll grab that one, too! Along with Eevee, of course," Jessie says.

"Well, whatever plan we use, this time, I know we're gonna win!" Meowth says with a smile.

"You seem awfully confident today," James replies with a deadpan expression.

"No way we can lose! Not with the secret weapon I've come up with this time, Jimmy," Meowth says, and brings out a controller.

He then presses the button, and launches a Magikarp shaped projectile to the surface and towards Mew and her friends. Soon, Mew and the others notice it.

"What is that?!" Tracey asks.

"Let's get out of here!" Mew says.

But before they can leave, the head of the projectile pops off and releases a net, trapping everyone.

"Oh no! Are you all okay?" Tracey asks, looking around.

"Yeah, but we're totally trapped, and I bet I know who trapped us," Mew says.

Right on cute, Team Rocket's Magikarp submarine surfaces as they laugh in triumph

Confused, Nurse Joy says, "Magikarp?!"

"That's not a real Magikarp! That's Team Rocket's submarine!" Misty says.

"Who's Team Rocket?" Nurse Joy asks.

"They're a bunch of crooks who steal everyone's Pokemon," Mew says.

Soon, the hatch opens and Team Rocket comes out to say their motto.

Jessie:

Prepare for trouble, ahoy!

James:

Make it double, Nurse Joy!

Jessie:

To protect the world from devastation!

James:

To unite all people within our nation!

Jessie:

To denounce the evils of truth and love!

James:

To extend our reach to the stars above!

Jessie:

Jessie!

James:

James!

Jessie:

Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light, light, light!

James:

Surrender now, or prepare to fight, fight, fight!

Meowth:

Meowth, dat's right!

Then says with pride, Well, it looks like we got ourselves a net gain of three Pokémon.

"Lucky us!" Jessie and James happily say.

Annoyed, Mew demands, "Why can't you leave us alone?!"

"As long as you have that Pikachu.." Jessie says.

"We three, to you, will stick like glue!" James says.

"Poecy!" Meowth replies.

In her thoughts, Nurse Joy says in concern, "What am I gonna do? The sick baby Seel are waiting for me. I have to get out of here somehow. If I don't, who knows what will happen?" She struggles to get out of the net, but it won't break.

Nurse Joy soon thinks of the poor Seel who are sick, "Those poor Seel. Please. Please let something happen to save them." and begins to shed tears.

Just then, a giant figure swims up towards Team Rocket's submarine and smacks it. This catches Team Rocket and the others by surprise.

"What was that impact?" Jessie asks, surprised.

"Did we hit something?" James wonders.

But Meowth says, "No way! We weren't moving!"

Just then, the giant Magikarp leaps from the water and towards Team Rocket. Team Rocket are shocked.

Jessie exclaims, "What's that?!"

"A mammoth Magikarp!" Meowth screams in fright.

Mew and the others are very surprised to see it.

Nurse Joy calls out, "Magikarp!"

"How did it know to come here?" Tracey wonders.

Team Rocket quickly regains themselves.

"Let's get rid of it!" Jessie says.

"We'll rip this water type weakling!" James says.

Then Giant Magikarp rams into their submarine again. I then ram at the submarine again.

Just then, Meowth says, "Hey! What am I worried about? No way, our metal Magikarp can lose this match!"

However, Giant Magikarp continues to ram at them, not giving up, but it's also getting badly battered in the process and is going to get hurt.

"It's no good," Tomo says.

"hat Magikarp's not strong enough to beat Team Rocket!" Misty says.

Magikarp continues to tackle the submarine. Magikarp then uses Tackle, but hits its head and crashes into the water.

He desperately gets up and says, "Kaarrp, Magikarp!" (Let my friends go!)

Nurse Joy becomes scared and teary eyed.

She then cries out, "It's no use… Magikarp!"

Seeing Nurse Joy shed tears, Magikarp becomes more determined to save her. Soon, Magikarp begins to glow.

"What's happening?!" Jessie asks, shocked.

The bright blinding light begins to change its shape, and reveal a giant Gyarados before them.

"It's Gyarados!" Nurse Joy says, surprised.

"It evolved right in front of us!

"And it's a big one," Tomo says.

"It's as big as Mew's, maybe bigger," Misty says, surprised.

And with that, Gyarados gives Team Rocket a hard smack with its tail, sending the submarine and Team Rocket flying.

Mewoth says, "Our timing was way, way off!"

"We got involved when it evolved," James says.

Team Rocket screams, "Now we're blasting off again!"

Soon, Team Rocket flies far across the sea.

"There they go," Mew says.

"Great job, Gyarados," Tracey says.

"And pretty far," Tomo says.

Soon, the group notices Gyardos turns to them, and begins to worry.

"It, doesn't look too friendly," Tomo says.

"I think we were a lot safer with Team Rocket," Misty says, worriedly.

Soon, Gyardos charges towards Mew and the others, causing them to freak out as they prepare for the possible attack. However, Gyardos nuzzles Nurse Joy instead, making everyone fall to the ground in disbelief. Then Gyarados removes the net off of New and her friends.

"It didn't attack us," Tomo says, a little surprised.

"Well what do you know, even when it evolved, Gyarados is still as friendly as ever," Mew says.

"You're right, It evolved into Gyarados, but it's still got Magikarp's personality," Misty says.

Nurse Joy strokes Gyardos and says, "Thank you. Thank you so much, my old friend."

Later on, Mew and the others arrive at the island where the baby Seel are. Nurse Joy gives one of the baby Seel some medicine to make it feel better.

"That wasn't so bad. You'll be fine now," Nurse Joy says.

Then place the baby Seel down. Soon, all the Seel are feeling better now and thank Nurse Joy for the help. Later on, Nurse Joy spends some time with Gyarados.

"Looks like those calcium tablets and that tussle with Team Rocket were just what you needed," Nurse Joy says, petting Gyarados.

"Nurse Joy and Gyarados, really do get along together, don't they?" Mew says.

"They're like best friends," Tomo says happily.

"They're just picture perfect," Misty says.

"Well, if we all just treated our Pokémon and each other with the same kind of care and love and respect we deserve, the world would be picture perfect," Tracey says, and looks at his sketch of Nurse Joy and Gyarados.

Nurse Joy turns to Mew and says, "I almost forgot! You mentioned that you train to be a great Pokemon trainer, didn't you, Mew?

"You bet I do," Mew says with a nod.

"Then you should make a stop over at Navel Island. There's an Orange League gym there where you might be able to win a badge," Nurse Joy says.

"Navel Island," Mew replies.

Then happily says to her Pokemon, "Okay, that's where we'll go!"

"Pi Pikachu!" (And we're ready!) Pikachu says.

"Eev Eevee!" (Yeah, let's go!) Eevee says.

And so Mew and her friends say goodbye to Nurse Joy and are now making their way to Navel Island for Mew's next gym battle to earn a badge.
