Chapter 16: Episode 16: Navel Maneuvers

Today, Mew and her friends are riding on Lapras through the ocean. They're heading to Navel Island where Mew hope to earn a second Orange League Badge. Soon, they notice something up ahead.

"There it is, Navel Island," Tracey says.

The group looks ahead to see the island has a very large mountain that gives up to the clouds.

"Look at that mountain," Mew says.

"It's really big," Tomo says.

Then Misty says, "I wonder what kind of badge they have at the gym there."

"I think it's called the Sea Ruby badge because it's made out of a seashell with a ruby in it," Trace says.

"The Sea Ruby badge," Mew says.

Then Tomo says, "I wonder what kind of battle you have to do."

"We won't know until we get there. Now, let's get to that island," Mew says.

"Pi Pikachu!" (Full speed ahead!) Pikachu cheers.

Then Eevee cheers, "Eevee!" (Let's go!)

Soon enough, Mew and her friends reach the island and find a small village.

"This place sure is quiet," Misty replies.

"Seems like it's deserted," Tracey says.

"And I don't see any gym around here, either," Mew adds.

"Where is everybody?" Tomo replies.

Just then, Mew and the others look out to the ocean to see a sailboat sailing by. They soon see a young man with brownish colored hair. He is wearing an orange Hawaiian T-Shirt, blue shorts, and ivory shoes. He is also listening to tropical music on the boombox. Mew and her friends become surprised and notice the sailor sails to the shore where they're at.

The man says, "Hi! I bet you guys are looking for a gym battle."

"Uh, yeah," Mew replies.

"Well you came to the right place. It's nice to meet you all. I'm Danny," The young man says.

Mew smiles and says, "Hi. I'm Mew.

"And my name's Tracey," Tracey says.

"Pika Pika! Pikachu!" (Nice to meet you! I'm Pikachu.) Pikachu says.

Then Eevee says, "Eevee Eevee." (Hi. I'm Eevee.)

"I'm Tomo," Tomo says.

Then Meloetta says, "Mel Mel Meloetta." (I'm Meloetta, nice to meet you.)

"Skwovet Skwovet." (I'm Skwovet.) Skwovet says.

Finally Misty introduces herself. "Oh! My name's Misty."

"Misty, eh? That beautiful name suits you," Danny says with a smile.

Shocked, Tracey and Tomo questions, "You mean, her?"

The Pokemon do seem a bit confused.

Danny walks over and reaches his hand to Misty, "My pleasure, Misty."

"Nice to meet you," Misty does the same and shakes hands.

"I've seen lots of beautiful things on these islands, but nothing as beautiful as you," Danny says.

Misty blushes and asks, "Beautiful as me?"

Tomo and Tracey are confused, so do Pikachu and Skwovet. Mew, Meloetta, and Eevee giggle as they cover their mouths.

Unknown to Mew and the others, Team Rocket is spying on them once again on the island.

"There they are," Jessie says. She laughs and says, "Now, I know we've suffered several significant setbacks, but just remember that old saying: 'A twerp and her Pikachu and Eevee are soon parted.'"

"Well, it can't be soon enough for me, Jessie," James says.

Then Meowth questions, "We gonna win this time?"

"Yeah!" Team Rocket answer.

Back on the island, Danny has changed his clothes and is carrying a backpack. Soon, the group is following Danny.

"Looks like you've got everything you need in that backpack," Misty says.

"Well, you can't be totally prepared for the surprises life has in store, but I always try to plan where I'm going and know what I'll need before I do something," Danny says.

"That's such a mature way of looking at things, "Misty says.

"Yeah. It's always good to be prepared before going on an adventure. Of course, sometimes things don't always go as planned and you still have to stay on top of it," Mew says.

"And let's not forget that some trainers travel with trainers who know different ways of training and Pokemon," Misty says.

"Kind of like us," Tomo says.

"Yeah," Misty says.

Danny laughs and says, "Sounds to me like you all are pretty close to one another."

"Huh? What do you mean?" Misty asks.

"Well, you all seem to have different values and you're able to get along despite different situations," Danny says, and walks off.

Misty follows after him. Mew and the others follow after him.

Tomo then begins to wonder, "I wonder who Danny is, is he a local?"

I guess he's another trainer, and he must be here to challenge the Navel gym leader just like you," Tracey says.

"It's possible. Looks like I got a rival for this badge," Mew says.

Soon, Mew and the others arrive at the Navel Gym.

"This is the place. Let's go in," Mew says.

Mew and Tracey open the doors and to her and her friend's surprise, they find a path that goes up towards the mountains, and a cable car lift right next to it.

"There doesn't seem to be a gym here, just a path that goes up the mountain and a cable car," Mew says.

"Maybe we have to take the cable car to get to where the gym is?" Tomo suggests.

But Pikachu notices something ahead, and calls out, "Pika Pi! Pika!" (Mew! Look there!)

Mew looks to see a sign right next to the path.

"Maybe that sign has instructions," Misty says.

"Let's see," Tracey says, and leans to the sign.

He then says, "It says: 'Welcome, Pokémon trainers.'

"Odd welcome," Mew says, confused.

Then Tracey reads, "'All Navel gym challengers must climb to the top.'"

"Climb to the top?!" The three humans say, surprised.

Even the Pokemon are surprised. Everyone looks up to see the large mountain in front of them.

Then Tracey says, "Wait, there's more. 'Trainers must reach the top on their own. Pokémon may not provide help. Any trainer using a Pokémon will be disqualified.'

"Talk about a challenge," Mew says.

"Yeah," Tomo says.

"Do we have to climb up, too?" Mew asks.

Tracey answers, "It says, 'Those accompanying the challenger should ride the cable car.'"

"So I have to climb the mountain by myself," Mew says, surprised.

Then Pikachu climbs on Mew's shoulder and says, "Pi, Pika Pika!" (Hey Mew, We know you can do it - just give it your best shot!)

Then Eevee climbs on Mew's other shoulder, "Eevee Eevee Eev Eevee." (Yeah. You can do it Mew. You can climb up that mountain.

Mew nods her head with a smile, "You're right! Yes! I can do it if I try!

Pikachu and Eevee cheer "Pika! Eev!" (Let's do it!)

Danny simply smiles to see Mew and her friends having spirit.

Sometime later, Danny and Mew are climbing up the mountain. Danny is climbing the mountain with ease as Mew is not far behind. Piakchu and Eevee climb up the mountain with them. Mew climbs up to the ledge where Pikachu and Eevee are. She looks down to see how high up they are and how far the ground is.

Danny calls out, "Is everything okay, Mew?

"We're okay. It's just a little tiring climbing up this mountain," Mew calls out.

A few more feet later, Danny continues to climb the mountains with ease. Mew is doing pretty good climbing the mountain herself, though it is tiring. Pikachu, Eevee, and Mew reach the next ledge of the mountain.

She sighs, "Phew, that was a difficult climb, but I still have ways to go to get to the top."

Suddenly she hears Tracey's voice, "Hey Mew!"

Mew turns her head to see Tracey, Misty, Tomo, Meloetta, Skwovet, Pichu, and Togpei riding the cable car up the mountain.

Mew waves, "Hi guys!"

"Hi Mew! We'll see you at the top!" Tomos says.

"Be careful Mew!" Misty says.

They continue to ride the cable car up the mountain and soon reach where Danny is.

Danny waves, "Hi!"

Misty calls out, "Oh, hi! Hi, Danny!"

"I'll be at the top in just a little while!" Danny says.

"Please be extra careful, Danny!" Misty calls out.

Mew snickers to see Misty being extra nice to Danny. Just then, the rock that Mew is resting her foot on gives way, causing her to fall.

Piachu and Eevee cry out, "Pika Pi! Eevee!" (Mew!)

Danny calls out, "Mew, hang on!"

Everyone in the cable car cries out, "Mew!"

Luckily, Mew is able to catch herself in the nick of time.

She sighs, "Phew, that was too close. Better keep climbing and be more careful."

With that, Mew continues to climb up the mountain and does her best to be careful.

Sometime later, Mew, Pikachu, Eevee, and Danny have reached the top of the mountain, and can see all of Nevel Island from up the mountain, including the ocean and the blue sky.

"The air is clean, the view is great, there's nothing like the mountains," Danny says.

"Pikachu!" (You said it!) Pikachu says.

"It's so amazing up here," Mew says.

"Eevee," (You're right.) Eevee says.

Just then, two suction cups come down from the sky and grab both Pikachu and Eevee by their backs. Then start reeling them up.

Mew calls out, "Pikachu! Eevee!"

"What's going on?!" Danny asks.

Soon, they hear familiar laughter. The clouds clear to reveal Team Rocket. And soon begin their motto

Jessie:

Prepare for trouble!

James:

Make it double!

Soon, it's revealed that Team Rocket is cooking fish.

Jessie:

To protect the world from devastation!

James:

To unite all people within our nation!

And it shows that Mewoth is holding the fishing rods with the two Pokemon stuck to it.

Jessie:

To denounce the evils of truth and love!

James:

To extend our reach to the stars above!

Annoyed as she holds onto her Pokemon, Mew says, Them again?! Let go of Pikachu and Eevee!

Just then, Danny walks over and takes the suction cups off of Pikachu and Eevee. Then lets them go for the line to reel back to Team Rocket, knocking them back. Then both Pokemon jump to Mew's arms.

"Pikachu! Eevee!" Mew happily says and jumps into Mew's arms.

Then turns to Danny, "Thanks a lot, Danny."

"No problem," Danny says.

Then Jessie angrily calls out, "Hey! Twerps!"

The group turns to see Team Rocket regain themselves and stands up in anger.

Jessie angrily shouts, "You're not getting off that easy!

"That's right! You didn't even let us finish our motto!" James says.

Mewoth stands up and angrily says, "I'll show you, wise guy!"

Then tosses the suction cup reel back down, but Danny holds up a rock in his place. The suction cup hits it, and goes flying back to Team Rocket's balloon, causing it to hit the balloon to make a hole. Then sends them blasting off.

Team Rocket screams, "We're blasting off again!"

Soon Team Rocket is gone.

"We don't need troublemakers like that on Navel Island. I hope we don't see them again," Danny says.

Then turns to Mew, "Ready to finish our climb, guys?"

Mew is still shocked, but quickly regains composure and answers, "Uh, yeah. Sure."

Danny laughs as he walks to the wall of the mountain to continue climbing. Mew hoever senses there is something off about Danny. She also wonders about this the whole time they get to the island. Meanwhile, Team Rocket zooms to the top of the mountain.

Jessie and James hug Mewoth and scream, "I'm freezing!"

"Let go! You're choking me!" Meowth screams, being crushed.

"You're the only fur I have!" Jessie says.

Then I saw the mountain, "Look!"

"Oh no! We're gonna crash!" Meowth screams.

Just then, a geyser goes off.

"What's that?" James asks.

"It's a geyser!" Jessie answers.

Then another goes off, and Jessie and James say, "That looks warm."

"That thing couldn't hit us, could it?" Meowth questions.

Right on cue, the geyser hits Team Rocket and sends them blasting further into the clouds.

Meanwhile, Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee are near the top as snow begins to fall. Just then, Pikachu and Eevee collapse from exhaustion.

Mew kneels down to them, "Pikachu. Eevee. Are you both tired and cold?"

Pikachu and Eevee nod their heads.

Mew then takes out a small blanket from her bag, and uses them to wrap the two Pikachu, bundling them together.

"That feel better?" Mew asks.

Pikachu and Eevee nod their heads, but show concern for Mew."

"Don't worry about me. I'll just hold you both real close, and that way, we'll both be warm," Mew says.

Pikachu and Eevee show concern.

"No mountain's gonna beat us! Right, guys? Mew replies.

"Pika. Eev." (Right.) Pikachu and Eevee reply.

Mew continues to climb the mountain holding her friends in her arms. Danny smiles and is very impressed by Mew's actions and kindness towards her Pokemon.

Meanwhile, Misty, Tracey, Tomo, and the Pokemon are at the top and wrapped in blankets, waiting for Mew to arrive.

Suddenly, they hear Mew's voice, "Hey! Misty, Tracey! Tomo! Guys!"

"Pika!" (You guys!) Pikachu calls out.

"Eevee! (We made it!) Eevee calls out.

"They did it!" Tracey says.

"Hey, you guys! We made it!" Mew calls out.

"Great job, Mew!" Tracey calls out.

"You were great!" Tomo says.

"You're here!" Misty happily says, and rushes past Mew and to Danny.

She then asks, "Are you okay, Danny? You must be cold. Wanna share my blanket?"

"Thanks, but I enjoy the brisk weather," Danny says.

Mew giggles and says, "Oh Misty."

Danny laughs and says, "That was quite a test, Mew Congratulations. You passed."

"I passed?" Mew says, confused.

Mew gasps and says, "So I was right."

Misty giggles, "Looks like you figured it out as well Mew. And I knew it!"

"I figured it out when we got to the top and nobody else was here," Tracey says.

"What are you talking about?" Tomo asks.

Then Mew says, "I just put the pieces together myself. Danny's not here to win the badge, he's the Navel Island Gym Leader."

"Climbing that mountain was just a test to weed out the wimps," Tracey says.

Tomo becomes surprised. Even Pikachu, Eevee, and the other Pokemon are surprised.

"True. I'm the Navel Island gym leader, and I'm also a member of the Orange Crew," Danny says.

He then smiles and says, "I hope you're ready for our big match, Mew."

Mew is still surprised by it. Knowing Danny is the gym leader is gone, but they now have to get to the real challenge off the bat.

Soon, Mew and the others are listening to Danny as he explains the rules.

Danny explains, Here are the rules, Mew, so listen carefully. Matches here are decided in three rounds. And if either of you or all of you win two out of three, you'll each get a Sea Ruby badge. Understand?"

Then holds out the Sea Ruby badge. It is shaped like a giant clam shell with a small gemstone on it.

Mew nods her head.

"First, we'll see who can freeze hot water the fastest," Danny says.

Mew and the others look up to see a Geyser goes up into the sky.

"Wow! A geyser!" Misty says, amazed.

"So cool!" Tomo says

"Hey! That means they're gonna have to start with ice attacks!" Tracey says.

Just then, Danny calls out, "I choose you, Nidoqueen!"

With that, Nidoqueen materializes from the Pokeball.

"So, ice type attacks, huh?" Mew replies.

Then throws her Pokeball, "Okay. I choose you, Lapras!"

Lapras then comes out of his Pokeball.

Soon, both trainers and Pokemon are standing in front of the geysers.

Danny and Mew calls out, "Ice Beam Attack!"

With that, both Nidoqueen and Lapras unleash their Ice Beam Attack to freeze the geyser, but Lapras isn't as fast as Nidoqueen.

Mew calls out, "Hang in there, Lapras. Give it everything you got."

"Nidoqueen, full power, now!" Danny calls you.

Nidowueen then unleashes the full power of its Ice Beam, freezing the Geyser solid, shocking Mew and the others.

Tracey, Misty and Tmo are shocked, "No way!"

"Pika!" (Amazing!) Pikachu says, surprised.

"Eevee," (Incredible!" Eevee adds.

"Wow. That's amazing Danny," Mew complements.

" Thanks. And, well, it looks like I win the first round," Danny says.

Lapras finally freezes his geyser.

Later everyone is set for the second round. Each of them has the ice block they freeze from the geyser.

Danny explains, "In the second round, we'll compete in sculpting that ice. The first one to carve out this ice sled using only three Pokémon wins."

Then turns to Mew, "So, then, do you three know which three Pokémon you'll each use?"

"Mew says.

Then calls out, "Pikachu, Bulbasaur, and Charizard!"

With that, Bulbasaur and Charizard come out of their Pokeballs, and Pkachu joins in.

Danny chooses his Nidoqueen, Scyther, and Machoke.

"I'm using Machoke, Scyther and Nidoqueen," Danny says.

Then Danny says, "Let's go!"

Danny's Pokemon quickly gets to work on carving the ice sled. Bulbasaur, Charizard, and Pikachu work on Mew's sled. Soon enough, Mew sees the sled is working great.

Then Mew says, "Alright, time for the finishing touch."

Hearing that Bulbasaur and Pikachu move out of the way.

Tomo and the others are confused.

"Finishing touch?" Misty says, confused.

"What's Mew up to?" Tomo asks.

Then Mew asks, "Now Charizard, Flamethrower!"

Charizard then performs a Flamethrower that hits the ice, and finishes shaping the ice into a sled, shocking everyone. Mew ends up winning this round.

"Alright! We did it!" Mew happily cheers.

"Well, I don't know how you did it, Mew, but you just won the second round," Danny says.

"Yes! You three were great. Thanks," Mew says.

Soon after the sleds are finished, Mew and Danny are now at the last challenge. They are facing at the starting light, and a path that leads down the mountain.

"Well, it's all downhill from here," Misty says.

"Really down hill," Tomo says.

"Yeah," Tracey says.

Then says, "The first to cross the goal line wins. This isn't gonna be easy."

In Danny's sled, he has Geodude, Scyther, and Electrode. In Mew's sled, she has Eevee, Bulbasaur, and Squirtle.

The lights turn red from the three rows of light. Then all together, all six lights turn green.

Danny shouts, "Go!"

Right then and there, the two trainers race down the mountain at a tremendous rate.

Tracey says, "Let's take the cable car and meet them at the finish."

"Right," Misty says.

Tomo turns to Pikachu, Meloetta, and Skwovet, "Let's go."

The Pokemon agree and follow the others.

Meanwhile, Danny is racing down the mountain instructing his Pokemon, "Right! Now left! Hold it there! Stay on course, everyone! You're doing great!"

Meanwhile, Mew is racing down the mountain, "Alright give it a left. Then right."

Then turns to Bulbasaur, "You're doing great Bulbasaur. Remember to keep steady. We don't want to go too fast."

Mew's sled continues to speed, but not too fast, but enough to gain speed and catch up to Danny.

Meanwhile, from above, Team Rocket is watching the race.

And Jessie spots Danny, "I don't like that guy's attitude. It's too positive."

She removes the binoculars and asks, "Is that trap ready?"

"Ready!" James and Mewoth answer, sticking out of the hole.

"Too bad, Mew! You're still a little behind to catch up with me!" Danny says.

"We'll see about that," Mew says.

Danny then speeds up, and suddenly, falls down the trap Team Rocket sets up. Mew and the others notice what's wrong.

She calls out, "Danny!"

Then turns to the Pokemon, "We gotta stop the sled."

Bulbasaur stops the sled and the group get off.

"Danny, are you okay?" Mew asks.

"I think so," Danny answers.

Then turns to his Pokemon, "Are you alright?"

All Danny's Pokemon confirm that they're okay.

"That's what counts," Danny says.

Then turns to the hole, "But that was no accident. Somebody dug that hole."

"Oh, it was a trap alright, and I think we know just who set it up!" Mew says.

"Who's that?" Danny asks.

"It's Team Rocket," Mew says.

Suddenly, they hear Jessie's voice, "Is that your final answer?"

The group turns to see three snowmen, until they are revealed to be Team Rocket in disguise.

"If it is, you are correct," Jessie says.

"You're getting good, kid," Mewoth says.

"Well, they have known us for quite a while," James replies.

"Mew do you know these three? Are they friends of yours?" Danny asks.

Mew rolls her eyes and says, "No way!"

Then turns to Team Rocket, "We're having a match, so get lost!"

"Oh, I get it. You want to cave in," Jessie says.

"Cave in?" Mew says, confused.

"You got it!" James says.

Then Mewoth holds a remote, "Here's your cave in! Ha!"

Then presses the button on the remote, causing the group to fall into a deep crevice.

Down below, Danny says, "Wow. Your friends must be pretty smart and pretty skilled to set a trap like this one, guys."

"They're not smart, they're not skilled, and they're not friends. They're lame, they're crazy, and the dumbest criminals on this planet," Mew says.

Suddenly, a mechanical arm comes in and grabs Eevee from behind.

Mew cries out, "Eevee!"

Mew and Danny look to see Team Rocket flying over them.

"Thanks for the Eevee!" James says.

Then Jessie says, "It's not Pikachu, but it will do!"

"Stay cool!" Meowth says.

And flies away.

Mew calls out, "Come back!"

In the balloon, Eevee is trapped in a glass case.

Jessie says, "And now, let's bring our little Eevee-prize back to the boss!"

James and Meowth reply, "Aye aye, sir!"

On the ground, Bulbasaur uses a Vine Whip to help Mew and Danny climb out of the hole. Then they help the Pokemon.

Back in the balloon, Eevee tries to break free with her electric attack, but to no avail.

"Try as hard as you like, Eevee. You can't shock us," Jessie says.

"Yeah! Go ahead, turn up the juice. Give it all you got, cause you're only helping us," Meowth says.

"That's right. We'll just save on our electric bill," James says.

Turns out, the case Eevee is trapped in is connected to a coffee pot and a toaster, and the voltaire giving them power.

"Bon Appetit," Jessie and James reply.

"We like to be energy efficient," Meowth says.

Suddenly, a snowball hitsMeowth in the face. Then one hits Jessie. Then a large group of snowballs bombard Team Rocket.

Jessie asks, "What's going on?"

With snow on her face, Jessie muffles, "Prepare for…"

But Meowth interrupts her, "We already did the motto! Let's get em!"

Team Rocket looks to see the source of the snowballs are Mew, Danny, and their Pokemon. They continue to throw the snowballs in the basket of the balloon. Soon, the balloon is getting heavy. Team Rocket then retaliates by tossing the snowballs back. Just then, Danny's Scyther rolls Electrode onto a plank of wood.

Danny calls out, "Mew, are you guys ready?"

"Ready!" Mew says. "One, two!"

At the right moment, Mew, Squirtle, Bulbasaur, Danny, Godude, and Scyther jump on the other end, and catapults Electrode right into the balloon, knocking the case Eevee in the case out of the balloon.

"Eevee!" Mew happily says, and catches the case.

Seeing their catch has escaped, Jessie angrily says, "This calls for a Pokémon battle!"

"I choose you!" James says.

But Victreebel comes out of the Pokeball and munches on James' head again.

In the mouth, James says, "Oops! Wrong Pokémon!

"Train dat ting!" Meowth shouts.

Suddenly, Electrode lands in the basket.

Then Danny calls out to his Pokemon, "Electrode! Explosion!"

Electrode suddenly blows up in Team Rocket's balloon, and sends them blasting off once again.

Team Rocket screams, "We're blasting off again, again!"

Soon, Team Rocket is gone.

Mew happily cheers, "We did it, everybody!"

Everyone cheers and Electrode lands back on the ground.

Later, Mew, Danny, and their Pokemona are ready to continue to race

"Well, we still have half of this race to go. Are you ready to finish it Mew?" Danny replis.

"Yeah, we're ready when you are," Mew says.

"We'll start the second the sun comes out from behind that cloud," Danny says.

Mew says in thought, "I have to win this one to get that badge."

As soon as the sun peaks out, "GO!"

The race is on once more.

Meanwhile, at the finish line, the rest of the group are waiting for the racers. Still racing, the snow grounds changes to a dirty area

"He didn't tell me the sledding would be this rocky!" Mew says.

Then Mew's sled leaps on ahead over a rock-like ramp. Meanwhile, Danny is still sledding with his Pokemon.

He instructs them, "Go right! Good job, Scyther!

Mew calls out, "Bulbasaur, we're heading right for that rock! We're gonna hit it!"

Bulbasaur quickly avoids the rock in the nick of time, but the sled slides through some bushes.

Back at the path, Danny says, "Good. We're almost at the finish line! Just a few more seconds."

Back at the finish line, the others notice someone is ahead.

Tomo calls out, "Look!"

"Who is it?" Tracey asks.

"I think it's, Danny!" Misty says.

Danny, who is ahead, says, "Looks like I'm the winner."

Suddenly, Mew's voice calls out, "Hang on!"

Danny and the others look up to see Mew's sled flying in. When they land, the sled breaks apart.

Mew chuckles, "She's not bad!"

Soon, it's neck and neck between Danny and Mew. Mew then decides to have a little fun. She carefully stands on the sled like a snowboard and slides down the mountain. Eevee, Bulbasaur, and Squirtle are having a lot of fun.

Everyone calls out, "Here comes Mew!"

Soon, Mew's sled slides right past Danny's speed and all the way to the finish line. Then they splash right into the water, creating a rainbow on impact.

Tracey says, surprised, "She won!"

Danny's sled stops after crossing the finish line. He is surprised at first, but smiles and says, "She beat me."

Sitting in the water, Mew and her Pokemon are soaked and wet.

"That sure was a rough ride," Mew says.

Danny approaches Mew and says, " Mew. You and the others were great. You all chose your Pokémon well and you won it for your fellow challengers, two out of three. Now I'd like to give you something you really deserve, Mew." Then presents the badge to Mew, "The Sea Ruby badge. It's yours."

Mew smiles and takes the badge, "WE did it, guys. We earned a Sea Ruby badge!

Pikachu runs to Mew and happily says, "Pi Pikachu!" (And that one makes two!)

"Eevee Eevee!" (And two more to go!) Eevee says.

New turns to her Pokemon and says, "Thanks, guys. I couldn't have done it without you.

"That was great!" Tracey says.

"Yeah, but.." Misty says.

"But?" Tomo asks.

"But Danny lost!" Misty says, disappointed.

Tracey and Tomo groan.

Later, Mew and her friends say goodbye to Danny and depart from the island.

Danny calls out, "Bye! Good luck on the rest of your journey!"

Mew and the others wave goodbye.

"I hope we meet again, Danny!" Misty calls out.

Soon, the group sail on Lapas to another part of their adventure. Mew looks at her second badge of the Orange League. With courage, skill, and a little bit of luck, Mew has earned her second badge, and will need to get two more badges to get to the Orange League.

Chapter 17: Episode 17: Snack Attack

After earning the Sea-Ruby Badge on Navel Island, Mew is a step closer to participating in the Orange League. As of now, Mew and her friends continue riding on Lapras on the ocean blue, searching for a new Island adventure.

Just then, Pikachu notices something and calls out, "Pikachu!" (Guys! Look ahead!)

Everyone hears Pikachu and looks to see an island.

Tomo calls out, "Hey, look!"

Then Tracey says, "Oh yeah! We're coming up on what they call the Seven Grapefruit Islands."

"Grapefruit Islands?" Misty says.

"Yeah, all the Islands are supposed to be covered with grapefruit groves. Come to think of it, the grapefruits should be getting ripe right about now," Tracey explains.

"Why don't we stop an' check 'em out?" Mew suggests.

Misty agrees, "Let's go!"

"Yeah. Let's go," Tomo says.

Mew then turns to Lapras, "Lapras, full speed to the Grapefruit Islands!"

Lapras happily squeals, "To Grapefruit Islands!"

And with that, Lapras sails the group to Grapefruit Island.

In no time, Mew and her friends reach Grapefruit Island, and soon find a lot of fruits on the trees.

"Wow, just look at the size of them! They're humongous!" Mew says, amazed.

She then reaches to the tree and picks one of the fruits.

"They look delicious!" Misty says.

Togepi happily says, "Toki, toki toki…" (Very, very yummy...)

"Pichu!" (Yummy!) Pichu happily says.

Suddenly, they hear someone calling out, "Stop! Stop thieves!"

They turn their heads to see a young woman with dark green hair and a pink outfit charging towards them with a stick in her hand.

"Did she say, thieves?" Misty wonders.

"That's terrible!" Tracey says.

"Well, I hope she catches 'em," Tomo replies.

Then Mew wonders, "And why is she running toward us?"

Soon, the woman charges at them and calls out, "I caught you red-handed!"

This shocks the group as the girl tries to attack Mew with a stick. Surprisingly, she is able to grab it with her bare hand, shocking the woman. Both females hold opposite sides of the sticks, not giving an inch.

The woman continues, "So, you thought you could get away with it? You thought you could just sneak in here and steal all our grapefruit?! After we worked so hard to grow it?!"

But Misty calls out, "We didn't come here to steal anything!"

"We're not grapefruit thieves! Honest!" Tracey calls out.

"No lie!" Tomo calls out.

"They're right. We just got here!" Mew adds.

The woman becomes confused, "Huh?"

Soon, Mew and the others clear the misunderstanding with the young girl.

"I'm sorry I acted that way, but lately, somebody's been coming into our groves and stealing our grapefruit," The girl says.

"I thought they grew by themselves," Tomo replies.

"Toki! Pichu!" (Me too!) Pichu and Togepi reply.

"Yeah, we didn't know the grapefruit belonged to somebody. We should have asked before we picked any," Misty says.

"It was our fault. We're sorry we caused you any trouble," Tracey says.

"Sorry about that," Mew says.

"Oh, that's very nice of you. We worked so hard on the grapefruit, we can't stand the thought of losing a single one to thieves," The girl says.

Then Pikachu and Skwovet try to lift one up, but it's pretty heavy.

Seeing the fruit, Misty says, "I've never seen grapefruit that big before."

"Pika…" (Let's see...) Pikachu says, and lifts the fruit.

Meloetta says, "Loetta Meloetta." (It looks really heavy.)

"How do you get them to grow like this?" Misty asks.

The girl begins to explain, "It takes a lot of work, and more than a little bit of love. Every winter, we wrap the grapefruit trees with straw to protect them from the cold. We spray them with insect repellent and weed them. But all that hard work pays off when the weather warms up and the trees are covered with beautiful white grapefruit blossoms. That's when we gather the Butterfree from neighboring islands to pollinate the trees on all the seven grapefruit islands so they can produce fruit. Then after watering and caring for every single tree, slowly but surely, they start to bear fruit."

"Pika Pika." (And they're pretty.) Pikachu says.

"They're almost like my children, so I care about all of them," The girl says.

"I can see why after so much work," Tracey says.

Suddenly, they hear someone shout, "Ruby!"

Everyone gasps as one of the employees runs to the girl, who's name is Ruby.

The employee calls out, "Ruby, the thieves just struck again!

Ruby quickly stands up, "If we hurry, we might catch them!"

And hurries off.

Mew turns to the others, "Guys, let's go help her!"

Everyone agrees to the idea and follows them.

Mew and the others hurry to where the employee sees the thieves have struck. When they arrive, everyone gasps in shock to see the trees are stripped bare.

"Whoa!" Tomo says, shocked.

Ruby is upset, "They even tore off the branches!"

"This is disgusting!" Mew says in anger.

"Who'd do such an awful thing?" Misty wonders.

Suddenly, they hear someone shout, "Hurry! Over here!"

Everyone rushed over.

Then they see the employee as he calls out, "Over here! Bring help!"

"Where are they?" Ruby asks.

"Not they, Ruby. It!" The worker says, and points them to the direction.

Mew and the others turn their heads and are shocked to see a large Snorlax munching away the grapefruits while they're still on the branches.

(The worker points and our heroes are shocked when they see a Snorlax munching away at the grapefruits while they're still on the branches)

"S-s-s-s-s-s Snorlax?!" Misty says, shocked.

"And one with a big appetite," Mew says.

She gets out her Pokedex, and Dexter says, "Snorlax, the Sleeping Pokémon. A Normal Type. Snorlax isn't satisfied unless it eats at least 900 pounds of food per day. Once it is full, it will probably go to sleep."

"Tracey sweats drops and says, "Snorlax is one of the Pokemon that eats more than any other Pokémon!"

"I'd hate to be a grapefruit on this island," Misty says.

"What'll we do?!" Tomo asks.

Then Ruby answers, "Stop that Snorlax immediately!"

"Right! Let's go, guys!" The Worker says.

The workers try to pull Snorlax to move it away, but it has no effect, and is knocked to the side with its left arm.

"That didn't work too well," Misty says.

"Well, I guess Snorlax doesn't like being interrupted during its lunch time," Tracey says.

"I can't imagine how Snorlax got here," Ruby says.

"This is not good. If Snorlax keeps this up all the grapefruit will be gone!" Mew says.

"Well, we'll have to hurry," Ruby says.

Then turns to the others, "Come on, guys. If we work fast enough, maybe we can pick all the grapefruit before Snorlax gets to it!"

The workers agree and begin picking the fruit off the tree.

"I just hope we can pick quick enough," Ruby says, and rushes to join the others.

Mew then turns to the others, "Maybe our Pokémon can help!"

"Good idea," Tracey says.

"Pikachu!" (Let's get picking!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee!" (And fast!) Eevee adds.

Soom, Ruby and the others are working to pick up the fruits.

Mew brings out her Pokeballs and says, "Come on out, guys!"

Coming out of her Pokeballs are Bulbasaur, Ivysaur, Weepinbell Meditite, Pansear, and Drowzee.

"Alright everyone, get gotta pick up the fruits from the trees, and fast!" Mew says.

Everyone nods their heads and begins to work on picking the fruits.

Snorlax continues until it stops eating.

Everyone nods their heads. However, Snorlax begins to get up and walks away. The group is confused, and becomes shocked to see it eating more of the gra[efruit, shocking them. Soon, Snorlax has eaten almost every grapefruit off the island, and Snorlax continues eating.

When he tries to slice them with his claws, the fruit doesn't have a scratch.

"Pika! Eev! (And how!) Pikachu and Eevee reply.

Back at the second Island, Snorlax continues to eat

Arbok looks like a snake skin belt," Mewoth comments.

Back at the island HQ, Ruby checks the monitor to see the islands.

But soon, James falls asleep instead of Snorlax. (snaps his fingers)

Back to reality, Misty continues to count, "Ninety-seven Snorlax. Ninety-eight Snorlax. Ninety-nine Snorlax.

Meloetta starts off, "Mel Mel. Mel o e tta!" (One! two! A one, two, three!)

Then calls you, "Okay, Pikachu, Eevee, Thunder, now!" Mew calls out.

With that, both Pokemon begin the attack and it's a direct hit. Snorlax feels the attack and falls over, splitting the tree in half as it comes down. Then, something falls out of Snorlax from the back. Tomo rushes over and catches it. Turns out to be a kind of egg. The egg is cream colored on the bottom, but most of the egg is a teal color, and has two white dots between the dividing line.

Then Mew says, "Nice work guys!"

The Pokeball hits Snorlax and pulls it inside. The Pokeball wobbles a few times and pings, indicating that Snorlax has been caught.

Mew calmly says, "Snorlax."

Snorlax turns to Mew.

Mew then says, "I know that you love to eat, but these fruits belong to people who grow the fruit with care. If you eat them all, there won't be any for anyone else who also likes it."

"Snor Snorlax?" (You can understand me?) Snorlax asks.

"Yes. And I like you to understand that you can't just eat without knowing if they belong to someone. It's kind of like stealing," Mew explains.

Snorlax then apologizes, "Snorlax," (I'm sorry.)

"It's okay. I know you didn't mean too. You were just doing what you do," Mew says.

Then Snorlax turns to Tomo, " Snor Snorlax," (And I see you're holding my little brother.)

Just then, the egg Tomo is holding begins to glow, surprising everyone. Tomo places the egg on the ground as it bursts out. Then the egg soon forms a small Pokemon.

The Pokemon is a teal Pokémon with a cream spot on its chest. Its round head is teal in the top half and cream on the bottom half. It has big, round eyes and large pointy ears. It has five-fingered hands and cream feet with three clawed toes. The fur close to the bottom seems to resemble a dress, and has two pointy teeth that stick out of its mouth even if closed.

"Munch!" The little Pokemon replies.

"It's a Munchlax," Tracey says.

Mew takes out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Munchlax, the Big Eater Pokemon. A Normal Type. Anything that looks edible, Munchlax will go on and swallow whole. Its stomach is tough enough to handle it even if the food has gone rotten."

"Oh no, another Pokemon with a big appetite!" Misty whines.

Soon everyone begins laughing. Little Munchlax turns to Snorlax and smiles. Snorlax smiles back. Munchlax turns to Tomo and hugs him on the leg.

Snorlax says, "Snor Snorlax Snorlax." (I think my little brother wants to be with you.)

Tomo becomes surprised and asks both Pokemon, "Are you sure?"

"Munch," (Yep.) Munchlax happily says.

Tomo smiles and pats Munchlax on the head, "You can count on it. I'll take good care of you."

Then Mew turns to Snorlax, "And be sure to take good care of you."

Snorlax smiles in reply.

Later in the evening, Ruby expresses her gratitude, "Thank you. If it weren't for all of you, we wouldn't have a single grapefruit left."

"It's no problem. And yet, me and Tomo end up with new friends,

"We're just happy that we could help you save all that grapefruit," Misty says.

Then Ruby hands Misty a bag, "I have something for you. They're our candied grapefruit peels. They're delicious."

"Thanks, Ruby," Misty says.

Togepi and Pichu look interested in eating the candy.

Then she kneels down to the Pokemon, "Try one."

Pikachu, Eevee, Skwovet, and Meloetta take a candied grapefruit peel and begin to eat it.

"How do you like it?" Misty asks.

The Pokemon smiles and answers that they love it.

Just then, a worker rushes to Ruby and says, "Ruby! You won't believe it, but there are new trees growing wherever Snorlax went!"

Ruby gasps in shock.

Everyone soon sees grapefruit tree seedlings growing in their place.

"This is amazing! I've never seen anything like this before!" Ruby says.

"Maybe Snorlax has some kind of special ability that helps the trees grow back again," Tracey replies.

Then Misty says, "Whatever it is, I guess it proves something good can come out of something bad."

"I think you're right, Misty. Next year, we may have more fruit then ever!" Ruby says.

"I hope so, Ruby," Mew says.

Soon, Mew and the others bid farewell to Ruby and her workers as they sail into the sunset out to sea. Mew and Tomo end up with new friends, and they have another adventure. They continue to sail out to sea, waiting for another adventure to take place.

Chapter 19: Episode 19: Meowth Rules

One night, somewhere in the Orange Island, Jessie and James are trying to fix their submarine. Usually, they're in hot pursuit of Mew and her friends, but not this time around. Their Magikarp submarine is caught between some rocks as they try to fix some repairs to their submarine.

"Nothing ever seems to work out right for us, does it, Jessie?" James replies, fixing the submarine.

He sits up and says, " Or maybe I wasn't meant to be happy."

"Only spoiled little brats like you can afford to waste time thinking that way," Jessie says, frustrated.

Then points the wrench at James, "Haven't you ever heard of positive thinking? Try looking on the bright side for a change."

Suddenly, they hear Meowth say, "Ah, I am so happy."

The two become confused and look down to see Meowth is crying for joy for a pile of clams.

He holds the clam in tears and sas, "I'm gonna have free clams for dinner! I'm da happiest Meowth in da whole world!"

Jessie and James look at Meowth with confused looks.

"I'm all for positive thinking, but Meowth seems to be stretching the concept a little too far," Jessie says.

James then jumps down to Meowth, "Well, I'm very happy for you. "

He then grabs Meowth by his legs and holds him upside down.

He then shakes him by his legs, "Now why don't you learn Pay Day and make us happy with some money?"

"I'd love to make money, Jimmy, but I put so much energy into learning how to talk that I just can't learn Pay Day," Meowth explains.

"Oh, well," James says, and drops Meowth.

Jessie asks, "Didn't I just hear the sound of a coin?"

"I heard it, too! And it was coming from him!" Meowth says, pointing to James.

James begins to panic.

And then Jessie grabs James by his leg and spins him around as she shouts, "So, holding out on us, are you?! Cough it up!"

James screams, "No, stop! Let go! Please! Don't!"

Then something flies out from James' shirt and falls to the ground. Meowth walks over to see what it is.

Seeing the object, Meowth says, "Hey, this ain't a coin, it's some kind of bottle cap."

James pounces on the cap and cries out, "I couldn't live without my most very extra special favorite limited edition vintage bottle cap!"

"I guess he likes it," Jessie replies.

Soon, Jessie spots something, and points to the direction, "Look out there!"

James and Meowth look to where Jessie is pointing to, and it's Mew and her friends.

"It's them!" Meowth shouts.

"Pikachu, Eevee, and the twerps!" James says.

Then Meowth says, "Let's go get em!"

"Yeah!" Jessie and James cheer.

Meanwhile, out in the ocean, Mew and her friends are sailing on Lapras under the full moon.

Mew looks around, "See any place we can stay for the night, Trace?"

"No islands, just a bunch of rocks," Tracey says, looking through the binoculars.

Just then, Pikachu calls out, "Pika!" (Look there!) and points to the water.

Mew and the others look to where Pikachu is looking to see some strange glow.

"What's that?" Tomo asks.

"Some weird kind of light," Tracey says.

"And it's headed this way," Misty says.

Just then something splashes and rises from the water.

"Hey, look!" Mew says.

And what they see is Team Rocket and their submarine. And Team Rocket begins the motto. Again.

Jessie:

Prepare for nighttime trouble.

James:

Make it after-dark double.

Jessie:

To protect the world from devastation!

James:

To unite all people within our nation!

Jessie:

To denounce the evils of truth and love!

James:

To extend our reach to the stars above!

Jessie:

Jessie.

James:

James.

Jessie:

Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light, light, light!

James:

Surrender now, or prepare to fight, fight, fight!

Meowth:

Meowth! Dat's right!

"Team Rocket!" Mew calls out.

Jessie then points to the kids, "This time, I'm afraid you're sunk!"

However, Team Rocket's submarine is the only thing that is sinking.

That causes them to panic, "We're sinking!"

Mew turns to her friends, "So, do you we should help them or blast them?"

"I say we blast them!" Tomo says.

Suddenly, multiple figures rise from the water. And those figures are a large group of Gyarados.

Everyone panics, "GYARADOS!"

With that, Gyarados begins to fire their Water Guns at everyone in sight. Lapras ends up getting hit, and knocks each other into the water. One of them hit Jessie and James, sending them flying.

Jassie and James scream, "We're blasting off again!"

Lapras is able to swim back up. Misty, Tracey, Tomo, Pikachu, Eevee, and the others swim back up and grab on to Lapras.

"We gotta get out of here!" Misty panics.

Tracey looks around, "Wait, where's Mew?!"

At the submarine, Meowth climbs up, "Phew! That was close!"

Just then, Meowth is able to climb up the submarine.

Meowth panics, "What are you doing here?"

Just then, they see a large Gyarados staring down at them. Then uses a water gun blasting them into the air.

"I'm blasting off, too!" Meowth screams.

Seeing what is happening, Misty, Tracey, and Tomo cry out, "MEW!"

Even Pikachu and Eevee are shocked, "PIKA PI! EEVEE! (MEW!)

Mewoth and Mew are sent flying over Team Rocket.

"There goes Meowth and the twerpette," Jessie says.

"They're flying high," James adds.

Somewhere out to sea, there is an island, where there is a giant Meowth statue with fruits and vegetables gathered around it. Standing before it is a group of villagers of the island.

A man stands and calls out, "Hear me! Tonight is the night we've long awaited! The night we finally see the ancient prophecy fulfilled! Our ancestors foretold of the night of a foam white moon, when the great Meowth of Bounty will bestow great wealth upon us. That night has come! And now we await the great Meowth's arrival!"

The villagers are in awe, and then, right on cue, Meowth and Mew land in the water close to the beach. Meowth and Mew are able to swim to the shore and are soaked and wet.

"I should be getting frequent flier miles," Meowth says, feeling in pain.

"Now I know how you feel like being blasted off," Mew says, and spits the salt water from her mouth.

Just then, light comes over Meowth and Mew, and they both look to see a group of people shining down on them. Just then, the people put Mew and Meowth on a platform and carry them away.

"Hey! What are you..?" Meowth asks.

"What's happening?" Mew asks.

As the two are being carried away, a pair of eyes stare at them with curiosity.

Soon enough, Mew and Meowth are placed in front of a bounty of fruits. The two are so confused and look around until they see the golden Meowth statue behind them.

"That's a major Meowth!" Meowth says, confused.

Mew then whispers to Meowth, "Hey Meowth, look."

Meowth turns his head and notices the villagers are bowing. And notices that they have cat ear headbands and cat noses, and some have cat glove paws.

"What are they doing?" Meowth asks himself.

Just then, a young man who is the Ceremonial Leader, a village elder.

Ceremonial leader says, "You honor us with your presence. Words cannot express our gratitude. Please, partake in our humble offering."

"I'm a little short on cash, but I can pay you for the food on Tuesday," Meowth says.

Mew giggles as she covers her mouth.

The villagers are shocked that Meowth can talk.

"Could it be?!" Ceremonial leader.

"Maybe I should've kept my big mouth shut," Meowth softly says.

Mew softly whispers, "Let's see what happens.

Ceremonial leader whispers to the elder, "The prophecy doesn't mention talking. Now that I think of it, it also didn't mention a girl going with it. Are you sure this is the Meowth of Bounty?"

"There's no doubt about it! The Meowth of Bounty is a special creature, so it must have special powers. And the girl must be sent to assist the Meowth of Bounty," Village elder says.

In tears, Mewoth turns to Meowth, "I bet they're trying to figure out how to get rid of us."

"I'm not sure," Meowth says.

"You're right. Let the bounty ceremony begin!" Ceremonial leader.

" We mustn't hurry. If we start the ceremony too soon, we may put the Meowth of Bounty in bad spirits," Village elder

Still in tears, Meowth says, "We're in trouble and I don't even have Jessie and James to blame."

"First, let's gain Meowth's favor, then we can begin the ceremony." Village elder says.

Still in tears, Meowth says, "I really did it this time. I'm a goner for sure."

Soon he has an idea, "But maybe I can still sneak away."

Ceremonial leader turns to the villagers, "We must bow down before the great Meowth of Bounty!"

Meowth stops trying to sneak away and asks, "Did somebody call me great?"

"And did he say bow?" Mew asks.

Soon, the villagers begin to bow for Meowth, and they chant, "Hail Meowth of Bounty. Hail Meowth of Bounty. Hail Meowth of Bounty."

"What's going on?" Meowth asks.

Mew whispers, "It seems that the villagers think you're this Meowthof Bounty."

"Oh I get it, they got me mixed up with some other Meowth," Meowth says, understanding.

He smiles and says, "If I don't let the cat out of the bag, I could have a good thing going here."

"Are you sure this is a good idea?" Mew asks.

"Relax kid, Meowth got everything under control," Meowth says.

"That worries me," Mew says softly.

"Excuse me, young miss," Someone says.

Mew turns her head to see the Ceremonial Leader and two female villagers, and they're holding some clothes.

"As the loyal servant of the Meowth of Bounty, it's important for you to look more subtle for the Meowth of Bounty. Plus, I'm sure you want to get out of those wet clothes," The Ceremonial leader says.

"Um, thank you," Mew replies.

The next day, Meowth is feasting up like a storm. Mew stands close to Meowth as she eats. Because of the respect for the Meowth of Bounty and her clothes having been soaked, Mew is now wearing the clothes the islanders are wearing. As Meowth eats, he soon lets out a frown, and the ceremonial leader hurries over.

The ceremonial leader asks, "Are you in any way displeased, oh, great Meowth?"

"How come I ain't got any meatballs up here?!" Meowth shouts.

"Forgive me," The leader says.

Then calls out, "Bring some meatballs!"

"I only need a hundred!" Meowth says.

Later, Meowth's request was granted, and there are a lot of meatballs.

"Well, this oughta do for a start!" Meowth says.

And with that, Meowth munches the meatballs away.

And later on, Meowth is stuffed, "Ah! Whisker licking good!"

"You surely had your fill," Mew says, rolling her eyes.

Meowth then claps his paws twice and the ceremonial leader comes running.

He then asks, "Do you wish something, oh, Meowth of Bounty?"

"I could go for some entertainment." Meowth says.

"Your wish is my command!" The leader says, and bows his head.

Then calls out, "Bring on the dancers!"

And soon, some dancers appear before Meowth and begin to dance.

Two of the dancers approach on both sides of him and say, "We welcome you, oh, great Meowth of Bounty."

Then they both give him a kiss on the cheek

"Are you entertained, oh, Moewth of Bounty?" The Ceremonial Leader asks.

"Oh, yeah," Mewoth says, feeling satisfied.

Later on, Meowth is standing close to the cliff as he strums on a guitar.

Meowth:

Landing here was such a blessing!

Now all day long, I'm reminiscing!

But still, I wish I could share my happiness with somebody.

Soon, Meowth begins to remember her friends from last night.

"I wonder what my old friends Jessie and James are doing now," Meowth wonders.

"I'm sure they're somewhere. So are my friends," Mew's voice appears.

Meowth turns to see Mew walking toward them and sits down.

"I hope my friends are alright, since the Gyarados attack," Mew says.

"Yeah. Those Gyarados were a lot to handle," Meowth says.

Suddenly, they hear something coming from the bushes. They turn their heads to see something in the bushes.

"What was that?" Meowth asks.

"I'm not sure. Let's look," Mew says.

Mew and Meowth secretly sneak up to the bushes. They quietly tip toes as they approach the bushes. Just then, a Mewoth peeks out of the bushes. But this Meowth seems a bit larger.

"It's another Meowth," Meowth says, surprised.

Meowth walks over and asks, "Hey Meowth, what are you doing here?"

"Meow Meow Meow, Meow Meow," (I kind of live on the island, so I'm a local here.) The large Meowth says.

"You live here?" Mew asks.

"I'm surprised the islanders didn't notice you," Meowth says.

"Meow Meow Meow," (I'm a little shy to get close to the islanders.) Shiny Meowth says, blushing a bit.

"You're shy?" Meowth says, confused.

The Large Meowth shyly nods his head.

"Why not come with us, I'm sure the others will like to meet you," Mew says.

The Large Meowth blushes and quickly hides in the bushes.

"That Meowth is really shy," Mew says.

"Yeah," Meowth says.

Then turns to Mew, "Come on twerpette, let's go back to the villagers."

"Um sure. But still…" Mew says, and begins to think.

"What is it?" Meowth asks.

"I have to wonder why they call you the Meowth of Bounty, and why a Meowth at all," Mew says.

Mewoth then begins to think about it, "Yeah. I have to wonder why."

"Maybe they can explain it to us," Mew replies.

"Yeah. I'm still confused about it," Meowth says.

Meanwhile, somewhere in the ocean, Misty, Tomo, Tracy, and the Pokemon are on Lapras and are searching for Mew.

Tomo calls out, "Mew!"

"Mew, are you sure!"

"Pika pi!" (Mew!) Pikachu calls out.

"Eevee!" (Mew!) Eevee calls out.

Even Lapras squeals, "Mew!"

"Where are you?!" Tracey calls out.

"She can't get sent this far," Tracey says.

Pikachu and Eevee begin to feel sad for their Trainer and her safety.

"Don't worry, we'll find Mew. We just need to find out where she flew off to," Misty says.

"According to the direction she flies, she should be somewhere around this area," Tracey says, looking at the binoculars.

"Look, there's an island," Tracey says.

"Maybe Mew is over there," Misty says.

"Let's go look," Misty says.

Tomo then asks Lapras, "Lapras, can you take us to the island?"

Lapras nods and swims to the island.

Meanwhile, Jessie and James are on the island and are still a bit drenched.

Jessie spits sand from her mouth, "Blech. I can't believe those twerps beat us."

"And we lost Meowth," James says.

Jessie soon notices, "At least we land on the island."

"Yes. I wonder if Meowth is here somewhere," James says.

Before they can think, they hear squealing. They turn to see Lapras swimming towards the island.

"It's the twerps!" Jessie and James say, shocked.

As the group comes close to the island, they see, "Team Rocket?!"

And so, the two groups end up meeting up.

"You're the one who got Gyarados blasting us!" Tomo angrily says.

"Until we find Meowth and your Poke speaking twerpette," James says.

Back at the giant Meowth statue, Mewoth is still being pampered by the villagers. Mew is still skeptical about the villagers who are Meowth worshipers.

One of the dancers gives Meowth a berry, "Have another, great one."

But before Meowth can eat it, the Ceremonial leader calls out, "Excuse us, oh, great one."

Meowth looks to see the leader and the elder bow with respect.

"Did you say Pay Day?" Meowth asks, looking uneasy.

"I guess it's understandable because you were focusing on one thing and not thinking too much about the other. However, that doesn't mean it's too late to learn how to use Pay Day," Mew says.

Hearing that has the leader, Elder, and the villagers a little surprised, but interested.

Meowth becomes confused and looks at Mew, "What do you mean? I've spent a lot of my energy talking, I haven't learned any other attack."

"I think you can still learn how to use Pay Day and maybe other attacks. You just need to have more confidence, and a little help," Mew says with a smile.

Then Meowth remembers and happily says, "That's right, you know about Pokemon, attacks, and health more than anyone I've ever met. If anyone could help me learn how to use Pay Day, You can."

He then answers, "Alright, let's get training!"

Suddenly, they hear a familiar voice, "Meow Meow Meow? (Can I train too?)

Mew, Mewoth and the leader turns to see the large Meowth hiding behind the platform and peeks out.

"Meowth!" (Yeah!) Large Meowth says with a smile.

Soon, everyone is at the stadium, all the villagers have gathered as the Leader and Elder are sitting on separate chairs than the others who are sitting on stone seats. Mew, Meowth, and Large Meowth are in the middle of the battlefield.

Mew then turns to Meowth and Large Meowth, "Alright, the best way for you two to learn an attack is to battle and gain the experience. When a Meowth used Pay Day, it comes out from the charm on their heads."

"Oh, great Meowth of Bounty, please gain your experience quickly so that you may learn to use Pay Day!" The leader says.

Then turns to Skitty, "Alright Skitty, use Pay Day!"

Skitty performs Pay Day three more times, and both Meowths pay close attention to how Skitty uses her Pay Day attack.

"Alright, you two got it?" Mew asks.

"We sure are," Meowth says.

The Large Meowth nods his head.

Then Mew calls out to the leader, "Alright, we're ready."

And with that, the bars rise from the stadium to reveal two rather strong Pokemon, much to the three's surprise. One is a Nidoking, and the other is an Onix."

"I didn't expect this!" Meowth panics.

"Don't be scared, Meowth. We can beat them if we work together," Mew says.

"Right," Meowth says.

Just then, Nidoking begins to charge towards the two Meowth.

"Meowth, you both need to dodge!" Mew calls out.

And both Meowth dodge the attack.

Then Mew calls out, "Alright, Meowth use, scratch on Nidoking. Large Meowth, use Cut on Onix!"

"You got it," Meowth says.

Meowth then performs Scratch, but it doesn't have much effect. Meowth quickly dodges the attack as he runs away. The Large Meowth rushes and performs Cut on Onix, and it has a little more effect. Just then, begins to perform an attack.

"Meowth jump, it's going to use Poison Jab!" Mew calls out.

Meowth quickly jumps as Nidoking slams the Poison Jab to the ground.

Mew then calls out, "Meowth, use Bite!"

Meowth then dives down and bites on Nidoking by the head.

Mew quickly turns her head to see the Onix chasing after Large Meowth.

Mew then calls out, "Quick, Meowth, us Night Slash!"

Large Meowth then dodges Onix's tackle attack, and performs Night Slash, and strikes at it with strong force.

Meanwhile, somewhere in the forest, Mew's friends along with Jessie and James are still searching for Meowth.

"We've been walking for a while and no sign of Meowth or the twerpette," Jessie says.

"Maybe they're not even on this island," James says.

"Come on, we've been only on this island for fifteen minutes," Misty says, annoyed.

"They have to be here somewhere," Tracey says.

"I'm sure we'll find them," Tomo says.

Back in the stadium, Mew along with Meowth and Large Meowth are still battling against the Nidoking and Onix. Just then, Onix begins to perform Rock Throw.

"Dodge guys, it's Rock Throw!" Mew calls out.

Both Meowths quickly dodge the attack.

Mew then calls out, "Quick, Large Meowth use Bubble Beam on Onix!

Large Meowth then performs Bubble Beam and strikes at Onix, causing critical damage. Just then, Nidoking charges Meowth the talking one. Meowth soon finds himself cornered.

Then Mew calls out, "Meowth, it's time for you to try to use Pay Day! Try to concentrate hard on your charm!"

"Are you sure, I'm ready?!" Meowth asks.

"Trust me!" Mew calls out.

Reluctant, Meowth says, "Okay."

Meowth then closes his eyes and begins to concentrate as hard as he can as Nidoking charges closer.

Meowth struggles as he says, "I can do it. I can do it. I can do it.

Soon, Meowth's charm begins to glow.

Just then, Mew calls out, "Now Meowth, use Pay Day!"

"Alright, here I go…" Meowth says.

Then calls out, "PAY DAY!"

With that, glowing round orbs come out of Meowth's charm and fly towards Nidoking. All the round balls clash at Nidoking one by one, and coins pop out of then after every hit. Soon, the leader, the Elder, and all the villagers become surprised. Soon, coins begin to land on the battlefield.

Mew calls out, "Meowth, you did it! You've learned how to use Pay Day!"

"I… I did…?" Meowth asks, opening his eyes.

Meowth becomes surprised to see the coins are on the ground.

"I… I DID IT!" Meowth happily cheers.

Then screams with happiness, "I CAN USE PAY DAY! I CAN USE PAY DAY!"

But Mew calls out, "Quick Meowth, dodge!"

Meowth looks to see Nidoking charging at it. Meowth panics and quickly dodge the attack, and bumps into the Large Meowth.

Meowth turns to the large Meowth, "Sorry pal."

"Meow Meow," (It's alright.) Large Meowth says.

"Quick. Large Meowth, try to use Pay Day on Onix. Meowth, use Pay Day on Nidoking!" Mew calls out.

"Alright. Get a load of my new attack! Pay Day!" Meowth calls out.

He then begins to perform Pay Day and now he can use it perfectly.

The Large Meowth then concentrates and begins to perform Pay Day perfectly.

"Alright! You just learned Pay Day too! You both are doing great!" Mew says.

"Meow meow!" "(Thanks!) Large Meowth says with a smile

"Yeah. Thanks twerpete," Meowth says.

Mew rolls her eyes, "I have a name you know!"

Just then, Nidoking and Onix begin to charge for both Pokemon.

"Ready to finish this guys?" Mew asks.

Mewoth turns to Mew, "Kid, let's finish this."

"Meow Meow!" (Let's go!) Large Meowth says.

Both Onix and Nidoking continue to charge for both Meowths.

Mew then calls out, "Alright you guys, Multiple Pay Day!"

Meowth says, "You got it! Pay Day!"

"Meow! Meow Meow!" (Alright! Now, Pay Day) Large Meowth calls out.

With that, both Meowth perform Pay Day together and continue to create multiple glowing balls. They strike at Nidoking and Onix, and then coins come out of both attacks. There are multiple Pay Day coming out at once, that it stop the two Pokemon in their tracks.

Then Mew calls out, "Alright then, Large Meowth, use Double Edge on Onix! Meowth, use your Scratch attack!"

Large Meowth then charges and collides with Onix, on the forehead. Causing Onix to be thrown back and crashes to the ground.

"Alright, time to give it my Scratch Attack!" Meowth says, and charges to Nidoking.

Suddenly, Mewoth's claws glow and grow longer. With that, Meowth slashes at Nidoking with full force. Then, both Pokemon from either side are still standing and are exhausted.

Just then, the leader calls out, "Alright, let the training come to a close!"

Hearing that, the Pokemon decides to stop. Both Meowth sit on the ground and feel tired. Both Nidoking and Onix are called back to their Pokemon.

"Man, that was tiring, but it was really worth it. We both can use Pay Day," Meowth says.

Large Meowth says, "Meow Meow." (We really did.)

Meowth then picks up the coin to see that it is true. They've both learned to use a new move.

The Village Elder cheers, "It worked!"

"It's true! The great Meowth of Bounty has finally used Pay Day!" The Ceremonial Leader happily says.

And with that, the villagers soon run onto the battlefield and start grabbing as many coils as they can. Both Meowth then run to Mew to get away from the crowd.

"Wow. Look at them go," Meowth says.

"They must really take their ceremony seriously," Mew says.

"Meow meow," (You said it.) Large Meowth replies.

After the ceremony, Meowth, Large Meowth, along with the villagers, return to the Meowth Statue.

The leader expresses his gratitude, "Oh great Meowth of Bounty, we cannot thank you enough for what you and your commerads have done."

"You have produced these coins, great ones, and so fulfilled the ancient prophecy!" The Elder says.

Soon, the elder pours the coins into a large bowl.

"Wow. Never thought we made so many coins during our battle," Meowth says.

"Meow Meow," (Yeah. Guess we didn't know our own strength.) Large Meowth says.

Then the Elder says, "Our people are entirely grateful."

"We would be most honored if you would stay here and rule us. Oh Great Meowth of Bounty," The ceremonial ladder says.

"Stay here and rule?!" Mew and Meowth say in shock.

The two then look at each other.

"Uh yeah, we kind of have a little problem," Mew says.

"You see, uh. It's a very nice offer, but excluding this Meowth who has lived here. The kid and I well…" Meowth begins to explain.

"We really can't stay here. You see, we actually have friends who are looking for us, after an incident with a group of Gyarados, and we still need to look for them. We have our own lives to be honest," Mew explains.

"Yeah. As much as we like to help you, but we have friends and family. So we're sorry, but me and the kid can't stay," Meowth explains.

Then Mew turns to the Large Meowth, "But I think he doesn't mind staying."

The Large Meowth walks over to the leader and rubs his head against his leg. The leader smiles and picks up the Large Meowth.

The leader says, "I suppose you're right."

Then turns to the Large Meowth, "So, do you want to stay with us."

"Meow Meow," (Yes, I would love to.) The Large Meowth happily says with a nod.

Suddenly, they hear two familiar voices, "Meowth!"

"Mew!" Three familiar voices call out.

The group turns to see Misty, Tracey, Tomo, Jessie, James, and the other

Meowth is very happy, "Jessie! James!"

"Meowth!" Jessie and James call out, relieved to see Meowth.

The three soon hug each other and begin to cry in tears.

"You guys!" Mew happily calls out, and rushes over to her friends.

"Mew, you're okay!" Misty says.

"We were worried!" Tomo says.

"Are you okay?!" Tracey asks.

"We're fine. Nothing too serious," Mew says.

`"Why do you look like a cat?" Misty asks.

"Uh yeah. It's a long story, but we better get going. It's been a long day that we had," Mew says.

A little time later, Mew and her friends, and Team Rocket take their separate leaves. Each of them say goodbye to the villagers, the leader, elder, and the Large Meowth. And a lot has come out of the time Mew and Meowth have spent on the island.

Sometime later, Mew has explained to her friends what has happened, and it's surprising to say the least.

"I see. Those villagers believed that Meowth was brought to them to use Pay Day to bring them wealth," Tracey says.

"And that you were his companion," Tomo adds.

"I can't believe you battled with Meowth from Team Rocket of all Pokemon, and taught him how to use Pay Day," Misty replies.

"I know, but Meowth seems happy, and is able to learn how to use two new moves: Pay Day and Furry Swipe," Mew says.

"Impressive. I'm surprised you haven't tried to capture Meowth or convince him to come with us," Tracey says.

"Well, it's not my place to choose. Besides, mayne him learning new attacks will teach him a few things, especially if he wants to have another battle," Mew says.

"Maybe," Tomo replies.

Pikachu and Eevee look at each other and shrug their shoulders.

And so, the group continues to sail on Lapras and far from the island, where both Mew and Meowth had another solo adventure together.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket are out fishing. After the day and night they have, it's best to simply relax. There, Meowth has explained to Jessie and James what has happened on the island.

"So the twerpette helped you learn Pay Day?" James asks, a bit surprised.

"Yeah. And I actually learned Furry Swipe as well," Meowth says.

"Have to admit, the kid is an impressive trainer," Jessie says.

"Yeah. If she ever stops being a trainer, she sure will make a great teacher," Meowth says.

"I have to agree, but I have to guess you just can't stop there," James says.

"Yeah. This day taught me that I need to battle more if I'm going to learn new attacks and get stronger," Meowth says.

He sighs, "But for now, I think it will be good for me to relax a little while. That battle has me popped."

"Yeah. Maybe we should have you battle more Pokemon to gain more experience, in future," Jessie says.

"Well, if experiencing battling with the twerpette helped, maybe we should have you battle her more often," James says.

"Maybe," Meowth says.

Meowth then lies down and decides to take a cat nap. James and Jessie decide to do the same, after the long day they have.
