Chapter 20: Episode 20: Tracey Gets Bugged

One day, Mew and her friends are stopping at an island known as Murcott Island. It looks very peaceful, but looks can be deceiving. On the shore, Mew and her friends are at the beach and off the island.

"Thanks for the ride, Lapras," Mew says, and calls Lapras back into his Pokeball.

"Okay, Venonat and Marill, go!" Tracey says, and calls out his Pokemon.

"You really seem psyched, Tracey," Mew says.

"I've been waiting to visit this island for a long time. I can't believe we're here!" Tracey says.

Suddenly, the group hears buzzing sounds. Misty turns her head, lets out a yelp, and Ducks her head. Then a Beedrill flies past them.

Tracey asks, "What's that matter?"

"That was a Beedrill," Misty answers with fright, pointing to the Beedrill flying away.

"And a big one!" Misty adds.

"That was one of the reasons I'm so happy to finally be here, Misty," Tracey says.

"What?" Misty asks, shocked.

"Not just some Beedrill, Jun. Murcott Island's famous for having tons of bug element Pokémon," Tracey says.

"Sounds cool," Tracey says.

"You going to be okay, Misty?" Mew asks.

Misty quickly stands up, "I'll be alright, the Beedrill caught me by surprise and you know it's best to be uneasy around them."

"Are you okay, Misty?" Tracey asks.

"I'm okay. The Beedrill scared me a bit," Misty says.

"On the bright side, you were a lot better than before, but that Beedrill is pretty big," Mew says.

"What are you talking about?" Tracey asks.

Mew nervously giggles, "Well, back when Misty and I traveled in Kanto, Misty showed strong fear of Bug Pokemon, but she is getting a lot better cause she has some Big Pokemon on her own. But I guess some Big Pokemon still spook her like Beedrill."

"And for good reason," Tomo says.

Tracey then turns to Misty, "Well, it's good that you were able to face your fears."

"Thanks," Misty says.

"Don't worry Misty, as long as you stick with us, we won't have many problems. Besides, as long as we don't bother the Pokemon much, we'll be okay," Mew says.

Misty nods her head in reply.

And with that, Mew and her friends are walking in the forest to find any interesting Bug Type Pokemon. Marill and Venonat are leading the way, until they detect something.

"Did they find something?" Mew asks.

"Yeah, seems like it," Tracey says.

"What kind of something?" Misty asks.

"Is it a Pokemon?" Tomo wonders.

"I'll take a look," Tracey says and gets out his binoculars.

He looks around and spots a bunch of Caterpoe, "Wow! A Caterpie swarm."

"Aww, they look cute, and living peacefully," Mew says.

"You're right. They look very happy," Misty says.

"Kind of reminds me of when I first got mine," Mew says.

Just then, Tomo calls out, "Go Pokeball!"

Tomo then throws a Pokeball and hit one of the Caterpie and it goes inside. The Pokeball shakes a bit, and ping, Caterpie's been caught.

"Alright, I caught a Caterpie," Tomo happily cheers.

"Nice job, Tomo," Misty says.

"Great catch," Mew compliments.

Just then, Marill and Venonat begin to panic.

Tracey calls out, "Guys, there's something behind those bushes!"

"What is it?" Misty asks.

Just then, a Pinsir reveals itself from the bushes, frightening the girls, and the Pokemon.

Misty screams, "Caterpie are much better than Pinsir!" Then runs away.

Later on, Mew and her friends are walking through the forest again.

"Venonat and Marill are good to have around," Mew says.

"Venonat's radar eyes and Marill's super sensitive hearing make them a really great team. Marill and Venonat are more like partners than anything. We're all a team," Tracey says.

Suddenly,Venonat and Marill detect something.

"What's up, guys?" Tracey asks.

Venonat and Marill continue to detect something.

"I hope it's not too buggy," Misty replies.

"We can help it's not bigger than a Pinsir."

"Pika! Eev!" (Agreed!) Pikachu and Eevee reply.

"Whatever it is, it's over in that direction," Tracey says.

Soon, Venonat and Marill head after it.

"Let's see," Tracey says, and runs off. (runs off)

"Yeah!" Mew says, and follows Tracey with Pikachu and Eevee.

"I'm coming too!" Tomo says, and follows them with Meloetta and Skwovet.

"Wait for me!" Misty calls out, and follows them with Togepi and Pichu in her arms.

Mew and the others rush over to see a Scyther lying on the ground, and it looks badly hurt.

"A Scyther!" Mew says, and brings out her Pokedex.

Dexter says, "Syther, the Mantis Pokémon. A Bug and Flying Type. Its claws are sharp as swords and it is a powerful flyer. This Pokémon is rarely seen by humans and almost never captured."

Mew and the others approach the downed Scyther."

Tracey kneels down to it and asks, "What's the matter? Are you okay, buddy?"

Scyther looks up at the group, causing it to stand up a bit.

"It doesn't look too happy," Misty says.

Tracey reaches into his backpack, "I have something that'll make you feel lots better."

Tracey then pulls out a potion. Tracey then tries to give it to Scyther, but Scyther leaps up and assamese a battle position, but his body is shaking.

"Whoa!" Tracey says, surprised.

"We only want to help you, Scyther!" Tomo calls out.

Scyther then prepares to battle.

"Okay, now, hold still," Mew and and brings out her Pokeball.

"What are you gonna do, Ash?" Tracey asks.

"If I catch it, we can take it to a Pokémon Center," Mew says.

"Yeah! Then it can have a rest and heal up!" Tracey says.

"Pokéball, go!" Mew calls out and throws her Pokeball.

Scyther then manages to knock the Pokeball away, but staggers as doing so.

"Scyther's still fighting," Mew says.

"It's almost like it doesn't want us to help out," Misty says.

"But it's badly hurt," Tomo says.

Tracey then looks at Scyther intensely.

"I think it's gonna fight us!" Misty panics.

"But we can't fight it like this," Mew says.

"You're right. Scyther is too weak to fight," Tracey says.

"And it's not going to back down. We need a different approach," Mew says.

Then Tracey has an idea, "I have an idea. Venonat, come on."

Venonat nods and walks in front of Scyther. However, Scyther aggressive approach, frightening it.

Tracey calls out, "Don't back down, Venonat! Sleep Powder!"

With that Venonat releases the Sleep Powder. Scyther tries to fly, but is too weak to fly away. Soon, the Sleep Powder reaches Scyther and it's starting to take effect.

"Hey, it worked!" Tomo says.

"Yeah!" Tracey replies.

He gets out his Pokeball and throws it at Scyther. "Quick! Let's get it to a Pokémon Center!"

Scyther is pulled to the Pokeball and with a ping, Scyther has been caught. Then everyone hurries off to find the Pokemon Center.

"Hurry!" Mew says.

Meanwhile, overhead, Team Rocket is flying over the forest in their balloon. As usual, Team Rocket is trying to spot any Pokemon to steal, or to find Mew and her friends.

Jessie asks, "See anything?"

"Nothing yet," James answers.

"Me neither," Meowth says.

Soon, Mewowth spots a Beedrill.

"Except for a…" Meowth says in fright.

But before he can finish, Beedrill pierces straight through the balloon, causing it to lose altitude, and falling to the ground. Soon, the balloon crashes to the ground, and the three emerge from the balloon.

"Well, that was certainly a gigantic let down," Jessie says in pain.

Just then, the three spots a Caterpie and a Weedle near them, followed by a Venomoth flying by. Then they spot a Paras and a Metapod in a nearby tree. The three get up to find themselves in the large forest of Bug Pokemon.

"Where are we?" Jessie asks.

"It's certainly buggy," James answers.

"Yeah," Meowth replies.

Suddenly, a swarm of Scyther surrounds them, with their leader having a scar on its forehead. Team Rocket gather together in fear, and the leader Scyther begins to attack, terrifying them.

Meanwhile, Mew and her friends are at the Pokemon Center as they watch Scyther on the treatment table. As it's being bandaged up by Nurse Joy, Scyther is staring at Tracey.

"It was so weak, but it just wouldn't give up without a fight," Mew says.

"It's almost like it's mad at us," Tomo says.

Then Misty says, "Yeah. Just look at how it's staring at Tracey."

Soon, the treatment light goes off, indicating that Nurse Joy has finished with the treatment. Both Nurse Joy and Tracey roll Scyther on the stretcher.

"Nurse Joy, how's Scyther doing?" Mew asks.

"Scyther is still very weak. It's gonna take a few days to get its strength back," Nurse Joy answers.

"How do you feel, Scyther?" Tracey asks.

But Scyther gives Tracey a harsh response, causing him to back up.

Nurse Joy says to Scyther, "You've got to relax or you won't heal properly, Scyther.

Scyther remains sounding defiant.

Nurse Joy turns to Chansey, "Chansey, would you take Scyther to recovery?"

Chansey agrees and rolls Scyther down the hall.

Just then, Nurse Joy says, "I guess the old warrior finally lost a battle for leadership of its swarm."

"Battle for leadership?" Tomo asks.

"How do you know that that Scyther used to be the leader of its whole swarm?" Tracey asks, looking at Scyther.

"Well, an older Scyther only could've gotten these kinds of injuries by battling another Scyther," Nurse Joy says.

"To stay leader!" Misty replies.

"Yeah. I have to suspect it seeing all those bruises it has. I guess the other Scyther must have been stronger.

"Usually, it's a younger, faster Scyther that challenges the leader. Sometimes speed and power can overcome even the most experienced Pokémon," Nurse Joy says.

"How come Scyther was all alone when we found it?" Misty asks.

Then Mew explains, "Papa told me that once a leader is defeated by another Scyther, it can't stay with the swarm. Unless it wins a new leadership battle, it has to live all by itself."

"You're correct," Nurse Joy says.

Later on, Mew and her friends are in the lobby talking with Professor Oak.

"Well, you should be very proud of your capture, Tracey," Professor Oak says.

"But it wasn't like a real capture, Professor," Tracey says.

"What do you mean, Tracey? Of course it was real," Tomo replies.

"Yeah, but it was injured," Tracey says.

Then Professor Oak says, "You don't sound very happy, Tracey."

"Maybe because Scyther doesn't seem to be very happy," Tracey says.

"I'll bet it's because Scyther's sense of pride has been injured, too," Professor Oak says.

The group becomes puzzled.

"What do you mean?" Tracey asks.

Even the Pokemon are puzzled.

"If Scyther was defeated by another Scyther, and then it was captured by you, it must be feeling very low," Professor Oak explains.

Then Tracey asks, "So what am I supposed to do now?"

"You always have to keep in mind that every single Pokémon has its own unique feelings and personality. You must try to help Scyther regain confidence in its strength and in itself," Professor Oak explains.

"Right," Tracey says with a nod.

Meanwhile, in the forest, Team Rocket are able to get away from the swarm of Scyther.

"That was a close one!" Jessie says in fright.

"Scyther missed us by a…" James says.

James and Meowth then notice something shocking about Jessie.

"What's wrong?" Jessie asks.

"I'm afraid that your hair's not there," James says.

"My hair?" Jessie says, confused.

Jessie touches her head and moves her hands to feel the back. To her shocking discovery, she realizes that she hasn't escaped unscaved. Her hair has been chopped off.

Jessie gets her mirror as she freaks out, "My hair!"

And sees that her hair has been chopped off short.

And gets up, furious, "I'm gonna get that Scyther!"

Then rushes off to go after Scyther to get back at it for her hair.

"Wait a second!" Meowth calls out, and runs after her.

Then Meowth jumps onto Jessie's back.

"You fraidy cat! Get your paws off me!" Jessie angrily says.

Meowth questions, "Why catch just one Scyther when we can swipe the whole swarm?"

"You think we can do it?" Jessie asks.

"Of course," Meowth says, and jumps off Jessie's back, "If we had a swarm of Scyther on our side, we'd be simply unstoppable."

"That way, we can get revenge on Jessie's haircut, and score points with the boss at the same time!" James says."

Then Jessie says in anger, "Let's go catch them all! Especially that one!" and runs off to catch the Scyther.

"Hold it, Jessie!" James calls out.

James and Meowth leap on Jessie and stop her, and the three fall to the ground. James is pounding on the ground as she grits her teeth in anger.

"We gotta plan this," Meowth says.

"If you're not careful, you could wind up with a crewcut!" James adds.

Jessie comes to realize it, and imagines herself with a crewcut look.

Jessie screams in fear, "That's my nightmare!"

Back at the Pokemon Center, Tracey is in the medical room where Scyther is laying.

Tracey says to Scyther, "I think I know how you must be feeling, Scyther. And I can only imagine how down you must be about me capturing you without really having a battle. But as a trainer, I couldn't just leave you there hurt and all by yourself. I just wish I knew how to make you happy."

But Scyther gives no response.

Then Mew has an idea, "Hey, I know!"

"What, Mew?" Tracey asks.

"There's no reason why Scyther couldn't go back and challenge the new leader of the swarm to another battle as soon as it gets better," Mew says.

"You mean like a rematch?" Tracey asks.

"Pika!" (Bingo!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee!" (Good idea) Eevee says.

"A Scyther's a natural born warrior, and it's happiest when it's battling," Mew says.

"You're right," Tracey says.

"Sounds good," Tomo says.

"Yeah. You're usually right about stuff like this," Misty says.

Then Tracey turns to Scyther, "What do you think, Scyther? When you're better, you can go and battle again. Maybe I can even help you to train, if you want me to."

Scyther however, doesn't answer.

Out in the forest, Team Rocket are able to find the Scyther swarm at a pond.

"Look! They're taking a bath, "James calls out.

"Good, then we'll get a clean shot at them," Jessie says.

Then Meowth pulls out a bazooka, "Da blaster's ready."

Then Jessie takes out a bazooka, "Let's have it."

"They won't look so sharp when we're through," James says.

"Hey! Here's some goo for all of you!" Jessie angrily calls out and fires the bazooka.

The rocket comes flying towards the swarm, and releases some sticky goo onto the Scyther Swarm. The Scyther Swarm tries to pull the goo away, and get themselves free, but the goo is too strong for them to do so.

"That'll teach you not to get snippy with me!" Jessie angrily shouts.

Then Meowth fires a net launcher and traps the swarm.

Team Rocket shouts, "Got em!"

The Scyther Swarm then let out a cry for help.

In the Pokemon Center, the former leader Scyther hears them.

"What is it? What's the matter, Scyther?" Tracey asks.

Just then, Mew asks, "Did you guys hear that?"

Nurse Joy soon takes the bandages off, "Well. It still has a way to go, but Scyther's healing nicely."

"You'll be up and around in no time," Tomo says.

"Skwovet!" (And how!)

Just then, Scyther begins flapping his wings, shocking everyone in the room.

"Scyther, wait! You're too weak to…" Nurse Joy calls out.

But Scyther is already flying over the bed.

"Scyther, don't!" Tracey calls out.

And with that, Scyther smashes through the window and heads to the forest.

Tracey calls out, "Scyther, come back!"

Scyther soon loses his flying strength and falls to the ground.

"Scyther!" Tracey calls out, climbs out of the window, and rushes to Scyther.

Scyther weakly gets up onto one knee.

Tracey rushes to Scyther and says, "Scyther, you have to rest now!"

Scyther pushes Tracey aside and takes off.

"Scyther!" Tracey calls out, but Scyther is already gone, "Scyther, no."

Mew and the others rush to Tracey.

Tomo says, "I bet it's gonna challenge the new leader to a rematch!"

"But that's dangerous. Scyther's not strong enough," Misty says.

"Its body may be weak, but its heart is super strong," Tracey says.

"You're right, but I don't think Scyther is looking at a rematch," Mew says.

"What do you mean?" Misty asks.

"I think I heard Scyther cry, and Scyther heard it too. And Scyther has a concerned look on his face. I think there's another Scyther in trouble," Mew says.

"Then we better get going," Tracey says.

Misty then says, "We gotta go, Nurse Joy."

With that, Mew and her friends hurry off to catch up with Scyther.

Nurse Joy sighs and calls out, "Alright! But just remember to be careful out there!"

Meanwhile, Team Rocket has the Scyther Swarm trapped in the net, hanging in a tree.

Jessie laughs as wickedly as a witch and picks the swarm with a tree branch, "So, you thought you could get away with cutting my hair, did you? Well, now I've cut you all down to size!"

James and Meowth are growing frightened by Jessie's behavior.

"She's scary!" James says.

"Things get messy when you mess with Jessie!" Meowth says in fright.

"I've been robbed of my crowning glory, my resplendent hair!" Jessie says,

"Resplendent?" James says, dumbfounded.

"Must mean big," Meowth replies with the same expression.

"Since I was a child, it was my only companion. And now it's been destroyed," Jessie says, showing sorrow.

Then switches with a laugh of madness, frightening the Scyther Swarm.

Jessie laughs evilly and says, "Now it's payback time."

The Scyther Swarm struggles to break free. Just then, something swift passed the net, causing it to be cut down, freeing the Scyther trapped inside. Team Rocket becomes puzzled and shocked. And then, Tracey's Scyther friend lands in front of the swarm, determined to protect them. The Swarm are surprised to see their former leader has come back and is rescuing them.

"Well, who's this?" Jessie asks.

"Looks like we missed one," Meowth says.

"One Scyther isn't going to scare us, is it?" James asks.

Scyther lets out a cry of anger, causing Team Rocket to Panic.

Just then, they hear Mew's voice, "It's them!"

Team Rocket turns their heads to see Mew and her friends.

"Huh? The twerps?!" Jessie asks, a little surprised and annoyed.

Suddenly, Mew and her friends are surprised to see Jessie's 'new haircut'.

"What are you looking at?" Jessie asks, embarrassed.

Just then, Mew and her friends, including the Pokemon, are covering their mouths to prevent their laughter.

"Hey. Where'd you get that new do?"Misty asks, trying not to laugh.

Jessie becomes furious, "How DARE you?! You insult my hair, prepare for trouble!

"It used to be there but now it's stubble," James says.

And with that, Team Rocket begins the motto.

Jessie throws her Pokeball.

Jessie:

To protect my head from humiliation!

And Arbok comes out of the Pokeball.

Then James throws his Pokeball.

James:

Too bad her hair went on vacation.

Weezing comes out of its Pokeball.

Then Jessie throws her other Pokeball.

Jessie:

My gorgeous hair was my one true love!

And Lickitung comes out of its Pokeball.

Then James throws another Pokeball.

James:

They went together like a hand in glove.

Victreebel comes out and munches on James again.

Jessie:

JESSIE!

James:

James.

Jessie:

Now my hair's short, but it won't be for long!

James:

And it won't stop our Jessie from doing what's wrong!

Meowth:

Hairy!

"How do they come up with that stuff?" Tomo asks, dumbfounded.

"I like your new hairstyle a lot, Jessie," Misty says.

Then Mew says, "I have to agree. So what happened to your hair?"

Then Misty asks, "Yeah, who cut it? A barber or a butcher?"

"Very funny! One of them did it, and now they're all gonna pay for it!" Jessie angrily says, and points to them.

"So what are you gonna do to those Scyther now?" Tracey demands.

James chuckles, "They're going to be Team Rocket's new cutting edge fighting force."

"Maybe their first mission should be to capture your little Pikachu and Eevee!" Meowth says.

"That's what you think!" Mew angrily says.

Then turns to Pikachu and Eevee, "Pikachu, Eevee, go!"

"Pika!" (Gotcha!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee!" (On it!) Eevee says.

Then James says, "Weezing, Smokescreen attack!"

Weezing performs Smokescreen and manages to blind everyone. Just then, Scyther get in front of them and spins around, blowing the smoke away, surprising Team Rocket.

Meowth has to complement, "Nice move!"

"What's that?" Tomo asks.

"That was Swords Dance!" Mew says.

Then Mew shows Tomo the Pokedex, Dexter says, "Swords Dance, Scyther's special attack. Scyther spins furiously to focus its energy and increase its attack power."

Soon, Scyther stops spinning.

"Scyther's great!" James says, amazed.

Jessie angrily asks, "Who's side are you on?!"

Then turns to see Scyther, "Besides, its energy boost was a bust."

Soon, Scyther is revealed to still be weakened.

"It's still weak," Tracey softly.

"Looks like you're out of shape, buggy," Meowth mocks.

"This one's over the hill," James says.

Then Jessie says, "Now try the two-step and step out of our way."

Team Rocket begins laughing at then.

But Scyther refuses to give up and says, "Scyther Scy!" (I may not be their leader anymore, but I won't let you take 'em!)

Ha! Yeah, you're really scaring me!" Meowth says in a mocking tone.

"What's it saying?" James asks.

"It's saying 'I may not be their leader anymore, but I won't let you take em.' Like it could stop us!" Meowth says.

"Sounds like these Scyther had a little scrape," James says.

"How noble. You've come back to defend the swarm that sent you away," Jessie says.

"Ooh! How inspiring!" James says.

Hearing Team Rocket, the lead Scyther realizes what the older leader is doing, including Tracey

"Scyther didn't come back here to defeat the new leader!" Tracey says.

"Right. It came back to rescue its friends," Mew says.

"That Scyther is brave," Tomo says.

But Team Rocket continues to mock it,

"What a touching story," Jessie says.

Then James says, "But I don't think you'll be able to touch us."

"I say we find out!" Meowth says.

With that, Jessie calls out, "Alright, Arbok, Weezing, Lickitung and Victreebel, let's exterminate this little pest!"

The four Pokemon hang up on Scyther. Piakchu and Eevee try to jump in, but Scyther blocks him, telling them that this is his fight and his fight alone.

Meowth laughs, "The big bad bug just told Pikachu and Eevee it don't need help because it can beat us by itself!"

"Ha," Jessie mocks.

Then James says, "Ha! Awesome!"

Jessie and Mowth look at James with a weird look. Soon, all five Pokemon are at a stare down.

"You can do it," Tracey says.

Tomo calls out, "You can do it, Scyther."

Then Mew says, "Pikachu, Eevee, come back."

Hearing Mew, Pikachu and Eevee return to Mew.

"Why are you calling them back?" Misty asks.

"Scyther has to fight this battle all by itself," Tracey says.

"But why?" Misty asks.

"Because Scyther's got something to prove to itself by itself," Tracey says.

Scyther nods his head.

Then Tracey says, "Alright, Scyther, let's go!"

Scyther stands, prepped for a battle as all four Team Rocket charge with Meowth taking the lead.

"Come on! This one's gonna be a pushover!" Meowth says.

With that, Scyther knocks Meowth back with one attack, knocking him out of the battle.

Tracey happily calls out, "Good work, Scyther! Keep it up!"

Lickitung and Victreebel attack together from a different direction.

Tracey calls out, "Look out, Scyther! They're double-teaming you!"

Scyther then leaps, and goes airborne, while Lickitung goes headfirst into Victreebel's mouth.

Then Tracey calls out, "Scyther, Arbok's coming at you from below!"

Scyther looks to see Arbok leaping up to it.

Then Tracey calls out, "Try Double Team!"

Scyther then performs a Double Team to make copies of himself, causing Arbok to get confused. Arbok attacks two fake Scythers and falls to the ground.

"It worked!" Mew cheers.

"Great job!" Misty says.

"Alright!" Tomo cheese.

Scyther lands on the ground, but has gotten weaker.

Mew cheers, "You can beat em, Scyther!"

"Pika!" (Get up!) Pikachu calls out.

"Eevee Eevee!" (Knock them into next week!)" Eevee says.

Victreebel rears back for an attack.

Tracey calls out, "Scyther, it's gonna use Razor Leaf!"

Scyther charges and uses its scythe arms to cut the Razor Leaf attack apart, causing Victreebel to panic.

"Yes!" Tracey cheers.

"That was great, Tracey," Mew says.

Misty then asks, "But how did you know it was gonna use Razor Leaf?"

I could tell by the way Victreebel was moving. That comes from being a Pokémon Watcher." Tracey says.

Jessie angrily calls out, "Arbok, Poison Sting attack, now!"

With that, Arbok launches the Poison Sing. Scyther Dodges. Arbok performs the attack again, but Scyther dodges again.

Tracey calls out, "Scyther!"

Arbok then charges straight for Scyther for another attack. Scyther is still so weak that it can't avoid the attack. Just before the Poison Sting can attack, the lead Scyther defends it, surprising Arbok and the others.

"Yeah! It blocked Arbok's attack!" Tracey says, amazed.

The lead Scyther looks at Tracey's Scyther, and vice versa.

Jessie calls out in anger, "Go, all of you! Attack them together!"

With that, all four of the Pokemon charge toward the Scyther, but both Scyther stand and ready to attack. The leader then allows Scyther to leap into the fray from its shoulders. With that, the lead Scyther charges while Tracey's Scyther is ready to attack.

Then Tracey calls out, "Slash attack!"

Scyther then performs the Slash Attack, and knocks all four Pokemon down in three slashes.

Tracey cheers, "Alright!"

Meowth is shocked, "Do something."

Just then, Jessie angrily holds the bazooka, "I still go one last shot at stopping you!" and aims it at Scyther.

Mew has enough, "That's no fair! Thunderbolt, Pikachu!"

Pikachu then comes up and performs the Thunderbolt Attack, and lands on Team Rocket. Then Scyther charges and performs Slash Attack, cutting off Team Rocket's hair, fur in Meowth's case. leaving Jessie and James with mohawks and Meowth with a bald spot between his eyes.

Then the three retreat in fear.

Jessie cries out, "That was certainly a close shave!"

"Scyther's a real cut up!" James panics.

Mowth screams, "We all got a scalp treatment!"

Then all three shout, "Team Rocket's dashing off again!"

Mew and the other to Scyther to congratulate it.

"You did it, Scyther!" Tracey says.

"You beat them all!" Mew says.

"That was cool!" Misty says.

"You were awesome!" Tomo says.

Then Pikachu says, "Pikachu!" (Nice going!)

"Eevee!" (So cool!) Eevee says.

"Skwovet Skwov!" (Totally radical!)

Meloetta happily says, "Mel Melooetta," (You were very brave!)

Scyther then lets out a cry for victory.

Later on, the Scyther Swarm clean themselves off from the sticky goo. Soon, the leader of the Swarm approaches Scyther, and the two make peace. Soon, the Scyther Swarm takes their leave.

"Winning that battle did more for Scyther than any Pokémon Center could," Tomo says.

Tracey then says, "Yeah, I think Scyther probably feels stronger now than it ever did."

Scyther then turns to Tracey and nods his head.

Tracey nods back, "We both feel stronger."

Then Tracey brings out Scyther's Pokeball and calls him back, "Scyther, return!"

Scyther is soon called back into the Pokeball.

Then Tracey says, "Alright, I caught Scyther!"

"Yeah. You really caught Scyther for real. I think he'll make a great addition to your team," Mew says.

"I have to agree," Tracey says with a nod.

Then Tomo asks, "Hey Tracey, can Scyther help me train with my Pokemon sometime."

"Sure Tomo," Tracey says.

At the end of the day, Tracey's patience and perseverance finally paid off. He now has a new Pokemon and a new friend. Scyther has a new friend, too, and a new reason to believe in itself. We can find those same things, but only if we look.

Chapter 21: Episode 21: The Buzz on Misty

On a bright sunny day, Mew and her friends are still sailing over the ocean blue on Lapras. The day seems very relaxing. Misty is playing with Togepi. Tracey is looking around with his binoculars. Mew along with Pikachu and Eevee are relaxing. Tomo, Meloetta, and Skwovet are looking at Mew's Pokedex, which Mew allows him to use. The sea is calm, the sun is shiny, the cool breeze blows at them and the day feels great. Suddenly, they begin to hear the sound of thunder, and lightning. The group stops their relaxation to see dark storm clouds rolling with thunder and lightning in it. Piakchu and Pichu soon have electric sparks coming from their cheeks.

"It looks like there's a storm," Tracey says.

"And a really big one," Mew says.

"I don't like the look of that storm," Misty says.

She then puts Togepi and Pichu into their backpacks, "You both better stay inside."

Togepi and Pichu agree and hide in their backpack.

Mew opens her bag as well, "You two better get inside too."

Pikachu and Eevee hurry inside the backpack. Meloetta and Skwovet quickly hide inside Tomo's backpack as well, and Tomo quickly closes it for them to be safe.

Mew says to the others, "Hang on, everybody"

It doesn't take long for Lapras to end up swimming into the storm. Mew and her friends hold on to Lapras as the waves become very rough. The sky becomes dark and thunder and lightning flash in the sky. The waves become very rough and grow bigger. Lapras struggles and continues to swim across the rough sea in order to find land, but the waves are too much for him. Just then, the group begins to panic to see a giant wave in front of them. The group scream in fright and the waves crash down on them.

Moments later, Lapras rises up, and Tracey and Mew cough out the water from their mouths.

"The storm is getting too much!" Tracey says.

"We need to get out of the storm before…" Mew says.

But hears Misty crying out, "Help!"

Mew and Tracye turn their heads and become shocked to see Tomo and Misty are gone.

"Misty! Tomo!" Mew exclaims in shock.

"They're gone!" Tracey says, shocked.

Just then, they hear Tomo call out, "Help! Mew!"

Mew and Tracye turn their heads to see Misty and Tomo are being pushed back by the waves.

"Tomo!" Mew calls out.

Tracey calls out, "Misty!"

With that, the waves push them back and away from Misty.

"There's no way we can reach them with the storm!" Tracey calls out.

"Yeah. I don't think Lapras can hold up any longer!" Mew says.

All Mew, Tracey, and Lapras can do is try to swim their way across the sea.

Meanwhile, Misty and Tomo struggle to stay on the surface, Misty quickly brings out her Pokeball and calls out, Goldeen and Staryu to help keep themselves a float. Misty hangs on to Staryu while Tomo is hanging on to Goldeen.

Misty asks, "Are you okay, Tomo?"

"I'm okay, but what about Mew and Tracey?" Tomo asks, coughing out water.

"We can't get to them with the storm. It will be too much for Staryu and Goldeen," Misty says.

Just then, the waves continue to push them back and farther away from Mew, Tomo, and Lapras who are being pushed back in the opposite direction.

Time has gone by, and the storm has come to an end. Misty and Tomo are now lying on the island unconscious on the beach of an island as Staryu and Goldeen are next to Misty with exhaustion. Soon enough, Misty eyes begin to squint and move, and begin to regain consciousness.

Misty begins to sit up and coughs a bit, "Wha-what happened?"

Tomo begins to regain consciousness as well. Then coughs out some of the sand and water from his mouth.

"Blech! Yuck!" Tomo reacts as he spits sand from his mouth and sticks his tongue out.

"Are you okay, Tomo?" Misty asks, concerned.

"I'm okay," Tomo answers.

Misty then opens her backpack, "Togepi, Pichu, are you both okay?"

Pichu and Togpei stick their heads out of the backpack and answer, "Toge prriii/ Pichu," (We're okay.)

Tomo opens his backpack, "Meloetta. Skwovet. You both alright?"

Meloetta comes out answer, "Meloett," (I'm okay.)

Skwovet comes out of the backpack, but looks a bit sick and rubs his tummy, "Skwov Skwovet," (I think I got seasick.)

"Poor Skwovet," Tomo replies.

"What's wrong?" Misty asks.

"Skwovet's a little queasy," Tomo answers.

Misty looks at Skwovet and says, "Poor thing, it must have gotten sick from the storm."

Skwovet slowly nods his head in reply.

"Don't worry Skwovet, I might have something of your stomach ache," Misty says, and reaches in her bag, "I know those motion sickness pills are around… aha!"

Misty then takes out a small pill. Then bring out a small jar of mashed berries.

Misty gives Skwovet the pill, "Her you go, something for your tummy."

Skwovet takes the pill and swallows it in his mouth.

"And here's some mashed berries Mew made. Made with Oran Berries, Sitrus Berries, and some Leppa berries," Misty says, and opens the jar.

She then takes a small spoon full and feeds it to Skwovet. Skwovet eats a little bite and is starting to feel better.

"Now just get some rest and I'm sure you'll feel better," Misty says.

Skwovet nods his head and climbs back into Tomo's backpack to get some sleep.

Misty looks around, "Still, I wonder which island we ended up on."

"Yeah. It looks like we landed on a rather large island. I wonder how far we are from the others," Tomo says.

"I don't know, but we have to find then," Misty says.

She then brings out her Pokeball and calls out, "Come on, Staryu!"

Misty throws her Pokeball, but Staryu isn't coming out.

"Huh?" Misty says, confused. "Why can't Staryu come out?"

"Maybe try your other Pokemon?" Tomo asks.

"Alright," Misty says, and brings out another Pokeball.

Then throws it, "Go Tentacruel!"

But Tentacruel isn't coming out of his Pokeball either.

"My Pokemon aren't coming out?!" Misty says, shocked.

Tomo brings out his Pokeball, "Let me try."

"Go Delibird!" Tomo then throws his Pokeball.

But Delibird isn't coming out of his Pokeball either.

"That's weird. My Pokeball isn't working either," Tomo says.

"I guess the best we can do is stay here until Mew and Tracey find us," Misty says.

Then turns to see a large jungle area on the island, "I wonder what island we landed on."

Just then, Misty screams in surprise and quickly ducks her head as a large Beedrill flies past her. Misty and Tomo turn their heads to see it flying into the sky.

The green on its thorax extends onto its abdomen in three triangular markings. There are also several triangular flaps that extend upward and attach to the bubble over its head. The head itself has large light blue eyes with darker pupils and sclerae, two blue bumps on top, and a light green mouth similar to a spinneret.

Dexter says, "Dewpider, the Water Bubble Pokemon. A Water and Bug Type. Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head."

It has small wings used for flying with others, and a pattern of three oblong yellow spots on its rear.

This Pokémon loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise. Illumise, the Firefly Pokemon. A Bug Type. Illumise attracts a swarm of Volbeat using a sweet fragrance. Once the Volbeat have gathered, this Pokémon leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky."

Surskit is now a light blue Pokémon with two pairs of rhombus-shaped wings on each side of its body. Its head is shaped like an elongated teardrop with a pink face and round, black eyes. On either side of its head is a large antenna that resembles an angry eye. The antennae are white with pink along the lower rim. White lines along the rim resemble eyelashes, while a large, dark pink dot in the middle represents the pupil or iris. These eyespots are used to intimidate enemies.

Combee is now a bee-like Pokémon with a typical insect-like, three-part body, i.e. divided into an abdomen, thorax, and head. It has a yellow- and black-striped abdomen, which flares out from a thin, waist-like protrusion under its thorax in a manner that resembles an elegant ball gown. Underneath the expansive abdomen are seven orange, honeycomb-like cells. She also has black arms that each consist of two thin, conical segments. Each arm ends in two small, orange claws. It flies with a pair of relatively small wings, each of which consists of two stacked, translucent teardrop segments. Her arms and wings attach to its round thorax, which is yellow on the front, black on the back, and orange on each side where its arms attach. A curved line on its back, between its orange shoulders, separates its thorax and waist. Her head consists of its face and horns. Its orange face has intimidating red eyes; yellow mandibles that protrude from its face and connect to its horns; and a large, red gem on its forehead. And her horns are yellow close to its face and black at the tips, and with the gem.

Just then, Surskit's new form flies in the air and performs what looks like an Air Slash attack, which is enough to break apart the large beak of the robot, and everyone is free. Then Combee's new form performs a powerful Signal Beam and fires at the two Pokemon. Knocking them out.

Mew and the others including the Pokemon are able to get out through the opening and hurry towards Misty.

"Misty, are you alright?" Mew asks.

"I'm okay. A little bruised is all," Misty says.

Tomo then asks, "Did Surskit and Combee evolve?"

"They did," Misty says.

"That's amazing, Surskit is a Masqurain now," Tracey says, amazed.

"And your Combee is a Vespiquen," Rose adds.

"Amazing," Misty says.

Cassidy and Butch then call back their Pokemon.

"Our Pokemon have been crushed," Cassidy says.

"And we lost the Pokemon we caught," Butch says.

Then Misty steps in, "And I'm going to make sure to save these Bug Pokemon. It's time for you to 'Buzz off'"

Then Misty calls out, "Masquerain, use Whirlwind! Vespiquen, use Silver Wind!"

With that, both Pokemon begin to perform their attack and begin to blow Team Rocket's Pokemon towards them, and to send them flying in the air.

"I think we really got winded this time," Cassidy screams.

"And those kids are really starting to bug us!" Butch screams.

"Those kids are nothing but pests!" Cassidy screams.

As they been sent flying Cassidy and Butch scream, "We're blasting off again!"

After Team Rocket is gone, and later in the day, Mew and her friends are ready to go. After that, it turns out that the Bug Pokemon want to go with Mew and the others.

"So you sure it's okay for them to come with us?" Misty asks.

"I don't mind at all. Besides, they are very happy to be with you," Rose says.

"Thanks Rose," Misty says.

"And thanks for helping us," mew says.

"I should be the one thanking you. You helped save the Pokemon from Team Rocket, especially you Misty," Rose says.

"Thanks," Misty says.

Tomo soon notices, "Hey Mew, your backpack is shaking."

Mew turns to her backpack and quickly opens it. Then brings out her glowing Pokemon Egg.

"It's hatching," Mew says.

She removes the lid as the others watch the egg glow. Finally, the Pokemon Egg pops and a new baby Pokemon is born. Soon, the baby Pokemon is revealed to be a Fomantis.

"It's a Fomantis," Misty says.

"And a very healthy one too," Rose says.

Mew looks down to Fomantis and happily says, "Hello Fomantis, welcome."

The little Fomantis smiles and wraps scythe-like arms around Mew's face. The group begins laughing with a smile, and welcomes the new Pokemon.

After that, Mew and her friends are sailing out to sea with Lapras as they wave goodbye to Rose and her Pokemon, and the other Pokemon on the island. And they have one crazy adventure, but everything turns out well in the end. Mew and the others have new Pokemon, Misty is scared of bugs anymore, and Mew has a new baby Pokemon. And soon new adventures will await them.

Chapter 22: Episode: 22 A Way Off Day Off

On a bright sunny day, out in the ocean blue, Mew and her friends are at the high seas, and are always in high spirits. However, this time around, the group of friends are feeling very bored.

Tomo lies down on Lapras and says, "I am so bored."

"Yeah. Me too," Mew says.

"We should do something," Misty says.

"Yeah," Tracey says.

Suddenly, Tomo's stomach begins to growl, "I'm hungry."

"And I'm kind of hot," Mew says.

"And I'm thirsty," Misty says.

Just then, Pikacho spots something and calls out, "Pikachu!" (Land ho!)

"Land? Where?" Mew asks.

"Pika Pika!" (Look up yonder!) Pikachu answers.

Mew and the others look to see what Pikachu spots.

Pikachu continues, "Pika Pika!" (It's an island!)

"Hey, look! Pikachu spots an island!" Mew says.

"Maybe we can get something to eat there," Tomo says.

"Good idea," Tracey says.

Then Misty says, "At least it'll give us something to do."

Mew turns to Lapras and says, "Okay, Lapras, let's head for that island!"

Lapras then speeds ahead to the island.

Soon enough, Mew and the others are now on the peach of the island as Pikachu, Eevee, and the others begin to explore.

Mew calls out, "Make sure you don't go too far and get lost, okay, guys?!"

Mew looks around the island, "It's beautiful."

"And it looks like we have it all to ourselves," Tracey says.

The group turns to see some of their Pokemon in the water.

Musty calls out, "Goldeen! Staryu! Marill! Tentacruel! Ducklett! Buizel! Frillish! Why don't you go have some fun?!"

The Pokemon nod their heads as some dive in the water to swim.

"That's right," Misty says.

Then Mew calls out, "Lapras! You can go with them if you want!"

Just then, something small and brown hits Tomo on his head.

"What was..?" Tomo asks, surprised.

Then looks up, "Maybe a meteor."

Tracey picks up the object, "Looks like some kind of fruit."

"Something must've dropped it on you," Misty says.

The group then looks to see a flying Pokemon flying away.

"Hey, that looks like…" Mew questions and brings out her Pokedex.

Dexter says, "Farfetch'd, the Wild Duck Pokémon. A Normal and Flying Type. This extremely rare Pokémon can always be found holding a leek or green onion, which it uses to build its nest."

"It WAS a Farfetch'd!" Mew says.

Soon, a whole flock of Farfetch'd appears.

"Wow! A whole flock of them!" Mew says, amazed.

"Awesome!" Misty says.

"Amazing!" Tomo says.

"Cool! I gotta get a sketch of this!" Tracey says.

The gang watches as the flock fly away. Just then, Pikachu, Eevee, and the others return with some spotted fruits.

"Hey! Looks like it's time for lunch!" Tomo says, excited.

Then Mew asks, "Where'd you find those, guys?"

Meloetta then points to the forest full of fruit trees. Soon, Tomo and Misty pick one from the tree.

"These look sweet," Misty and Tomo reply.

But when they take a bite of the berry, their mouths pucker.

And they scream, "They're so sour!"

"I have to guess that they're not ripe enough," Mew says.

Tomo and Misty turn to see Tracey and Mew holding darker spotted berries.

Tracey laughs and says, "Mew's right. You just have to know which ones to pick. (holds up some fruit he picked) Here, these should be ripe."

"Let Tomo taste them," misty says, not feeling confident.

"Okay"Tomo says, and takes the berry, "These do look a little darker."

Tomo takes a bite of the berry and happily says, "Great!"

"There are so many kinds of fruit growing on this island that even Tomo isn't gonna go hungry," Tracey says.

"The Farfetch'd must fly here so they can eat it," Misty suspects.

"Yeah. And I can see why," Tomo says.

Then Mew has an idea, "Hey guys, since we're on this island and there's delicious food here, why don't we spend the day here and give ourselves and the Pokémon a little vacation?"

"Great!" Tracey agrees

"Yeah!" Misty and Tomo agree.

"Okay, then. Come out, guys!" Mew says, and calls out her Pokemon.

Mew calls out plenty of her Pokemon. Out comes: Squirtle, Bulbasaur, Wartle, Ivysaur, Charizard, Pidgeot, Primeape, Drowzee, Snorlax, Wooloo, Floette, Igglybuff, and Skitty.

Tracey then calls out, "Venonat, Marill, Scyther, Frillish, Sewaddle, come on out!"

And all of Tracey's Pokemon come out.

Tomo then throws some of his Pokeballs, "You all come have some fun too."

Kangaskhan Abra, Munchlax, Caterpie, Umbreon, Buneary, Zorora, Riolu, and Kecleon come out.

"Come on out," Misty says and throws some of hers.

She calls Oddish, Golduck, Wingull, Jigglypuff, Goomy, and Pink Frillish, Illumise, Volbeat, and Masquerain

Then Misty brings out another Pokeball, "Okay, Psyduck, it's your turn!" But Psyduck is already out.

Misty stumbles in disbelief, "You gotta wait till I say so!"

Soon, all the Pokemon begin to stare at Scyther as it cries out, "Syther!" (Oh yeah!)

Scyther then begins to slashes the air, "Scyther!" (My scythes cut sharp.)

Seeing this display makes the Pokemon nervous.

Squirtle is the first to express his concern, "Squirtle Squirt!" (Those blades look sharp")

"There's no reason to be scared. This is just one of Tracey's newest Pokémon," Mew says.

Then Bulbasaur says, "Bulbasaur saur." (He looks kinda dangerous, though.)

"Squirtle," (Yeah.) Squritle agrees.

"Yeah, you haven't met yet," Tracey says.

Then calls out to Scyther, "Hey, Scyther. Say hi to everybody, will ya?"

"Scyther!" (Hello to all!) Scyther calls out.

The other Pokemon back up in fright.

"Scyther's not gonna make any friends if it scares everybody just by saying hello," Misty says.

Togepi soon happily says, "Toki! Toki! Toki!" (Hello! Hello! Hello!)

"Pichu Pichu!" (Hello Scyther!) Pichu happily says.

With that, both baby Pokemon hop out of Misty's arms and walk to Scyther.

Misty calls out, "Togepi, Pichu, wait!"

But the two little Pokemon walk to Scyther.

Togepi happily says, "Togepiiiii." (You're not scary.)

"Scyther?" (Really?) Scyther asks.

"Pichu pichu," (Yeah, you're nice.) Pichu happily says.

Seeing Scyther not hurting Togepi and Pichu, Squritle says, "Squirt." (Oh, okay.)

Soon the other Pokemon begin to approach Scyther.

Squirtle introduces himself, "Squirtle." (I'm Squirtle.)

Then Bulbasaur, (I'm Bulbasaur.)

And then Psyduck, "Psy." (I'm Psyduck.)

Then Scyther introduces himself, "Scyther." (I'm Scyther.)

The others see how less feared Togpei and Pichu are and are glad that it helps the others become friends with Scyther.

"Look at that. Togepi and Pichu are too young to be afraid of anything," Misty says.

"Now the others aren't scared of Scyther, either," Tracey says.

"Scyther's gonna fit in just fine," Mew says.

"I'll say," Tomo says.

"Pika Pika," (I agree, Tomo.) Pikachu says.

"Eevee," (Scyther will be fine.) Eevee replies.

Mew turns and calls out, "Hey Charizard, Snorlax, everyone. Come over and say hello.

Charizard simply lies down and calmly says, "Rrr!" (No!)

Snorlax however is fast asleep. The other Pokemon decide to come though.

Mew giggles and says, "I guess Charizard and Snorlax want to relax a little longer."

"So what do you wanna do now?" Tomo asks.

"I say we have some fun," Mew says.

Everyone nods their heads in reply.

Meanwhile, it turns out, Mew and her friends are not the only ones having a day off, Team Rocket and their Pokemon are too on another part of the island. They are now soaking in some rays.

Jessie says, feeling relaxed, "This is delightful."

"Yeah. Too bad fur don't tan," Meowth says.

"It's been a long time coming, but we're finally having our day in the sun," James says.

"We needed this vacation because failin' cause is hard work, too," Meowth says.

Then Jessie says, "I wish you wouldn't use the word 'work'. Today, we're not even gonna think of stealing other Pokémon."

"What a relief," James says.

Soon enough, Marill along with Togpei, Frillish, and Pichu are swimming near the submarine. Seeing the familiar Pokemon leave Team Rocket shocked.

"Is that...?!" Jessie asks, shocked.

James then says, "Togepi?!"

"And Pichu too?!" Meowth adds.

Jessie then turns to the boys, "You know what that means, don't you?"

"The twerps," James concludes.

Meanwhile, many of the Water Pokemon are having fun in the water, while the others are picking fruit from the island with the others. Charizard and Snorlax are still sleeping.

Unknown to the group, Team Rocket are now spying on Mew and her friends, more specifically, their Pokemon.

Jessie sees the Pokemon, "Pikachu, Eevee, Charizard, Scyther, Venonat, Snorlax, Squirtle, Bulbasaur, Meloetta, Skwovet, and a lot more than I can count."

"A Pokémon-sterally!" Meowth replies.

"This is an opportunity we can't pass up," Jessie says.

But then James says, "Jessie, I thought we were going to forget all about Pokémon for change."

Jessie angrily says, ""We can forget about Pokémon when the boss forgets about our debts!"

"If we can grab those Pokémon and bring them back to the boss, we'll finally be free and clear!" Meowth says.

Then James agrees, "I'm all for that!"

"Then we can go on a real vacation!" Jessie says.

Meanwhile, Mew and the others have already gathered a lot of fruits.

"We have more than enough!" Tomo says.

"Skwovet!" (You said it!) Skwovet happily says.

Suddenly, the group hear Snorlax, "Snor lax!" (I wanna eat!)

Then hear Scyther, "Scyyyyy!" (Stooooop!)

But Scyther says, "Scyther!" (It's not time yet!)

Then Snorlax says, "Laax mm." (But it's too delicious.)

Scyther sternly says, "Scyther," (You'll have to wait.)

Then the others hurry towards the two Pokemon

"What's up, Scyther?" Tracey asks.

"Scy," (The big guy's hungry.) Scyther answers.

Then Snorlax says, "Snorlax" (I don't wanna wait.)

"I see. Snorlax's hungry, but Snorlax doesn't want to wait," Mew says to the others.

Then turns to Snorlax, "I know how you feel, Snorlax but it won't take us long to get everything ready. Try to be patient a little longer.

But Snorlax replies, "Snor," (Hungry...)

Just then, Jigglypuff walks over, "Jiggly Jigglypuff." (Maybe a nap can help.)

"What's Jigglypuff up to?" Tomo asks.

And with that, Jigglypuff begins to sing.

Jigglypuff:

Jigglypuff, Jiggly, yy-puff, puff

Jigglypuff, Jiggly

Jigglypuff, Jiggly, yy-puff, puff

Jigglypuff, Jiggly

And in no time, Snorlax has fallen asleep due to Jigglypuff's song. the group applauds.

"Wow. Nice work, Jigglypuff," Misty says.

"Jiggly," (You're welcome.) Jigglypuff says and bows her head.

"Maybe we'd all be better off if we just let Snorlax sleep a little bit long, Mew," Tracey says.

"I think you're right," Mew says.

Then Pikachu and Eevee say, "Pikachu/ Eevee." (Good idea.)

After extra time of gathering the fruits and berries on the island, Mew and the others have not only gathered enough fruits for themselves, but make a big pile for Snorlax and Munchlax for when Snorlax wakes up. Now, all the Pokemon begin to have fruits for dinner. Misty, Tomo, and Mew watch as the Pokemon have a good time.

"This is just what we needed!" Mew says.

"We haven't been together like this in a long time," Misty says.

"Yeah. And had this much fun," Tomo replies.

Just then, Tracey walks over with a plate of sandwiches and says, "Okay, everybody! Come and get a nice peanut butter and juicy tropical fruit sandwich fresh off the tree!"

"Fruit huh? That sounds really cool, Tracey," Mew says.

"Cool, and refreshing," Tracey says, and places the plate on the table.

Tomo chuckles, "Well, it sure looks good."

Misty becomes confused, "Fruit? Don't you have any bologna or swiss cheese?"

"Well, bologna and cheese don't grow on trees," Tracey says.

"He's right, gotta go what we have," Mew says, and picks up a sandwich.

She takes a bite and says, "Hmm, it tastes really good."

Then Tomo says, "I'll eat yours if you don't want em, Misty."

But Misty says, "Oh, no. I just never had a fruit sandwich before."

"You should try it, it tastes good," Mew says.

Tomo takes a bite of one of the sandwiches, "Yeah. it tastes great."

"Okay," isty says.

She picks up a sandwich and takes a bite of it.

She smiles and says, "You're right. It tasted good."

And with that, the group begins to eat the peanut butter and fruit sandwich. It doesn't take long for Snorlax to wake up and begin to eat all the fruits the group gathered for him and Munchlax. All the Pokemon are eating and having a good time.

Later on, Mew and his friends begin cleaning the dishes in the river while Snorlax and Munchlax are sleeping after eating so much food. Mew and Tomo turn to see their Pokemon sleeping as they chuckle

"Snorlax sure isn't shy about eating when it wants to eat and sleeping when it wants to sleep, is it?" Tracey says.

"I have to agree," Mew says.

Then Tracey asks, "Tracey, did you notice that Snorlax didn't eat as much as it usually does?"

"I think that's probably because it doesn't use as much energy when it's in its Pokéball," Tracey says.

"Maybe, but it could also be that I make sure to let him know to have his own food and not take food from the others," Mew says.

Soon, some of the Pokemon come by as Togepi and Pichu play with Marill's tail.

"Those three really hit it off!" Misty says.

"Marill's letting Togepi and Pichu use its tail like a toy. That's really nice," Tracey says.

"I agree. They're very sweet," Mew says.

Just then, Tomo notices something, "Hey Mew, look at Scyther go."

The group turns to see Scyther training on a rock in the middle of the lake and close to the waterfall. Charizard decides to watch to see how tough Scyther is.

Charizard then lets out a low growl, "Rrroarrr." (Showoff.)

Scyther becomes irritated after hearing the comment.

"I wonder what's up with those two?" Mew wonders.

"I'm not sure, but I hope those two don't fight," Misty says.

Later in the night, everyone is fast asleep. Just then, Pikachu and Eevee wake up to notice Mew is gone.

Pikachu becomes confused, "Pika Pi?" (Mew?)

"Eevee?" (Where'd she go?) Eevee wonders.

Meanwhile, Mew is actually sitting on the shore and is looking at the GS Ball. Mew has been curious about it for sometime.

"I wonder what it's for," Mew wonders.

She then pulls out a regular Pokeball and compares the two, "There's gotta be something different about the GS Ball besides the color. I wonder if there's something inside it. Maybe a Pokemon."

Suddenly, Mew feels her bag moving, and looks inside to see her second Pokemon Egg is beginning to glow. Which means, it's going to hatch soon. Mew takes the incubator with the egg inside.

Mew smiles and says, "It won't be long until you hatch, so you can be with me and the others too."

Suddenly, she hears Pikach's voice, "Pika Pi! (Mew!)

"Eevee Evee!" (There you are!) Eevee's voice follows.

Mew turns to see Pikachu and Eevee walking over.

"Hey there, Pikachu. Evee. Come on over, have a seat," Mew happily says.

Pikachu and Eevee sit on the rock beside them. Mew then places the incubator on the rock of her opposite side.

Mew then looks up in the sky, "You can see the stars clearer here than you can back home, huh?"

"Pika Pika," (They're beautiful.) Pikachu says.

"Eevee," (And sparkly) Eevee adds.

Then Mew says, "The Orange Islands sure are different." And pulls out her two badges. And so are the gym leaders."

Mew then remembers her battle against Cissy, and with Lapras' Ice Beam, she has won and gained her first badge.

Then her second match with Danny. And remembers how she sled with her Pokemon. At the end, Mew and her friends won the race and she gained her second badge.

Mew then says, "I wonder what our next Orange League gym battle is gonna be like. No matter what it's like, we'll do our best to win it! Won't we, Pikachu? Eevee?"

"Eevee Eev," (And how.) Eevee says.

Then Pikachu says, "Pi Pikachu! (We'll win hands down!)

"You can't do any better than that," mew says.

"Pika Pika! Eevee Eevee!" (Absolutely!) Pikachu and Eevee happily reply.

Back at the campsite, everyone else is still fast asleep. Just then, Tracey bolts up, half-asleep and half away.

In his sleeplessness, Tracey says, "Whoa, look! There's Moltres! Hey, that's Articuno! And that's Zapdos!"

Soon the talking begins to wake Misty asks.

Drowsily, Misty asks, "What are you talking about?"

Still half asleep, Tracey says, "Oh boy! I better make a sketch of these before they…"

Suddenly, a blizzard of sparkly blue powder comes sprinkling down from the air, sending Tracey back to sleep.

"Dreamy," Misty says, feeling sleepy.

And soon, the powder puts her to sleep as well. One by one, all the humans and Pokemon are falling into a deep sleep from the powder. The only ones who are far enough away are Charizard and Scyther.

Charizard is the first to wake up to sense something, "Rrroooarr" (?)

Scyther is sleeping in a tree, and soon wakes up, "Scyther." (?)

It's soon revealed that the Sleeping Powder is coming from James Victreebel.

"Wow! Your Victreebel's Sleep Powder really works!" Meowth says.

"Yes. We're a knockout combination," James says.

And turns to his Pokemon, "Aren't we, Vicy, old pal?"

Victreebell responds by biting James on the head, again.

James creams, "Hey! Let me go! Enough already! Unbound me! Cease! Desist! Stop already!"

Jessie and Meowth look very embarrassed.

"We better start without him," Meowth says.

"Right," Jessie agrees.

Then she prepares a bazooka while Meowth stands by ready at a winch next to her.

"Things are about to get sticky!" Jessie says, and fires the bazooka.

Soon, the suction cups attached to the bazooka come down on the snoozing Pokemon.

"Perfect! Our plan is working!" Jessie says with pride.

"Now all we do is reel dem in," Meowth says.

Meowth and Jessie start reeling in the Pokemon but because one is attached to Snorlax, it's harder to move.

"These are heavier than I thought they'd be!" Jessie says.

"Dat Snorlax has ta cut out da snacks!" Meowth says.

Suddenly, the rope has been cut, causing the two to fall down. It's revealed that Scyther has cut the rope. Soon, Charizard shows up, and is ready to help.

Jessie says nervously, "It's Scyther and Charizard."

Mewoth feels the same, "How come dey're awake?"

"I think it needs a touch more training," James says, getting Victreebel off his head.

Soon, Scyther and Charizard begin calling out, hoping to get someone's attention. Mew, along with Pikachu and Eevee hear Scyther and Charizard, and sense trouble.

Back at the site, Misty, Tracey, and Tomo begin waking up.

"What's happening?" Misty asks.

One bright sunny day, Mew is having a Pokemon battle on a beautiful island called Mandarin Island. Battling alongside her is Bulbasaur. Misty and the others watch Mew perform great with her battle.

Pikachu dashes forwards.

Pikachu tries to run towards the barrier, but Pikachu ends up getting bounced off.

Pikachu wakes up and is ready to battle.

"That's the spirit!" Mew says.

Then calls out, "Pikachu, Thunder attack!"

Pikachu then uses Thunderbolt and the attack lands, blinding it.

Mew soon notices, "That's weird, why didn't Cloyster attack."

Then shouts, "Unless Lorelei is planning something.

Just then Cloyster opens its eyes and begins to glow red.

"Oh no. That's…" Mew says, shocked.

Tracey quickly says, "Cloyster's Rage attack."

Pikachu dashes forward.

And Cloyster fires the attack.

Pikachu then dodges the first blast, and then dodges the second blast, and is able to dodge the third blast.

"Cloyster, Take Down, now!" Lorelei calls out.

"Quick Pikachu, use Iron Tail!" Mew calls out.

Cloyster charges for Take Down while Pikachu's tail glows and performs Iron Tail. Both attacks collide with one another, and they both bounce off. Cloyster and Pikachu both land on the ground, but are still standing.

"You okay, Pikachu?" Mew asks.

"Pika pi," (I'm okay.) Pikachu answers.

Just then, Pikachu collapses and lands on his bottom, and is looking tired.

Mew walks to Pikachu and picks him up, "Are you alright, Pikachu?"

"Pika Pika," (I'm a little tired.) Pikachu says.

"Pika," (Thank you.) Pikachu replies.

"The match is over," Tracey says.

Lorelei calls back Cloyster and walks over to Mew.

Then says, "Hey Mew, let's end the battle here. And I'm sorry I had to do that."

"It's okay Lorelei," Mew says.

Then Lorelei turns to Pikachu, "Are you alright, Pikachu?"

A little tired, Pikachu says, "Pika." (I'm good.)

"Even now. I can tell you really care for your Pokemon, and are confident with your skills as a trainer," Lorelei says.

"Not sure if I'm that confident. In fact, I get my skills from learning about Pokemon from Pokemon," Mew says.

"I can tell, but you don't become a great Pokémon trainer just by using your skills. Which I can tell that you know that very well," Lorelie says.

"What do you mean?" Mew asks.

"Let me ask you something, didn't your Pokémon, do the battling to earn those badges, as well?" Lorelei asks.

"Yes. They did. I always believe that the badges show how hard my Pokemok and I worked to train and learn to earn the badges," Mew says.

Lorelei calmly smiles, "Those badges were gifts from your Pokémon that show how much they care for you."

Mew nods her head and says, "They battle for me, because they care about me."

"That's right. And remember that losing is a very important part of becoming a Pokémon master," Lorelei says.

"Why's that?" Mew asks.

"You need to experience the pain of disappointment of defeat. It's easy to win, when you lose, you have to rely on your real strengths, the people and the Pokémon you love and who love you back," Lorelei explains.

Mew nods her head with a smile, "I'll remember that."

"I know how much you want to compete in the Orange League, but remember, if you want to get there, you have to become closer to your Pokémon then ever before. You'll do that by battling side by side with your Pokémon. As time goes on, I think you'll learn almost as much about your Pokémon as you do about yourselves. And when you've conquered all the gyms in the league, any of you will be presented with an honorable trainer trophy for your accomplishments," Lorleli explains.

"An honorable trainer trophy for any of me and my Pokemon?" Mew asks.

"That's if any of you prove you have the heart of a true Pokémon trainer," Lorelei says.

"Right Lorelei, and thank you. I promise to remember what you said. Thank you very much," Mew says.

Lorelei smiles in reply.

Suddenly, they hear a familiar voice, James' voice, "Bravo."

Jessie:

James.

Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light.

"Eevee Eevee Eev Eevee Eevee" (Didn't think they could get any weirder.) Eevee comments.

"That's what you think!" Mew angrily says, holding Pikachu in her arms.

Just then, Lorelei steps forward, "Don't fight."

Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee turn to Lorelei, and notices her having a Pokeball.

Then she says, "There's no reason to argue. Maybe I can cool them down."

Then Lorelei's Jynx performs Blizzard and sends Team Rocket flying as the ice breaks surrounding their heads. Then they are sent blasting off with a trail of sparkling ice behind them

Mew cheers, "Great job!"

"So awesome!" Tomo says.

Everyone watches as the ice comes down and sparkles.

"Wow. Look how it sparkles," Tracey says.

Later in the evening, Mew and her friends are going to take their leave for their next adventure.

Lorelei says to Mew, "The nearest gym is Trovita."

"Trovita?" Mew says, confused.

Then turns to Pikachu and Eevee, "Ready for Trovita?"

"Okay, Pikachu, ready for Trovita?

"Pika!" (Sure am!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee!" (Ready!) Pikachu says.

"It's been a pleasure meeting you all. And seeing you again, Ben. And I hope I've helped you, at least, a little," Lorelei says.

"You have. And if I ever get into trouble, we'll listen to the wind and think about all the things you taught us, Lorele," Mew says.

"And I'm gonna try our best to go with the flow, just like you do, Lorelei," Misty says.

Then Tracey says, "And no matter what, I'm always gonna remember that my Pokémon and I are partners and friends.

Mew turns to Pikachu and Eevee, "Pikachu, Eevee, I just hope that you and I will get to be even better buddies.

"Pikachu," (I'm sure of it.) Pikachu says.

Soon, Mew and her friends begin to depart.

Mew and her friends wave goodbye to Lorelei as they depart. Mew and her friends have learned a lot from Lorelei today, and keep the lesson she has in mind.
