Chapter 24: Episode 24: Wherefore Art, Thou, Pokemon?

After meeting and having fresh new lessons from Lorelei, Mew and her friends find themselve passing a quaint little village as they head to the next Orange League gym. They soon walk into town to see a few people on the streat.

"This sure is a quiet little place," Trace says.

"Yeah. Kinda looks like it's from a history book," Mew says.

"You're right. Just like merry old England," Misty says.

"Yeah. I wonder if they had Pokémon Centers back in olden times," Tomo replies.

Suddenly, they hear someone calling out, "Maria!"

The group stops to see a little girl running in their direction.

The little girl continues to call out, "Maria! Maria! Oh, where are you?"

The little girl has blonde hair in pigtails tied by green ribbons. She is wearing a light pink blouse with pink flowers on it, and a hot pink dress, wearing white knee high socks and pink mary janes.

Seeing Mew and her friends, the little girl asks, "Oh. Excuse me, but maybe you can help me. Have you seen my little Maria?"

"Who's little Maria?" Eve asks.

Hearing that the girl realizes, "Sorry. You're strangers here. Maria's my Pokémon. A Nidoran."

"Nidoran?" Misty says, confused

"Yes," The girl says.

Then begins to explain Maria's description, "My Maria's this big and she's a really pretty blue color. And she's got long ears and bright eyes and the cutest little buck teeth. She's smart and strong and... Oh, Maria is the best Nidoran in the whole wide world!"

"Blue color, long ears, and buck teeth. That would mean your Nidoran is a girl," Mew says, and brings out her Pokedex.

Then shows her the picture of the Nidoran as description,

Dexter saus, "Nidoran female, the Poison Pin Pokémon. A Poison Type. Its Poison Sting is quite powerful for its size, but its horn is smaller than the male's.

"That's right, my Nidoran is a girl," The girl says.

"Do you know why she's missing?" Mew asks.

"Oh, Maria's been running away a lot lately and I just hope I can find her," The girl says.

"Don't you worry. With us helping, you'll find you're Nidoran," Mew says.

Then asks, "Is there anything else you can tell me about Maria? Something to separate her from another female Nidoran."

"Oh right, she has a bright orange ribbon around her neck," The girl says.

"Got it. We'll see if we can find her," Mew says

Soon enough, the group begins searching all over the park for Maria the Nidoran.

Mew calls out, "Maria! Where are you?!"

"Toge togeprrrriii," (Maria!) Togepi calls out.

Pichu calls out, "Pichu!" (Maria!)

"Maria!" Misty calls out.

Pikachu calls out, "Pikachu!" (Maria!)

"Eevee!" (Maria!) Eevee calls out!

Mew looks in the grass, "Maria!"

The little girl calls out, "Maria!"

"Where are you, Maria?! Come on out!" Tracey calls out.

"Maraia!" Tomo calls out.

"Loetta!" (Maria!) Meloetta calls out.

"Skwovet Skwovet?!" (Maria, where are you?!) Skwovet calls out.

Misty calls out, "Maria! Maria!"

Pikachu and Eevee soon spot fruits, and decide to grab themselves some. Pikachu and Eevee continue to call out to Maria as they secretly sneak towards the fruit tree.

Mew calls out, "Hey! Maria!"

Suddenly, they hear someone calling out, "Tony!

Maria calls out, "Maria!"

Then the voice appears again, "Tony!"

"Tony?" Mew says confused.

Mew soon turns her head to see a young boy with brown hair, wearing an ivory collared shirt, blue vest, black pants, white socks, and dark shoes.

The boy calls out, "Tony! Where are you, boy?!"

Confused, Mew wonders, "Who's that boy?

"I don't know," Misty replies.

Just then, the boy approaches Mew and Misty, "You haven't seen my Pokémon, Tony, have you?"

"What is it?" Mew asks.

Soon, the boy realizes, "Oh, you're. You're not from here. My Tony is a Nidoran."

The group becomes surprised to hear what Pokemon the boy is trying to find, even Pikachu and Eevee stop eating their fruits.

"Did you say that this Tony of yours is a…" Mew asks.

"Nidoran?" Misty adds.

"Yeah, a Nidoran," The boy answers.

Then begins to describe him, "I'd say he's about this big, maybe a little bigger, kinda purply-pinkish, and he's got big ears, little buck teeth, and a horn coming out of his head. If you saw Tony, you'd understand why he's the best Pokémon in the whole world! But lately, he's been running away a lot."

"Anything else?" Misty asks.

"Yes. He's also wearing a blue bow type," The boy adds.

"Purply-pinkish, big ears, buck teeth, and horns. So a male Nidoran then," Mew says.

She then brings out her pokedex, and shows it to the male Nidoran.

Dexter says, "Nidoran male, the Poison Pin Pokémon. A Poison Type. Its horn is larger than the female's and its Horn Attack is quite powerful.

Surprised, Mew says, ""Wow. Two Nidoran in one day."

"What do you mean?" The boy asks.

Suddenly, Tracey calls out, "Guys!"

The group turns to see Tracey, Tomo, Meloetta, and Skwovet, and the girl running toward the,.

"Did you find Maria?!" Tracey calls out.

"Not yet! No!" Mew answers.

Suddenly the boy pushes Mew aside, "Hey! Kidnapper!"

"Kidnapper?!" the girl says, shocked.

Just then, the two approach each other.

The boy demands, "Why don't you admit that you stole Tony because you're jealous, Emily?!"

But the girl, Emily says, "Me jealous? You're the one who's jealous of my Maria, Ralph!

"Why would I be jealous of your dinky Nidoran?" the boy, Ralph questions angrily.

"Dinky?! I wouldn't talk if I were you!" Emily angrily replies.

"Anybody who knows anything about Pokémon can see that I have the best Nidoran!" Ralph argues back.

"Yeah, that must be why you stole Maria so you could finally have the best one!" Emily angrily says.

Ralph angrily shouts, "You're a liar!"

"So are you!" Emily shouts back.

Soon, the two pick up the stick and begin to have a stick fight.

"Hey! What's the problem?!" Tracey calls out.

"What are you fighting for?" Tomo asks.

"It sounds like they're fighting over their Pokémon," Misty says.

Mew steps forward and pushes them aside, "Alright, break it up! Break it up!"

Just then, Marill approaches them, "Marill Marill." (Hey Tracey, I found them.)

Tracye turns to Marill and asks, "Hey. You find something already, Marill?"

Marill points to the direction.

Mew says, "Marill says they're that way."

That makes Emily and Ralphi relieved, "It's my Maria/Tony!"

The two then dash off and tramples Tracey.

Tracey weakly says, "That's nice."

Meanwhile, Emily and Ralph dash to find their Pokemon.

Ralph shouts, "Stay out of my way!"

Emily shouts back, "You stay out of MY way!"

When Emily and Ralph arrive, they see both Maria and Tony are very close to one another.

Ralph calls out, "Tony!"

"Maria!" Emily calls out.

Both kids arrive and become very confused about what they see. That's when Mew and the others show up.

"Looks like your Nidoran are okay," Tomo says.

Tracey brings out his sketchbook, "Boy, they sure are friendly. I'm gonna make some sketches."

Tony then picks a rose and passes it to Maria.

"Pretty obvious what's going on here, eh Trace?" Misty says.

Then Misty turns to Mew, "What do you think?"

"Yeah. It's as plain as day," Mew says.

"It is?" Tomo says, confused.

"It's as plain as day, Tomo. Those two are in love," Misty says.

"Sure looks like love to me," Tracey says.

"Yeah. It's so sweet," Mew says.

Both Pokemon finish eating the rose, and they both insist that one of them takes the last petal. Both trainers seem to be happy for their Pokemon, but they don't seem to be happy with each other. And so, the two separate the two and walk away in opposite directions.

Emily says to Maria, "What can you possibly see in that loser's Nidoran?"

"I'm glad I got you away from her nasty Nidoran in time," Ralph says to Tony

Emily says to Maria, "You're much too good for HIS Nidoran."

"I don't want you to ever see her Nidoran again," Ralph says to Tony.

However, both Nidorans are crying out to each other, and their trainers ignore their wishes.

"I don't think they like each other," Tomo replies.

Mew look at the two and is showing a disapproving expression on her face.

Sometime later, Mew and her friends are at a sandwich store to have some lunch, and decide to ask about Ralph and Emily.

"Oh, we have lots of Pokémon trainers here. They're all friends," The chef says.

"Well, we just met two of them and they sure don't seem like friends to us," Misty says

"Their names are Ralph and Emily," Tomo says.

"And even though Ralph and Emily don't like each other. Maria and Tony are in love with each other," Mew says.

"Ah, I know those two," The chef says.

"You know them?" Tracey asks.

"Everybody in town knows about those two," The chef says.

"Not us until they started fighting," Misty says.

"Ralph and Emily have known each other since they were little babies. Nice kids," The chef explains.

And so the chef explains, "They've been competing ever since they were old enough to walk, and catch Pokémon, of some strange reason, they always ended up catching the same Pokémon. We have lots of Pokémon contests here in town, and it always seems to come down to a face off between Ralph and Emily. This year, they tied for first place. Ralph and Emily weren't too happy, but their Nidoran sure were. It was love at first sight for those two."

He sighs and says, "Their Nidoran are meant for each other. But because Ralph and Emily are so stubborn, I'm afraid those Pokémon won't ever be together. It's a real shame."

"Wow," Tracey says.

"It's too bad those two can't get along," Tomo says.

"I know what you mean. And what they did to Maria and Tony. It's not easy to forgive," Mew says, and remembers how Ralph and Emily pull them apart without the Pokemons' consent.

Later on, Mew and her friends are walking down the road.

"I wish there was something we could do for those poor Nidoran," Misty sadly says.

"Yeah. It's a real shame," Tracey says.

Soon, the group turns to see Tony running in front of them.

"That's Tony," Mew says.

"You're right. It is Tony," Tracey says.

"Where's he going?" Tomo wonders.

Tony then runs into an alley and the group follows. Soon the group arrives at a house. Suddenly, Tony lets out a lot of grunt, and Maria comes out on the balcony and responds back. Mew and the others are approaching the bush.

"What are they doing?" Tomo asks.

"Just listen to them Tomo, they're talking sweet talk!" Misty says.

"How do you know that?" Tomo asks

"I can just tell, because…" Misty says, and adds with starry-eyes, "I'm a romantic."

"I have a natural understanding of the ways of the heart," Misty says.

"How come?" Tomo asks.

"You're too young enough to understand," Misty says.

Tomo becomes confused.

Then Mew whispers to Tomo, "I think this will make more sense when you're older."

Tomo nods his head in reply.

Misty turns to Mew, "You know what they're saying?"

"Yes. They're talking to each other, and tell each other how they love each other, and wish they can be together," Mew says.

She sadly sighs, "But it's understandable why they can't."

Tony continues to call out to Maria, until he notices Emily coming out with a bucket of water.

"This oughta cool you off, Romeo!" Emily angrily says and dumps water all over Tony.

Everyone is in shock to see this, and Emily takes Maria inside.

Ralph shows up to see what has happened, "Tony! Tony, what happened? Oh, you're soaking wet."

Then turns to the house and suspects what's happened, "Who does she think she is?!"

Ralph then picks up Tony and takes him home, "Don't bother with them, you should be home, here, with me."

Soon, Ralph takes Tony inside the house, and to Mew and the other's surprise,

"I can't believe it! They're next-door neighbors!" Mew says, shocked.

"I guess that proves you can live close together and still be worlds apart," Tracey says.

Soon, Misty has enough, "This is absolutely crazy! Those two Nidoran belong together and I'm gonna do something about it!"

"I couldn't agree more. We can't just stand here and let this happen," Mew says, sounding upset.

"Wow Mew, you sound very upset," Tracey says.

Mew sighs and says, "Sorry about that. I'm just mad at Ralph and Emily. They act like they don't care for their Pokemon at all. Tony and Maria love each other and they've been trying to keep them apart. They should make their problems with each other the Pokemons' problem."

"I have to agree with Mew. Trainers should make Pokemon happy," Tomo says.

"How are we going to do that?" Tracey asks.

Mew turns to Misty, "What do you think?"

"I'll think of something," Misty says.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket are watching nearby

Jessie asks, "Hear that?"

"I heard it," Meowth says.

"Me too," James replies.

"A male and female Nidoran!" Jessie says.

And James says, "A perfectly matched set!"

"Like a birthday present! Two nice, neatly wrapped Nidoran," Meowth says.

Then James says, "Or like two stocking stuffers from Santa Claus himself!"

"Or like a pair of first prizes in da Pokémon Poach-off!" Meowth says.

Jessie mutters, "And I got the booby prize."

That night at the Pokemon center, Misty is writing something on a piece of paper.

Tomo walks over and asks, "Whatcha doing?"

"Writing identical letters to Emily and Ralph. (chuckles) It's the perfect way to get those two together," Misty says.

"You think it'll work?" Tomo asks.

"Of course it'll work! Ralph and Emily are both gonna get a letter. A love letter from each other," Misty says.

"Are you sure it's a good idea?" Mew asks.

"Those two are gonna wind up thanking me for this. They're not mature enough to admit it, but they really like each other," Misty says.

Then turns to Mew, "Besides, it's almost the same as you and Gary."

"Uh me and Gary?" Mew says, surprised and her cheeks are blushing.

Then turns her head away, "I uh, don't know what you mean. I uh… Well, I guess… but I'm not… I'm not sure…"

"Who's Gary?" Tracey asks.

"He's a friend of hers from Pallet Town and Professor Oak's grandson. Right now, Gary's on another journey somewhere else," Tomo says.

"I see," Tracey says.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket are working on a plan of their own close to Ralph and Emily's house.

Jessie says, "We're close to having our own pair of Pokémon. All we have to do is convince those Nidoran that the only way they can be together is if they come away with us. The Pokémon will learn a valuable lesson. A painful one. The heart always leads one to heartache."

James and Meowth look at each other.

James then turns to Jessie, "Sounds like, you've had some heartaches yourself."

Jessie then explains her sad story, "I've had my share. Ever since I was a little girl I've dreamed of finding love, but all I ever got was heartache. I can't find anyone to love me, just because I'm mean and nasty and evil!"

Then Jessie's face falls to the ground in tears.

"All in loves unfair!" James says, and comforts Jessie.

"Now I understand why she's such a nut-job!" Meowth says.

Jessie glares at the boys and shouts, "How dare you!" And then kicks them both, "It's time to put our plan into action!"

"Aye-aye, ma'am," Meowth says, feeling dizzy.

In Emily' bed room, she and Maria are sleeping peacefully. Maria suddenly wakes up tapping to see Meowth. Curious, Maria approaches the window to meet Meowth.

Then Meowth says, "Hey. How'd ya like ta be wit your boyfriend? An' I'm talking foreva here."

Next door, Ralph is sleeping in his bed, but Tony isn't getting any sleep and is trying to get out of the house. Then gets surprised to see Meowth appear in front of them.

Meowth explains, "Hey, buddy, how'd ya like to be with your little princess? I got connections. I can arrange it. An' I'm gonna tell ya exactly whatcha gotta do." And chuckles.

Meanwhile, Jessie and James are waiting for Meowth with excitement.

"You'll tell them that they'll be going on a little honeymoon, but instead, you'll take them straight to the boss," Jessie says with a grin.

"Pretty dirty trick," James says.

"What good's a trick if it's not dirty?" Jessie replies.

Then Mowth shows up, looking a bit disappointed.

Jessie turns to Meowth and asks, "Well, everything go according to plan, Meowth?"

Meowth then explains, "Dey ain't gonna do it, Jess. Dey both said dat even dough dey're in love, dey could neva disobey deir masters an' runaway from dem."

"I can't believe those pipsqueaks are gonna give up this chance to be stolen!" Jessie shouts in anger.

"She sure has a unique way of looking at things," James replies.

Then Jessie says, "We'll just have to go with Nidoran plan number two!"

"Number two?" James asks.

"But what's dat?" Meowth asks.

"Nidoran-napping," Jessie answers.

"I was afraid of that," James says.

Jessie chuckles, "I made that up myself."

The next day, Mew and the others are hiding in the rose garden in the park.

Misty chuckles with a smile, "I'm sure my love letters will get them here."

"I'm not sure," Tomo replies.

"I didn't leave a thing to chance. I sent her a beautiful bouquet of flowers, and I sent him a remote control model airplane. And as far as those two know, they sent the gifts to each other." Misty says.

Just then Tracey spots Ralph, "He's here!"

Soon, Ralph walks into the park with a box in one arm and Tony's in his carrier in the other.

Mew turns and says, "Here she comes."

They also see Emily enter the garden with the bouquet of flowers and Maria in her carrier.

They both approach each other and asks, "Why did you send me that stupid letter?!"

The group becomes shocked, especially Misty, seeing the plan hasn't worked.

Then the two demands, "And why did you send me such a stupid present?!"

"Is this your idea of a joke?!" Emily angrily asks.

Tony feels the same, "That's what I'd like to know!"

"Well, thanks a lot for sending me these flowers, Ralph! You know I'm allergic!" Emily angrily says and throws the bouquet at Ralph.

"I guess you think it's funny that I throw up in airplanes!" Ralph angrily says.

"At least. At least they're talking to each other," Tracey says.

Emily shouts in anger, "I can't stand you, Ralph!"

"I can't stand you, either!" Ralph feels the same.

Emily and Ralph then pick up the sticks and about to charge at each other, but then two hands grab the stick. Everyone becomes surprised to see Mew is the one who grabs hold of the sticks.

"You two may can't stand each other, but I'm starting to unable to stand you two," Mew angrily says.

Then pulls the sticks away and shouts, "Enough all ready!" and tosses them aside.

Then Mew glares at the two, "Why are you two fighting anyway? I bet you both don't even know!"

Ralph angrily says, "Well Emily is the one who started it!"

"No, it's Ralph who started it!" Emily angrily says.

But Mew shouts at the back, "I don't care, start it! I'll know that your constant arguing, and stubbornness is not fair to Maria and Tony! Both your Nidorans loved each other and want to be together, and you shouldn't let your stupid little competition and stubbornness tear them apart! If you really are trainers, then start thinking about your Pokemons' feelings and not your own!"

Ralph and Maria become startled to hear Mew shouting at them, and see her taking deep breaths.

"Boy, was she mad," Tracey comments.

"You should have seen when she got mad at a trainer named Damian," Misty says.

Suddenly, the group begins to hear the sound of church bells, and turn their heads to see a newlywed couple walking towards them.

"A bride and groom! Well, congratulations!" Misty happily says.

Then everyone congratulates them.

Suddenly, a familiar voice says from the bride, "On this our sunny wedding day."

The same with the groom, "There's a funny trick we'd like to play."

"Our matrimony…" The bride adds.

Then they both say, "...is a total phony!" and take Tony and Maria by the carriers, "Now we'll take these Pokémon away!"

Ralph becomes shocked, "Tony!"

"They got Maria!" Emily cries out.

Mew soon realizes, "You're no bride and groom!"

And the bride and groom begin the motto.

Jessie:

Prepare yourself for trouble, kid!

Soon, a platform in the form of a wedding cake rises from the ground, shocking the kids.

James:

And make it doubler than you ever did!

Jessie:

To protect the world from devastation!

James:

To unite all people within our nation!

Jessie:

To denounce the evils of truth and love!

James:

To extend our reach to the stars above!

Jessie:

Jessie!

James:

James!

Jessie:

Team Rocket, Blast off at the speed of light!

James:

Surrender now or prepare to fight!

Meowth:

Hurry up an' cut da cake!

Just then, the cake platform cuts in half and reveals Team Rocket's balloon. Meowth laughs as the balloon rises, allowing Jessie and James to climb aboard and gives them a chance to escape with Maria and Tony. On the bottom of the balloons are empty cans hanging on the strings.

Ralph cries out, "Hey, wait!"

"Please, come back!" Emily calls out.

In the balloon, James says, "Time to say ta-ta, toddlers!"

"Your Nidoran need a little time alone," James says.

"The love birds are flying the coop!" Meowth adds.

Team Rocket Rocket calls out, "Bye-bye!"

Soon, Team Rocket are flying away with Tony and Maria.

"We gotta follow them!" Mew says.

Mew, Tracey and Tomo go on ahead while Misty stays behind with Ralph and Emily.

Emily sadly says, "Poor Maria."

"And my Tony," Ralph says.

Misty turns and scolds the two, "Mew's right about one thing. Your fighting has caused nothing but problems with Maria and Tony, and now this. If you hadn't been fighting, then this never would have happened! You only have yourselves to blame!"

Hearing that, they end up realizing that Mew and Misty are right. Their fighting caused all this.

Then Misty says, "I just hope you learned your lesson."

Misty prepares to join the others, but notices them still standing in the park and looking down.

"Don't just stand there!" Misty calls out.

Mew then points to the ground, "Look there."

Misty looks down to notice a trail, "Those cans!"

"They must've dropped from Team Rocket's balloon!" Tracey says.

"And there's a tail of them," Tomo says.

"Great! They'll lead us right to them!" Mew says.

Meanwhile, somewhere in the woods, Jessie and James are trying to dress Maria and Tony in outfits.

Jessie shouts, "Stop wiggling around!"

Then James says, "Would you hold still?!"

"Take it easy, we're just giving you a makeover!" Jessie says.

"You want to look your best for the boss, don't you?" James adds.

Suddenly a can drops, and the three turn to see Mew and the others right behind them.

"Bet you didn't expect to see us," Mew says.

"Now give back their Nidoran this second!" Misty demands.

"It's da twerps!" Meowth exclaims in shock.

Jessie asks, "How'd you find us?"

Tracey then shows him a bag of cans from the balloon, "You wouldn't have been so easy to follow if you had cleaned up your act."

"We must've dropped the cans!" Meowth panics.

James whispers to Jessie "I guess I should have tied them a little tighter, huh?"

"I guess I should have dropped you off the balloon instead, huh?" Jessie angrily says.

Emily calls out, "Maria!"

Ralph does the same, "Tony!"

Both Maria and Tony quickly get out of the clothes and run to their trainers.

But Jessie isn't having it, "Not so fast! Arbok, attack!" and calls out Arbok.

Arbok comes out of the Pokeball and chases the two.

Mew calls out, "Hey! Look out!"

Ralph calls out, "Tony!"

Emily does the same, "Maria!"

Then they call out together, "Tackle attack!"

Both Maria and Tony turn around and strike a Tackle on Arbok together, knocking it out.

James then brings out his Pokeball, "I'll stop them! Victreebel, go!" and throws the Pokeball.

Victreebel comes out and chomps on Jessie's head instead.

Jessie screams, "James! Will you get this thing off of me!"

Then both Tony and Maria charge.

Emily calls out, "Maria, use your Scratch attack!"

"Tony, Tackle!" Ralph calls out.

Maria gives Victreebel a Scratch Attack, but Arbok charges forward and strikes at Tony.

Ralph calls out, "Oh no!"

Maria quickly checks on Tony to see if he's okay. Tony sits up to let Maria know that he's okay. Then Tony pushes Maria out of the way over Victreebel. Then Maria tackles Victreebel and Tony scratches Arbok.

"Those two sure make a great team!" Tomo says.

"Yeah! They may not be that strong, but they really know how to battle!" Tracey says.

James calls out, "Get in there, Victreebel!"

Victreebel manges to pin down Tony, but Maria tackles Victreebel, saving Tony.

"Look! They're fighting for each other!" Misty says.

"Yeah. It shows that they really care for one another," Mew says.

Seeing this really surprised their trainers.

Emily says in surprise, "Maria's battling for Tony."

Ralph feels the same, "Tony's battling for Maria."

That's when they realize that they both love each other so much, that they're willing to fight for each other.

Soon, Abok wraps both Nidoran.

Emily calls out, "Maria!"

Then Ralph, "Tony!"

Both of them turn to each other and nod their heads. Then they both bite on Arbok, forcing it to let them loose. Then they both begin to use their Scratch Attack on Arbok and Victreebel.

Jessie shouts, "Come on! Don't let those little runts beat you!"

Yet Tony and Maria continue to pound away on Arbok and Victreebel.

"Those two are a great combination!" Misty says.

"Those two make quite the pair," Mew says.

Emily says, "You're right!"

And Ralph agrees, "They are!"

Then they both call out to their Pokemon,"Fury Swipes attack!"

Both Nidoran then perform Fury Swipe at Arbok and Victreebel.

Then Ralph and Emily call out, "Double Kick!"

They both soon give Arbok and Victreebel a combined Double Kick.

Ralph cheers for Tony, "Great job, Tony!"

"You too, Maria!" Emily says.

Then Jessie and James call back their Pokemon.

"Turn on da Pokémon picker-uppa!" Meowth says.

"Right!" Jessie and James agree.

Mew becomes shocked to see the balloon lift itself off the ground.

Meowth then activates the machine, "Power on!"

"We gotta do something," Mew says.

Eevee turns to Pikachu, "Eevee Eevee!" (I have an idea!)"

"Pika!" (Gotcha!) Pikachu replies.

Meowth continues laughing until he realizes that Pikachu and Eevee stop the machine with a branch to prevent anything from being pulled in. Both Pokemon give them a mischievous smile and let loose their Thunderbolt, shocking them.

Then Misty calls out, "Okay! Let er rip, Staryu!"

Staryu comes out of its Pokeball, and pieces a hole on the balloon. And soon, the balloon is sent flying as Pikachu and Eevee hop off.

Jessie screams, "We lost again!"

"This time it was a…" James says.

"Doubleheader!" Meowth adds.

Then they all scream, "Team Rocket's blasting off again!"

Soon, Team Rocket is gone.

Misty calls out to them, "Bon Voyage! Just remember what happens to anybody who tries to mess around with Pokémon in love!"

Then Misty turns to Ralph and Emily, "Hey! You know, you two are much better than Team Rocket. The both of you have such beautiful Nidoran. And now you can see how much they want to be together. Trainers ought to make their Pokemon happy."

"Misty's right," Tomo says.

The pokemon nod their heads in reply.

"Yeah," Emily replies..

"Yeah," Ralph replies.

She then asks, "But how could I say goodbye to Maria?"

Then Ralph asks, "How could I say goodbye to Tony?"

Then Tracey says, "You don't have to say goodbye. You're next-door neighbors, right? You can build a little house for them, right in between. Then you can be together, everyday."

The pair asks, "With Ralph?/Emily?"

The two soon realize that they both like the idea of being together and say, "I guess, we'll try."

"A truce!" Misty happily says.

Then look at the two Nidoran, "Finally, the two of you can live happily ever after."

Both Maria and Tony louch noses with happiness, soon, they both suddenly begin to glow. To everyone's surprise, Maria has evolved to a Nidorina, and Tony has evolved to a Nidorino.

"They both just evolved!" Misty says, surprised.

"They're a Nidorino and a Nidorina!" Tracey says.

Mew brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Nidorina, the Poison Pin Pokémon. The evolved form of the female Nidoran. A Poison Type. It emits supersonic waves from its mouth to confuse its enemies. Nidorino, the Poison Pin Pokémon. The evolved form of the male Nidoran. A Poison Type. Its highly developed horn is extremely powerful."

Tracey sketches the pair, "Wow! This is almost like a fairy tale!"

Emily kneels down to Maria, "Maria!"

Ralph does the same, "Tony!"

Then the two begin laughing.

"I wonder how they evolved. From the battle or the kiss?" Tracey says.

Misty blushes and grabs the sketchbook,"Tracey, you're a goof." and knocks Tracey with it.

A little confused, Tomo asks, "You think people change when they get kissed?"

Misty chuckles with a smile, "I guess we'll have to find out for ourselves."

Tomo is confused, but Mew thinks and begins to blush, whatever has her thinking, has her face turning red.

Later on, Ralph, Emily, Maria, and Tony say goodbye to Mew and her friends and vice versa. And so Mew and her friends help teach the two young trainers a lesson and help two Pokemon find their happily ever after.

Meanwhile, at the church in town, as a newlywed couple leaves to begin their new lives together, Team Rocket are trapped in the ringing bells.

Chapter 25: Episode 25: Get Along, Little Pokemon

Mew and her friend find themselves trekking across a rugged desert landscape on Mandarin Island so Mew can get to the next Orange League Gym in Trovita. However, with the desert landscape and the hot sun, the group is getting pretty tired.

"Tracey, how much longer is it gonna take us to get to Trovita?" Misty asks, feeling tied.

"I dunno. I'd say, maybe, three days," Tracey answers.

"Three days?" Misty exclaims.

"Oh, man! That feels like forever!" Mew whines.

Then Tomo says, "I'm not gonna make it!

Then Mew asks, "Trace, isn't there any place close where we could stop and rest?"

"Yeah, Tracey, there must be some place," Misty adds.

Tracey looks at the map and says, "Well, there is a town nearby. We could be there tomorrow morning."

"Tomorrow?" Mew and Tomo say, shocked.

Then Misty complains, "Why isn't there anything closer?!"

"I didn't make the map, Misty," Tracey replies.

Misty falls on her back, "I can't walk for another whole day!"

Mew sits down along with the Pokemon, "I don't think I can either."

"I guess we're tired because we haven't been doing much walking lately," Misty says.

"Yeah, we didn't get much exercise riding every place on Lapras' back," Mew agrees.

"I have to agree. We've been riding on Lapras on the ocean to travel from Island to Island," Tomo adds.

Tracey turns to the others, "Well, I don't think Lapras will be able to help us out in this place."

As Tracey explains, dark clouds gather behind them. Mew, Pikachu, Eevee, Tomo, Meloetta, and Skwovet quickly notice.

Mew calls out, "Hey, look."

"Look at what?" Tracey asks.

"Those clouds!" Tracey calls out.

Thunder begins to boom into the sky. Everyone looks to see the dark clouds, indicating a storm is coming their way. Soon, everyone starts running to get away from the storm.

"I think I'd rather be hot and tired than wet and tired!" Tomo says.

"I just can't believe how fast this storm came up!" Mew says.

Then Tracey calls out, "We better look for cover!"

Soon, Misty collapses from exhaustion.

Tracey and Mew turn and call out, "Come on!"

The thunder continues to boom.

Mew looks up, "This is bad! The lightning's getting closer!"

Tracey soon finds shelter, "Let's head for that big rock over there!"

Everyone heads towards the rock. They arrive in the nick of time, and stay under as they sit to rest.

"The storm's close! Stay low!" Tracey says.

And everyone ducks down. Just then, a lightning bolt comes down towards them. The group brace themselves for the lighting, but they suddenly hear something. Suddenly, Pikachu hears something and looks up to see lightning collected in one place and notices something in the center.

Pikachu asks, "Pika?" (What the..?)

Mew and the others look up to see the multiple round beings in the sky.

Tomo asks, "Are those..?"

"Magnemite?" Tracey adds.

The group looks up to see a herd Magnemite is collecting the lightning.

Mew brings out her Pokedex, and Dexter says, "Magnemite, the Magnet Pokémon. An Electric Type and Steel Type. Is able to float through the air and emits Thunder Wave through its magnet shaped units located on its sides.

"I wonder what a bunch of Magnemite would be doing all the way out here," Tomo replies.

Suddenly, a bolt of lightning strikes from the sky towards the Magnemite as the others watch.

"Look at that," Mew says, amazed.

"Looks like the Magnemite are absorbing the lightning!" Tracey says.

Soon, the group hears a, "Jolt! Jolt!"

The group turns their heads to see a Jolteon running on top of the small cliff close by.

Tracey says, surprised, "Guys, that's a Jolteon!"

Mew points Dexter at Jolteon and Dexter says, "Jolteon, the Lightning Pokémon. An Electric Type. When angered or frightened, the hairs on Jolteon's body become like needles that are fired at its opponents. It absorbs charged atoms and produce ten thousand volts of electricity.

Jolteon soon starts emitting electricity from its body, and the Magnemite are drawn to it. And then a wagon pulls up behind the Pokemon. There, they see a man wearing a western outfit: Dark brown cap, gray shirt, dark vest, brown pants, black boots, and a red scarf. He is in a wagon being pulled by two Tauros. The Magnemite float to the

The man calls out, "Hop in, pilgrims!"

The group then looks at each other, and decides to hurry to the wagon.

But the man says, "Hurry! You'll be safe from the lightning in here."

Mew and the group climb aboard the wagon as another bolt of lighting strikes the Magnemite. Everyone watches as the Magnemite absorbs the lighting, but is also safe.

Later, the storm is clear, and the cowboy explains to them about him, his Magnemite, and his work.

"A Magnemite ranch?" Mew asks.

"Yep." The man answers, "A heap of lightning falls out in these parts. I have my Magnemite suck up all that electric energy from the storms and I take it right on to neighboring towns and villages to power em up!"

"Wow! I bet chasing after lightning storms must be a really dangerous and exciting job, isn't it?" Misty saya, amazed.

The man chuckles and says, "It sure does have its moments, missy."

He then blows his whistle and the Magnemite comes floating.

"That only took about two seconds!" Tracey says, looking at the stop watch.

Then turns to the cowboy, "You've done a really good job training those Magnemite."

Soon, the cowboy uses cables to check the electricity level of each Magnemite.

"Numbers one, two, three and four are fully charged up, and all of the rest of my little Magnemite look to be about fifty, maybe sixty, percent charged," The cowboy says.

"You call them by numbers?" Tomo asks.

"I can't remember a lesser name," The cowboy says.

"And you can tell them apart?" Misty asks, surprised.

"Oh sure," The cowboy says.

Then points to each Magnemite, "This here's number one, and that's number two, of course. Three is right above it, and there's number four right over there!"

Misty looks at the Pokemon and asks, "Can you see a difference?"

Mew narrows her eyes, "Not too much. They do look the same, but you have to be really good to tell them apart."

Just then, the cowboy blows the whistle and calls out, "Where do you think you're going, number six? You get back here!"

But Magnemite Six continues to float away.

"That's six?" Mew asks.

"Yep. That's my black sheep," The cowboy says.

Then turns to his Pokemon, "Round it up, Jolteon!

Using its electric power, Jolteon rushes to Magnemite Six, attracts it, and leads it back to the others.

"Alright, that's good work, Jolteon," The cowboy says.

Then the cowboy gently grabs Magnemite Six, "I tell you this, number six here is like a little maverick, gives me nothing but trouble," He chuckles and adds, "Always wandering off."

"They wouldn't be able to wander away if you kept them in their Pokéballs," Mew replies.

But the cowboy says, "If I had to get them out of Pokéballs every time, we'd miss the lightning."

"But it must be a lot of work taking care of them that way," Misty says.

"It's a heap of work, missy. But it's better for them to roam free in the wide open spaces," The cowboy says.

Unknown to Mew, A Vine Whip comes out of the water and taps on Mew's shoulder. Mew swats it away. Then the Vine Whip taps on her shoulder again. Mew feels tapping on her shoulder and turns her head to see nothing there. The others turn around to notice Mew has stopped and has her head looking back.

Bulbasaur performs Razor Leaf, but the creature hits the leaves away. Then it grabs Bulbasaur and begins to pull him to the water.

Meloetta and Skwovet try to go into the water to save Tomo, but misty grab hold of them both. Mew tries to do the same, but Tracey grabs her too.

Meloetta and Skwovet struggle to break free, but Misty is keeping them in her arms.

Suddenly, a manhole is lifted and the group looks up to see Officer Jenny.

Officer Jenny calls you, "Do I hear somebody down there?!"

And with that, Mew and the others begin to take the rope and climb out of the sewers.

Mew crosses her arms with a displeased look, I'm so not liking this.

Meloetta calls out, "Melo! Meloette Melo Meloett Meloetta!" (I agree! It's against the law to put Pokemon in prison!) and bangs on the door as well.

Just then, Officer Jenny opens the door to the cell, causing Mew and the others to move out of the way.

Then Jenny says, "You're all free to go now."

Then Mew asks. What took so long?

"We've had some strange things happening," Jenny explains.

Just then, a man comes walking in. He has dark brown hair, mustache, and wears an orange suit, white dress shirt, and a yellow bowtie.

The man says, "I hope you're not releasing these people, Officer."

"What a pleasant surprise, Mister Mayor," Officer Jenny salutes, but she doesn't seem pleased.

Misty and Tracey say, in surprise, "Mister Mayor?"

"Sir, they told me that they all only arrived in town today and they're on their way to the Pokémon gym on Trovita Island and their story checks out," Officer Jenny explains.

"I can't have this thing leaking out yet. Better keep them locked up until next week," The mayor says.

"I can't charge them if they're not charged with the crime, Mister Mayor," Officer Jenny says.

"Well, if that's the law. But I forbid any of you to say anything about that creature!" The mayor says.

"You can't do that! Why can't we say anything about it if it's the truth?" Tracey questions.

"Yeah. especially since one of our Pokemon and a member of our group is down there," Misty adds.

"All I care about is getting Tomo and my Bulbasaur back. They must be so scared by now," Mew says.

Suddenly, the mayor lost his temper, "Say another word and I'll have you all arrested for endangering public safety!"

Then Jenny explains, "That creature, you're not the only ones who saw it."

But the Mayor tries to stop her, "Officer, don't."

"Mr. Mayor, we can't keep this a secret forever," Jenny advises.

"Can't we at least try?" The Mayor questions.

Mew then says, "I like to know more about this creature you're referring to."

Jenny nods her head and says, "We've recently had a number of people who've reported encounters with a mysterious creature reaching out of the sewer."

"The same thing that we saw?" Tracey asks.

"Yes," Jenny answers.

Then explains, "So far, we've only had a few reports of stolen food. No serious injuries were reported. But the Mayor says people will panic if they hear about the creature, because we'll never be able to capture it.

"Why not?" Mew asks.

"There are almost 500 miles of sewer under the city, and more than 5,000 manholes," Jenny says.

"That's why we have to take drastic and immediate action to ensure the safety of everyone in this city. There's an election next week and if word gets out that I'm letting a monster run amok right beneath people's feet, I'll be ruined!" The mayor says.

"It just doesn't seem right to be mad at it if all it wants to do is eat," Misty replies.

"Still, I don't think it's a monster. If anything I think it's a Pokemon," Mew says.

"How can you tell?" Officer Jenny asks.

Suddenly, the group hears a knock on the door.

"Come in," The mayor says.

The door opens and Nurse Joy walks in, "Mr. Mayor! I've heard what you intend to do!"

"That's my business," The mayor says.

Nurse Joy walks to the mayor and says, "You can't go through with that plan of yours, Mayor!"

"Go run your Pokémon Center and I'll run the city," The Mayor says, brushing her off.

"Instead of trying to capture the creature alive so we can study it and learn where it may have come from, the Mayor wants to send a SWAT team to destroy it!" Nurse Joy explains.

This causes the group to become shocked and angry.

"That's cruel!" Misty angrily says.

"It's not fair!" Mew angrily says.

The mayor loses his temper again, "Enough! I am the mayor and I am the one who's responsible for this city! And I will do what I see fit!"

This has made Mew and her friends angry, especially Mew, Pikachu, Eevee, Meloetta and Skwovet.

Later on Mew and the others are at the Pokemon Center and explain to Professor Oak on what has happened and what they heard.

"Tracey's right. This mysterious creature could very well be a new species of Pokémon, or it could be a Pokémon that's undergone some kind of strange mutation," Professor Oak says.

"Professor Oak, what should we do? My Bulbasaur and Tomo are still down in the sewer with the creature," Mew asks.

"There's got to be some way to prevent the mayor from exterminating that creature, especially when a child is involved," Professor Oak says.

But Nurse Joy says, "I don't think so. The only thing the mayor cares about is getting re-elected, and he's not going to let anything stand in his way."

Team Rocket then makes themselves look scary to frighten the creatures. They run around the corner to scare the creature, but end up crossing with the Mayor's SWAT team.

We have no choice. Close up every manhole and opening, and seal that sewer shut!" The Mayor says.

Tracey, Misty, and the others look at the symbol on the bell. Excluding Tomo, the group knows exactly where they've seen this symbol before.

Back in the mayor's office, Nurse Joy is having a stern talking to with the mayor, "You can't do it! Mr. Mayor, you can't just send your own personal little army around to seal up every single manhole in the city!"

"What's wrong with my plan? This is a perfect solution to the problem. We don't have to worry about exterminating the creature if we just close up the sewer system," The mayor says

Meanwhile, at the sewer outlet, water begins to leak out, indicating the water buildup behind the concrete, and it looks like it's ready to burst.

At the mayor's house, the mayor is taking a relaxing bath.

He says to himself, "Well, now that that creature problem is finally taken care of, I should win re-election in a landslide."

Suddenly, the room begins to shake.

The next thing he knows, the water from the pipes burst from the floor, flooding the mayor's office, and freeing Mew and her friends, and the giant Bulbasaur in the process. Flashback:

He then places the Bulbasaur in the box in the river of the sewer and it drives down the river into the sewer system.

Flashback Ends:

Chapter 27: Episode 27: Misty Meets Her Match

Today, Mew and her friends are on a ferry to Trovita Island, so Mew can challenge the gym and earn her third badge. The group ride on the ferry as they see the wind ocean. As they draw closer to the island, they see the island is surrounded by whirlpools and huge spiked rocks.

"What are those spikey thing?" Tomo asks.

"They're rocks that formed millions of years when Trovita Island rose up out of the ocean," Tracey answers.

"Wow!" Tomo says, amazed.

"Wonder what the Trovita Island gym leader's like, Mew," Misty replies.

"I'm not sure, but I'll have to be prepared because who knows who the Gym Leader is and the kind of challenges I have to face," Mew says.

"You're right about that," Misty says.

Suddenly, Pikachu spots something in the water and calls out, "Pika Pika!" (We've got trouble!)

Suddenly, everyone soon sees a little girl with burgundy hair and a yellow shirt along with a Seel are caught in the strong current.

The girl cries for help, "Help! Please somebody! Help me!"

"That little girl's in trouble!" Mew says, shocked.

"She's drowning!" Tracey calls out.

"We have to do something fast!" Misty says.

The girl continues to cry out, "Hurry! Please help! Somebody help!"

Seel tries to swim them away, but the current is too strong.

The little girl continues to cry out, "Somebody! Please get my brother!" and the whirlpool swallows both her and Seel.

Meanwhile, a boy around the same age as Misty, runs to the cliff as he calls out. "Mahri! Mahri, where are you?!"

The boy is wearing dark clothes with a light vest. He has a darker red color than the girl. The boy looks out with his binocular to see the ferry that has come to a stop. He sees Misty call out to her Staryu and she dives into the water.

Misty says to her Staryu, "Come on, Staryu, let's go!"

Staryu and Misty soon dive into the water to search for the little girl. Lucky, they're able to find them right away, and Misty rescues the girl and the Seel. Then rises up the surface. Then Mew arrives on Lapras with Pikachu and Eevee.

Mew calls out, "Misty! Bring her over here!"

"Pikachu!" (This way!) Pikachu calls out.

Eevee calls out, "Eevee!" (Hurry!)

"Staryu, let's get them both over to Lapras!" Misty says to Staryo

The boy on the island along with others hurry along the cliff as the boy observes the whole thing. He sees Misty help Mew get the little girl and Seel on Lapras. Then Misty hugs her Staryu with a smile.

Impressed by Misty'saction, the boy smiles and says, "She's great."

While riding on Lapras the rest of the way to Trovita Island, Mew and the others are being spied on by Team Rocket.

Jessie says, "Aha! I've spotted the twerps. Full speed ahead."

"Aye-aye, sir!" James and Meowth say.

James and Meowth begin to pedal harder, but Jessie notices something off.

Jessir turns to the boys, "We're not moving. Pedal faster."

"Something's wrong," James says.

Then Meowth groans worried, "I hope it's not a…"

And then, the submarine gets pulled away by the current and towards the whirlpool

Team Rocket screams, "Whirlpool!"

The whirlpool pulls them in and the submarine begins to spin.

Back on the surface, Mew and the others are approaching Torvita Island, as well as the ferry boat. Turns out, the little girl's name is Mahri.

"That was a close call," Mew says in relief.

Then asks, Mahri, "What were you doing out there?"

"I was swimming with Seel near the beach, but the ocean pulled us out," Mahri answers.

"You have to be careful in the ocean. The currents can be dangerous, so always make sure you swim with other people around. Okay?" Misty says.

Mahri ndos her head.

Then Misty winks, "And Seel."

As Lapras and the ship arrive at the pier the boy and his friends hurry over to see the little girl.

The boy calls out, "Hey!"

"There she is!" Another boy says.

"She's okay!" the third girl says.

Soon, Lapras and the boy come to a stop, and Mew places Maria on the pier

The young man calls out, "Mahri!"

Both the young man and little Mahri run over and embrace each other.

Then the youngman says, "Never go swimming alone again!"

"I won't," Mahri replies.

Then the young man turns to the group, "I'm very grateful to you. I can't thank you enough for saving my sister."

"We were glad to do it," Mew says.

But then, the young man approaches Misty, and asks, "May I ask your name?"

"My name's Misty," Misty introduces herself.

Then the young man says, "Misty. You're amazing."

Mew and the others stare at the young man with a confused look.

The young man snaps his fingers, and the boys each present a bouquet of flowers. Misty is surprised and yet very pleased.

Then the man asks, "Music please? And snaps his fingers.

One of the guys brings a boombox and presses the button to play music.

Then the young man bows to Misty and says, "Misty, it would give me great pleasure."

Misty becomes confused, and the young man puts Togepi and Pichu and Mew's arms, and takes Misty away.

"Woah," Tracey says, surprised.

"Who is this guy?" Tomo asks.

"I have no idea," Mew answers.

Soon, the young man and Misty begin to slow dance.

Then the young man says, "Misty, from the way you saved my sister, it's clear you're an excellent Pokémon trainer. There aren't any water type trainers as skilled as you are. I'd be very honored and very grateful if you could stay here for a while and instruct the trainers in my humble gym."

Misty is caught by surprise, "Your gym? You mean you're the Trovita Island gym leader?"

"Yes. Is it such a shock?" The boy says.

"He's the Trovita gym leader?" Mew says, surprised.

"Pika?" (He is?) Pikachu says, confused.

Then Eevee says, "Eevee," (I guess so)

"Really?" Tomo asks, confused.

Even Meloetta and Skwovet are confused.

Then the boy says to Misty, "And you're not just a great trainer, you're a great dancer, too."

"Thank you," Misty says.

Tomo turns to the others, "I think he forgot that we existed."

"Yeah," Tracey replies.

Then the boy asks, "So what brings you and your friends on the island?"

"Well, my friend, Mew is challenging the Orange Island, so we can to Trovita so she can have a battle," Misty answers.

Mew steps forward, "That's right. I'm going to challenge you to a match. I've already got two badges and plan to earn my third one."

"Yeah! Come on! Mew came here to have gym matches with you!" Mahri says.

"So, what's your name?" Mew asks.

"Rudy. My name is Rudy. I'll be glad to accept your challenge, but first you'll each have to pass a little test," Rudy says.

"Sounds fair to me," Mew says.

"I hope you have good luck, Mew," Mahri says.

"Thanks," Mew says.

"You're gonna need lots of it to beat my big brother, Rudy," Mahri says.

Misty giggles, "Try not to underestimate Mew, Mahri. Mew is a pretty tough trainer."

Sometime later, Mew along with the others, including Ruby and Mahri are on a speed boat in the river.

One of the trainers raised the flag and says, "Ready?! Set! And go!" and waves it down.

And with that, Rudy drives the speed boat down the river.

Ruby says, "I'll agree to a match, but only if you can each get your Pokémon to attack and knock down all the targets that come up at us."

"Alright," Mew says.

Soon, the first target appears.

Mew calls out, "Pikachu, Thunder Shock!"

Then Pikachu performs a Thunderbolt attack, and hits the target.

"Perfect, Pikachu!" Mew says.

Then turns to Rudy, "What do you think Rudy?"

Then Mew becomes confused, "Uh Rudy?" and turns her head.

Rudy however is distracted by Misty, and says, "Your eyes, they're like diamonds, but lovelier."

"Hey you two love birds, this isn't the time for romance," Mew says with a grin on her face.

Then the second target appears.

Then Mew calls out, "Eevee, use Swift!"

Eevee jumps up and performs Swift Attack, hitting the target.

Misty sees this and says, "Nice work, Mew."

"Thanks," Mew says.

Suddenly, Team Rocket's Magikarp submarine emerges from the water. The hatch opens and Team Rocket appears out, performing the motto.

Jessie:

Prepare for trouble!

James:

And make it double!

Jessie continues, "

Jessie:

To protect the world from deva…

"Yeah, and they're heading this way!" Meowth says.

Right on cue, the target comes down in front of Team Rocket.

"Get it Mew," Tomo calls out.

Mew throws her pokeball and calls out, "Squirtle, go!"

Squirtle comes out of his Pokeball.

Then Mew calls out, "Squirtle, Water Gun, now!"

Squritle hits the target. Just then, the cliff that is attached to the tree, which is attached to the target, gives way in front of Team Rocket, and the impact makes a big splash and sends them flying off.

Team Rocket screams, "Looks like Team Rocket's blasting off again!"

Soon, Team Rocket is gone.

"Guys, did I just hear what I thought I heard?" Mew asks.

"Could be," Tracey says.

"Yeah. It's Team Rocket," Misty says, a little surprised.

"Glad to know we didn't imagine it," Tomo replies, dumbfounded.

Soon, Charizard comes out and hits two more targets. Squirtle and Eevee hit a separate target. Then Pikachu and Eevee hit a separate target as well.

Mew happily says, "We got them all!"

Misty and the others smile to see Mew's success.

Later in the evening, Mew and the others arrive at Rudy's home which is also the gym.

"Well, Mew, I'm surprised that you passed my attack test," Rudy says.

"Thanks Rudy, I've been training my Pokemon for a long time," Mew says.

"Tomorrow, we'll have a match, and if you beat me 2 out of 3, I'll give you that badge you want so much. Pick whatever element Pokémon you want, and I'll use the same," Rudy explains.

Mew nods her head, "Okay, Rudy. I'll use an electric type, a grass type, and a water type."

Then Rudy turns to Misty, "And as for you, would you care to have dinner with us this evening?"

"Oh, please say yes! My brother is a really good cook!" Mahri says.

"I don't know," Misty says, unsure.

"We'd both be happy if you would," Rudy insisted.

Misty soon agrees, "Alright, let's go."

Mahri then pushes Misty as Rudy takes her hand, and the three walk away, leaving the others behind.

"See ya," Tracey says.

"Bye, Misty," Mew says.

Everyone also says goodbye as well, and says to see her later.

Sometime later, Mew is talking to Professor Oak on the video phone while Pikachu, Eevee, and the other Pokemon are eating dinner.

Professor Oak says, "Ah, Trovita."

"I already passed Rudy's attack test, so the match tomorrow," Mew says.

"Sounds like you're doing very well, Mew," Professor Oak says.

Then says, "But don't get overconfident."

Then Tracey walks over and says, "Hi, Professor Oak. It's me, Tracey. And I wanted to show you a drawing of this thing I saw in the woods."

"Yeah. Now I wonder how Misty's doing," Mew replies.

Meanwhile, in the dining room, Misty, Rudy, and Mahri have just finished dinner.

"Thank you," Misty says with a smile.

"My pleasure," Rudy replies. Was everything alright?

"Oh, everything was delicious, Rudy," Misty says.

"I'm glad you liked it," Rudy says.

Then Mahri says, "You wanna know a secret? I always wanted a big sister just like you, Misty."

Then Mahri says, "I love my brother and the other boys at the gym, but I'm the only girl here."

Then Mahri has an idea, "Hey! I have an idea! Why don't you be my big sister and stay here forever?"

At the gym there are many of Rudy's Pokemon dancing. He has an Exeggutor, Electabuzz, Rhydon, Alakazam, Ninetales, Venomoth, Golem, Pidgeot, Hitmonchan and Starmie. They look like they're having a lot of fun.

"I don't think it's enough to just teach Pokémon a lot of attacks. I found that the Pokémon's abilities can improve and change if they learn to do something completely new and different," Rudy explains.

Then Mahri says, "That's why my brother gives all of our Pokémon dancing lessons."

Rudy then turns to Misty, "So, Misty, shall we dance?"

Misty blushes.

"Come on, Togepi! You too, Pichu!" Mahri happily says, and takes Togepi and Pichu.

Soon, she begins dancing with them.

Meanwhile, outside, on one of the tall rocky spikes, Team Rocket's submarine is tilting back and forth

"Alright, we seem to have it balanced now, so let's try to keep this thing steady," Jessie says.

As Jessie talks, the tip of her hair rubs Meowth's nose, causing him to let out a big sneeze. Then the submarine tilts over and falls into the water below and into one of the whirlpools.

Team Rocket screams, "Team Rocket's whirling round again!"

The next day, the Pokemon Battle Challenge is about to start. Rudy and Mew on the battlefield that is on a very large and tall rock pillar. Misty, Tomo, and the others watch from high above in the hot air balloon.

"I hope you're ready to battle, Rudy! I challenge you!" Mew says.

Pikachu agrees and steps on to the battlefield.

On the Pidgeot, the Referee says, "So it's Electabuzz versus Pikachu in the first battle of this three round match!"

Mahri calls out, "Come on! Beat him, Rudy!"

Tomo calls out, "You can do it, Mew!

Misty isn't saying a word. She is conflicted about who to root for, and the request Rudy and Mahri ask of her.

Mew calls out, "Pikachu, give him your Thunderbolt!"

Pikachu performs Thunderbolt and the attack lands, but it doesn't affect Electabuzz at all.

Pikachu then dashes forward.

Then Rudy calls out, "Electabuzz, Quick Attack back!"

Electabuzz dashes forward as well.

Both collide and are both pushed back by the attack, and both able to land on the rocky field.

Mew jumps and catches Pikachu in the nick of time.

In the basket of the hot air balloon, Mahri happily says, "My brother's a really good Pokémon trainer, isn't he, Misty?"

Tracye cries out, "Squirtle, look out!"

Just then, Squirtle tucks into his shell and performs a Water Gun whole spinning around. Soon, Squirtle launches himself back up, and amazes everyone.

"Woah! Look at Squirtle go!" Tomo says, impressed.

Tracey asks, "What's Squirtle doing, Misty?"

"Looks to me like Squirtle just learned to use Hydro Pump!" Misty says.

Squirtle continues to perform the attack until he pops out of his shell, and lands on the battlefield.

Seeing what's happening, Mew cheers, "Alright Squirtle, you did it! And you've learned Hydro Pump!"

"Pika Pika!" (Well done, buddy!) Pikachu replies.

"Eevee!" (Alright!) Eevee cheers.

Then Mew calls out, "Okay, Squirtle! Hydro Pump, now!"

Squritle quickly ducks back into his shell and performs Hydro Pump. The Hydro Pump nails Starmie multiple times. Starmie falls to the ground and quickly gets up, but it shows that it has some energy left.

Then Mew calls out, "Now use your Skull Bash attack!"

Squritle then speeds forward head first as he performs the Skull Bash. Then, Squirtle is right on target, bashes at Starmie, and sends it flying.

Rudy cries out, "Starmie, no!"

Squirtle lands safely on the ground, and Starmie falls to the ground. Its jewel blinks, showing that it's out of energy, and is defeated.

The referee announces, "The match is over! Squirtle wins the third round! Mew has defeated Rudy, the Trovita Island gym leader!"

"Alright!" Mew cheers.

Misty and the boys smile to see Mew has won her match.

Mew picks up Squirtle in her arms, "We did it, Squirtle! We finally won! That Hydro Pump was awesome!"

Ruby brushes his hair and says, "Nice job, Mew.

Late in the evening, everyone gathers at the beach.

Rudy then brings out the badge, "Here are your Spike Shell badges, Mew."

The badge is shaped like a triumphant star turban with a small gemstone on it.

"Thanks Rudy," Mew says, and takes the badge.

Mew kneels to her Pokemon and says, "See guys, we won the Spike Shell badge!"

Pikachu and Eevee nod their heads with smiles.

Just then, Rudy hands Misty a bouquet of flowers, "And Misty, I already know you've made your decision, but these are for you."

"I... Thanks, Rudy," Misty replies, and takes the bouquet.

Then remember, and Mahri has a present for you."

"A present?" Misty says, confused.

Mahri walks over and presents Misty a Pokemon Egg. The Pokemon Egg has different shades of blue. A dark on the top, and the rest so a light blue color, and has two white spots at the front.

"I found it a few days ago. I like you to have it. I know you'll raise it to be a great Pokemon," Mahri says.

Misty smiles and says, "Thank you, Mahri." and takes the Pokemon Egg.

Later on, Mew and her friends depart on Lapras out to sea as Rudy, Mahri, and the other trainers say their goodbye.

Mahri calls out, "If you change your mind and want to come back, we'll both be waiting for you, Misty!"

Mew and the others wave goodbye. Mew has won her third Orange League Badge. Mew also ends up winning something as well, a young man's heart and a Pokemon egg, but what will it hatch to? They'll have to wait and see what happens.
