Chapter 28: Episode 28: Pokemon Island Odyssey

After winning her third badge, Mew and her friends are now sailing on Lapras in the ocean blue, looking for their next adventure. Since it's a nice day, everyone is simply relaxing on the ocean, catching some rays or z's

Just then, Eevee notices something and questions, "Eev?" (Huh?)

Eevee climbs on Larpas' head to notice an island a short distance away.

Eevee turns to the others and calls out, "Eevee Eevee?" (Hey everyone, wake up!)

Hearing Eevee's cry, everyone either wakes up from their sleep or sits up from their relaxation.

Mew sits up and asks, "What is it, Eevee?"

Eeve looks ahead and points her paw out, "Eevee Eevee." (There's an island up ahead.)

Mew turns to where Mew is looking to see the island up ahead. It seems to have forests, mountains, and it seems to have grass areas as well.

"Oh that's Odyssey Island," Tracey says.

"Odyssey Island?" Tomo says, confused.

"What's that?" Misty asks, curiously.

"Odyssey Island is where Trainers can come and catch Pokemon. Many Pokemon lived around the island. There are also possibilities that you might find a rare and unusual Pokemon. A hundred years ago, the island became overpopulated, and food, water, and space were running low. One day, a group of trainers came to the island to help the Pokemon who wished to leave get to the main lands where there is more space. However, the island became overpopulated because many Pokemon end up with families or travel to live there. One day, they decided to make it a special island where trainers can catch different Pokemon, and it kind of became a popular attraction," Tracey says.

"Sounds like the Safari Zone back in Kanto," Misty says.

"Yeah. And we got to see so many Pokemon," Tomo says.

"Yeah. I even heard there are some ancient ruins on the island, and a very huge lake for the water Pokemon," Tracey says.

Mew then asks, "So guys, what do you say? Shall we explore the island and find ourselves some new friends."

"I don't mind, it sounds fun," Misty says.

"Yeah! Let's go!" Tracey says.

"Sure. It will be good to catch new Pokemon," Tracey says.

The Pokemon happily agrees.

Mew then turns to Larpas, "Alright Lapras, time to head to Odyssey Island!"

Lapras squeals with excitement, and swims towards Odyssey Island to catch some new Pokemon and meet some new friends.

Sometimes later, Mew and her friends arrive on Odyssey Island.

Mew sighs with a smile, "This island is beautiful. It's a perfect place for Pokemon to live."

"Yeah. I can see why the Pokemon love it here," Misty says.

Tracey soon notices a building along with a large wooden gate close to it.

"There's the Odyssey Island's office. This is where we register to get into the Safari Zone of the Island," Tracey says.

"Great," Mew says.

And the four friends and their Pokemon walk inside the building so they can gain access to the Safari Zone of the Island. When they walk inside, they see an older man. The older man with gray hair, a mustache, tan skin, and brown eyes. He is wearing a green long sleeve shirt, a brown vest, brown pants and boots.

Mew and the others walk over and to see the man.

"Hello sir. My friends and I would like to go into the Safari Zone," Mew says.

"Yeah. Can we?" Tomo asks, excited.

"Of course. Is this your first time here?" The older man asks.

"Yeah. I'm Mew and these are my partners, Pikachu and Eevee," Mew says.

"My name is Misty, and this is Togpei and Pichu," Misty says.

"I'm Tomo, Meloetta and Skwovet are my partners," Tomo says.

Then Tracey says, "And my name is Tracey."

"My aren't you a fine group. The name is Barneby, I'm the one in charge of the Safari Zone on Odyssey Island," The older man says.

"It's nice to meet you," Mew says.

Then Misty asks, "So what are the rules here?"

"Well, each trainer is allowed to catch up to 8 Pokemon Each. We'll be supplying you with 8 Safari Balls. Fishing lines, lures, and berries are supplied for trainers. You can only use the Safari Balls when you're in the Safari Zone, so other Pokeballs aren't allowed," Barneby says.

"Okay," The four replies.

Barneby then places four bags of Pokeballs, each of them has eight of them on the counter. As well as some extra fishing poles, and lures, and a bag of berries.

He then brings out a ticket that has a safari ball and the island on it, "And this is your pass to get into the Safari Zone."

"Thank you," Mew says, and takes the card.

Just then. Barneby says, "Before I forget, if you plan on heading to the ruins, it's best you be careful."

"How come?" Misty asks.

"I've been getting reports of some Pokemon chasing trainers out of the specific area of the ruin. Many suspect it must be a parent Pokemon who is protecting its young ones. It will be best for you to keep your distance if you decide to explore the ruins," Barneby says.

"We'll be careful," Tracey says.

"Alright then, see you all later and have a good time," Barneby says.

"We will," Tomo happily says.

And so, Mew and her friends head off to the Safari Zone to catch some Pokemon and have some fun. They leave the building and arrive at the gate. Soon they see Officer Jenny at the gate.

"Hi Officer Jenny," Mew says.

"Hello. Are you entering the Safari Zone?" Officer Jenny asks.

"We are," Misty says.

Then Mew shows Officer Jenny the ticket, "Here you go."

Jenny takes the ticket to observe it. Then uses a hole puncher to punch a hole on it.

Then gives it to Mew, "There you go. You're all ready."

"Thank you Officer Jenny," Misty says.

"And remember to only use your Safari Balls and be careful around the ruins," Jenny says.

"I have to suspect it must be the wild Pokemon that Barneby told us," Tracey says.

"That's right," Officer Jenny says.

"Do you know what kind of Pokemon it is?" Tracey asks.

"No. The Pokemon keeps itself hidden in the cave so we never see the Pokemon. And every time someone tries to enter the cave, it chases everyone out with its attacks," Officer Jenny says.

"Hmm, do you know what kind of attack it uses?" Mew asks.

"It was using an Aura Sphere," Jenny says.

"An Aura Sphere," Mew replies.

She then begins to think as she says, "There are not that many Pokemon that can actually use Aura Sphere, at least Wild Pokemon."

Then turns to the others, "Let's head to the Safari Zone and explore."

Everyone nods their heads in reply and begins to enter the Safari Zone Park. They walk around to see a large grassy field. There are plenty of trees and wide open fields and such. There's even hill tops, and a large

"Wow. The place looks really nice," Tracey says.

"Yeah. And I suspect there will be a lot of Pokemon living here. I sure love to sketch this place and some Pokemon," Tracey says.

Then, Tracey notices a pair of Dewgongs, one normal and the other is a shiny one. The two are happily snuggling their cheeks against each other as they are in the lake and relaxing in the cool water.

"Aww, how sweet," Misty says.

Tomo then brings out his sketchbook, "I gotta sketch this."

Tracey begins to sneak towards the Dewgongs in the lake. Once he's close enough, Tracey begins to sketch the picture of the pair of Dewgong. Mew and the others watch as Tracey sketches the two Pokemon in the water. Suddenly, the three begin snickering as they cover their mouths. Even the Pokemon are trying their best not to laugh.

Tracey turns his head with a confused look, "You guys okay?"

"Um Tracey…" Mew says.

Then Misty says, "It looks like you got a sketch partner."

Tracey becomes confused and looks to see a Pokemon is sitting next to him with a large leaf. It's a bipedal, beagle-like Pokémon with white and brown fur. It has a long tail with an end resembling a paintbrush. It has a footprint on its back that is the same color as the tip of the tail, and a mark placed on its back. It also has a round structure on its head with a point that resembles a beret. It has floppy, brown ears and a brown collar on its neck. The rings encircling its eyes are also brown, as are the eyelids. Its arms have two brown bands, and its legs have only one. Each of its limbs has three digits.

It seems to be using its tail to paint the Dewgongs on the large leaf.

Tracey yelps in surprise and falls on his rump, scaring the two Dewgong and dive into the water and tosses his sketch book in the air. Luckily, the Pokemon catches the sketchbook and the pencil. Then presents them to Tracey.

"Thank you," Tracey says, and takes his belongings.

"What Pokemon is that?" Misty asks.

"It's a Smeargle," Mew says, and takes out her Pokedex.

Then Dexter says, "Smeargle, the Painter Pokemon. A Normal Type. It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks. The fluid of Smeargle's tail secretions changes in the intensity of its hue as the Pokémon's emotions change."

"Wow. I have never seen a Smeargle before. They originated in the Johto Region," Tracey says.

Then Smeargle says, "Smeargle. Smeargle Smeargle, Smear Smear. Smeargle Smear Smeargle." (Hello. Sorry for scaring you, I was trying to paint and decided to do it next to you because you're sketching too. I wanted to do it next to you.)

"Smeargle said hello, and apologized for scaring you. He said that he was painting and wanted to do it next to you because ke noticed you sketching and wanted to do it next to you," Mew translates.

"Oh," Tracey replies.

Then turns to Smeargle, "It's okay, you just caught me by surprise."

Smeargle then holds out the leaf and Tracey sees the incomplete drawing of the two Dewgongs.

Tracey is impressed, "That's actually pretty good."

Then shows Smeargle his sketch, "Here is my sketch."

Smeargle looks at Tracey's sketch, and smiles.

He happily says, "Smeargle Smeargle. Smeargle Smear Smeargle?" ( Your drawing looks good. Are you an artist?)

Mew translates, "Smeargle said that he likes your drawing, and asked if you're an artist."

Then Tracey says to Smeargle, "Well, I'm not an artist, I'm actually a Pokemon Watcher. I travel to sketch and observe Pokemon, even try to find undiscovered Pokemon."

Smeargle gives Tracey a thumbs up with a smile.

Suddenly, he hears someone calling out, "Stufful!" (Smeargle!)

The group turns their heads to see another Pokemon walking over with a few large leaves.

It's a quadrupedal Pokémon resembling a bear cub. Its body and head are mostly pink, while its legs are brown. Each foot has a single pink paw pad on the bottom. There is a white, semicircle marking around its face similar to a headband, and it has a white muzzle with a triangular, black nose. Its white-tipped ears are situated on the sides of its head, and there is a small, white-tipped tuft of fur under each. Around the center of its short, puffy tail is a dark pink ring marking. Under the tail is a small, white flap resembling the tag on a stuffed toy.

"Aww, it's so cute," Misty happily says.

"It's a Stufful!" Tracey says, amazed.

"That's right and this one is from the Alola Region," Mew says, and brings out her Pokedex.

Dexter says, "Stufful, the Flailing Pokémon. A Normal and Fighting type. Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation. Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling."

"Wow. Cute and tough," Misty says.

"Kind of cool," Tomo says.

Stufful then hands Smeargle the leaves, "Stufful Stufful." (I brought you some more leaves.)

"Smeargle Smeargle," (Thank you, Stufful.) Smeargle says.

"Well, it appears that Smeargle and Stufful are friends," Tracey says.

"Looks like it," Mew says.

Just then, Stufful walks towards Tracey with curious eyes. Before he knows it, Stufful hops on to Tracey's shoulder and adjusts itself for Stuff to snuggle his face with glee.

Tracey chuckles with a smile and says, "Cute little guy."

"That's sweet. Stufful really likes you," Misty says.

"Yeah. She really likes you," Mew says.

"She?" Tomo says, curious.

"I think you're right, Mew. This Stufful's a girl," Tracey says.

Tracey then turns to Smeargle and Stufful and asks, "Hey, would you both like me to catch you. I promise to take good care of you, and we can sketch together.

Stufful is very happy and snuggles him more. Smeargle thinks for a bit and nods his head in reply.

"Alright" Tracey replies and brings out the Safari Balls.

Then tap each of them, "Pokeball go."

Then they both materialized into the Pokeballs.

With a simple click, Tracey catches both Smeargle and Stufful.

"Alright, I caught both Smeargle and Stufful," Tracey says.

Suddenly, Smeargle and Stufful get out of their Pokeballs on their own. Stufful still sits on Tracey's shoulder and Smeargle is standing next to him.

Tracey chuckles with a smile, "I guess you two want to stay out of your Pokeballs."

Smeargle and Stufful nod their heads with a smile.

"I think that's a yes," Misty says.

"Alright guys, let's go explore Odyssey Island and find some more Pokemon friends," Mew says.

Mew and the others continue to explore around the Safari Zone of Odyssey Island to find and catch new Pokemon. They find a large lake and fish for Pokemon. Misty ends up fishing out and catching two Pokemon known as Basculin, but one has red stripes and the other has blue stripes. Tomo aslo catches a Wooper and a Barboach, while Mew ends up catching a shiny Feebas and a Slowpoke.

After exploring the lake, Mew and the others begin to explore one of the forest areas to see so many Pokemon, especially bug type Pokemon. Luckily, she isn't afraid of Bug Type Pokemon anymore. Misty actually catches a Wimpod and a Wurmple. Tracey catches a Mankey. Mew ends up catching two Plant Cloak Burmy, a male and a female. Tomo catches a Shinx and a Blitzel, and a Girafrig.

After exploring the forest, Mew and the others are now at a wide open area. It doesn't have much grass and trees, but it's a beautiful wide open space. Tomo catches a Rufflet and a Bidoof Mew catches a Jumpluff, an Emolga, and a Furret. Misty catches a Budew, a Delibird, and an Eevee. Tracey also catches an Eevee alone with a pair of Darumaka, and a Phantump.

After catching so many Pokemon, Mew and her friends arrive at the ancient ruins Barneby has told them about. They look to see the ancient ruins. As they walk around, they see old ancient buildings, and the walls have ancient writing on it. It looks like an ancient town if anything.

"Wow. This place looks very cool," Tomo says.

"I have to agree. There are so many old buildings here," Misty says.

Then says, "Some of them even look like old houses, and there are a few wells."

"My guess is that the ancient ruins used to be a civilization a long time ago," Tracey says.

Then Mew says, "Remember guys, Barnaby and Officer Jenny did say that the ruins is where this mysterious Wild Pokemon is at."

"You're right. It's best we stay away from the cave they mention," Misty says.

"Wonder what kind of Pokemon it is," Tomo replies.

"All we know is that it can use Aura Sphere," Tracey says.

"Still, I have to wonder what Pokemon it is. For all we know, this Pokemon could be hurt, or must have a family nearby," Mew says.

"Possibly," Tracey says.

Suddenly, Tomo points ahead, "You think that's the cave?"

The group soon look ahead to see a large cave next to one of the old ruins.

"So this is the cave where the Pokemon might be in," Misty says.

"Seems so. I wonder if the Pokemon is still inside," Mew says.

Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee slowly walk to the cave, much to the others' concern.

"Mew, what are you doing?" Misty asks.

"I'm going to see if that Pokemon is in the cave. Maybe we can help," Mew says.

"I don't know if it's a good idea. The Pokemon sounds pretty aggressive," Tracey says.

"Wouldn't hurt to try," Mew says.

Mew then turns to the cave and calmly calls out, "Hello!"

Her voice echoes through the cave.

Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee look around the entrance of the cave. Unknown to them, something opens its eyes and it doesn't look happy. Seeing this, Mew squints her eyes, but opens her eyes and gasps in shock to see an Aura Sphere flying towards them.

"Get down!" Mew calls out.

Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee rush out of the way as Misty and the others run out of the way as the Aura Sphere. The move flies out of the way and hits the wall close by.

"That was close!" Misty says, shocked.

"Guess the Pokemon is in that cave after all," Tomo says.

"I think it's best we keep away from the cave," Tracey says.

Suddenly, Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee hear a thud coming from the cave.

"Hold on guys, I think I heard something," Mew whispers.

Mew gesture to the others to come forward. Tracey and the others slowly walk towards the cave. Tracey, Smeargle, and Stufful are with Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee on the left side of the cave, while Misty, Togpei, Pichu, Tomo, Meloetta, and Skwovet are standing on the other side. They all take a peek through the entryway of the cave and hear some strange noises.

"What's that?" Misty asks.

"I'm not sure. They sound like Pokemon sounds," Mew says.

"I think you're right. They're saying that he's very weak and sick," Tomo says.

"Do you think the Pokemon might be hurt?" Misty asks.

"Maybe, and this sounds like there's more than one in the cave," Mew says.

"What do we do?" Tracey wonders.

Mew takes a calm breath and says, "I'll go in first. The rest of you stay clear until I say otherwise."

The group is reluctant about letting Mew go into the cave first. They then turn to Mew and nod their heads in reply. Mew then nods her head and begins to enter the cave. Pikachu and Eevee follow closely and slowly from behind for support. Mew turns to her Pokemon and gently shushes them, and they nod their heads. They continue to walk deep inside the cave, and soon notice something up ahead. Mew then brings out the Silph Scope and puts it on, remembering that it can let her see in the dark. She looks around and notices four Pokemon inside the cave. One of them is lying on the ground and is breathing heavily. Mew is shocked, but then decides to take a deep breath and approach the Pokemon. Just then, the three Pokemon turn to see Mew and grow aggressive.

Mew quickly says, "Calm down everyone. Calm down. I'm only here to help."

However, the three Pokemon don't seem to believe her.

Mew calmly says, "I'm only here to help. I… I noticed your friend is looking very exhausted and needs some help."

Mew soon notices that the Pokemon who is lying on the ground is not looking good. It's heavily breathing, and parts of its face are looking red. She also notices a bad bruise on its right side.

"Please, I don't think he's feeling so well. He really needs help. I can help him, but only if you let me and my friends help," Mew says.

One Pokemon turns to the group and asks, "Pancham Pancham?" (What do you guys think?)

"Mien Mien Mienfoo," (She seems like a nice person.) The other Pokemon says.

Then the third Pokemon says, "Clobbo Clonno Clobbopus Clobbopus." (I don't know. Lucario feels touchy about humans.)

"Mien Mien Mienfoo Mienfoo," (But she's right. Lucario has been hurt and is starting to run a fever for using too much of his Aura Sphere to keep them away from us.) The second Pokemon says.

"Pancham Pancham Pan Pancham." (Then we'll take our chance for the human's help.) The first Pokemon says.

The other two nod their heads. The three Pokemon then walk to Mew and point to their ill friend.

"Thank you. I'll try to help the best I can," Mew says.

Mew then slowly walks towards the Pokemon as it heavily breathes. Pikachu and Eevee stay close to the other three Pokemon as Mew sits down on her knees and observes the Pokemon, using the Scope.

Mew touches the Pokemon's forehead and says in concern, "I thought so, he's running a fever."

Then turns to see the red bruise on the side of the Pokemon's body.

"And it also injured," Mew says to herself.

Mew turns to her Pokemon, "Pikachu. Eevee. I can use your help."

Pikachu and Eevee nod their heads and rush over. With their help, Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee, move the Pokemon so it will be on its back and not on its stomach. Mew then takes off her bag and places it on the ground. Then she digs into it and pulls out some Healing potions, bandages, oran berries, and sitrus berries, and other kinds of medicine for Pokemon. Mew then starts by checking on its injury on the side. She sprays the healing potion, and the Pokemon grits its teeth in pain.

"I'm sorry, but it does sting for a bit, but you'll be okay," Mew says to the Pokemon.

Mew then applies a bandage on it. Once she's done, Mew observes the Pokemon's body and sees some of its body, mainly some parts of its arms are red.

"This Pokemon must have used Aura Sphere so much that its arms become sore, "Mew says to herself.

She then spray the potions all over the arms, and wrap bandages around it. Mew then brings out a bowl and a grinder. Then begins to mash oran berries and sitrus berries in. Once the berries are mashed. Then she transfers the mashed berries to a small bowl.

She scoops a bit on a spoon and presents it to the sick Pokemon, "Here you go. It will help you feel better. Then I can give you a little medicine."

The Pokemon slowly opens its eyes and looks to see Mew. However, the Pokemon frowns and turns its head away.

"Please eat it, it will make you feel better," Mew says.

Just then, the first Pokemon walks to its friend and says, "Pancham Pancham Pancham. (Don't worry, you can trust her. We gave her a chance and she's been taking care of you.)

The Pokemon turns to Pancham and gives it a stern stare. However, the three smaller Pokemon stand beside it and give it calm smiles as they nod. Informing him that the girl can be trusted. The Pokemon turns its head to Mew and nods.

Mew gives it a gentle smile and presents it with the mashed berries, "Now then, here you go."

The Pokemon then begins to eat the mashed fruit. Mew gives it a few spoonfuls until it's satisfied.

"There you go. I did all I can, but if you want, I can take you to the Pokemon Center to have you checked," Mew says. Then takes out the Safari ball, "I can carry you in the Pokeball until you get there.

Then the Pokemon frowns again.

"It's okay. The Pokemon Center can help you feel better, and if you want, my friends and I can do what we can to keep you and your friends safe," Mew says.

The Pokemon firmly stares at Mew and decides to agree with a nod.

"Okay then. I promise to let you out as soon as we get to the Pokemon Center," Mew says.

She then gently taps the Pokeball with the Safari ball and it goes inside. With a click, the Pokemon has been caught.

Mew stands and turns to its friends, "Come on, let's get your friend to the Pokemon Center."

With that, Mew, Pikachu, Eevee, and the three other Pokemon hurry to the exit of the cave.

Meanwhile, Misty and the boys are growing concerned.

"Do you think she's okay?" Misty asks.

"I know Mew's fine. We just need to wait," Mew says.

Then Tomo notices and points to the cave, "Look!"

The group turns to see Mew, Pikachi, and Eevee exit the cave with three more. Now that they're out, it's easier to see the three Pokemon's appearance.

The first Pokemon is a bipedal, mammalian Pokémon that resembles a young panda. Its head and short, puffy tail are white. It has a triangular black nose, rounded black ears, black circles around its eyes, and tufts of fur on top of its head and on each cheek. Its upper body and hind feet are black, while the lower body is a dark gray. Where the two colors meet the dark gray forms a three-pointed pattern on its chest. There are three digits on each paw and small, dark brown circular pads on the soles of its black hind paws. It also carries a small, green leaf in its mouth.

The second is a yellow, bipedal, mustelid-like Pokémon, with round ears, red eyes, and a pink nose with a whisker on each side. Its red arms look similar to flared sleeves, and the paws are yellow. Mienfoo's chest has a small red band, and its pelt piles around its thighs resembling a tunic or robe. Its legs are red, and its yellow tail is also tipped red.

The third one is a small, off-white cephalopod Pokémon with small, blue eyes with horizontal slit-shaped pupils, and an orange mask pattern around them. It has a rather large head with four orange spots on its forehead, and small, orange ears or siphon ports on each side. It has several small tentacles that it uses to get around, and two large tentacles that act as arms. Each of these large tentacles has an orange suction cup on the underside and large, indigo bumps on the end, with an orange suction cup that resembles boxing gloves. Its dot-like mouth is located underneath its tentacles.

"Mew, you're okay," Misty says relieved.

"But who are these three?" Tomo asks.

"There's no time to explain. Their friend is badly hurt and sick," Mew says.

The group gasps in shock.

"Then let's get to the Pokemon Center right away," Tracey says.

Tomo and Misty nod their heads.

Sometime later, Mew and the others arrive at the Pokemon Center just outside of the Safari Zone. Thanks to Officer Jenny Barneby, they're able to get the four Pokemon out of the park without any problems. In the emergency room, Nurse Joy and Chansey tend to the Pokemon.

The Pokemon looks a lot like Tomo's little Riolu. A bipedal, canine-like Pokémon with predominantly blue and black fur. It possesses a short, round spike on the back of each forepaw, in addition to a third on its chest. It has red eyes, a long snout, and ears. When its mouth is open, two pairs of pointed teeth, one in the upper jaw and one in the lower, can be seen. It possesses cream-colored fur on its torso and blue fur on its thighs that resemble shorts. It has a medium-length tail of the same blue color as well. It stands on its toes rather than on its entire foot. It has developed four black appendages that hang down from its head.

The three young Pokemon watch their friend with deep concern as Mew and her friends watch.

"Those three must be very worried about him," Tracey says.

"I wonder what Pokemon they are," Mew says.

"Well, one is a Mienfoo. Remember, Gary has one," Tomo says.

"The other two are a Pancham and a Clobbopus," Mew says.

"And the last one is a Lucario," Tracey says.

"Let's see," Mew says, and brings out her Pokedex.

Dexter says about Pancham, "Pancham, Playful Pokémon. A Fighting Type. It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can't help grinning if anyone pats its head."

Misty giggles, "Sounds like a little prankster."

Then Mew has the Pokedex pointed to the second Pokemon.

Dexter says, "Mienfoo, the Martial Arts Pokemon. A Fighting Type. Though small, Mienfoo's temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be met with a flurry of attacks."

Then turns to the third Pokemon, "Clobbopus the Tantrum Pokemon. A Fighting Type. It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land."

Then has Dexter points to the last Pokemon, "Lucario, the Aura Pokemon, and the evolved form of Riolu. A Fighting and Steel Type. It can tell what people are thinking. Only Trainers who have justice in their hearts can earn this Pokémon's trust."

"I wonder what could have happened to that Lucario?" Misty replies.

"I'm not sure," Mew answers, and looks at the treatment Nurse Joy and Chansey perform on Lucario.

Sometime later, Mew and the others are in the medical room as Lucario is lying on the bed after the treatment.

"How's Lucario doing?" Mew asks.

"Lucario is starting to heal properly. He'll just need to rest for a little while until he heals," Nurse Joy says. "It seems that Lucario got this way from exhaustion. Probably from using its Aura Sphere so much and suppressing its pain."

"Poor Lucario," Tomo replies.

"Do not worry, Lucario just need a few days to rest and it's be all better," Nurse Joy says,

"Thank you Nurse Joy," Mew says.

Nurse Joy then says, "I'll return later to check how you're doing."

"Okay," Mew says.

Nurse Joy then heads out of the room. Pancham, Mienfoo, and Clobbopus walk to their friend's house to see their friend. Lucario turns to see the younger Pokemon and gently reaches its paw out to them. Mew and the others gently walk towards Lucario and the younger Pokemon.

"How are you doing Lucario?" Mew asks.

Lucario gives the group a calm stare. Despite the frown, it's not as serious as before.

"It's okay, if you have trouble at first. I can imagine you must have been hurt by humans before. I suspect that's the reason why you chase away any humans who get close to the cave," Mew replies.

Lucario looks at Mew with a confused look, but calmly nods his head.

"I thought so. I met a few Pokemon who had difficulties trusting humans, but they learned that not all humans are like that. I'm sure we can help you if you uh, explain to us your situation. And maybe there's a way we can help you," Mew says.

Lucario thinks for a minute and replies what everyone hasn't expected, "... Okay…."

This catches Mew and her friends by surprise.

Then Lucario says without moving his mouth, "And thank you for helping me…"

"Did Lucario just talk?" Misty asks, shocked.

"It's telepathy," Tracey says, surprised

"Sounds cool," Tomo says, amazed.

"So how are you feeling?" Mew asks.

"A… little better…" Lucario answers.

"If you don't mind us asking Lucario, what happened?" Mew asks.

Lucario lets out a sigh and says, "It's difficult to explain, but I was captured by a group of humans. They used electricity like nets and Pokemon to capture me and many other Pokemon in the forest I lived in. All I know is that those humans used Pokemon and ruthless weapons to attack us and trapped us in those round capsules. I was trapped there for a long time. Then Pancham, and the others found me and freed me from the Pokeball a week ago. They've been helping me since then. I've been… reluctant about getting near humans after what happened…"

"That makes sense," Misty says.

"Don't worry, you're safe with us now," Mew says.

"Thank you. I do apologize for scaring you and try to chase everyone away," Lucario says.

"It's okay. We understand. You're just uneasy for humans getting close to you," Misty says.

"Any Pokemon will feel that way if they're in your position," Tracey says.

Just then, Pancham climbs on Misty's shoulder and makes Misty giggle. Clobbopus stands next to Tomo and Mienfoo is close with Tracey.

"What's up?" Misty asks.

Lucario calmly smiles and says, "I think they like to come with you three."

"Really?" Tomo asks.

The three nod their heads.

Then Mew turns to Lucario, "Lucario, I know that I caught you with the Safari ball just to bring you to the Pokemon Center, but if you want, would you like to come with me and my friends?"

Lucario becomes confused and shows skepticism on his face.

"It's up to you if you want to. If you want to come with us, we can help you get better acquainted with humans, and we can take care of you. If not, then we can do what we can to help you get better and you'll be safe at the Safari Zone," Mew says.

Lucario thinks for a bit. He then looks at Mew and looks towards her eyes. From the looks in Mew's eyes, he can tell what kind of human this girl is.

Lucario calmly says, "I'll accompany you and your friends. I can tell that you have strong justice in your heart, especially after helping tend to my wounds and bringing me to this 'Pokemon Center' for more medical treatment."

Then turns to the younger Pokemon, "And I can see these three have also taken a liking to your friends."

Mew smiles and says, "That's good to hear. I promise to take good care of you."

A few days later, Lucario is back to perfect health and still decides to go with Mew and her friends.

They soon see Barneby and Officer Jenny before leaving the island.

"Thank you for helping us with our problem," Barneby says.

"And thank you for helping Lucario, and glad to see it in perfect health," Officer Jenny says.

"You're welcome," Mew says.

"We hope you'll come by someday," Barneby says.

"Maybe we will," Tracey says.

Sometime later, Mew and her friends are riding on Lapras as they leave Odyssey Island as they wave goodbye to Officer Jenny, Barneby, and Nurse Joy. Now Mew and her friends have new Pokemon friends, and are able to help another Pokemon in need.

Chapter 29: Episode 29: The Prehistoric Pokemon Girls

Still sailing on Lapras along the ocean blue, Mew and her friends continue to explore through the Orange Island. However, some of them are not doing so well being out at sea for so long. Plus, the sun is already beginning to set so it's starting to get pretty late. They know that they need to find an island soon.

Tomo lets out a groan and lies down, "I don't feel so good."

"I don't feel too good about myself. I may be a water Pokemon trainer, but I'm starting to get a bit seasick myself," Misty says.

Togepi and Pichu also rub their tummies as they begin to growl.

"I think Togepi and Pichu are getting hungry," Mew says.

Then takes out a small bag and looks inside. She then takes out one oran berry.

"Unfortunately, this is the only berry I have," Mew says.

She then splits the berry in half and gives the pieces to the little ones. Then they begin to eat it.

"We should find an island soon. We're running low on supplies," Tracey says.

"Including our food supplies," Mew adds.

"And some of us are starting to get tired of the sea," Misty says.

Then Tomo says, "And it's going to be dark soon."

Meloetta then pets Tomo's forehead.

Just then Skwovet calls out, "Skwovet Skwovet! Skwov Skwov Skwovet!" (Look there! There's an island ahead!)

"An island?" Tomo asks, sitting up.

Tomo looks to where Skwovet is looking and sees an island a short distance away in front of them.

"It is an island. We can go there for supplies," Tracey says.

"And we can get some rest from being out at sea for so long," Mew says.

Then turns to Lapras, "Okay Lapras, sail to that island so we can get some rest."

Lapras agrees and so sail to the island so everyone can get some rest, including himself.

Sometime later, Mew and her friends are on the beach of the island.

Mew calls back Lapras, "Lapras, return." And lapras returns to his Pokeball.

Mew and the others look at the island to see so many fruit trees and bushes with different kinds of fruits and other kinds of food.

"Wow. There are so many different fruit trees and berries," Misty says.

"And I think I see a few herbs and other healing berries. This should be more than enough for a few supplies," Mew says.

Then Tomo along with Meloetta and Skwovet's stomachs begin growling.

"I'm starting to get hungry," Tomo says.

Meloetta and Skwovet feel the same.

"We'll grab some berries so you can eat while we get some berries and herbs," Mew says.

"Okay," Tomo says.

Mew then picks some berries and fruits and puts them in a pile for Tomo and the Pokemon to eat. Misty decides to eat with them, so she can keep an eye on them. Mew and Tracey pick some berries like Oran Berries, Pecha Berries, Drash Berries, Chesto Berries, Aspear Berries and other berries that are good for healing. Even some of the berries and fruits for some food supplies.

Picking some berries from the bushes, Tracey says, "There are a lot of berries and herbs here. There should be more than enough to last us for a while."

"I agree. However, we will need to go find some potions and other supplies from the stores. If there are stores on this island," Mew says.

"I'm not sure if there is a store here. In fact, I'm not sure if this island has a town," Tracey says.

"I suppose staying at a Pokemon Center is out of the question," Misty replies.

"I think so. I actually don't remember seeing this island on any map. I wonder if this is a deserted island," Tracey says.

"Maybe, but it's nice to get some peace and quiet from the city," Mew says.

"Maybe, but it would have been nice to be at a Pokemon Center, but it's also nice to sleep outdoors in the stars," Misty says.

"Yeah. This place is great," Tomo says.

Unknown to Tomo and the others, two figures watch them from a distance, hiding within the branches of the trees.

Mew turns to the group and says, "Come on guys, let's set up camp before it gets dark."

"Good idea," Misty says.

Soon, the group begins to set up their campsite along with their sleeping bags. While Tomo and the girls get the campsite set up, Tracey makes some more fruit sandwiches with what supplies they've found and had left.

Later in the night, everyone is fast asleep in their sleeping bags, and their Pokemon are tucked in with them. Tomo along with Meloetta and Skwovet are among those who are still asleep. Suddenly, a strange rustling sound slowly wakes Tomo up.

"Huh?" Tomo softly says and slowly opens his eyes.

Then turns his head, "Wha-what was that?"

But is still sleepy, "Probably nothing."

Then Tomo falls back to sleep.

Suddenly, he begins to hear strange rattling and leaves rustling. That causes Tomo to wake up more and sit up.

Confused, Tomo wonders, "What was that?"

Soon, Meloetta and Skwovet begin waking up as well. They both let out a yawn and look at Tomo with tired eyes.

Meloetta turns to Tomo, still feeling tired and asks, "Melo… etta…" (What's… going on?)

"Sorry Meloetta, but I thought I heard something," Tomo says.

"Skwovet Skwov…" (So sleepy…) Skwovet says and lets out a yawn.

Suddenly, the three hear rustling in the trees and bushes, catching them by surprise.

"Loetta?!" (What was that?!) Meleotta asks, startled.

"Let's go check it out," Tomo says.

Meloetta and Skwovet nod their heads in reply. Tomo gets out of his sleeping bag, grabs his backpack and heads off into the forest with Meloetta and Skwovet without waking everyone up. Tomo, Meloetta, and Skwovet find themselves somewhere in the dark forest as they search for the source of the noise.

Tomo calls out, "Hello! Is anyone there?! Hello!"

Meloetta calls out, "Meloetta!" (Hello!)

"Skwovet Skwov?!" (Anyone here?!) Skwovet calls out.

Tomo looks around and suddenly has this feeling that something or someone is behind him. Tomo quickly turns around to see no one is there.

"That's weird," Tomo says.

He then begins to walk around, "Wonder what was…" but he then tips on arised up root of a tree and begins to fall and roll down the hill.

Meloetta and Skwovet panic as they see Tomo rolling down the hill, which leads to the edge. Tomo ends up falling over the edge and a loud thud appears. Meloett and Skwovet panics as they rush down the hill and see Tomo lying on the ground. Meloetta and Skwovet look and see that Tomo has been knocked out from his fall and are deeply worried. Suddenly, two figures arrive in front of the unconscious Tomo and the two Pokemon. They both loom over him.

The next day, Mew and the others are up, but already notice that Tomo along with Meloetta and Skwovet are not in their sleeping bags.

Mew calls out, "Tomo, where are you?! Tomo!"

"Pika pi!" (Meloetta!) Pikachu calls out.

Eevee calls out, "Eevee!" (Skwovet!)

Misty calls out, "Tomo! Meloetta!"

"Skwovet! Tomo!" Tracey calls out.

Smeargle, Stufful, Togepi and Pichu look around as well.

Mew calls out, "Tomo! Where are you?! Tomo!"

Then grows concern, "Where could Tomo be?! Where could he have disappeared to?!"

"I'm not sure. He was sleeping last night," Misty says.

"Meloetta and Skwovet are gone too," Tracey says.

"Still, it's not like Tomo to disappear like that," Misty says.

"Maybe Tomo ran off into the forest" Tracey suggests.

"Maybe he did. We should go look," Mew says.

The others nod their heads in reply, and head off into the forest to go look for Tomo and the Pokemon.

Meanwhile, Tomo is still unconscious, unaware that he has bandages wrapped around his head, made of leaves. Tomo then slowly begins to wake up from his unconsciousness. His vision slowly clears from the blur to see that he seems to be inside somewhere. Then suddenly two figures appear, looming over him.

"What…? Who…?" Tomo softly says, confused.

One of the female voices asks, "Are you okay?"

Tomo's vision soon clears to see two girls looming over him.

The first one is a long red haired girl with tan skin and turquoise eyes. From the looks of her age, she seems to be a teenager. She is also wearing a long brown fur prehistoric dress with a rope tied around her waist.

The second girl seems to be a year younger than Tomo. She has short light blue hair, light tan skin, and has turquoise eyes as well. Tomo notices that the young girl is wearing a similar attire from the outfit he has worn during his life in the Pokemon Preservation Zone.

Tomo sits up and says, "I… I think so."

Tomo rubs his eyes and looks to notice the two girls who are sitting down.

"Who… who are you?" Tomo asks, surprised.

"Hello. My name is Kate," The red haired girl says.

The blue haired girl giggles and says, "And I'm Jen, her younger sister. It's nice to meet you."

"It's uh, nice to meet you too. I'm Tomo," Tomo says.

Then look around, "Where's Melotta and Skwovet?"

"They're playing with Amaura outside of the cave," Jen says.

"Amaura?" Tomo says, confused as he stands up.

"She's my friend," Jen happily says.

The three then walk out of the room which is actually a cave. Tomo looks to see Meloetta and Skwovet playing with another Pokemon that is Amaura. Amaura is a quadrupedal, dinosaurian Pokémon that resembles a sauropod. It is light blue with a white underbelly. It has a long neck, a short, stubby tail, and a single white claw on each hind foot. Above each of its large, deep blue eyes is an iridescent, sail-like structure. The sails are yellow at the bottom and fade into pink toward the tips. On each side of its body is a dark blue crystal.

"Wow. She's kind of cute," Tomo says.

"Thanks," Tomo says.

Just then, Amaura walks over to Tomo and looks at him with curious eyes.

She then happily says, "Amaur." (Hello.)

"Hello. It's nice to meet you. I'm Tomo," Tomo happily says.

"Amaura Amaura," (I'm Amaura.) The Pokemon happily says.

"It's nice to meet you Amara," Tomo says.

Surprised, Kate asks, "You can understand her?"

"Yeah. I can. So is my big sister," Tomo says.

"Do you mean, those people we saw the other day?" Jen asks.

"Yeah," Tomo says.

But soon realizes, "Oh yeah. They don't know I was even out here. I fell and must have gotten knocked out."

"You actually did. Jen and I found you and you seem to be a lot better now," Kate says.

"Maybe you stay with us for a while, I'm sure the others will find you here in no time," Jen says.

Tomo thinks for a bit and says, "Sure. I don't mind staying here for a while."

"Yay!" Jen happily says.

Meanwhile, Mew and the others are still walking down the forest in search for Tomo and his Pokemon.

Mew calls out, "Tomo!"

"Pika Pika!" (Meloetta!) Pikachu calls out.

Eevee calls out, "Eevee!" (Skwovet!)

"Where are you, Tomo!" Misty calls out.

"Tomo!" Tracey calls out.

"Smeargle!" (Where are you?!) Smeargle calls out.

"Stuff Stuff Stufful! (Come out, come out, wherever you are!) Stufful calls out.

"Where could those three have disappeared to?" Misty wonders.

"I don't know, but it's strange how we haven't heard him after we call," Mew says.

"I hope that he's alright. Meloetta and Skwovet too," Tracey says.

"I'm sure we'll find them. We just need to keep looking," Mew says.

Mew and the others soon walk through the bushes. When they push past the bushes, the group stops and are surprised at what they're seeing. What they see are large amounts of Pokemon all around, but not just any Pokemon. They're prehistoric Pokemon. Pokemon that were thought to be extinct millions of years ago.

There are Omanyte and Omastar swimming in a small lake. Kabuto and Kabutops are walking around. There are so many different prehistoric Pokemon.

"Wow! There are so many different prehistoric Pokemon here!" Tracey says, amazed.

"And there are other different Pokemon from other regions as well," Mew says.

"And they look so happy living here," Misty says.

"Yeah. The island has everything the Prehistoric Pokemon needs," Tracey says.

Suddenly, something falls on Tracey's head, while something lands on Mew's shoulder.

Mew looks to see the Pokemon, a small, bipedal Pokémon with mixed reptilian and avian traits. Its large, red head is covered in discernible scales, and its neck has blue and red feathers. Its body is covered in untidy, sallow feathers, and it has blue, clawed wings. It has short, thin legs, and a twig-like tail that bears a diamond-shaped blue feather. It has wide white eyes with black pupils and no irises.

Misty surprisingly says, "Tracey, you have a Kabuto on your head."

Tracey picks up the Pokemon and looks at it.

"Uh hello, Kabuto," Tracey says, uneasy.

Kabuto makes clicking sounds.

Mew says, "He says, nice catch. I slip off the tree and land on your head."

"Um thanks," Tracey says with a calm smile.

"But what's that on your shoulder, Mew?" Misty asks.

"Hmm, I think I've read about this one. It's an Archen," Mew says.

She brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Archen, the First Bird Pokemon. A Rock and Flying Type. It is the ancestor of all bird Pokémon. Archen itself could not actually fly but moved by hopping from treetop to treetop."

"Wow. So this is the first of Flying Type Pokemon. Even if it can't fly," Misty says.

Suddenly, Misty feels something crawling on her leg, sending shivers. She looks down in fright, but stops to see that it's another Pokemon, a greenish-gray, arthropod Pokémon that resembles an anomalocaris. A stalk extends from either side of its head, with large, spherical eyes at the tips. The middle of its head is black with two red, teardrop-shaped markings, and an x-shaped mouth is visible on the underside of its torso. Beneath its head are two large, segmented claws that serve as weapons and are used to capture prey. On each side of its body are four white appendages with red tips.

"What's that?" Misty asks.

"That's an Anorith. Another prehistoric Pokemon," Tracey says.

Mew points to her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Anorith, the Old Shrimp Pokemon. A Rock and Bug Type. It is a kind of Pokémon progenitor. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor."

"I'm guessing the Pokemon are here to greet us," Misty says.

"They probably don't see many humans. I figure they'll be nervous around us," Tracey says.

"Maybe they're just curious," Misty says.

Then Mew says," Still, we need to find Tomo and the others."

Tracey and Musty nod their heads in agreement.

Then Mew turns to the Pokemon, "You three want to come with us?

Archen, Anorith, and Kabuto reply with a yes. The group then continues to search for Tomo and his Pokemon.

Meanwhile, Meloetta, Skwovet, and Amaura continue to play together. This time Tyrunt is in the group as they play together. Along with another Pokemon who decides to join the group.

This Pokemon is a gray, dinosaur-like Pokémon resembling the Pachycephalosaurus. It has a hooked beak, red irises, and a hard, blue, dome-shaped head with four spikes on its back. It has stubby arms with three claws; despite the stubbiness, it can attack with them. The back half of its body has a large, spiky pattern of blue and it has a short tail. It has feet with three forward claws and one backward.

Kate, Jen, and Tomo, who is now wearing his old wild attire, run over and they begin to play a game together.

Tomo then jumps and swings on the vines with excitement. Kate and Jen swing on the vines as well. Meloetta and the other Pokemon follow after them as they play.

Tomo shouts, "Kanga Kangaskhan!" as he swings on the vine.

Jen laughs and says, "You're fun Tomo!"

"Thanks!" Tomo happily says.

He then shouts, "KANGAAAAAAA!"

Meanwhile, Mew and the others are looking around the forest of Prehistoric Pokemon.

Misty sighs and says, "We've been searching for a while now."

"Yeah. And we haven't seen Tomo, Meloetta, or Skwovet," Tracey says.

Suddenly, they hear a loud sound, "KANGAAAAAA!"

"Did you guys hear that?" Tracey asks.

And then, they hear a loud sound, "Kanga Kangaskhan!"

"And it's very familiar," Misty says.

"KANGAAAA!" The voice shouts

Soon, Mew relaizesa, "I recognize that yell. It's Tomo."

Misty soon realizes, "You're right. It's Tomo's Kangaskhan yell."

"I remember you telling me that Tomo shouts Kangaskhan, but it's amazing to hear the real thing," Tracey says.

"If we hear that yell, then it means that Tomo must be nearby," Mew says.

"Let's go," Tracey says.

With that, the group follows the yelling to find Tomo, Meloetta, and Skwovet.

Meanwhile, Tomo along with Kate, Jen, and the Pokemon are playing a game of tag as they run across the field and having fun.

Suddenly, Tomo hears someone calling out, "Tomo!"

Tomo stops running and turns his head to hear another voice calling out, "Tomo!"

"Meloetta! Skwovet!" A third voice calls out.

The others stop to hear the voices as was.

"What was that?" Jen asks.

"Who is more like it? That's Mew and the others," Tomo says.

He then calls out, "Mew! Misty! Tracey!"

Then hears Mew's voice, "Tomo!"

"Mew!" Tomo calls out.

Soon walking to the top of the hill are Mew, Misty, Tracey, and the Pokemon group.

Mew sees Tomo and calls out, "Tomo!"

"Hi guys!" Tomo calls out and waves.

Mew and the others walk down the hill to see Tomo.

"Tomo, we finally found you," Misty says, relieved.

"We were worried about you," Mew says.

"Sorry guys, but I heard something and I ended up hitting my head when I fell, and I met these girls…" Tomo says, and turns to the two girls.

Mew and the others become surprised to see the two girls before them.

Sometime later, everyone is now at Kate and Jen's cave as they are having berries, fruits, and vegetables for lunch. Even the Pokemon are having lunch. There are also many prehistoric Pokemon looking down to see the group. Some are also eating, sleeping, and such.

"Oh so you're traveling around the Orange Island to compete in the Orange League," Kate replies to Mew.

"That's right. I've already won three badges and just need to get one more," Mew says.

"That's great. And I'm amazed that you and Tomo can understand Pokemon," Jen says, excitedly.

"I'm glad you think so. However, I still don't fully understand how or why I have it. I just do," Mew says.

"The same goes for me, but we just accept it," Tomo says.

"True, but I still like to learn about it," Mew says.

"That's good," Kate says.

"So how long have you and your sister known about the island?" Tracey asks.

"We've known about this place for around over two years," Jen happily answers.

"That's right. A few years ago, Jen and I were on a ship with our family, but we fell overboard during a storm. We were able to drift towards the island and the Pokemon were able to take care of us," Kate explains.

Then Jen hugs Amaura, "Especially Amaura."

"Maur!" (That's right.) Amaura happily says.

"She's been very nice to us and was able to find food and drinks for us. Kate said that the Pokemon are prehistoric and this island is full of them. All the Pokemon were all very nice to us," Jen adds.

"She's very sweet, and an adorable Pokemon," Misty says.

"I've never seen an Amaura before," Mew says and brings out her Pokedex.

Dexter says, "Amaura, the Tundra Pokemon. A Rock and Ice Type. It lived in cold areas in ancient times. It's said that when Amaura whinnies, auroras appear in the night sky."

"Yes. Amaura and the other Pokemon have been good with us, and we lived here happily. A few days later, A rescue boat found the island and we were found right away. Officer Jenny and our parents were able to figure out where we drifted to and we were able to go home. However, we make time to come here once in a while during our travels and we play with our Pokemon friends. also promise to keep the prehistoric Pokemon a secret and this will become our special place," Kate says.

"Yeah. Our parents let us visit the island anytime we want and agree to help make sure the island is a nature preserve. That way the Pokemon who are living here can be protected and no home will try to kidnap them or bother them," Jen says.

"That's a good choice. We saw how happy the prehistoric Pokemon are living on the island. It will be bad if someone comes to the island to capture them or bother them," Tracey says.

"I agree. It will be terrible if someone attacks the island to take the Pokemon away," Mew says.

"So then, what do you plan on doing?" Misty asks.

"Well. I'm planning on being a gym leader. I'll be testing survival skills in the way of cave people with prehistoric Pokemon as their companions. I'll be battling with some of my friends here," Kate says.

"Will it be okay for them?" Mew asks.

"Well, It's still under development, so I want to make my gym so it won't be near the prehistoric Pokemon. Officer Jenny plans to help make this a Nature Preserve so capturing them won't be allowed," Kate says.

Suddenly, someone says, "Then it's a good idea we decide to come here now."

Everyone becomes shocked to hear the voice. Then they hear a loud sound coming towards them. Just then, a large car or a jeep comes driving past the trees and now in front of the group as they exclaim in fright.

"What in the world?!" Misty exclaims.

"Who are you?!" Mew asks, shocked.

Cassidy:

Prepare for trouble…

Butch:

...and make it double!

Both:

Here's our mission, so you better listen!

Coming out of the jeep and on the hood are Cassidy and Butch from Team Rocket.

Cassidy:

To infect the world with devastation!

Butch:

To blight all people in every nation!

Cassidy:

To denounce the goodness of truth and love!

Butch:

To extend our wrath to the stars above!

Cassidy:

Cassidy!

Butch:

And Butch, of course!

Cassidy:

We're Team Rocket, circling Earth all day and night!

Butch:

Surrender to us now or you will surely lose the fight!

"It's Team Rocket again!" Tomo says, shocked.

"Cassidy!" Misty says.

"And Butch!" Tracey adds.

Then Kate asks, "Do you know them?"

"They're a group of bad guys who always try to steal Pokemon from other trainers and use them against their will," Mew angrily says.

Then Misty confronts Team Rocket, "I'll bet you're here to steal the Pokemon here."

"What do you think?" Cassidy questions.

"We came here to see if there's Pokemon worth taking, but to our surprise to find so many prehistoric Pokemon," Butch says.

Then Cassidy says, "It's just too tempting to pass up. So we'll be taking these Pokemon off your hands."

"No way!" Tomo denies.

"That's right. These Pokemon are our friends," Jen says.

"Amaura!" (That's right!) Amaura says.

"Sorry kiddies, but we'll be collecting those prehistoric Pokemon," Cassidy says.

"And our new jeep will take care of the job," Butch says.

They both climb inside the jeep as the hatch on top opens and some kind of cannon up.

Cassidy says, "Alright, aim…."

"And fire," Butch says.

With that, the cannon fires and a strange disk comes flying at them. One of the Kabuto tries to escape, but the disk opens to reveal some metal cure bars and trap them in a cage. The group gasps in shock.

"Let's go!" Mew panics.

And with that, everyone begins to run on their feet and make a run for it including the Pokemon run away in a panic.

"Looks like we got a few runaways," Butch says.

"Let's go after them," Cassidy says.

Cassidy and Butch drive the large jeep to chase the others. The group of friends including the Pokemon run through the forest as fast as they can. Soon, they get out of the forest and soon find themselves in a large open field with a large lake close by. The jeep continues to chase after them.

"They're gaining on us!" Misty panics.

"Maybe if we split up!" Kate calls out.

With that, everyone split off in different directions to avoid capture.

In the jeep, Cassidy and Butch continues to drive it, and on the monitor, it's seems to be pointing towards Amaura.

"Alright Butch, get ready for another catch," Cassidy says.

"You got it," Butch says.

Butch then presses the button and fires the cannon again. This one, ends up flying towards Amaura.

Jen gasps to see this and rushes over, "Amaura!"

Jen is able to reach Amaura, but the round cage ends up catching them both. The cage ends up rolling down the hill and towards the lake with the two trapped inside.

Tomo and his Pokemon turn in shock to see Jen and Amaura are trapped and rolling towards the lake.

Tomo gapss and cries out, "Jen! Amaura!"

Tomo chases after the cage with his friends inside. Meloetta, Skwovet, and Tyrunt chase after them as well. The cage rolls so fast that it ends up flying a bit and splashes into the water, and soon the cage sinks with the two trapped inside.

Tomo turns to Meloetta and Skwovet, "Meloetta, Skwovet, go tell Me what happened. Tyrunt and I will get Jen and Amura."

Without answering, Meloetta and Skwovet rush off to get Mew and the others while Tomo and Tyrunt rush to rescue Jen and Amaura.

Tomo quickly brings out his Pokeball and calls out, "Spheal, I choose you!"

Spheal comes out of the Pokeball and into the water. Tomo and Tyrunt then dive down into the water.

Tomo swims to Spheal and says, "Spheal, we need to save our friends who are in the cage."

Spheal nods his head and all three dive into the water to save the girls.

Meanwhile, Mew turns to Pikachu and Eevee, "Pikachu! Eevee! Use Thunderbolt!"

Pikachu and Eevee quickly turn around and perform Thunderbolt, but nothing seems to work.

"No way!" Mew exclaims in shock.

Cassidy laughs and says, "Sorry kid, but this is electric proof."

"Not even your Pokemon can zap this," Butch says.

Then Archen rushes over and cries out.

Misty and Tracey's Pokemon perform their attacks and strike at the Jeep with full force, knocking it down, and making the jeep fall to the side.

Just then, Meloetta and Skwovet rush over.

"Melo Melo Meloetta Meloet Meloet Meloetta!" (Jen and Amaura got caught and they fell in the lake!) Meloetta cries out.

Then Skwovet says, "Skwov Skwov Skwovwet!" (Tomo and Tyrunt dive in the lake to save them!)

Kate and some of the prehistoric Pokemon rush over to check on them.

"Jen and Amaura are in trouble, and Tomo and Tyrant rush into the lake to save them.

"You won't be leaving so easily," Cassidy says.

Tomo takes out his Pokeball and calls back Tyrunt. Jen and Amara swim and Tomo takes them in their arms. Then swims them to Spheal. The group begins to swim to the surface. But suddenly, Jen and Amaura begin to lose air. Tomo turns to see Jen and Amara about to lose air, and grab on to them, and try to get themselves to the surface with Spheal. Spheal struggles to get them to the surface, and soon, Tomo begins to lose air as well and struggle to hang on. Struggling to keep up, Tomo, Jen, and Amaura lost their break and lost consciousness. Spheal sees his trainer and friends in trouble, and swims down to save them.

Determined to save them, Spheal soon begins to glow and its form begins to change. It can only mean, Spheal is starting to evolve. Spheal glows as it grows to a large size. It swims to Tomo and the others and picks them up on its back. Then carries them all to the surface.

Back on the surface, Mew and the others are having a battle with Cassidy and Butch.

Houndour performs Flamethrower and it's heading towards Pikachu.

The Pokemon is a bright-blue, pinniped Pokémon. Its throat and chest are beige with speckling around the edges. There are two short tusks protruding from its upper jaw, and it has dark brown, oval eyes. It has a powerful pair of front flippers, which are able to crush ice. Additionally, it has a short, flipper-like tail. On the sides of its blunt muzzle are thick, white whiskers.

Before anyone can react, the Pokemon performs Powder Snow and freezes all of Cassidy and Butch's Pokemon in their tracks, making the Team Rocket members shocked.

"Don't worry, we'll see them again someday," Mew says.

Jen then asks, "So can I join you?"

"Yeah," Tracey says.

Jen and Amaura smile happily.

Then Meowth leaps into the balloon as it lifts off.

Meowth laughs and says, "We've still got one more little surprise tucked away in our basket!"

From the bottom of the balloon basket, a cannon appears.

"I can take care of that! Go, Staryu!" Misty says, and calls out her Pokeball.

However, the Pokemon to come out is Psyduck, making the group become surprised by Misty's blunder.

"That's Psyduck!" Misty panics.

Then says, "Okay, Psyduck, send Team Rocket flying with a Confusion attack!"

However, Psyduck doesn't do anything. Then the cannon powers for an attack.

Misty panics, "Hurry!"

James holds the targeting device, "Get ready to fire."

The cannon has nearly enough power to fire.

Mew quickly turns to Misty, "Misty, maybe Togpei can help."

"Okay!" Misty says.

Then lifts Togpei out, "Togpei, use Metronome!"

And with that, Togepi moves his little arms, and the attack destroys the balloon and sends Team Rocket flying.

"We're blasting off again!" Team Rocket screams as he flies off.

"Now that's an attack," Tomo comments.

"Go Togepi," Jen says.

Misty giggles and says, "You did a good job."

Togepi is happy to see his mommy happy.

Mew kneels to Pikachu and Eevee, "Eevee, Pikachu. I'm so glad you're back."

Pikachu and Eevee happily cheer, "Pika Pi!/ Eevee Eev! (Mew!)

And the trainer and Pokemon embrace each other with glee.

"It's great to see those three back together again. Isn't it, Tracey?" Misty says.

"Yeah," Tracey says.

"It's very sweet," Jen says.

And so, Mew, Piakchu, and Eevee are reunited. They are glad to be together again.

Meanwhile, on the other part of the Island. They're both still a bit bruised from being blasted off.

"I am simply famished," Jessie says.

"Not me. I'm just hungry," James says.

Soon, Meowth spots an apple in the tree, "Hey, look up there!"

Jessie and James look up.

"An apple!" James says.

"Oh, baby!" Meowth happily says.

But James kicks him away from it, "Paws off!"

Then Jessie pushes James' head into the ground with her foot.

"We all have to share this apple! I'll go first," Jessie says, and takes the apple.

Then she begins to eat it.

"Maybe they never should've found me," Meowth says to himself.

Jessie drops the apple core on Meowth's head, "Ow."

He sighs and says, "I'm starting to kinda miss Pikachu and Eevee."

Chapter 32: Pokemon Movie 2000: The Power of One Part 1

Somewhere in the Orange Islands, there are three different islands, across from the three islands, there is a large shrine facing them. The shrine has large pillars circling around a small shrine in the center. Standing in front of it, is a creature that looks like a Pokemon looking over the horizon of the island. The Island also has beautiful red flowers.

Just then, the voice says, "Disturb not the Harmony of Fire, Ice, or Lightning, lest these titans wreak destruction upon the world in which they clash. Though the water's great guardian shall arise to quell the fighting, alone its song will fail, lest the earth shall turn to a child whom greeted Mew. Oh, chosen one, into thine hands bring together all three, their treasures combined tame the beast of the sea."

Then, somewhere else, a man reading an ancient stone tablet that is in a glass capsule

The man then says, "Now it, begins."

Suddenly, a beeping sound draws the man's attention.

A female computer voice says, "Analysis indicates that the titan of fire referred to in the ancient inscription is the legendary Pokémon, Moltres. Believed to have originated in a remote region of the Orange Islands."

Then behind the man, the computer makes a holographic image of the Pokemon, Moltres.

The computer continues, "The titan of lightning is the Pokémon, Zapdos."

Then makes another Pokemon image appear. A large, avian Pokémon with predominantly yellow plumage. It has small, triangular eyes with black around them and a long, thin, light orange beak. Its wings and tail are a mass of spiky feathers and there are black feathers covering the back of its wings and inner tail feathers. A large crest of spiked feathers surrounds its head. Its thighs are tan, and it has thin, light orange legs. It has feet with three forward-facing toes and one backward-facing toe; each toe has a short talon.

Then shows the last one, "And Articuno is the titan of ice."

A large avian Pokémon with predominantly sky blue plumage and wings said to be made of ice. On its forehead is a crest that consists of three, darker blue rhombus-shaped feathers. It has circular red eyes, a short gray beak, and long, thin gray legs. Each foot has three forward-facing toes and one that faces backward. On its chest is a mass of pale blue, downy feathers. Its long, streamer-like tail is longer than its body and the same shade of blue as its crest.

The computer continues, "Historical documents confirm that the three legendary Pokémon are unique species found only in the vicinity of Shamouti Island."

The man walks over to his seat in his chair and says, "Moltres, Zapdos, and Articuno. Any one of them would be a priceless edition to my collection."

The man in question has violet color eyes, mantis hair, and wears purple and light purple color outfit with black shoes.

Soon, he has the virtual map of the Orange Islands on the screen. Then zooms in on the four islands.

Then says, "But together, they are the three keys that unlock, the ultimate treasure."

Soon the computer says, "Pokémon matching subject parameters Moltres, Articuno, Zapdos, detected."

"Then let's get started," The man says.

The chair the man is sitting in rises towards a hole in the ceiling to a different part of the building.

The man asks, "Which one is nearest?"

"The fire Pokémon, Moltres," The computer answers.

"Good," The man replies.

Soon, the chair stops in some kind of command area, revealing large windows of him piloting a large airship right over Shamouti Island, and the three Island of the legendary birds dwell. He soon has his airship fly to Fire island where Moltres lives.

Then cannons come out from under the airship and fire one of the islands, making it turn to ice. The cannon continues to fire and soon, blast and freezes a cave entrance. Suddenly, it begins to glow of fire inside the cave, and soon begins to melt. With that, fire bursts through the cave wall, and Moltres flies out of it. Moltres lets out a cry as it flies out and towards the airship.

"Now the chase," The man says with a snap of his fingers, "Is on."

Soon, cannons fire at Moltres, but Moltres uses its fire to deflect the attack. Just then, a compartment opens from under the ship to send in strange ring devices. Moltres uses its flying power to deflect and advise the strange devices. Moltres tries as hard as it can, but to no avail. The device soon captures Moltres, and it's causing it pain. Moltres tries to fight, but is unable to break free. Soon, Moltres is brought into the airship against its will and the hatch closes.

Seeing the Pokemon capture, the man says, "Well, I've taken the first piece without too much difficulty. It's like a simple game of chess. Next, I'll capture Zapdos, and Articuno soon after. And that will flush out the king. And then, that's when the game's going to get interesting. Bring together all three, their treasures combined tame the beast of the sea. Lugia."

Under the ocean, there is a loud cry, and soon, a large Pokemon swimming/flying through the water.

Sometime later, somewhere in the calm seas and sailing through the Orange Island, Mew and her friends meet up with a sailor named. Maren, who agrees to take them to the next island on their journey. However, Pkachu, Eevee, Meleotta, Skwovet, and Amaura sense something amiss. Almost like something's wrong. Mew turns to see the Pokemon look out into the ocean, and can sense that something doesn't seem right.

Her thoughts are interrupted when Tomo looks around and happily says, "Nice day."

"It's beautiful! Right, Togepi? Pichu?" Misty asks.

"Togepriii!" (Beautiful) Togepi happily says.

"Pichu!" (Very beautiful!) Pichu happily says.

"Yeah. It looks great," Tomo says.

"And it's really nice outside," Jen replies.

Tracey walks up to Mew and asks, "Hey, Mew, think we have time to give the Pokémon a little fresh air?"

"Sure, Tracey," The voice says.

The group looks up to see Maren, the captain of the boat. She is wearing an orange and blue shirt with orange pants, with dark blue boots, and a black hap. She has green hair, and red eyes.

Maren says, "It'll take us about an hour to get to the next island. There's plenty of time."

"Well, what are we waiting for?!" Mew happily says, and throws her Pokeball into the air.

Song:

I wanna take the ultimate step

Find the courage to be bold (yeah!)

Soon, the first one to come out of Mew's Pokeball is Lapras.

The lessons that I hold

Mew and Tomo throw a few of their Pokeballs in the air. Mew releases Squirtle, Bulbasaur, Dratini, Wooloo, Shiny Eevee, and Emolga.

Tracey then climbs up the ladder and rushes to the driver seat.

Mew then lets out Charizard, Pidgeot, Wartortle, and Shaymin. Squirtle and Wartle dives into the water while Charizard and Pidgeot take to the air.

Soon, the Pokemon are having a good time either relaxing on the boat, flying in the air, or swimming in the water.

(Master of them all)

Unknown to Mew and her friends, they are being followed as a periscope peeks out of the water.

We all live in a Pokémon world

Put myself to the test to be better than all the rest

Better than all the rest!

Down under the water is a Magikarp submarine, and the ones piloting it are Team Rocket.
