We all live in a Pokémon world

(Pokémon world)

I wanna be the greatest master of them all

(Master of them all)

We all live in a Pokémon world

As of now, Mew, the others, and the Pokemon are relaxing on the boat. Suddenly, Maren, along with Mew, notice something up ahead. What they see is a large blanket of storm clouds begin rolling in. Pikachu, Eevee, and the other Pokemon sense it. Suddenly, large waves begin to rock the boat. Togepi and Pichu nearly fall overboard if Misty hasn't caught them. Tracey, Tomo, and the others do their best to support each other in the boat. Tyrunt also helps Tomo along with Jen and Amaura. The waves begin to carry the boat off its course. Lapras and the other Pokemon quickly follow them.

Even Team Rocket are having trouble driving their submarine as Magikarp swings alongside them.

Back on the surface, Mew and the others quickly call back their Pokemon into their Pokeballs, and help others climb onto the boat. The boat continues to rock them, and is carrying them away from their destination. Even the Magikarp group are sweeping Team Rocket behind the boat. Soon, the boats stop rocking.

In the different locations, there seems to be crying, along with singing. Back on the surface, the waves suddenly begin to slow down. However, Pikachu, Eevee, and the Pokemon who remain out of their Pokeball, can sense something is wrong. Just then, Mew begins to hear the strange sound, causing her to look out at sea.

Mew softly asks herself, "What… What was that? A voice?"

Suddenly, she hears Maren say, "We're way off course."

Mew and the others look at Maren, to notice the island.

"That's Shamouti. We're right in the middle of the Orange Islands," Maren says.

Soon, Mew and her friends find the current carrying them to the island. Unknown to them, Team Rocket is still being carried by the Magikarp school. They soon regai themselves from their sudden drift.

Jessie notices, "An island!"

"In a storm!" James says.

"I've seen this movie," Meowth says, feeling a little sick.

Soon, Jessie notices they're heading towards some rocks where a lighthouse is standing.

Jessie feels uneasy and asks, "Do we have, karp insurance?"

James and Meowth soon realize that something is wrong.

"We're about to be…" Jessie says, nervously.

Then Meowth says, "Filet of fish?"

As Mew and her friends continue to get closer to the island, Team Rocket's submarine crashes into the rocks, and then their sub explodes, and the school of Magikarp swims on.

Meanwhile, in Pallet Town, many of the Pidgey and their evolved forms Pidgeotto, Pidgeot, Spearow, and Fearow are flying away. At her home, Adriana is working in the garden as Mr. Mime sweeps.

Soon, Professor Oak rides up on his bike. "Good morning, Adriana! Well, you certainly do have a green thumb.

"Thanks, dad. But the truth is, I've been getting a lot of help with my garden, lately. The weather's been just beautiful!" Adriana says.

"Well, this is the time of year when the sun shines every day," Professor Oak says.

Suddenly, the wind begins to pick up, and they look up to see a storm coming. Mr. Mime then hurries inside and gets the umbrella. But soon, the storm begins to pick up. Mimey is able to come back with the umbrella and quickly covers for Adriana, but Professor Oak is soaked. And then suddenly, the rain quickly stops.

"Say, that was awfully strange," Professor Oak says.

"And it passed by so quickly," Adriana says.

Soon, snow begins to fall from the sky.

Adriana is amazed, "Oh my! It looks like snow!"

But they soon realize the stuff really is snow.

Adriana says, confused, "It, is snow. But, this is summer. How can it snow?"

"I… I don't know," Professor Oak answers, just as confused.

Soon, Mimey sees something in the sky, which shocks him. Professor Oak and Adriana look up to see an aurora borealis, the Northern Lights into the sky. Soon, multiple flocks of flying Pokemon, including Pidgey, are flying overhead. And in the matter of minutes, the storm stops and the sky clears again. Soon, Mimey senses something and looks behind. There, they see a swarm of Diglet stampeding this way. It almost carries off Professor Oak, but he quickly jumps on to the fence as he watches his bike being carried away by the Diglet. Soon, Mimey begins to panic.

Adriana turns to Mimey and asks, "What is it, Mimey?"

Then turns to the professor, "Mr. Mime is very upset."

"Yes. And so are the other Pokémon," Professor Oak answers.

Suddenly, Zeraroa rushes over to them as fast as he can. Then stops in front of Professor Oak, Adriana and Mr. Mime.

"Zeraora, what a surprise. I'm guessing you're worried about this as well," Professor Oak says.

Zeraora nods his head in reply.

Then Professor Oak says to Adriana, "Pokémon are more in tune with nature than we are. When something goes wrong, they can sense it. And I'm afraid something somewhere is going terribly wrong."

Meanwhile, at the Orange Island, Mew and her friends come ashore on Shamouti. As they climb off ship, Mew looks up to the sky and notices that Pikachu and Eevee are doing the same.

"We sure are lucky," Tomo says.

"Yeah. the storm was really rough," Jen says.

"If we hadn't found this place, we'd be in real trouble," Misty happily says.

Suddenly, Tracey notices something off and grows nervous.

Mew notices it, "What's up Tracey?

Still nervous, Tracey answers, "I think we still might be."

Mew and the others turn and freak out to see a group of islander wearing masks and holding different items, approach them. They all stare at Mew and her friends as the group is petrified.

Suddenly, one of them calls out, "Maren! How are you?"

That catches the group off guard. The islander removes the mask to reveal a girl with dark brown hair and green eyes.

The girl says, "It's been a while."

"Carol, I can't believe it! It's great to see you," Maren happily says.

"What are you doing back on Shamouti Island?" The Islander, Carol says.

"We got caught up in that storm and floated in, and it looks like we got here at the perfect time," Maren says.

"You're right. The annual Legend Festival starts today," Carol happily says.

"It's my favorite island holiday!" Maren happily says.

Then asks, "Are you going to be the star of the show again?" and moves her fingers like she's playing a flute.

"No, I'm too old to be the Festival Maiden anymore. This year, my little sister will take over for me. Wonder where she could…" Carol says.

But soon hears someone say, "I'm right here!"

Everyone looks up to see Carol's little sister, but she seems to dress differently, and has long brown hair. Jeans, sandals, a pink and black tank top, sunglasses, and a green hat. She is also carrying an orange purse.

"The only one not wearing some stupid costume. You'd think after a few centuries, you'd have outgrown this dorky ritual," the girl says.

Carol sternly says, "It's our tradition! You should be honored to take part!"

"Don't worry, I'll play my role in the big legend. I've only seen you do it, like, a zillion times," The sister says, not really giving a care.

"Just be there!" Carol says.

Then says, "Unfortunately, that's my little sister. Her name is Melody, but don't get fooled. She's not always this adorable."

Then Carol notices the group, "Who are they?"

"Hi my name is Misty," Misty says.

"I'm Tracey," Tracey says.

"Tomo," Tomo says.

"I'm Jen," Jen replies.

"And I'm Mew," Mew says.

Then Maren says, "And Mew is a Pokemon trainer and winner of the Pokemon Indigo League."

"Pokémon trainer?!" Carol and the crowd are surprised.

Soon, the crowd begins to celebrate, and that catches Melody's attention.

Just then, one of the men approaches Mew and says, "The ancient legend foretells your arrival. And only with you can the guardian of the waters vanquish the great titans of fire, ice, and lightning!"

Then remove the mask to reveal a slightly tan man elderly man, with an ivory mustache and hair, "In your hands, oh, chosen one. In your hands rests the world and its fate."

"It does?" Mew says, confused.

"Don't let it worry you, kid. It's just for the tourists," The older man says.

Just then, Melody walks over and asks, "So, you're a Pokémon trainer, huh?"

"Um yeah," Mew says.

"I guess she'll do," Melody says, removing her sunglasses.

Then spots Misty and asks, "Are you her little sister?"

"I am not!" Misty says.

Then notices Tracey and asks, "And is he your boyfriend?"

"Bleh! Gross!" Misty says in disgust.

"Oh, I don't think so." Melody teases.

Then turns to Mew, "I'll be glad to play for her tonight at the Legend Banquet. Starts around eight," and puts on her sunglasses.

Then turns to Misty, "Oh, and Misty, try not to get jealous."

Mew giggles a little bit to notice Misty annoyance.

Just then, the elder man announces, "We have found our chosen one!"

Soon, the islanders lead Mew and her friends to where the Legend Festival and Banquet are to be held. However, Mew, Pikachu, Eevee, and the other Pokemon are looking quite concerned. Just then, Mew hears the cry again, and looks out into the sea.

That very night, a festival is underway. There is a parade with a Gyarados puppet as people dance while holding the poles, making it dance as well. There are many people gathered as the natives dance around the totem pole. There is music, dancing, food, and all kinds of island traditions and celebrations.

In the banquet hall, Mew along with her friends are enjoying a big feast. Maren sits next to Carol and some of the natives, including the elder.

"And she says, 'No, but I have Krabbies!'" Maren says, and then Carol and the others begin laughing.

At one of the tables is where Mew and the others are sitting.

And Misty is still irritated by what Melody says, "It's ridiculous. Me, Tracey's girlfriend." Then takes a bite from her food. "It's totally ridiculous."

"Don't worry Misty, don't let Melody get to you," Mew says.

"I've never seen you this mad before," Jen replies.

Mew then says, "We have."

Then Tomo turns to Mew, "Hey Mew, what do you think your part in the legend ceremony gonna be?"

"I'm not sure. We'll have to wait and see what it is," Mew says.

Suddenly, someone begins to play music on a flute from a shell, catching everyone's attention. Mew and the others turn to the stage to see a familiar person on the stage wearing a maiden's outfit and playing on a shell flute. Mew becomes surprised to hear the song and the person playing it.

Tracey says, "Guys, that's her! The girl we met on the beach!"

"Melody," Misty says.

"Melody?" Tomo replies.

Everyone in the banquet hall watches as Melody performs the song and dance.

"She looks very pretty," Jen replies.

"She's a big showoff," Misty says, frustrated and annoyed.

Mew however is more captivated by the song than the dancer.

Then says in her thoughts, "That song. I've felt like I've heard it… just recently… but where…?"

Melody continues to perform the music on the flute, and concludes the song. Everyone applauded for the performance.

Then Melody rushes off the stage and towards Mew, "Hear ye all! From the trio of islands, ancient spheres shall you take. For between life and death, all the difference you'll make. Oh, chosen one, you must climb to the shrine to right what is wrong, and the world will be healed by the guardian's song."

"How do I do that, exactly?" Mew asks.

"Oh, it won't be very hard, Mew. Not for you. And besides, almost all the chosen ones come back alive," Melody says.

Carol scolds her, "Melody!"

Melody winks and chuckles.

"All you have to do is get these glass balls from three islands," Melody says.

Then takes out an orange, "One from Fire Island." and hands it to Mew.

Then hands her a lemon, "One from Ice Island."

And lastly a pear, "And one from Lightning Island."

And Melody gets out her flute, "And you bring them to the shrine back here."

She gets up and says, "And then, I celebrate by playing this song." She plays her flute a little more and says, "And then it's over, oh, chosen one."

"Oh, I see," Mew says.

Suddenly, Mew hears the strange voice again. Mew then turns to the sea and looks at the storm suddenly brewing.

Mew quickly gets up and says, "Okay! Get me a boat and I'm ready!"

But Melody says, "Oh, there's no hurry. You have all day tomorrow. Tonight's just for the party. Stay, have some fun."

"Well, some things are more important than fun. Besides, I can't help but feel that I need to do this," Mew says.

"Need to do this?" Misty says, confused.

"I'm not sure. It's a feeling. And this feeling is very strong. I feel that this is a responsibility that I need to do," Mew says.

Just then, Maren approaches Mew, "You know what? I like your attitude. We can take my boat, Mew."

"Then, let's go!" Mew says.

Then turns to the others, "You guys wanna come?"

"Well I wanna go," Tomo says.

Meloetta and Skwovet nod their heads in reply.

"Me too," Jen says.

Amaura answers, "Maura," (Me too.)

Mew turns to the others, "What about you guys?"

Suddenly, Pikachu takes Mew's cap and rushes off. Eevee, Meloetta, Skwovet, and Amaura rush along with them.

Mew calls out, "Pikachu! Eevee!"

"Skwovet! Meloetta! Where are you going?!" Tomo calls out.

"Amaura?" Jen replies, confused.

However, the four Pokemon aren't listening.

Pikachu turns to Mew and muffles, "Pika!" (Come on!)

Then Eevee says, "Eevee!" (Follow us!)

Mew rushes over with Tomo and Jen.

Mew turns to Tomo, "Pikachu and Eevee want us to follow!"

"Then let's go!" Tomo says.

"Before we lose them," Jen says.

With that, the two rush down the stairs after the Pokemon. Maren follows. Melody rushes over to see Mew, Tomo, Jen and Maren leave in a rush.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket is pedaling what's left of their submarine in the ocean.

"Our ship is ruined," Jessie says, tired.

"I'm sick of it!" James says.

"I'm seasick over it!" Meowth says, feeling sick.

Just then, Team Rocket notices Maren's boat speeding towards them with Mew, Tomo, Jen, and their Pokemon on board. Maren's boat speeds past them and knocks them into the sea. Then the three rise from the water and on to the sub.

James asks, "Wasn't that...?"

"The little twerp and twerpette? All alone?" Jessie replies.

"And Pikachu, Eevee, Meloetta, and Skwovet, too," Mewoth adds.

Team Rocket watches as the boat zooms out to sea. Soon, another storm begins and falls quickly, and Team Rocket are washed away by the waves.

Meanwhile, somewhere inside a cave, there is a creature watching the storm as it clashes.

Then the creature says, "Disturb not the harmony of fire, ice, and lightning."

The creature soon reveals to be a Pokemon known as a Slowking.

The Slowking is a bipedal Pokémon with a Shellder latched onto its head. It is primarily pink, with a pale yellow muzzle and scaled belly. Its feet and hands each have a single clawed digit, while the hands also have a clawless thumb. Around its neck is a spiny ruff with alternating red and white stripes. But then, they quickly get back up and continue to run as one of the propellers on the airship destroys a shrine close by and causes many of the group to fall to the ground. As Mew gets up, the yellow sphere lands right up to her.

Pikachu calls out, "Pika Pika!" (The yellow sphere!)

Mew looks at the lighting bolt within the sphere as Zapdos shows up.

Misty cries out, "Look out!"

Mew and the others retreat as fast as they can.

Meanwhile, under the frozen ocean, the giant underwater tornado raced to the surface. Above, Moltres and Articuno are battling each other. Then Zapdos swoops in and begins to battle. Down below, Team Rocket are already in the boat seeing the brawl.

Jessie says, "I'd hate to get burned by their fire!"

"I'd hate to get zapped by their lightning!" James adds.

Then Meowth says, "I'd hate to get hit by, their droppings!"

Soon enough, Mew and the others, including the Pokemon aboard the speedboat as Zapdos, open the water channel for their escape. However, the boat gets swept by the current and over a large waterfall and the speed boat begins to fall to the water. Just then, a water cyclone rises from the sea and stops the boat from falling, saving everyone. Then the cyclone begins to carry them. Then, a loud cry catches everyone's attention

Melody asks, "What's that sound?"

Mew gasps and recognizes "It's that sound I heard before.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket uncovers the life raft.

"Quick! We may need this!" Jessie says, then everyone climbs inside.

Team Rocket quickly brings out the lifeboat as the water cyclone takes everyone to Shamouti Shrine and drops them off the hard way. It sends them crashing on the shrine as it sends Team Rocket flying far over the shrine. Soon, the speedboat begins to fall over, so everyone is forced to abandon the speedboat. Luckily, everyone escapes in the nick of time, and reaches the shrine of Shamouti Shrine.

Soon, the group is greeted by Slowking.

The Slowking points to Mew and says, "Take the treasure," Then points to the shrine, and puts it there.

"You can talk?" Mew says, surprised.

Pikachu turns to Mew, "Pika Pika." (Get the spheres out.)

"Oh, right," Mew remembers and takes the two spheres.

Then Eevee says, "Eevee! (In the shrine!)

Then Pikachu and Eevee rush off. Mew follows after them.

Soon, Mew reaches the shrine that is covered in snow. She walks up the stairs to see the island where the sphere slots are.

"Fire Island," Mew then places the Fire sphere in place.

"Lightning Island," And places the Lightning Sphere in its place.

Then Mew looks to see the last island," And there's Ice Island."

Suddenly, Slowking speaks, "So, you're Mew?"

Mew quickly turns around to see Slowking in surprise.

"You're one treasure short," Slowking says.

"Yeah, I know, but," Mew says, but then asks, "How'd you know my name?"

Suddenly, the group hears the screeching and turns to see the legendary bird Pokemons battling over the frozen sea and causing a lot of destruction.

Having enough, Mew rushes over and shouts, "Cut it out! Stop this fighting right now!"

But the bird Pokemons ignore her and continue battling, until the cyclone that rescued them rises up once more and attacks the three birds. Everyone becomes astonished to see the figure coming out of the cyclone. Soon, the cyclone disappears to reveal an astonishing Pokemon.

It's a large Pokémon that resembles a dragon, a plesiosaur, and a bird. It is primarily silver-white, but it has blue undersides with slightly varying tones. It has a ridged mouth similar to a beak, although it has pointed teeth on its lower jaw. Its head has a point to the back, and Lugia's eyes have pointed blue or black spikes on them. It has a long, slender neck and a smooth, streamlined body. Dark blue or black plate-like protrusions run down the length of its back, and there are two smaller, more pointed ones on the end of its tail. It can fold back these plates to increase its speed. It has large wings that resemble hands.

Everyone is astonished to see the Pokemon before their eyes. This Pokemon is known as the Legendary Beast of the Sea, Lugia.

Chapter 34: Pokemon Movie 2000: The Power of One Part 3

Not long, Mew and the others reach Shamouti Island shrine, and meet Slowking. They also witness the battle between the three legendary birds, which is interpreted by a large Pokemon that lives in the sea.

"The great guardian! Lugia!" Slowking says, astonished.

"I can't believe it!" Melody says, shocked.

"Lugia," Mew replies, astonished.

"Pika!" (Lugia!) Pikachu replies.

Then Eevee, says, "Eevee!" (Lugia!)

Just then, Lugia lets out a call to the other legendary birds.

Melody recognizes the sound, "That sound!" and brings out her flute.

Mew then says to herself, "It… it's you…"

Meanwhile, far away from the shrine, Lawrence spots Lugia through his telescope.

Lawrence III says, "Finally, my prize. It's magnificent. The beast of the sea will soon belong, to me."

Soon, Zapdos, Articuno, and Moltres begin to attack Lugia, but dodges effortlessly. Lugia then folds down its back flaps and dives headfirst into the frozen sea. Then creates another cyclone that nearly strikes at the birds. Articuno then freezes the cyclone Lugia is in, but the beast is able to break free. Lugia continues to fly and dodge the attacks, but all three birds strike at Lugia at the same, but Lugia repels the attack and continues flying.

Seeing what is happening, Melody says, "Though the guardian of the sea shall arise to quell the fighting, alone its song will fail. Thus the earth shall turn to a child whom greeted Mew."

"This looks bad," Slowking says.

"You could say that again," Tomo replies.

The three legendary birds continue to attack Lugia until it strikes at Lugia with full force, and causes it to fall into the sea. Then the three seal the hole made from the empact. Then the three legendary birds resume their battle.

Up in the air, the news chopper approaches Shamouti Island.

Adriana notices them, "What are Mew and her friends doing out in this terrible weather? I'm worried about them."

"Save a little worry for us!" Professor Oak says in a panic.

"The fate of our planet is what we should really be worried about. And the Pokémon know that better than any of us," Professor Ivy says.

Meanwhile, somewhere in the frozen sea, a Gyarados performs Hyper Beam as it leads the Pokemon of the sea forward to Shamouti Island. Since the water is frozen, all the Pokemon of the land are able to cross the ocean and approach the island. The flying Pokemon also approach the island as well. Soon, all the Pokemon halt near Shamouti Island.

"It's like every Pokemon in the world is here," Tomo says.

"I wonder if the Prehistoric Pokemon from the island are here too," Jen replies.

Seeing this, Slowking says, "There's only one hope. Only the chosen one can bring together the treasures to help the water's great guardian."

"But the legend says its song will fail," Melody says.

"And thus the earth shall turn to a child whom greeted Mew," Slowking says, and turns to Mew.

"But how are we gonna find the chosen one if we don't even know where to look?" Melody asks, devastated.

Just then Misty soon realizes, "It's right in the legend! The earth shall turn to a child whom greeted Mew!"

Then Tracey turns to Mew, "Mew it's talking about you."

"I'm the, chosen one?" Mew asks, her eyes wide in shock.

"Pika Pikachu," (You are, the chosen one.) Pikachu says.

"Eevee Eevee Eevee," (And somehow we knew you're the one.) Eevee adds.

Mew is so shocked and says, "This… this is a lot to take in. I mean, I know that being a Pokemon trainer is hard, I… I never expect to save the world."

"I know it doesn't sound easy, Mew," Misty says.

"But you're the only one who matches the legend perfectly," Tracey says.

"And like you said, you had this feeling you need to do this, and it seems our Pokemon knows it too, especially since you were given the name Mew when you're found," Tomo says.

"So maybe you somehow subconsciously knew you needed to go to the island to get the orbs," Jen says.

"That seems possible, but still, this is overwhelming," Mew says.

With remorse, Melody says, "Mew, this whole thing is my fault. I –I never should've dragged you into this."

"It's not your fault Melody," Mew says.

"Mew right. Don't blame yourself. We always get ourselves into trouble," Misty says.

Mew chuckles and says, "And trouble finds us."

Then grows concern, "But this is so much…"

Then Mew realizes, "What if… what if Lugia knows too…"

"What do you mean?" Jen asks.

Then Mew turns to the frozen sea, "I think it's been Lugia calling all along, and it reminds me of…"

Suddenly, Melody realizes, "Lugia!" And brings out her flute, "The sound it makes is just like the song from the legend!"

"That's right. Its sound matches the song you were playing at the banquet," Mew says.

Melody begins to play the song of the legend through the chaos. Underneath the sea, Lugia begins to glow and regains consciousness. Just then, the cyclone rises from the sea with a glow and Lugia appears out of the tornado.

Through telepathy Lugia says, "The song. The song has restored my strength. But it alone cannot bring harmony to the three warring ones."

"What do you mean?" Mew asks.

"When the treasures of fire, ice, and lightning are aligned, my song shall harmonize with their powers, and tame the beasts both above and below the sea. But this can come to pass only with the help of the chosen one," Lugia explains.

Then Mew asks, "But what can I do that somebody else can't?"

"Only in the hands of the true chosen one will the ice sphere glow like the others, its power awakened," Lugia answers.

Mew looks ahead to see the Ice Island, "And the last sphere is on Ice Island."

"The choice is yours. You must go only where your heart leads," Lugia says.

"Where my heart leads…" Mew says and looks at the three waring Pokemon.

Just then, Pikachu gives Mew some encouragement, "Pikachu." (You can do it.)

"I can?" Mew asks.

"Eevee Eevee!" (We know you can!) Eevee says.

Soon, many of Mew's Pokeballs come out of their Pokeballs, cheering for Mew.

"You think so, too?" Mew asks.

All the Pokemon agree. She then turns to her friends and all of them nod their heads.

Mew soon begins to tear up, "Okay. I'll do whatever it takes to get that third treasure. But, what if I mess up? What if... I…"

Then Misty says, "You can do it."

"We know you can," Melody adds.

"She's right. You've done a lot to help Pokemon, even if it does get us into trouble. Of course trouble finds us," Tomo says.

"And the Pokemon you helped before might know that too. You're a good person," Jen says.

Mew smiles and says, "Thanks everyone. I can do this."

Moments later, Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee set out for Ice Island, but the deep snow makes their travel slow.

"Right now, I feel more like the frozen one!" Mew says.

She then trips and falls face first into the snow. Then she gets up.

Mew sighs, "This will take forever to get to Ice Island. We need another plan."

Just then, Pikachu calls out, "Pika Pika!" (Look over there!)

Mew looks to where Pikachu is pointing to and sees what's left of Melody's boat.

Then Mew has an idea and turns to Pikachu, "Pikachu, I think you just gave me an idea."

Soon, Mew is now traveling on a small sled with Squirtle, Bulbasaur, Charizard, and Pidgeot, pulling the sled.

"This is a lot better than walking, guy! We'll be there in no time, now!" Mew says.

"Pikachu!" (We're moving now!) Pikavhu says.

"Eevee Eevee!" (And it's better than walking!) Eevee says.

At the shrine, Misty says, "Good luck, Mew."

"I wish we can do something to help Mew," Tomo says.

"Me too," Jen says.

On the cliff above, Team Rocket watches as Mew rushes towards Ice Island

Jessie shrugs her shoulders, "She's always the hero.

"We're always a zero," James says.

But James says, "We could be heroes, too, if we ever caught a break."

Soon, they notice the helicopter the two professors and Adriana are in, and it soon crashes far away from them. Thankfully, everyone seems to be in one piece. Team Rocket peek out and spot the tail rotor turn off the helicopter from the crash. Then look at the raft behind them.

Suddenly, an idea pops in their heads, "I got an idea!"

Meanwhile Mew and her Pokemon continue their adventure towards Ice Island. But then, Moltes and Zapdos spot them, and try to attack them. Charizard and Pkachu use their own attack to repel them, and the smoke of the resulting explosion blows away. However, Articuno appears and heads towards them, but Lugia rescues them from getting frozen. Zapdos and Moltres try to attack, but Lugia pushes them out of the way. Articuno tries to attack, but Lugia intervenes. Zapdos then launches its Thunder attack, and breaks the eyes before Mew and the others can get through. Mew calls back Charizard and Pidgeot as the rest run along with her. Everyone looks to see the battle continues and an ice wall is in their way.

"Aw man. We'll never get there, now," Mew says.

Suddenly, the group hears the sound of the motor. She turns around to see something or someone is coming towards them

"Who could that be?" Mew wonders.

Soon, she sees Team Rocket riding on the raft towards them.

If that kid thinks we're here for trouble…

Jessie:

Instead of causing tribulation…

Being good guys for once would be super-dupulous!

That's right!

"Pikachu," (They're always weird) Pikachu comments.

Soon, Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee board Team Rocket's makeshift motorboat and fly over the ice wall.

"You wanna help?!" Mew asks, surprised.

And so, the group have a temporary alliance, and the rush to Ice Island. Soon, Moltres flies alongside.

"It's Moltres!" Mew calls out.

The group narrowly avoid Moltres's attack. Along with Zapdos' thunder, Lugia also forces it back. Then Lugia blocks Articuno's Ice Beam. The group continues to reach towards the island, and finally reach the frozen shore of Ice Island. They race uphill towards the shrine where the sphere is. Soon, they come across a cave.

Mew points out, "Up there!"

"Pikachu!" (Almost there!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee!" (And we're at the shrine!) Eevee says.

The team races through the cave and finally comes out of the cave, over a bridge, and into another tunnel. Finally, they reach the light of the cave, and fly out of the tunnel. Soon, they stop at the foot of the shrine.

Pikachu rushes out, "Pika!" (It's there!)

Eevee and Mew approach the Articuno statue.

And rush off.

"Okay, you got the third treasure! Now, come on! Let's get back to the island!" Meowth says.

Mew puts the sphere in her bag, and everyone rushes to the boat, but Articuno spots them. Everyone hops inside the boat and departs before the Ice Beam hits them. However, Zapdos' thunderbolt strikes, and sends the group flying. Then Moltres fires the flames and destroys the boat while the group evade the attack. However, the exit is blocked. The three legendary birds continue to attack. Ultimately, Moltres and Zapdos get the upper hand on Articuno, forcing it down.

Pikachu climbs up and calls out, "Pika! Pikachu!" (Up here! Hurry up!)

Meowth, Eevee, and Mew hear Pikachu and decide to follow.

"Come on, let's go!" Meowth says.

Everyone follows Pikachu up the wall and down the slope of the mountain. Soon, Lugia files in alongside them.

Mew puts the sphere back in her bag and calls out, "Piakcu! Eevee!"

Pikachu and Eevee then climb on Mew's shoulder. Then all three aboard Lugia's back. Team Rocket is not far behind.

Team Rocket manages to grab onto Lugia's leg as he takes off into the sky, but Zapdos and Moltres go on the attack as they rush to Shamouti Island. Then flies higher.

Lugia then says, "Hold on tight."

Everyone decides to do so, and Lugia continues to dodge the attacks left and right.

Then Jesse realizes something, "We're slowing Lugia down! The three of us are too heavy!"

"Let's try Weight Watchers!" James says.

Then James says, "It's too late for that!"

Then Meowth says, "I heard that it's never too late if you really stick to the program!"

Lugia continues to fly as he dodges Zapdos' Thunder Attacks.

"If we don't let go, they may not make it back!" Jessie says.

"Let's protect the world from devastation!" James says.

And with that, Team Rocket falls into the ocean, but quickly surface to find themselves face to face with a bunch of wild Pokemon. Meanwhile, up above, Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee see the wild Pokemon themselves.

Mew asks, "Lugia! Why are all those Pokémon down there?"

"Because they feel they must be here, in case they are needed," Lugia answers.

"But what can they do to help?" Mew asks.

"They are not sure, and that is why they are here," Lugia says.

Then Mew asks, "What do you mean?"

"That just one Pokémon could help the world would be worth the journey for thousands of them any day. But this day, the one that can make all the difference, is you," Lugia answers.

Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee nod their heads in reply as they're near the island.

Back at the island, everyone waits for Mew and the others to return.

"Please, hurry," Misty says.

"Let's hope the, legend is true," Melody says.

Lugia flies up as it launches a powerful beam in the air, almost striking at the legendary birds Soon, all four of them fall into the sea. Eevee cries out, (Eevee! Eevee!" (Mew! Mew!)

Down in the sea, Lugia continues to sin, and says his last words, "I, have failed." before losing consciousness.

Just then, Melody hands Misty her flute, "Here. Take this."

Misty and Melody take each other's hand and it seems the two have become friends.

Suddenly, they hear Misty's voice, "Mew!"

Pikachu and Eevee turn their heads to see Misty swimming towards them.

"Eevee Eevee!" (We're over here!) Eevee calls out.

Misty pulls on the rope that's attached to herself. Then, Tracey, Tomo, and Jen pull on the rope to get them to shore. Once to shore, Tracey, Jen, and Tomo help pull Misty and the others out of the water.

Tracey calls out, "Mew!"

Pikachu calls out, "Pika Pi!" (Mew!)

"Mew!" Misty says in concern.

"Are you alright?" Tomo asks.

"I'll be fine. I need to do this. I need to end this," Mew says.

Mew soon begins to walk up the stairs to the shrine. Despite feeling exhausted and struggling, Mew continues to walk up the stairs to the shrine. Soon, Mew reaches the shrine, Slowking, Melody, and the other Pokemon notice.

Melody says in relief, "She made it!"

Then Slowking asks, "Have you brought the final treasure, Mew?"

Mew gets out the sphere and presents it to Slowking, "Here it is, Slowking."

Then Slowking points to the shrine, "You must be the one to place it."

Mew then walks up the stairs to the shrine platform. Then places the final sphere in its place, facing Ice Island.

Soon, all three spheres begin to glow and a burst of light glows around the shrine. Then a green light glows in the shrine and evaporates the snow and ice. Then green water flows out of the shrine and flows across the area, lighting up the runes around it and turning them into crystals. Everyone is astonished by this.

Misty soon remembers, "The song!"

Melody nods her head and goes to the shrine. Mew smiles and nods her head. Melody does the same. Soon, Melody begins to play Lugia's song on the flute. As she does, the runes light up green light with every note.

Far on the other island, Moltres and Zapdos regain consciousness. Back on Ice Island, Articuno regains consciousness as well.

Then the weather returns to normal as the tornadoes fade and the sea calms.

Then the green water flows out of the shrine and down to the sea. Soon, the green water covers the entire ocean. Then Moltres and Zapdos begin to fly into the air. Then Articuno flies along with the others. Finally, rising from the surface and appearing from it is Lugia as the clouds disappear and the sky becomes clear.

Then Lugia lands on the foot of the shrine and closes its back flaps. Lugia then gestures to Mew to climb on his back. Mew points to herself in surprise, and Lugia nods his head. Agreeing to this, Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee climb on Lugia's back and Lugia takes off into the sky.

Melody continues to play her role as Misty and the others watch Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee in the sky with Lugia. Just then, a large cyclone rises from the sea, catching Mew and the other's attention in astonishment. At the wreckage, Lawrence sees the cyclone of water rise from the sky.

Soon, Moltres, Zapdos, Articuno fly alongside Lugia, Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee in the sky. Soon, all the Pokemon from land, air and sear are returning home. Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee look around in amazement.

Just then Mew notices Moltres, Articuno, and Zapdos fly over Lugia. And then, one by one, one of their feathers begins to gently float down to Mew until they land on Lugia's back and in front of Mew.

She looks to see Moltres' feather is a golden plumage with reddish-and orange, and yellow flames. Zapdos feather is a bit spiky with black tips and has electric sparks coming out of it. Articuno's feather is a sky blue feather and looks rather chilly. Mew then picks up all three feathers, to realize they are gifts from the Legendary birds.

And soon, the spiraling water descends back to the sea. Then Moltres, Articuno, and Zapdos return to their represented island. And so, Melody finishes the final notes to her song. Once she's done, she collapses on her knees, realizes what has happened, and holds the flute in her hands.

Meanwhile, at Shamouti's village, Carol and the others look outside to see the storm is over.

On T.V the reporters say, "And, as you can see from these live pictures, the severe weather that caused havoc around the globe has finally ended."

Later in the evening, at the Shamouti Shrine, as the sun sets and Lugia prepares to depart as he flies up in the air

Lugia says, "The beast of the sea has been tamed. The fate of the world could not have been in better hands."

Mew couldn't help but smile in reply.

Then, Lugia says, "And now, Chosen One, I shall present to you a special gift."

Mew and the others become confused.

Lugia then reaches under its wing and then pulls something out and places it in front of Mew and the others. To the group's surprise, the gift that Lugia gives to Mew is an egg. It's silvery white like Lugia with three darkish blue stripes on each side. On the egg is a beautiful silver-colored sparkling feather.

"It's an egg," Mew says, and picks it up.

Then holds the silver feather in her other hand.

"This egg has my offspring. I shall leave it in your care," Lugia says.

"What?" Mew says, surprised.

Then asks, "Are… are you sure… I mean… this is your baby and…"

Lugia nods his head and explains.

Then Slowking steps in and says, "This is a secret part of the legend, so that only the Chosen One can receive it. Once the Chosen One tamed the Beast of the Sea and the world's balance is restored, the Great Water Guardian will bestow the egg of offspring to the Chosen One who has also proved to be pure of heart. Therefore the Chosen One and the Offspring shall become partners and be together forever more."

Mew smiles and turns to Lugia, "Thank you Lugia. I promise to take good care of your baby."

"I know that my child will be in good hands. Farewell Chosen one, and friends," Lugia says.

Lugia then flies up into the air and then dives into the sea, returning to his home. Mew then looks at her egg and can feel how warm it is. She can't help but smile as they'll have a new family member along the way.

Suddenly, they hear a familiar voice, "Mew! Mew!"

Mew and the others turn their heads to see Adriana, Professor Oak, Professor Ivy, and Zeraora.

Professor Oak falls to the ground and screams, "Oh, my lumbago!"

"Papa?!" Mew says in surprise and quickly runs to him.

"Adriana?" Misty says just as surprise.

"And Professor Oak?" Tracy adds.

"And Professor Ivy?" Tomo adds.

Mew rushes to her father and they both embrace each other.

Adriana rushes over and asks, "Mew, are you alright? What happened?"

"It's a long story," Mew says.

Then Misty says, "She's right. Mew just helped save the whole world!"

"And helped rescue Moltres and Zapdos," Tomo says.

"And she's the chosen one of Shamouti prophecy," Jen adds.

Adriana notices Jen and asks, "Who are you?"

"Oh, this is Jen. She's a new friend and started traveling with us," Mew says.

"It's nice to meet you Jen," Professor Oak says.

Then asks, "So what about saving the world."

"Long story short, a man was trying to capture Moltres, Articuno, Zapdos, and Lugia, which caused crazy weather all over the world and nearly destroyed it. And it was prophesied that the chosen one can help restore balance, which is actually me. So with help, I was able to get the treasures of the island and brought here, and with Melody playing Luiga's song, the balance has been restored," Mew explains

Then, Mew takes out the four feathers in small bottles, "And Moltres, Articuno, Zapdos, and Lugia gave me their feathers."

Then shows them the egg, "And Lugia gave me the egg of its offspring to take care of.

"Oh my, you really have the legendary bird feathers. Amazing," Professor Oak says, amazed.

"And you meet the legendary Pokemons as well," Professor Ivy says.

Professor Oak then gently pats on the egg, "And it seems that you'll be having a new family member."

Zeraora and Mew look at each other and hug each other once more.

Then Professor Oak says, "We've got to get back to Pallet Town and tell the other Pokemon researchers about this! Come on!"

Both Professor rushes off.

Later that night, Lawrence stands in the wreckage of his airship and finds the Mew card that started it all.

He says, "How it all began. And how it'll begin," Then picks it up, "Again."

The next day, Mew and the others are ready to depart from Shamouti Island with Maren on her boat. They soon say their farewells to Melody and Carol.

Melody then presents Mew a small box, "We want to give you this before leaving."

"What is it?" Mew asks, taking the small box.

"Open it and find out," Carol says with a smile.

Mew opens the box and is surprised to see a shell flute that looks a lot like the one Melody has.

"You're giving me your flute?" Mew asks.

Melody giggles and holds out her flute, "No. I'm giving you your own flute. That way, you can practice playing Lugia's song."

Then gently pat the Lugia egg, "Besides, it will be good to practice the song for your little Lugia."

Mew smiles and says, "Thanks Melody. You too, Carol."

"Truth is, we should be thanking you. And well, kind of apologize to you for getting you involved," Carol says.

"It's cool. There's no hard feeling. From what I understand, you never know what life is going to lead you," Mew says.

"I hope we can see each other again someday," Melody says.

"Maybe someday, we will. And maybe you can visit us in Kanto," Misty says.

"Maybe," Melody says.

A few minutes later, Mew and her friends depart in Maren's boat for another part of their adventure as they say goodbye to Melody, Carol, and the locals of the island.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket is climbing up the cliff until they reach the Shrine of Shamouti Island.

"Who'd believe it?" Jessie replies.

Then James says, "For once, we were heroes."

"Too bad nobody saw us," Meowth says.

Suddenly, Slowking steps forward towards them, "Guess again."

Team Rocket looks up to see the Slowking, which catches them by surprise.

"What... Did you... Say?" Jessie asks, still surprised.

"Lots of people saw what you did out there. And all of them are watching you right now," Slowking says and turns his head.

So does Team Rocket.

"Oh, then I guess that bad guys…" Jessie says.

Then James says, "Are finally…"

"Good guys!" Meowth happily adds.

Then Jessie says, "So, then, we're not bad!"

"That's good!" James says.

But then Meowth asks in concern, "What if da boss finds out?"

"That's bad!" James replies.

Then Jessie says, "We'll start our own team!

"That's good!" James replies.

Then Meowth says in worry, "But we got no money!"

"That's bad!" James replies.

Then Jessie says, "Then we'll just steal some!"

"That's good!" James says, but soon asks, "Or is that bad?"

Chapter 35: Episode 31: The Birds of Bad Feathers

Time has passed since the adventure at Shamouti Island, and the group of friends are now sailing in the ocean of the Orange Islands. Tomo and Ten are relaxing with some of the Pokemon while Tracey is looking around with his binoculars. Misty is polishing her egg while Mew is practicing with the shell flute Melody has given to her, and playing Lugia's song to her egg. In fact, everyone feels relaxed by the music.

Tracey looks around and notices something ahead, "Hey guys, look over there."

Mew and the others, including the Pokemon stop what they're doing and look to where Tracey is looking through the binoculars. What they see is a large island that has mountains and trees, and clouds around the top of the mountain.

"It's an island," Misty says.

Then Tracey says, "That's Ava Island."

"Ava Island?" Jen asks.

"Ava Island is an Island that is well known to be inhabited by Bird-like Pokemon, and is known for using strong Flying Type attacks," Tracey says.

"Do you think we'll get to see some?" Mew asks.

"Maybe," Tracey says.

"I really like to get some rest," Misty says.

"Me too," Jen replies.

"Good idea," Mew says.

Then turns to Lapras, "Alright Lapras, let's head to Ava Island."

Lapras squeals with a smile and begins to swim to Ava Island.

Somewhere on Ava Island, there is a cave somewhere on the highest part of the mountain. Inside the darkness of the cave, there are seven pairs of eyes. They watch as they see Mew and her friends on Lapras swimming towards the Island.

Sometime later, Mew and the others arrive on the beach of the island.

Mew calls back Lapras, "You get a good rest, Lapras." and Lapras returns to his Pokeball.

Suddenly, Mew hears laughter and turns to see Tomo, Jen, Meloetta, Skwovet, and Amaura playing close to the water. Mew giggles with a smile on her face.

Misty looks around and says, "The Island is so amazing."

"I agree. It feels so peaceful," Mew says.

Then Tracey says, "Yeah. I can't wait to explore and sketch some Flying Type Pokemon."

"Smeargle," (I agree.) Smeargle says, and holds out his tail.

"Looks like Smeargle agrees," Mew says.

The three humans begin laughing.

Then Misty turns to Togpei and Pichu, along with the others, "Maybe you all can play with Tomo and the others while the rest of us get things ready for lunch."

Togepi, Pichu, and the other Pokemon nod their heads in reply. And so, the Pokemon play with Tomo and the others while Misty, Mew, and Tracey prepare lunch for everyone. However, unknown to the group, they're being spied on by six flying figures and are led by one who is at the front of the group.

Just then, the leader then shouts, "Chatot Chatot Chatot!" (Alright gang, let's dive down and catch them by surprise when their guard is down)

Soon, other chatters happen and sneak at an unknown location to take Mew and her friends by surprise.

Back on the beach, Tomo, Jen, and the Pokemon are still playing as Mew is cooking soup as Misty and Tracey set up the table, plates, utensils, and the bowls for the Pokemon food.

"I hope we have enough food for the Pokemon. I sometimes forget how many Pokemon we have caught so far," Misty says.

"I'm sure we have more than enough, and there seems to be some fruits and berries in the woods if we need to get some more," Tracey says.

Then turns to Mew, "How's the soup going?"

"The soup looks great. It should be finished soon. Maybe you can let the others know that it's almost time for lunch. So we can start serving the Pokemon some food," Mew says.

"I'll go get them, "Misty says.

Meanwhile, Tomo, Jen, and the other Pokemon are busy playing, building sand castles, playing in the water as they splash it at each other, relaxing in the sand, and all kinds of fun and relaxation. However, unknown to the group, the figures are flying down right towards them.

Just then, Misty walks over, "Tomo! Jen! Everyone!"

Soon, everyone stops playing and turns to Misty who is walking over.

"Lunch is almost ready, we could use help serving food to the Pokemon," Misty says.

"Okay," Jen happily says.

Then Tomo says, "Sure."

And so everyone begins to head to the table where Tracey and Mew are at and manage to get the bowls and table set. Just then, Pikachu and Eevee's ears begins twitching. They both turn around to see two Pokemon flying towards them.

Pikachu and Eevee scream, "PIKA!/EEV!" (LOOK OUT!)

Hearing the Pokemons' scream, Misty and the others look behind to see the two flying Pokemon diving towards them.

Misty screams, "Get down!"

Everyone quickly gets on the ground as the two Pokemon swoosh just over them and fly into the sky. Then they all look up to see two Pokemon flying in the sky.

The first one is a vulture-like Pokémon, particularly resembling a turkey vulture. It has a bare, pink head and neck, along with a notched black beak and red eyes. There are black eyelashes or eyeliner-like markings above its eyes. A long brown tuft with a bone in the middle extends from the back of its head. It has a tan ruff at the base of its neck, and shaggy darker brown wings with gray tips. It also has shaggy brown tail feathers. Its pink feet have black talons. It has decorated itself with bones — a jaw with sharp teeth — to form a skirt.

The second is a silver-gray, avian Pokémon with a long, metallic blue neck, legs, and tail. It has yellow eyes, a pointed beak with several pointed teeth, and a triangular crest on its head. There are red feathers under the sheaths that cover its sharp wings, and each feather can be moved independently. Its wings are actually hollow. Its feet have three toes on them, two in front and one in back, and its tail has hooked ends.

"Those are Pokemon," Jen says, surprised.

"They just came down from out of nowhere," Misty says.

Then Tomo panics, "They're coming back."

The girls look up to see the two flying Pokemon coming back from behind them. Everyone ducks their heads again as they fly past them from above. Then they look up to see the two Pokemon are flying close by.

"Why are they attacking us?" Jen asks.

"I don't know, but we gotta tell Tracey and Mew!" Misty answers frantically.

"Let's hurry!" Tomo says.

With that, Misty and the others quickly get up and rush to where Mew and Tracey are. Back at the spot, Mew and Tracey have just finished with the lunch preparations.

"There, lunch is all ready," Mew says.

"The Pokemon food is all set too. Now we just have to wait for Misty and the others to get here," Tracey says.

Suddenly, they hear a loud cry, catching them off guard.

"What was that?" Mew asks.

"I'm not sure. It sounds like it's coming from above us," Tracey answers.

Suddenly, two flying figures swoosh past then, and knock the two off their feet and they fall in the sand. Then, two more fishes swoosh down and knock the pot of soup and tail down to the ground.

"What's going on?" Mew asks.

"I think we're being attacked!" Tracey panics.

"Mew! Tracey!" Misty's voice cries out.

Mew and Tracey turn their heads to see they're being chased by the two Pokemon from before.

"What's going on?" Tracry asks.

"I don't know," Mew asks.

Misty, Tomo, Jen, and the Pokemon soon join the other group. And soon, they find themselves surrounded by seven Pokemon. The two Pokemon that have attacked Tomo, Jen, and Misty, along with five others. One of them is a Fearow, and four others.

The second is a swan-like Pokémon with primarily white plumage. Its beak is long and yellow topped with a black cere, and it has several white feathery features adorning its head. The more rounded of the features are to the sides of its head, and the more pointed feature is atop. It possesses a long, curving neck. With a fluid neck and a strong bill, Swanna is capable of very accurate jabbing and thrusting attacks. Two light-blue feathery features, similar to those on the sides of its head, are present on its underside, and Swanna's large wings are positioned so that they curve away from its body. Its legs are small, and its webbed feet are dark.

The third Pokemon is a bipedal, birdlike Pokémon with colorful plumage. Its head curves into a beak-shape in the front, but its mouth is located in a white patch under the beak's curve. It has a blue-green mask-like marking across its face, an orange blaze running from its forehead to the back of its neck, an orange ring around each eye, and a small, red patch at the tip of its beak. There is black space around its eyes, which are yellow with paler yellow sclerae. On the back of its head are two rectangular, tassel-like feathers. Its red, cape-like wings have blue-green undersides and are connected to its feathery tail. Near the tip of each wing is a three-clawed hand. Its front is white with a line of red along its neck and the top of its chest. It has small, yellow feet with three toes each.

The fourth Pokemon is a blue avian Pokémon resembling a cormorant. It has bright green, large, circular eyes with small pupils and a large, thin yellow beak. It has a ruff of light gray feathers that goes around its torso and sticks out at the back, making them resemble a bib. Its tail feathers have a small dot-shaped marking of this same shade of gray. It has a ruff of feathers on its head, with the largest clump pointing backward and being surrounded by small singular feathers. Its feet are black, webbed, and have three toes. Its wings seem to be perpetually extended.

And the last one is an avian Pokémon similar to a parakeet. Its head is black and resembles an eighth note, while its black tail resembles a metronome. Its plumage is brightly colored with blue wings, a yellow chest and feet, a green stomach, and a pink, hooked beak and eyelids. Additionally, there is a ruff of white feathers around its neck.

"We're surrounded!" Tracey panics.

"And I don't think they're the welcoming committee," Misty says, worried.

Just then, all Pokemon get into one side and use their wings to create a powerful wind. That causes the group to be sent flying across the beach and land in the sand.

Just then, the silver gray Pokemon along with the uses Wing Attack, the buzzard Pokemon uses Whirlwind. And the Fearow also performs Wing Attack as well.

"Watch out!" Tracey cries out.

Everyone quickly moves out of the way before the attacks can hit them. And with that, the Pokemon then swoop down and begin to try pecking at their heads, including the Pokemon's.

Jen panics, "Stop pecking at us."

"Cut it out!" Tomo screams.

Just then, Fearow begins to swoop down with Mew distracted to attack her. Pikachu and Eevee notice it and push Mew out of the way in time and they fall to the ground. Mew looks up to see Fearow and lets out a cry and it sounds angry. Then swoops down and tries to attack Mew once more.

Pikachu quickly steps forward and shouts, "PIKACHUUUUUUU!" and performs Thunderbolt at Fearow and the other Pokemon, stunning them.

Mew quickly gets up and says, "Come on guys, let's go!"

Agreeing to the idea, everyone begins to run off into the woods to get away from the flying Pokemon. The gang of Flying Pokemon are able to regain themselves and fly off to find Mew and her friends to attack them. However, Fearow is more determined to follow them, especially Mew.

Somewhere in the woods, Mew and the others continue to run through the thick woods to get away from the gang of Flying Pokemon.

"Do you think they're still behind us?" Jen asks.

Misty turns her head back, "It doesn't look like it, but they'll find us if we don't find a place to hide."

"But where can we hide?" Jen asks.

Tracey soon looks ahead and says, "In that cave!"

The group soon look ahead to see a large cave on their right.

"That's as good a place as any," Mew says.

The group then hurries inside the cave before the group of flying Pokemon could find them. Mew then takes a peek outside to see if the gang are still around.

"Are they out there?" Jen asks.

"No, but it's best we keep our guard up," Mew says.

Then walks back into the cave.

Misty then sits down with a sigh, "That was too close. I thought those Pokemon were going to get."

Then Jen asks, "What kind of Pokemon are they?"

"Well, there was a Fearow, along with a Chatot, Swanna, a Cramorant…" Tracey says.

"There's also a Mandibuzz, Hawlucha, and a Skarmory," Mew adds.

Then Mew takes out her Pokedex, "Let's see what Dexter has to say about them."

And so Dexter begins to give out information on each Pokemon.

"Chatot, the Music Note Pokemon, A Normal and Flying Type. A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic."

"Cramorant, the Gulp Pokemon. A Flying and Water Type. Cramorant's gluttony led it to try to swallow an Arrokuda whole, which in turn led to Cramorant getting an Arrokuda stuck in its throat."

"Skarmory, the Armor Bird Pokemon. A Steel and Flying Type. Skarmory's steel wings become tattered and bashed in from repeated battles. Once a year, the battered wings grow back completely, restoring the cutting edges to their pristine state."

"Mandibuzz, the Bone Vulture Pokemon, and the evolved form of Vullaby A Dark and Flying Pokemon. They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity."

"Swanna, the White Bird Pokemon, and the evolved form of Ducklett. A Water and Flying Type. Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles."

"Hawlucha, the Wrestling Pokemon. A Fighting and Flying Type. In combat, Hawlucha leaps nimbly about, taking advantage of its opponents' blind spots. It's also skilled at using superb submission holds."

"Fearow, the Beak Pokemon, and the evolved form of Spearow. A Normal and Flying Type. It's tough and has excellent stamina. It has no problem flying continuously for a whole day carrying a heavy load."

"Sounds like those Pokemon are pretty powerful," Misty says.

Then Tracey turns to Mew, "Hey Mew, why did that Fearow try to attack you like that."

"I'm not sure…" Mew answers.

But soon Mew begins to have an idea, "Wait a minute, you don't think that…"

Mew soon remembers the incident in the forest outside of Pallet Town and the battle Mew and Pidgeot have with Fearow and the flocks of Spearow.

"It must be that Fearow," Mew says.

Tomo asks, "You don't mean the Fearow that attacked us before and attacked you Pikachu, and Eevee when it was a Spearow?"

"I think it is," Mew says.

"It must have a real grudge against you after the last time you battled it," Misty says.

"Uh, what are you talking about?" Jen asks.

"That Fearow is the same Fearow that attacked me, Pikachu, and Eevee when we were back at Pallet Town. Both when I started my Pokemon Journey when it's a Spearow and attacked the rest of us when we were leaving for Valencia Island," Mew explains.

"And you're sure it's the same one?" Tracey asks.

"That Fearow must have been really mad," Jen says.

"I think it is. Still, we gotta do something about it," Mew says.

"But how did Fearow get involved with the other Bird Pokemon?" Misty asks.

"I'm not sure," Mew says.

"And how are we going to deal with them?" Tomo asks.

"Well, it might work if we use Electric Type Pokemon, maybe also Rock Type and Ice Types.

Suddenly, Jen hears a strange noise coming from inside the cave as the others discuss the situation. Curious, Jen decides to look inside the cave to find the source of the sound. Jen slowly walks deeper into the cave until she finds something or rather, someone lying on the floor of the cave. That something is a Pokemon. The Pokemon is a large avian Pokemon with a gray and white feathered body. The Pokemon's tail is shaped like a jet that has white tail feathers. The wings are shaped to resemble a white hand with black feathers underneath. The head feather is shaped like a hat. Its plumes have changed into purple flames with light blue eye markings on them. Its legs are long and thick with yellow feet that each have a digit facing backward, and three facing forward. Each digit is tipped by a short, thick, black claw.

Mew and the others turn their heads and look to see the Pokemon.

The Pokdex shows a picture of a Braviary, like the one before them.

The Pokedex says, "Braviary, the Battle Cry Pokemon, and the evolved form of Rufflet, Hisuian Form. A Psychic and Flying Type. Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that floats to the water's surface. No other date has been confirmed."

"That's interesting," Misty says.

Then Jen asks, "What does the normal Braviary look like?"

Mew shows Jen the Pokedex of the other Braviary.

This one has dark red feathers on its back and dark blue feathers on its underside. Its tail feathers are red, turning to yellow, and then blue at the tips. Braviary's legs are long and thick with yellow feet that each have a digit facing backward, and three facing forward. Each digit is tipped by a short, thick, black claw.

Dexter says, "Braviary, the Valiant Pokemon and the evolved form of Rufflet. A Normal and Flying Type. The more scars it has on its front, the more heroic it's considered to be. Those with many scars on their back are mocked by the flock."

"Wow. So there are two different kinds of Braviary," Misty says.

"That's pretty cool," Tomo says.

"But what's a Braviary doing in a cave?" Tracey wonders.

Jen looks at the Braviary and notices that it has some scratches and bruises on its body.

Jen speaks out in concern, "I think it's hurt. There are scratches and bruises on its body."

"I think she's right," Mew says.

"You don't think those other Flying Pokemon have anything to do with it?" Misty asks, worried.

"It's possible, but right now, we gotta help this Braviary," Mew says.

Mew and Jen then sit down and check on the injuries the Braviary has.

"How is it Mew?" Misty asks.

"Braviary is badly injured, and I think it's wing is sprained. Luckily, it's not broken, but it seems that it's not going to be able to fly for a short while," Mew says.

Just then, Braviary slowly opens its eyes and looks to see Jen who is giving him a gentle smile.

"Hello Braviary, I'm glad to see you're awake," Jen says.

And so she continues to help Mew with the treatment. A little time later, Mew and Jen are able to bandage the Braviary, especially his right wing.

"This should do for the time being," Mew says.

Then Jen shows some mashed fruits like Oran berries, Sitrus berries, apples, and other berries to help him heal. Jen then presents a bowl with a spoon and tries to feed it to them.

"Here you go, you must be very hungry," Jen says.

Braviary slowly reaches out and takes the bite of the food and the spoon. Soon, Braviary eats the food from the spoon and is starting to feel a little better. Jen gives it a gentle smile and continues to feed the Pokemon.

Suddenly, Braviary lets out a slow cry sound. Tomo and Mew hear Braviary and sit next to him to hear what he's saying.

"What is it, Braviary?" Tomo asks.

Braviary begins to let out his voice calmly and slowly as Jen gently rubs its feathers.

This leaves Jen, Tracey, Misty, and the Pokemon in shock.

"But according to Braviary, Fearow and Chatot showed up and Chatot, despite his small size, was able to defeat Braviary with powerful attacks. It's able to use Peck, Hyper Voice, Air Slash, and… shockingly enough it's able to use Hurricane. And with Fearow helping Chatot, Braviary didn't stand a chance," Mew explains.

Just then, Pikachu and Eevee rush to Mew's bag and backpack. Eevee then takes out Mew's Keystone with the bracelet, along with the Pidgeotite with her mouth. Pikachu then takes out a Pokeball. Pikachu then presses the button and Pidgeot comes out.
