Chapter 36: Episode 32: Ceremony of Legends

Early one morning, Mew and her friends are still making their journey through the Orange Island and find the next gym for Mew to earn her last badge. Since it's early in the morning and the waves are calm, Mew and the others are actually sleeping on Lapras shell as Lapas is cruising along the ocean blue. Soon enough, all the trainers begin to wake up from their sleep. Many of them stretch their arms as they yawn, and some also rub their eyes.

"Good morning everyone," Mew says.

"Morning," Misty says.

Tomo yawns and says, "Yeah. Morning."

"Morning guys," Tracey says.

Then everyone ends up saying, "Morning." in a tired tone.

"I can't believe we've been out in the ocean all night," Misty says, tired.

"I know, we haven't been able to find any land for the past two days," Mew says.

Then Jen says, "And I'm kind of hungry."

"Amaura," (Me too.) Amaura says.

"I'm sure we'll find land soon," Mew says.

"I hope we do," Tomo says.

Tracey brings out his binoculars, "I'm sure we'll find some place to rest soon."

"Yeah. Lapras is starting to get tired," Mew says as she gently pet Lapras.

Indeed, Lapras is looking very tired and it shows signs that he has a lack of sleep.

"She's right. Lapras need to get some rest," Misty says.

"Maybe we can use some of our other Water Pokemon so Lapras can rest," Tomo says.

"Good idea," Mew says.

Tracey continues to look through his binoculars until he notices something from a far.

"Hey guys, I think I spotted something," Tracey says.

"What is it, Tracey?" Jen asks.

"I think I found an Island," Tracey answers.

This makes Misty glad, "Really, an Island?"

"I think so," Tracey says.

Misty then takes the binoculars and looks to see a far distance area.

"Hmm, it's kind of hard to tell from far away," Misty says.

"Maybe we can go check it out?" Jen asks.

"Couldn't hurt," Mew says.

Then Mew turns to Lapras, "Hey Lapras, do you think you can travel in that direction?"

Lapras nods his head and begins to travel towards the island. Unknown to the group, a periscope rises from the water and is spying on Mew and her friends. The periscope belongs to Team Rocket's Magikarp submarine. In other words, Team Rocket is spying and following Mew and the others once again.

Jessie says, "I spotted the twerps." and lets out a yawn.

James yawns as well, "Jessie, can't we take a break? We've been following the twerps since yesterday. I'm really tired."

"I could really use a cat nap," Meowth says, and lets out a big yawn.

"Look I know we've not gotten any sleep, but we gotta capture the twerp's Pikachu and Eevee, and bring them to the boss." Jessie says, irritated.

"And they have't been able to find a place to rest either," Meowth says.

But Jessie says, "Don't be too sure."

James and Meowth become confused as Jessie watches Mew and the others heading to a different direction.

"I think the twrps have spotted something," Jessie says.

"If it's an island, I would like to get some rest," Meowth says.

"I hope we can get something to eat," James says.

"Then stop whining and start pedaling," Jessie says.

"Right," James and Meowth reply with a nod.

And so, Team Rocket begins to pedal as the submarine follows the group of friends as they head to the island a far distance away.

Sometime later, Mew and the others get closer to the location, and the distance area is an island, and a very large island. It has large trees, some that look like a jungle or a forest. there is also a large mountain that also appears to have snow on top.

"Wow. It really is an island," Tracey says.

"And a really big island," Tomo says.

"Yay!" Jen cheers.

"I wonder if there's a town on the island," Misty says.

"Maybe. If there is, maybe we can get some rest," Mew says.

"I hope there's a Pokemon Center over there," Tracey says.

"Well, we're about to find out because we're just about there," Mew says.

Lapras continues to swim across the ocean until they reach the beach of the island. The group arrives on the beach and begins to stretch their bodies after being in the water and sitting on Lapras' back for so long.

Mew calls Lapras back into his Pokeballs,"You've deserved a long rest Lapras, return."

Then Lapras returns to his Pokeball.

Misty stretches her arms, "It's finally nice to reach land after traveling the ocean for over a day."

"Yeah.

"I wonder what kind of island this is," Misty says.

"I'm not sure. I never heard of this island before," Tracey says.

But then Mew says, "But it seems that someone knows about it. Look over there." and points ahead.

The group turns their heads to notice a wooden house with a roof made of wood as well. It's a short distance away from the shore and there appears to be more of them. They also see different kinds of trees, especially white lilies so it makes the village very pretty, and has a nice landscape.

"Those are interesting buildings," Tomo says.

"You're right," Jen says.

"But still, it's good that we've found a town here. Maybe we can find a Pokemon Center," Misty says.

"Well then, let's go check it out," Mew says.

The group soon heads into the town. However, when they arrive, Mew and the others are very surprised to see that there are multiple houses that are wood and other essentials. The people living in the town are also wearing different clothes than what they've seen. Some wear kimonos, yukatas, and different types of pants and shoes, even the accessories seem different. There also appears to be different stores and other fun places. There are also some Pokemon living in the town as well, some are also passing through.

"Wow. This town looks really amazing," Mew says.

"I have to agree, but this place seems peaceful," Misty says.

Tracey then says, "I have to admit, this town seems a lot different than the places I've been, it feels like we're in another time period."

"Now that you mention it, you're right," Misty says.

"I wonder why that is," Mew replies.

Pikachu, Eevee, and the other Pokemon are just as confused.

"Hello," A voice says.

The group turns their heads to see a woman who looks like Nurse Joy. Nurse Joy is wearing a pink kimono with a white apron, and a magenta pink obi around her waist. She is also wearing the same nurse hat like many of the Nurse Joys wear.

"Oh, Nurse Joy," Mew says.

"Yes. It's a pleasure to meet you. Welcome to Hisui Island and welcome to Hana Town, it's nice to meet you," Nurse Joy says.

"Hisui Island?" Misty asks.

"That's right. Here in Hisui Island, we lived the lives of our ancestors of the Hisui Region. Currently, it's called the Sinnoh Region," Nurse Joy explains.

"Really? That sounds amazing," Misty says.

"So your ancestor is from the Hisui Region?" Jen asks.

"Yes. Many of the villagers of the region traveled and spread throughout the world. Some of the travelers came to this island and made a village. Now we call this Hisui Island while over the years the Hisui Region became the Sinnoh Region today," Nurse Joy explains.

"That sounds amazing," Misty says.

"Yeah. Maybe I'll visit the Sinnoh Region someday," Mew says.

"Me too," Tomo and Jen eagerly reply.

Then Misty asks, "Do you have a Pokemon Center here?"

"Yes. It's not far from here, would you like me to escort you there," Nurse Joy says.

"Yes," Everyone happily says.

Sometime later, Nurse Joy takes the group to the Pokemon Center. Like the rest of the buildings, the Pokemon Center is made of wood as well, and the inside seems like a Feudal Japan medical clinic.

"Wow. This is an interesting Pokemon Center," Tracey says.

"Yeah. It also seems peaceful," Jen replies.

"Thank you," Nurse Joy says. "The Pokemon Center is a very nice place, but it also has good charms to it."

"It's a very nice place you have Nurse Joy," Misty says.

"Thank you," Nurse Joy says.

"The Hisui Region seems like an interesting region, since you said the village is based on it," Misty says.

"And said that the people of the island are descendants of the Hisui Region residence," Mew says.

"Yes," Nurse Joy answers, "The Hisui Region has many different stories and tales, so it will be difficult to explain all the details. You see, a long time ago humans and Pokemon didn't interact with each other as we do now. Some people were either afraid of Pokemon. However, there was an Expedition Team who explored the region and its Pokemon, and to help people live without fear of Pokemon."

"Really? Humans and Pokemon didn't interact with each other?" Mew asks, surprised.

"I thought they would interact with each other forever," Tomo adds.

"Not exactly, but over time, humans and Pokemon are able to interact and work together. According to legends, the first human inhabitants who lived millions of years ago worshiped a Pokemon god, and built ancient ruins," Nurse Joy adds.

"That's amazing," Jen says.

Then Mew asks, "So what else can you tell us?"

"Well, as many of us spread out, we also bring many of our Pokemon partners, and some of the Pokemon scatter across the world of their own free world to find new homes or travel. So we also have many Pokemon that originated from the Hisui Region living here too. Those who live among humans and those who live in the wild of the island. The island is so large that it also has landscapes for different types of Pokemon," Nurse Joy says.

"Sounds cool," Tomo says.

Then Nurse Joy says, "Indeed." and asks, "So what brings you to the island?"

"We were hoping to get some rest after traveling at sea," Misty says.

Then Mew says, "We're traveling around the Orange Island so I can compete in the Orange League."

Then shows Nurse Joy her badges, "I've already got three badges so I need one more so I can compete."

"That's nice. You must be a good trainer," Nurse Joy says.

"I don't know about that," Mew says.

"Says the girl who won the Kanto Pokemon League and became the youngest trainer to do so," Misty says with a grin.

"Too true, but I still need to get my last badge in order to compete for the Orange League," Mew says.

"You're right about that, but for now, I think it's a good idea for us to have some fun," Misty says.

"Yeah. I want to explore the town," Tomo says.

"Me too," Jen replies.

Just then, Tomo and Jen's stomachs begin growling. Even the Pokemons' stomachs begin growling.

Tracey laughs and says, "I think the first thing we should do is get something to eat."

"Yeah. I'm getting kind of hungry," Mew says.

"There's a restaurant not far from here, and you're free to look around," Nurse Joy says.

"Great!" The group happily cheers.

After a talk with Nurse Joy, and deciding to reserve a room at the Pokemon Center for the night, the group decide to go to the small restaurant that Nurse Joy is talking about. They are having some dumplings, rice, some drinks, and other kinds of delicious food, including some hot soup.

"Hmm, the soup tastes really good," Misty says.

"I agree. The soup tasted really good, and so are the dumplings," Mew says.

"The food tastes great," Tracey says.

Tomo and Jen happily say, "Yeah!"

"So guys, what do you wanna do after eating?" Misty asks.

"Well, I think Sakura Town looks really nice. I would like to have a look around," Mew says.

"Yeah. I'll bet the town has some interesting places and other kinds of essentials. Maybe we'll even find some Pokemon," Tracey says.

Mew turns to the Pokemon, "You guys feel up exploring Sakura Town."

"Pika Pika," (I sure am.) Pikachu says.

"Eevee." (Yeah.) Eevee says.

All the Pokemon agree as well, and are excited.

"Alright then, we'll finish eating and then we'll explore around," Mew says.

Soon, everyone including the Pokemon continues to eat their lunch. Sometime later, Mew and the others begin looking around the town to see a lot of interesting stores with interesting items.

The first place they head to is a clothing store. Mew and the others look around to see so many different outfits for both male and female, and in many different shapes and colors. There's even some accessories.

"Wow. The kimonos look really pretty," Misty says.

"And look at some of the accessories they have," Mew says.

"There's even some for my size," Jen says.

"Amar," Amarua says, taking an interest in seeing a hat.

Tomo then notices the Pokemon masks, "Cool, they got masks too."

"And even hats and headbands," Tracey says.

"Let's try them on," Misty says.

"Yeah!" Mew and Jen happily say.

Soon, everyone begins to look around at the clothes, shoes, and accessories in the store. There are even some masks for them as well.

"Hey Mew, I think this one will be perfect for you," Misty says, and holds out a kimono.

Mew looks to see a white color along with some light blue, purple, and pink. The kimono also has a yellow obi.

"Wow. It looks really pretty," Mew says.

Just then, a female vendor says, "That kimono is a Cresselia kimono. It's a very nice outfit. It's designed to look like Cresselia, the Lunar Pokemon."

"It looks like a lovely kimono. I think I'll take it," Mew says.

"Maybe we can find more kimonos to see," Misty says.

The group continues to look around the store to find some outfits for them to wear. And soon, the group has outfits to wear. Mew is wearing the Cresselia kimono top with a white lily trouser, white zori sandals, and light pink bandana around her head. Misty is wearing a pink star pattern kimono top, black lily trousers, pink zori sandals, and a pink star hair clip. Tomo is wearing a sapphire kimono top, blue spruce cropped bottom, dark zori sandals, and wears an indigo twisted headband around his head. Tracey is wearing a green checkered kimono top, dark teal trouser, dark green sandals, and a tangerine headband. Last, Jen is wearing a light blue star kimono top, lily cropped bottom, pink zori sandals, and a Mime Jr mask.

After going to the store, Mew and the others are walking around the town. They look around to see the different stores. They find a grocery store and see the many different foods and beverages, including some items that could be found on the island. They even find a store that is full of items like medicine, healing potions, berries, and other essentials for both humans and Pokemon. Since Mew and the others need some more supplies, they decide to buy a few for them, along with other supplies they're able to find.

They also look around many other stores to see different kinds of jewelry, decor, even Pokemon based items, like clothes, accessories, masks, and other essentials.

They also go to a few stores, and other places, and now they decide to head to the outskirts of town. They are sitting under a large and beautiful tree with white flowers on its branches. The group are relaxing as they also have their snacks.

"This place is really nice," Mew says.

"I agree. This island is really peaceful," Misty says.

"And there's a lot of cool stuff there," Tomo replies.

Then Jen asks, "Can we stay here for a while?"

"Well, it wouldn't hurt for Lapras to get some rest, and we can get some rest too," Mew says.

"I agree. It wouldn't hurt for us to stay here for another day or so. It will help give our Pokemon a little vacation," Tracey says.

"Yeah!" Tomo and Jen happily cheer.

Just then, Togepi and Pichu, who are playing, hear something. They soon look around as they hear what sounds like footsteps. Curious to hear the noise, Togepi and Pichu run off to find the source.

However, Meloetta notices them and calls out, "Loetta. Meloett." (Pichu! Togepi!)

Then flies off after them. That catches the group's attention.

Misty notices, "Togepi! Pichu!"

"Meloetta!" Tomo calls out.

Soon, the group begins to follow them through the bushes.

Unknown to the group, Team Rocket who has followed them to the island, peek out from the bushes close by.

"Glad the twerps decide to find this island," Jessie says.

"Yes, and it's our perfect chance to catch Pikachu and Eevee," James says.

"Yeah. While the twerps are distracted, we'll grab them right under the twerpette's nose," Meowth says.

Then the evil maliciously chuckles, but quietly, and decides to follow Mew and the others.

Meanwhile, Togepi and Pichu continue to run through the woods to find the source of the footsteps. Meloetta follows after them. Mew and the others are also following behind Meloetta.

"I wonder where they're going," Jen replies.

"I don't know, but I hope they won't get too far from us," Misty says.

The group continues to rush after the Pokemon in order to catch up with them. Soon, Togepi and Pichu come to a stop after coming out of the bushes. Meloetta is able to catch up to them. Just then, the three Pokemon stop and notice something that catches their attention. Soon, Misty, Mew, and the others are able to reach the three Pokemon.

"There you two are. Togepi, Pichu, why did you two run off?" Misty asks, relieved and kneels down to them.

Tomo walks to Meloetta, "Hey Meloetta, what happened?"

Just then, Meloetta points ahead, "Meloetta Mel Mel." (Take a look over there.)

The group looks ahead and notices what looks like a large field that is next to a large lake with a waterfall close by. What's more, they see a small pillar shrine in front of the lake. On the shrine, there is a gray rock that looks like a crescent moon only more rounder. The last stone is some rectangular gray pearl color stone. It's smooth and has some rectangle pattern on the side.

"What is this place?" Misty asks, surprised.

"I never knew this place was on the island," Mew says.

"I wonder what this place is," Tracey says.

Suddenly, Pikachu and Eevee's ears twitch a bit. They soon turn their attention to their left and become curious. Smeargle, Stufful, Meloetta, Skwovet, and Amaura hear the strange sound as well. Then they all turn in the same direction.

"What is it everyone?" Mew asks.

"Pika Pikachu," (We hear someone coming.) Pikachu says.

"What did Pikachu say?" Misty asks.

"Piakchu said that someone is coming. We better hide,"Mew says.

Everyone agrees to the idea and quickly hides behind the trees and bushes close by. They all soon peek out to watch and see what happens. Unknown to the group, Team Rocket secretly peeks out from a tree a short distance away.

James whispers, "I wonder what the twerps are doing?"

"Maybe someone's coming," Jessie wonders.

Meowth shushes them, "Sssshhhhhh! I think the twerps have the right to hide. I hear someone coming."

James and Jessie nod their heads and remain quiet.

Mew and the others watch quietly from their hiding places when they see a group of Pokemon walk over from the woods. They see an Ursaring and a Scyther.

A Stantler, a quadrupedal, cervid Pokémon. It has a tan pelt with a cream-colored belly and a few spots on its back. Its tail is large, short, and round, and each of its legs ends in a black hoof. It has a large, brown nose and a pair of pale cream-colored antlers, each with a black orb in the center. The shape of the antlers and the black orbs causes them to resemble eyes.

Along with a bipedal mustelid Pokémon that resembles both a cat and a weasel. It is white and purple body with three bright purple feathers for its tail and a single one light purple feather on its left ear. The other ear is short and pointed, and it has narrow red eyes. The face, shoulders, and chest have dark purple spots and there is a yellow gem on both its head and chest. The two toes on each foot are closed, and it has rounder eyes,

Coming out of the water in the lake are two more Pokemon.

The first Pokemon is a sea dwelling piscine Pokemon with a spherical body and flat paddle-shaped tail. Its lower half is colored light yellow while the upper half is black with black spikes that have dark purple tips. The front spikes on their forehead are smaller. There are crescent purple lines underneath its eyes and its lips are colored purple. It now has a large, flat tail with a black outline and a purple inside, which also has a pattern that resembles the letter "q."

The second is a green aquatic Pokémon. It has a green, ovoid body, tapering off in the rear to a trapezoidal tail fin. A thick black stripe covers the top of their body from mouth to tail and a white, dorsal fin with four protrusions resembling spikes. Their lower jaw juts ahead of their upper jaw, with a small indent near the edges of their mouth. It also has its lower and upper jaws have beak-like protrusions at the front. It has three black dots on both sides of their body, behind their pectoral fins. It also has a very pale shade of light blue, as are its irises.

"It's an Ursaring and a Scyther," Tracey says, surprised.

"The Basculin looks like the ones I caught, but it has a white stripe," Misty says.

"And a Stantler," Tomo says.

The other two are a Sneasel and a Qwilfish, but they look different," Mew says.

Tracey turns to Mew, "Maybe Dexter might know them."

"Yeah. And let's see what Dexter has to say about those six Pokemon," Mew says and brings out her Pokedex.

Dexter says, "Ursaring, the Hibernator Pokémon and the evolved form of Teddiursa. A Normal Type. In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits."

"Stantler, the Big Horn Pokémon. A Normal Type. Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers."

"Scyther, the Mantis Pokémon. A Bug and Flying Type. It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking scythes. Its movements are like a ninja's."

"Basculin, the Mellow Pokemon. White-Striped Form. A Water Type. Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities."

"Sneasel, the Sharp Claw Pokémon. Hisuian Form. A Fighting and Poison Type. Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp."

"Qwilfish, the Balloon Pokémon. Hisuian Form. A Dark and Poison Type. Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions."

"Wow. So some of them are others from the Hisui Region," Jen says.

"Seems like it. I guess when the people of the Hisui Region came to the island, some of the Pokemon decided to come to the island as well," Mew adds.

"I wonder what they're doing here. And what are those stones on the small shrine?" Tomo replies.

"I don't know, but it seems those Pokemon are up to something," Tracey says. Then says, "I think it will be best to stay quiet and see what happens."

Everyone nods their heads and agrees to the idea. Team Rocket nod their heads agreeing with Tracey, even though he's not aware that they're there. They watch the four land Pokemon gather at the shrine as the two water Pokemon swim to it.

Stantler taps on its hoof on the ground and calls out, "Stantler Stant Stant Stantler!" (Let the Legends Evolution Ceremony commence!)

"Did that Stantler just say…" Tomo whispers.

"Evolution Ceremony…?" Mew adds.

Just then, the Hisuian Sneasel walks to the small shrine and picks up the gray crescent shaped rock.

"Sneasel picked a Razor Claw," Mew whispers.

Sneasel turns around as he takes a few steps away from the shrine. Then raises the stone to the bright sun. Just then, the Hisuian Sneasel begins to glow as its shape begins to change. Mew and the group, including Team Rocket, become surprised to see the Sneasel changing and evolving.

Soon, the Hisuian Sneasel becomes a different Pokemon. Now it's a bipedal weasel-like Pokémon. Its body is dark gray with purple accents around its face and ankles. Its fur is longer on its shoulders. It has long arms that extend to just above its ankles. On each arm is a dark brown spot, and its hands have three long claws, which are brown with three red lines streaking through. These claws are tipped with poison. Like its pre-evolved form, it has sharp, narrow eyes with red pupils and black markings resembling eyelashes on the edges. It has yellow diamond-shaped gems on its chest and head. Sneasler has three sharp toes on each foot. Its left ear has a long black and red feather that extends down to its back; it also has red and black feathers for a tail.

This really surprises Mew and the others.

"It evolved," Misty says.

"What is it?" Jen asks.

Still having her Pokedex out, Mew says, "Let's see…"

Then Dexter says, "Sneasler, the Free Climb Pokémon and the evolved form of a Hisuian Sneasel. A Fighting and Poison of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs."

As soon as it evolved, the Pokemon, Sneasler, walks away from the shrine and remains with the others. Then the Scyther walks to the shrine and picks up the black stone.

Tracey whispers, "It looks like Scyther picked up a Black Augurite."

Scyther then steps away from the shrine. Just then, it begins to evolve as well as it glows and changes its shape.

Soon, is now a mantis-like insect Pokémon with a craggy exoskeleton featuring a rock-like composition. Its predominantly beige and white body is adorned with numerous black rocky protrusions, including a ring of angular rocks on each of its shoulders, a mask of rock lining its brows down to its jawline, two sharp toe claws on each foot, and a single black shard of rock atop the crown of its head. It also has vestigial features on its wings, two spindly front limbs. end in large axe-like appendages made of heavy black rock.

Using her Pokedex, Dexter says, "Kleavor, the Axe Pokémon, and the evolved form of Scyther. A Bug and Rock Type. A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee. Scyther will only evolve into Kleavor using a Black Augurite."

"Wow. So Scyther has a different evolution form," Misty whispers.

"That's so cool," Tomo adds.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket is witnessing this as well.

"This is amazing," Jessie says, amazed.

"So these Pokemon are getting themselves ready to evolve," James says.

"If we can capture those evolved Pokemon, we'll be able to give them to the boss. And then the boss will give us a raise," Meowth says.

"And we'll be able to get a promotion," Jessie adds.

Then James whispers, "And maybe we can catch the twerps' Pokemon while we're add it."

They all snicker then sneak off to set their plan into motion to capture the Pokemon.

Just then, the White-Striped Basculin along with Hisuian Qwilfish begin to battle against one another. They both headbutted one another. Then Qwilfish uses Barb Barrage as Basculin performs Headbutt. Then Qwilfish performs Barb Barrage again. Then Qwilfish performs Water Gun, followed by Take Down. Basculin falls and splashes in the water, but is still up. As the two battle, Mew and the others watch.

"Wow, they're having a battle," Tracey says.

"Is this part of the ceremony?" Misty wonders.

"I'm not sure," Mew says. "Let's watch and see what happens.

Everyone nods their heads and agrees to watch.

Mew and the others continue to watch the two water Pokemon battle with one another. As they watch the battle, they notice that Qwilfish uses Barb Barrage multiple times. At the same time, Basculin has performed different attacks. That's not the only thing they notice. They notice that their attack is making water splash and shower all over the place, and a rainbow shines through it. As the two perform their last attack, they both come to a stop.

Just then, both of them begin to glow and evolve.

Qwilfish has evolved into a large, spherical Pokémon that resides in the sea. All over its body are overgrown conical spikes whose colors correspond to those on its body. Its top half is a black color while its bottom half is light yellow. In the middle of its body, the two colors create a pattern. The spikes on the top half of its body have parts of purple at their tips, and there are two very long spikes at the top and bottom of its body that jut out in a straight direction. Above its eyes and around part of the top half of its body, has circular purple dots. Its lips also have a purple coloration and appear puffy, and its small light-yellow eyes have purple pupils and are always fixated in an annoyed expression. In between its eyes are two pairs of spikes, the outer ones being longer and resembling eyebrows. Its large tail appears flat with a black outline and a purple inside, which also has a pattern that resembles the letter "Q."

The White-Striped Basculin has evolved into a large, green fish-like Pokémon. It has a jagged mouth with pointed teeth. Its spine is aligned with a dark gray line, with a colored line along it and extending around its gills, in addition to having spots along its torso and plumes of smoke around its tail, and have pale blue accents. Their eyes look rather sad. It has a pair of white pectoral fins, a three-spiked dorsal fin, and a two-spiked ventral fin. Additional smoke covers its face in a manner resembling barbels.

Mew uses her Pokedex to observe the Pokemon, and Dexter says, "Basculegion, the Big Fish Pokémon and the evolved form of Basculin. A Water and Ghost Type. Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal. When a White-Striped Basculin evolves into a Red Striped Basculegion when they're male, and evolves into a White-Striped Basculegion when they're female."

"Overqwil, the Pin Cluster Pokémon and the evolved form of Qwilfish. A Dark and Poison Type. Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself."

"Interesting, so part of the ceremony that they battle until they reach their evolution," Tracey says.

"Amazing," Jen says.

"So if that White-Striped Basculin became a White-Striped Basculegion, then that means that it's a girl," Misty replies.

"Seems like it," Mew says. "It also appears that Qwilfish is also using a specific move to help it evolve. I think."

"You might be right. Some Pokemon evolve by learning a specific move," Misty says.

Then Mew look at the Ursaring and the Stantler, "I wonder what those two will do for this ceremony."

"Yeah. It's already getting dark," Tracey says.

Indeed, the sun is already setting and it's starting to get dark. They have to wonder what the ceremony involves.

"I wonder if part of the ceremony has to be taken at night," Misty replies.

"Possibly," Mew replies.

"Let's see what they do," Jen replies.

Everyone nods their heads.

Soon, Stantler and Ursaring begin to have a battle. Ursaring performs Fury Swipe. However, Stantler dodges and performs Stomp. Ursaring then begins to perform Slash, but Stantler uses Psyshield Bash at Ursaring with strong force. Mew and the others continue to watch the two Pokemon and see that Stantler has been using Psyshield Bash multiple times. Ursaring continues to perform attacks like Hammer Arm, Metal Claw, Night Slash, it even knows movies like Mega Kick, Mega Punch, and Rock Smash. Stantler continues to use attacks like Zen Headbutt, Take Down, Megahorn, even Giga Impact. And yet, it continues to use Psyshield Bash multiple times. Time has gone by, and it's already night time. As soon as Stantler performs the last Psyshield Bash, and Ursaring performs the last attack, Mega Punch, they both soon stop.

Just then, Stantler begins to evolve. After glowing and changing shape, Stantler is now a snow deer-like Pokémon. It has a gray and white body with white spots and eyebrows. The antlers are gold with four spikes extending outwards and one black orb on each. Wyrdeer has a brown nose and black hooves. It has a white mane resembling a beard and a round, white tail. The lower portions of its legs are white with spiky fur on each one.

Dexter says, "Wyrdeer, the Big Horn Pokémon and the evolved form of Stantler. A Normal and Psychic Type. The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing."

"Amazing," Misty says.

"It has really nice fur," Jen says.

"This is amazing," Tracey says.

"And it looks like Ursaring is the last one," Mew says.

"I wonder what it's going to evolve too," Tomo replies, curiously.

"I don't know, but I can't wait to see," Mew whispers.

Ursaring begins to walk to the shrine to pick up the stone. Before it can reach the stone, a net appears out of nowhere in the sky and captures Ursaring, shocking Mew and the others. And soon, multiple nets come down from the sky and capture the other Pokemon. Then begin to carry them in the sky.

"What's going on?" Tracey exclaims.

"Someone's capturing the pokemon," Musty says.

"There's only one group who would be pulling this stunt," Mew says.

Suddenly they hear Meowth's voice, "That's right twerpette!"

The group looks up to see a large Pidgeot like robot. Inside the cockpit with a window viewing its team rocket.

Jessie:

Prepare for trouble! You already know who we are!

James:

Make it double! We're in the sky so far!

Jessie:

To protect the world from devastation!

James:

To unite all peoples within our nation.

Jessie:

To denounce the evils of truth and love!

James:

To extend our reach to the stars above.

Jessie:

Jessie!

James!

Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light!

James:

Surrender now, or prepare to fight.

Meowth:

Meowth! That's right!

Mew angrily shouts, "Team Rocket! You let those Pokemon go!"

"That's right! They're in the middle of their ceremony, and you're ruining it!" Misty calls out.

"Let them go!" Tracey calls out.

"Or else!" Tomo and Jen call out.

All the Pokemon agree.

"Sorry twerps, but these Pokemon belong to us," Jessie says.

"And they'll become full members of Team Rocket," James says.

"And there's nothing you can do about it," Meowth says.

"We'll see about that," Tracey says.

Then throws his Pokeball, "Go Scyther!

Then Tomo throws his Pokeball, "Skarmory, I choose you!"

Soon, Scyther and Skarmory come out of their Pokeballs.

Tracy calls out, "Scyther, use Fury Cutter!"

Then Tomo calls out, "Skarmory, use Slash!"

Scyther and Skarmory then use their attacks to cut the net off of the machine, causing the Pokemon to fall. That causes Team Rocket to freak out.

"Golduck!" Misty calls out and throws her Pokeball.

Then Mew throws her Pokeball, "Drowzee!"

Then both Pokemon come out of their Pokeballs.

Then both girls call out, "Use Psychic!"

Both Golduck and Drowzee use their attacks to catch the Pokemon with their Psychic ability, and gently place them on the ground.

Mew and the others rush to the Pokemon and remove the nets off of them. Misty and Jen help return the Water Pokemon to the lake.

"Are you all okay?" Jen asks.

All the Pokemon nod their heads.

"They seem to be fine," Tracey says.

Suddenly, they hear Jessie shouts, "Hey Twerps!"

The group looks up to see Team Rocket in their Pidgeot Robot in the air.

"If you think you can free what we're about to steal, you've got another thing coming!" Jessie angrily says.

"Yeah. We stole those Pokemon fair and square!" James says.

"So if you don't want to get blown away by our robot, you better give us all the Pokemon," Meowth says.

"No way!" The humans deny.

"We're not letting you capture these Pokemon and ruin their ceremony!" Mew says.

"You'll have to go through us first!" Tomo says.

Just then, Ursaring taps on Mew's shoulder.

Mew turns to Ursaring and asks, "What is it Ursaring?

Ursaring answers, "Ursa Ursa Ursaring." (Bring me the Peat Block, on the shrine.)

"The block?" Mew says, confused.

She turns her head to notice the gray block from earlier is still on the shrine. Mew walks to the shrines, picks it up and brings it to Ursaring.

"Is this one it?" Mew asks.

Ursaring nods his head in reply, "Ursa Ursaring." (Everyone stands back.)

Then Mew translates, "Everything Ursaring said to stand back."

Everyone quickly stands back as Mew gives Ursaring the Peat Block. Soon, Ursaring begins to glow and evolve along with the full moon's light. Soon, Ursaring is now a large, quadrupedal dark brown bear Pokémon with a gray pelt around its back, paws, and round tail. The pelt has nine rectangle brown spikes on its back and four spikes on each side of its head. The front paws have five claws each while the back paws have three claws. The face is brown with a light yellow circle at the forehead, two gray eyebrows, and a light yellow snout with a small black nose.

Then the new Pokemon before them let out a mighty roar.

"What is that Pokemon?" Tracey asks.

"It's really big," Tomo says.

Mew brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Ursaluna, the Peat Pokémon and the evolved form of Ursaring. A Ground and Normal Type. It is believed it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will."

Looking at the Pokedex, Mew says, "And it looks like Ursaluna has learned a new move."

Ursaluna then begins a powerful Hyper Beam attack. It's more than enough to knock the robot out of the sky and it lands on the grounds of the large clearing. Then Ursaluna performs a powerful move known as Headlong Rush. Then strikes at Team Rocket with full force, destroying their robots, and Team Rocket lands on the ground in front of it and is covered in bruises and debris.

"Looks like those Pokemon are tougher than they look," Meowth says.

"Maybe too tough," James adds.

Jessie says, feeling dizzy, "And that move packs a punch.

Just then, Mew calls out, "Alright Pikachu, Eevee, use Thunderbolt!"

Pikachu and Eevee perform Thunderbolt and strike at Team Rocket with full force. That causes an explosion and sends them flying.

They all scream, "We're blasting off again!"

And soon they aren't seen anymore.

"So long!" Jen calls out

Then Tomo sticks his tongue out.

After the fight, Mew and the others help the Pokemon clear out the mess Team Rocket has made. Luckily, the place hasn't suffered any serious damage. Soon, the clearing along with the shrine and lake have been cleaned of the wreckage of the Team Rocket's machine.

"There we go, everything is all fixed," Mew says.

Then Tracey turns to the Pokemon, "Sorry about your ceremony got interrupted by Team Rocket."

The Pokemon replies at the same time.

"They said that it's okay, and understand that it's Team Rocket's fault. Plus, they said that the ceremony was at its end until Team Rocket interrupted them," Mew says.

"Well, it was great to see your ceremony. It's very interesting," Misty says.

"It was awesome," Tomo says

"It was incredible," Jen says.

Just then, Ursaluna walks over to Mew and snuggles his head against her with a calm smile. Then Kleavor walks to Tracey, and Wyrdeer walks to Tomo. Then Basculegion and Overqwil look out for Misty and Jen's attention.

"I think they want to come with us," Mew says.

"I think you're right," Tomo says.

Misty and Jen then walk to the Water Pokemon to see them. Basculegion swims to Misty while Overqwil swims to Jen.

"I think they do want to come with us," Misty says.

Then Wyrdeer says, "Wyr Wyr Wyr Wyrdeer." (We've all decided to come with you, young ones.)

"Wydeer says that they decided to come with us," Tomo says.

Then Sneasler says, "Sneasler Sneasl Sneasl Sneasl Sneasler. (I don't plan on being caught by you, but I don't mind tagging along.)

"If you say so. You can be with me for the time being," Mew says.

Sneasler nods its head in reply.

Mew smiles and says, "Don't worry everyone, we'll be sure to take good care of everyone."

Misty then yawns, "Sorry guys, but I'm starting to get tired."

"Well, it's getting really late. We should get back to the Pokemon Center," Tracey says.

"Yeah," Jen replies.

Then Mew says, "Alright everyone, let's get to the Pokemon Center and get a well deserved sleep."

Sometime later, after making new friends and catching them in the Pokeballs, Mew and the others return to the Pokemon Center and get some well deserved sleep. All Mew and the group, along with Pikachu, Eevee, and the other Pokemon are fast asleep in their beds. However, unknown to the sleeping friends, a mysterious figure is looking through the bedroom window to see them. Whatever it is, the figure appears to be rather small. Then leaves as it appears.

Chapter 37: Episode 33: Of Thieves and Tricksters

Still staying at Hisui Island for a vacation, Mew and the others have been spending a few days on the island to have some rest. One day, Mew and the others are in a small restaurant having some lunch. As the group has their lunch, they are also having a conversation.

"Hisui Island is a great island to go to," Misty says.

"It sure is, but we should also be heading to the next island. I still plan to earn my last badge to compete in the Orange League," Mew says.

"You're right," Jen replies.

Then Tomo asks, "So which Island has the next gym?"

Tracey takes out the map as he says, "Let's see."

He then places the map on the table for everyone to see.

"Hmm, according to the map, Kumquat Island has an Orange Crew Gym, but it does seem a bit far," Mew says.

"And it looks like it will take some time getting there," Jen says.

Then Tracey says, "But according to the map, there are a few islands on the route to Kumquat Island."

"Sounds like we got our route and our next island for my gym battle," Mew says.

"Yeah. Wonder what the next gym would be like?" Tomo replies.

"I'll bet the gym leader would be really tough," Misty says.

"Yeah. And wouldn't be surprised if the challenges at the gym would be different as well," Mew says.

"But I know you can win it," Tomo says.

"Yeah!" Jen happily says.

Mew giggles and says, "Thanks, but I have to keep in mind that the gym leader would be a tough opponent to battle with."

"It's good to keep that in mind. We won't know until we get there," Tracey says.

"Now that's done, what you guys wanna do. We're planning on heading out later today," Mew says.

"I like to check out some of the shops some more," Misty says.

"Me too!" Jen happily says.

"Sounds good to me," Mew says. "Let's finish eating and then we can have a look around, get some more supplies, and we'll be on our way."

The group nod their heads and agree to the idea, and then they continue eating their lunch. Unknown to the group, a pair of figures is watching the group of friends from the window of the restaurant.

Sometime later, Mew and the others are in one of the stores looking around and see if there's stuff they like to buy. Misty and Jen are looking at the accessories. Jen then picks up a necklace. It has a white lace and it has a pink flower with five petals on it.

"Wow. This necklace is so pretty," Jen happily says.

Then turns to Misty, "Can I get it Misty."

"Sure. We'll get it after I'm done looking around," Misty says.

"Okay," Jen says

"Hey guys, look at this cool mask I found," Mew says.

The group turns to see an interesting looking mask. The mask is a grayish color that has large pointed ears with light purple tips. The mask also has white or lightish purple hair with purple at front. Along with yellow eyes, and purple and pale purple marking around the eyelids. It also has a bit of a long nose. The mask actually almost looks like a kind of fox.

"That's a cool mask," Tracey says.

"Yeah. It looks awesome.

"That's a Baneful Fox Mask. It's a very unique mask that resembles Zoroark from the Hisui Region," The female owner says.

"A Zoroark Mask?" Mew replies, taking an interest.

"Yes," The owner nods her head.

"Wow. A Zoroark in the Hisui Region is different from the Zoroark I've seen in books," Mew says.

Then says, "I think I'll buy this."

Suddenly, they hear someone say, "Hey, have you heard? Another Yuki was robbed yesterday."

Mew and her friends turn to see a group of people discussing it.

"Really," A woman asks.

"Yes. According to her, she and her brothers were walking down the street of the village and ran into those two strange girls that came to the island three weeks ago," The man says.

Another world says, "Strange things have been happening when those two girls show up, but I don't want to make any unnecessary assumptions."

"I have to agree, but many of the victims who have been robbed at least had some conversation with those girls one way or another," The chubby man says.

Then the elderly man says, "That's true, but we had no proof to confirm them."

"Is there anything being done about it?" The third woman asks.

"Well, Officer Jenny is doing her best to investigate the two girls, but they always seem to disappear before we can find him," The man says.

"I wonder where those girls are whenever they're not in town," The woman wonders.

Mew and the others look at each other, confused and concerned.

After looking and buying their things, Mew and the others are walking around the town. Jen is happily wearing the necklace Misty has bought her. Mew simply has the mask in her bag.

Tracey asks, "So what do you think of what we heard?"

"It sounds like the situation was serious," Misty says.

"Yeah. Hearing the conversation, it makes you wonder if those two girls are responsible for the robberies," Mew says.

"But like what we hear, there isn't much proof to confirm it," Tomo says.

"I guess you're right," Jen says.

Tracey says, "It would help if they know more about those girls. They said that they arrived on the island a couple of weeks ago, and the robbery began soon after."

"I think it's best we leave this to Officer Jenny," Misty says.

"You might be right. Let's go to the store and get some more supplies before we continue our travels," Mew says.

Not long, Mew and the others are in the store to gather some supplies, medicine, berries, potions, healing potions, and other kinds of supplies. Jen is looking around the store to see the items in the store and wonder if there's anything else they need. Just then, she bumps into someone.

"Oops, sorry about that," Jen says.

Jen looks up to see a young girl. She has white hair with a red tint at the end, and gold yellow eyes and pink eyelids. She is wearing a red kimono top, white shorts, white socks and light red sandals, and has her hair in a ponytail.

"Oh, hello. Who are you?" Jen replies.

The young girl doesn't answer and tilts her head with a smile.

"Um okay, my name is Jen. What's your name?" Jen replies.

However, the little girl continues to not say a word.

"Um alright. So what brings you here?" Jen asks.

However, the girl begins to look at Jen and circles around her with curious eyes. She then smiles and takes her hand and pulls her away.

"Wait, where are we going?" Jen asks.

The young girl walks down the aisle with Jen and soon finds themselves in front of a shelf that has stuffed Pokemon dolls on it.

"Wow. All these Stuffed Pokemon look really cute," Jen happily says and turns to the girl.

The girl happily nods her head and gives Jen a hug.

Jen giggles, "Hey, this is kind of sudden." and continues to giggle.

Then the young girl lets go of Jen and begins to take her leave.

Jen waves goodbye, "Bye."

The girl waves her hand goodbye and runs out of the store and seems happy.

Jen replies with a confused look, "What a strange girl."

"Hey Jen," Tomo's voice calls out.

Jen turns around to see Mew and the others walking towards her.

"Oh, hi guys," Jen replies.

"We got all the supplies we need, so we'll be heading out very soon," Tracey says.

"Oh, okay," Jen says.

Just then, Amaura notices something different about Jen and calls out, "Amurrrr Amurrr!" (Jen, your necklace!)

Jen turns to Amura, "What is it, Amura?"

"Amaura said something about your necklace…" Mew says.

Just then, Misty notices, "Jen, your necklace is gone!"

"What?!" Jen asks, shocked.

She looks down to notice the necklace that Misty has bought for her is no longer around her neck.

Soon, she begins to panic, "My necklace! It's gone!"

"Calm down Jen, maybe you dropped it somewhere, or perhaps you notice something out of the ordinary," Mew replies.

"No. Not really. The only thing strange that happened was this young girl who came up to me and…" Jen explains.

But Tomo interrupts her, "What girl?"

"A little girl who looks like she's around Mew's age, and she took me to see the stuffed Pokemon, and then hugged me out of nowhere," Jen explains.

"You don't suppose the girl took your necklace when she hugged you?" Misty asks.

"It's possible," Mew says.

"It is," A voice says.

The group turns their heads to see a young girl. The young girl has short gray hair with white and blue accent tips at the end, along with light gold yellow eyes. She is wearing a gray kimono top with a cyan blue obi, dark gray bots, light gray shorts, and wearing a white scarf.

"Hello. Who might you be?" Mew asks, with a smile.

"Um, my name is Zo. It's nice to meet you," The young girl says.

"It's nice to meet you too," Mew says.

Then asks, "Do you know something about those girls?"

"Not much, but um, I saw the girl ran out of the store with the necklace, but I don't know where she went," Zo replies.

"That's okay, but maybe you can help us," Mew says.

Zo gives Mew a smile and says, "Okay."

Then Tracey says, "We better go find Officer Jenny and asks about that little girl."

The group nod their heads and leave the store. Unaware of the group, Team Rocket, who has returned after being blasted off, peek out from behind one of the store aisle and see Mew and the others leaving the store in a hurry.

"You guys saw it right?" James asks.

"Yeah. The little twerpette has her necklace taken by that strange girl," Jessie says.

"There's something weird about that little girl," Meowth says.

"And the twerps just ran out," James says.

Then Jessie whispers, "We should follow them. We might be able to catch them off guard and take Pikachu and Eevee."

Then the three snicker in reply.

Soon, Mew and the others are able to find Officer Jenny. Jenny is wearing a pale blue and blue kimono top with a pale blue obi, a blue trouser and black boots.

"So you have something taken as well?" Jenny asks.

"Yes. My necklace disappeared after talking to a young girl," Jen answers.

Jenny sighs and says, "Just like the other reports I've been receiving."

"Did anyone who had something taken mention either one or two girls, and one of them has white hair with red tip ends, and gold yellow eyes?" Mew asks.

"Yes. And she's been seen with a teenager girl with dark red hair with black tips, and some hair tie at the end of her hair. Her eyes are also red-rimmed with light blue irises," Jenny says.

Misty turns to Jen, "Did you see a girl like that when you saw the little girl?"

"No," Jen answers.

"But it's possible that she was close by," Mew says.

"Maybe. I'll do whatever I can, but it's hard to tell where they went off to after they've stolen something," Jenny says.

After talking to Jenny, Mew and the others decide to walk around town. Even though Jenny decides to do the best she can, Mew and the others decide to try to help Jen find the girl who has taken the necklace. Jen sadly sighs about her necklace being taken from right under her nose.

Misty reassures her, "Don't worry Jen, we'll find that girl and get your necklace back."

"She's right. We're not leaving until we find her," Mew says.

"But where do we start looking to find those girls?" Tracey asks.

"Maybe we could ask around and see if anyone knows anything about the girls or where they live?" Tomo suggests.

"Good idea, and we'll do better if we split up," Mew says.

Everyone nods their heads, agreeing to the idea. Then they split up and asks around.

Misty, Tracey, and their Pokemon asks one of the store owners where the two girls are living.

However, the owner says, "Sorry, but I have no idea where those two live. In fact, I haven't seen them around except when the thefts happen."

Mew, Tomo, and Jen, along with their Pokemon at the Pokemon Center, asks Nurse Joy about them.

Sadly, Nurse Joy says, "I'm sorry, but I don't know where they live, and they aren't staying at the Pokemon Center either."

"Okay Nurse Joy," Mew says.

"I'm sorry I couldn't help you," Nurse Joy says.

"It's okay Nurse Joy. You did your best," Mew says.

Sometime later, the group meet up again and soon find themselves at the outskirts of town to discuss what they find out.

"So you didn't find any information about those girls?" Misty asks.

"Not much to be honest. In fact, no one seems to know much about those girls," Mew says.

"No one seems to know where they live, so it's possible they don't even live in town," Tracey says.

"But if they don't live here or they're staying in the Pokemon Center, where are they living while being on this island?" Tomo asks.

Mew then turns to Zo, "Hey Zo, do you know anything about those girls?"

"Well, not a lot, but um," Zo replies, sounding a bit timid.

She places her hands behind her back as she gently kicks her left foot on the dirt.

"It's okay Zo, just tell us everything you know," Mew says.

"Well, I don't know where they live, but I noticed that they always leave the town and head towards the mountains. Maybe that is where they went," Jen says.

"The mountains? Why would they go there?" Misty asks.

"I don't really know. Maybe they live there," Zo replies.

"Well, it's worth a shot, let's head over there right now," Mew says.

With that, the group begins to walk towards the mountains on the outskirt of town. However, Team Rocket is secretly following behind them. They all snicker and shush each other as they secretly follow the group from behind.

Mew and the others continue to walk along the train and soon reach the small peak area of the mountain. Suddenly, the group begins to hear depressed and sad nosis.

Misty notices the whimpering and asks, "What's that sound?"

Mew and the others stop to hear the noises.

Jen turns her head towards the bushes, "it seems to be coming from the bushes."

Mew and the others slowly walk towards the bushe to find the source of the sound. To their surprise, they see four Pokemon.

The first Pokemon looks like a Growlithe, but its fur is dark orange-red, while its mane and tail are light gray, and its muzzle is a light tan. The fur is made out of igneous rock components. Its mane covers its eyes and extends below its head, ending with three curls. Its ears are round and square with light orange-red interiors. It has a small horn in its head and its tail is curly.

The second Pokemon looks like a Voltorb, but has a different appearance. It has a wood grain pattern and a hole on top, from which it discharges all of its stored electricity while lacking the latch. On the inside, they contain numerous seeds, but it has been impossible to examine their interior due to it being pitch-black. It also has a distinctive red wooden unibrow.

And the last two are Lilligant, but are really different. One Lilligant has a thinner build. Its head and body are white, and the latter is covered in light green leaves, with two small slightly darker leaves coming out from either side. On the left side of its head is a six-petaled pink flower with short filaments jutting out from it, and dark green leaves underneath it. The scent released from this flower causes anyone nearby to experience a heartened feeling. Its eyes are light pink and purple. The leaves on its head that resemble hair are much shorter than on Unovan Lilligant. The sepal around its neck is also smaller. Its arms are green, with its forearms being a lighter green. They are much longer and thinner than those of Unovan Lilligant. It also has long, powerful legs, and they are white with a dark pink gradient at the calves. Its feet are golden and cover part of its legs, and they seem to resemble dance shoes or snow boots.

The second Lilligant has different colors. Its head and body are white, and the latter is covered in light yellow-green leaves, with two small slightly darker leaves coming out from either side. On the left side of its head is a six-petaled orange flower with short filaments jutting out from it, and blue-green leaves underneath it. The scent released from this flower causes anyone nearby to experience a heartened feeling. Its eyes are dark orange-red. Its arms are blue-green, with its forearms being a lighter yellow-green. It also has long, powerful legs, and they are white with a dark orange. Its feet are golden and cover part of its legs, and they seem to resemble dance shoes or snow boots.

"What are they?" Tomo asks.

"One of them looks like a Growlith, another looks like a Voltorb, and they're two Lilligants, but they don't look like the ones I've seen," Tracey says.

They must be Hisuian Pokemon," Mew says, and takes out her Pokedex.

Dexter informs, "Growlithe, Hisuian Form. The Scout Pokemon. A Fire and Rock Type. They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat."

"Voltorb, Hisuian Form. The Sphere Pokemon. An Electric and Grass Type. An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh."

"Lilligant. Hisuian Form. The Spinning Pokemon, and the evolved form of Petilil. A Grass and Fighting Type. It's suspected that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity."

"Wow. So that's what the Hisuian form of Growlithe, Voltrob, and Lilligant look like," Misty says, amazed.

"And one of the Lilligant is a Shiny Pokemon," Tomo adds.

Then Jen notices, "They look sad."

"I wonder what happened," Tracey replies.

Mew steps forward, "I'll go asks, maybe they see the two girls around."

"Okay, but be careful," Tracey says.

Mew nods her head. Pikachu and Eevee follow from behind to back Mew up.

Mew calmly calls out, "Um excuse us."

The four Pokemon turn to Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee in surprise.

"Oh, sorry for startling you, but we want to know if you've seen two girls. One is a little girl with white hair with red ends and gold yellow eyes, and the other is supposed to be a teenager that has red and black hair, and blue eyes. You see, one of them has taken one of my friends' necklace and we're trying to find them," Mew says.

The four Pokemon look at each other.

Then the Shiny Hisuian Lilligant explains, "Lilli Lilli Lilligant." (Some of our food have been stolen.)"

"Really?" Mew asks

"Lilligant." (Yes.) Shiny Hisuian Lilligant answers.

Then Hisuian Lilligant says, "Lilli Lilligant Lilligant Gant Gant Lilli Lilligant." (We actually saw the teenager girl you speak up with red hair and our berries disappeared.)

"Volt Volt Voltorb," (And saw her and the younger girl with white and red hair leave together with the berries," Hisuian Voltorb says.

Then Grwolithe barks, as it says, (We tried to follow them but they disappeared. They've been stealing some of our berries for the past week.)

"I see, so you were robbed as well," Mew says.

The four Pokemon nod their heads in reply.

Then asks, "Do you think you can show us where you last saw those girls?"

"Lilligant," (Of course.) Hisuian Lilligant replies.

And so, the two Hisuian Lilligants, Hisuian Growlithe, and Hisuian Voltorb lead Mew and her friends to where they last saw the two girls. Turns out, they've seen her somewhere up the mountain. They walk higher up the trail and towards the snowy part of the mountains.

Misty shivers as she wraps her arms around herself, "Brrrr! It's starting to get cold."

"Yeah. It's getting really cold as we climb up the mountain," Mew says.

Jen looks to notice Amura is having fun in the snow.

"It looks like Amaura is having fun," Jen says with a smile.

Soon enough, the group and the Pokemon come to a stop.

Growlithe barks in reply.

"Looks like they seem to have disappeared somewhere around here," Tracey says.

"I wonder if they're nearby," Misty replies, looking around.

"It's possible," Jen replies.

Mew looks around and says, "Where could they be?"

Just then, Zo walks forward and looks around. Mew, the others, including the Pokemon follow from behind.

"Hey Zo, where are you going?" Mew asks.

"Follow me," Zo replies.

Mew and the others become confused and begin to follow Zo to who knows where. Zo soon leads the group to a large cave. Mew and the others become surprised to see the young girl from earlier, and a teenager girl a little older than Mew walk out. She has the same eye color and hair color Nurse Joy describes, and she is wearing a black and red kimono top with black bottoms, and boots.

Everyone quickly hides behind the bushes before the girls can see them.

"It's her. The girl from earlier," Jen says.

"You're right, and that must be the other girl that Officer Jenny told us about," Misty says.

"I wonder what they're up to," Mew says.

The group waits as they watch the two girls talking.

The young girl says, "Mother, do you think we should keep doing this?"

"I know it's hard, but it does seem like the only way for us to get food, and to be sure we're not seen by humans," The teenage girl says.

Then asks, "Where's your older sister?"

"I'm not sure. I haven't seen her," The girl says.

Then asks, "Maybe we should go find her?"

"I have to agree," The teenage girl says.

Behind the bushes, Misty turns to the others and asks, "I wonder what they're talking about?"

"Whatever it is, it seems that there's one more besides those two," Tracey says.

"Maybe," Jen says.

"But why did the little girl call the other girl mother?" Mew wonders.

Suddenly Tomo lets out a big sneeze, loud enough to catch the two girl's attention.

"Tomo?" Mew whispers.

"Sorry, it's really cold here. I think I'm starting to catch a cold," Tomo says.

Suddenly, the group turned their heads to notice something land behind them. They quickly turn around to see the teenage girl Appearing behind her, but a strange red glow emits from her body. Then her form begins to change.

What once the teenage woman is now a bipedal, slate gray, fox-like Pokémon with crimson and black accents. It has a pointed snout and ears with red insides. It also has some red rimming its eyes and mouth. It has a large, red, voluminous mane with black tips, tied into a ponytail, as a teal bangle down its length separates a mass of the mane from the lower portion. It has a black ruff on its upper body, pointed at the shoulders from which its arms extend. Its upper arms are thin, whereas its lower arms, while still slim, are bulkier. The arms have spiky extensions of fur at the elbows, and it has red claws on its hands and feet, and eyes are red-rimmed with light blue irises.

"What is that?" Jen exclaims in shock.

"It looks like Tomo's Zorura!" Misty says.

"But it's even bigger!" Tracey says.

"That's a Zoroark!" Mew says.

Mew brings out her Pokedex, and Dexter says, "Zoroark, the Illusion Fox Pokémon and the evolved form of Zorua. A Dark Type. If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods."

"What's a Zorark doing here?" Tracey asks.

"And why is it mad?" Misty asks.

"Maybe it's because we invaded its territory," Tracey says.

Just then, Zo quickly gets in front of them and quickly says, "Wait."

This has Zoroark in shock.

Then Zo says, "Please don't hurt them, mother. They don't mean any harm."

Just then, the little girl rushes over and asks, "Sister, what are you doing with the humans? Mother said we can't be around them."

"Sister?" Tracey says, confused.

"What do you guys mean?" Misty asks.

Mew kneels to Zo and asks, "You're not really human are you?"

"No I'm not. Not even Zo, or my mother," Zo says.

Just then, Zo and the young girl both change their shape into what looks like Zorura, but something is different about them.

The girl who has taken the necklace is mainly light gray with red and white accents. Its ears are primarily gray with split cuts and a slight red tint at the tips. Its eyes have golden yellow irises and pink eyelids, and its limbs are tipped in black. The tuft of fur on its head, the ruff around its neck, and its tail are all white at their bases, with long wisps of fur that fade to red at the tips, and they are all smoother in appearance.

As for Zo, her fur is mainly more grayish gray with blue and white accents. Its ears are primarily gray with split cuts and a slight blue tint at the tips. Its eyes have golden yellow irises and cyan blue eyelids, and its limbs are tipped in black. The tuft of fur on its head, the ruff around its neck, and its tail are all white at their bases, with long wisps of fur that fade to blue at the tips, and they are all smoother in appearance. In fact, she's actually almost twice as large as the white one.

"They're Zorua, but they're so different," Tracey says.

"Let's see," Mew says and points to her Pokedex.

Dexter says, "Zorura, Hisuian Form. The Spiteful Fox Pokemon. A Normal and Ghost Type. A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice."

"Malice? These little guys." Jen says confused.

"They actually look kind of cute," Misty says.

Mew then asks, "Zo, what's going on? What's all this about?"

"I'm sorry for deceiving you like this, Mew, but being in this form is better for me to talk to you. And I felt that you can help me and my family," The Hisuian Zorua says in Zo's voice.

Just then, the other Hisuian Zorua asks, "Big sister, are you sure these humans are not mean?"

"I'm positive. I want us to stop taking things, especially from the townspeople. Even though, it felt like we didn't have another voice at the time," Zo says.

"Zo, you knew about this?" Misty asks.

"Yes. Regretfully, I'm actually helping my mother and sister take things, well, I act as they get away with my illusions. However, I'm starting to see how wrong this is, even though we didn't have much choice. Given what we've been through and what our ancestors went through," Zo explains.

Just then, Zoroark says, "I'll explain it from here. Normally, I wouldn't associate with humans, but my eldest daughter seems to have trust in you."

"It would be nice if you can tell us the story, and why you've been stealing things," Tracey says.

Then the red Hisuian Zorua says, "Well, the stealing stuff is originally a prank to be honest. We just like to play tricks on people."

"I wouldn't call stealing a prank," Tomo says.

Mew turns to Zoroark, "Um can you continue?"

"Of course. The story has been passed down from generations, us Zorua and Zoroark have always been disliked by humans because of our illusions and trickery, and so we've been exiled. As a result, many of us moved to the Hisui Region, but due to the harsh weather, it's hard for many of us to survive. Legend has it, being chased by humans, a young Zoraua lost its life, and the Zoroark parent grows resentful towards humans for what they've done. And the Zoroark and Zorua changed drastically due to the weather, and became the form my children became. As well as the Zoroark changed as well. Over the years, many of the Zorark and Zorua do their best to remain hidden from humans. This island also became home to a few of both the Zorua and Zoroark that are more common to you, and those of the Hisuian Region, were able to make a home here. Some decide to travel out, and those who did return here. And what's what I did, especially when I have my daughters. I suspect they came from my mother. We mainly take food and things that we need, and some are trickery," Zorark explains.

Then the young red Zorark says, "We're sorry for stealing things, but we do need food and medicine."

Then Zo says, "And I'm sorry for not telling you the truth."

"It's okay. We're not mad. I'm just surprised," Mew says.

"You surely took us by surprise," Jen replies.

"Yeah," Tomo says.

"You mean, you forgive us?" Zo asks.

"Of course, but the rest of the town you took stuff from, it might take a little time to forgive," Mew says.

"You're right," Zo says.

She then says, "You're very nice. I kind of know that since I first saw you."

"First saw me?" Mew says, confused.

Zo blushes and says, "Yes. I first saw you and your friends save some Pokemon from those strange people, and they decided to come with you, willingly. And so I decided to follow you and saw you sleeping in the Pokemon Center. I felt that maybe you can help us somehow."

Zo then jumps on Mew and snuggles her.

Mew giggles and says, "You're actually very sweet. As a human and a Pokemon."

Then the red Hisuian Zorua walks over and presents Jen her necklace.

"My necklace," Jen says surprised.

Then the Zorua says, "I'm sorry I've taken it. It was kind of supposed to be a trick and such. Again, I'm sorry for taking your necklace."

Jen smiles and pet Zorua and says, "I forgive you."

Jen then takes the necklace and places it around the Hisuian Zorua's neck, "There. You look nice."

"Thank you," Zorua says.

The Zorua then walks to Zoroark with glee. Zoroark simply smiled in reply.

Suddenly, a net comes down and captures the two Pokemon, Then lifts them up in the air.

Zo cries out, "Sister! Mother!"

"What's going on?!" Misty exclaims.

Suddenly, they hear a familiar mancially laugh, and look up to see the two Pokemon trapped in a net and held from under Team Rocket's balloon. Soon, Team Rocket performs their motto.

Jessie:

Prepare for trouble! It's time for a second try!

James:

Make it double! We're up in the sky!

Jessie:

To protect the world from devastation!

James:

To unite all peoples within our nation.

Jessie:

To denounce the evils of truth and love!

James:

To extend our reach to the stars above.

Jessie:

Jessie!

James:

James!

Jessie:

Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light!

James:

Surrender now, or prepare to fight.

Meowth:

Meowth! That's right!

"Those are the bad people that I saw!" Zo replies.

Mew demands, "Team Rocket, you let Zo's mother and sister go!"

"Sorry twerpette, but we catch them fair and square," Jessie mocks.

"And we'll take your pikachu, Eevee, and the Shiny Zorua too while we're adding it," James says.

Then Meowth says, "So just hand them over!"

"No way!" Misty denies.

"That's right! We're not letting you take any of them!" Mew says.

Then turns to Eevee, "Eevee, use Swift!"

Eevee then jumps in the air and performs Swift Attack. Soon, the Swift Attack cuts the net into shreds and the two Pokemon are free and falling to the snowy ground. Team Rocket panic as they seem to lose their catch. Zoroark is able to land on the ground safely, but Zorua, is panicking as she falls to the ground.

Jen runs over, "Don't worry, I got you!"

She jumps forward and catches Zorua in the nick of time and they both land in the snow.

Jen asks, "Are you okay?"

"I'm okay. Thank you for saving me," Hisuian Zorua says.

"You're welcome," Jen happily says.

"No fair! You didn't even give us a chance!" Jessie screams.

"We got them first!" James says.

"So prepare for trouble if you know what's good for you!" Meowth says.

"I think you're the one in trouble!" Mew says.

Just then, Zoroark steps forward, "Allow us!"

With that, the two Hisuian Zorua, Growlithe, Voltorb, and two Lilligant stand in front and prepare for the attack. With that, all the Pokemon perform their attacks at once, and turn into a powerful attack towards Team Rocket. Team Rocket panics in fright as the attack is heading right towards them. In the matter of seconds it strikes at the balloon and it explodes, sending them flying.

Team Rocket creams, "We're blasting off too soon!"

And soon, Team Rocket is gone.

Everyone looks up in the sky to see where Team Rocket has blasted off.

"That was pretty soon," Mew says.

"Yeah. Talk about having multiple attacks turning into one attack," Misty says.

Zo turns to Mew and the others, "Thank you for saving my sister and mother."

"It's no trouble Zo," Mew says

Then Zo asks, "So um, what do we do now?"

"Well, there's one thing you can do," Mew says.

The red Hsuian Zorua asks, "What's that?"

"You kind of need to return everything back to their owners and apologize to everyone. All three of you," Mew says.

Zoroark calmly nods her head, "Yes. I think it will be the best choice, and we should make it up to everyone for the trouble we caused."

The group nods their heads in reply.

Throughout the afternoon, Mew and the others along with the Pokemon take the things that've been stolen from the town and bring them back to their rightful owners. Of course, with help of Mew and the others, Zoroark and the two Hisuian Zorua are able to apologize to the town people and the Pokemon, and have to do what they can to make up for it. It has taken them the rest of the afternoon, but everything is finally settled.

Soon, Mew and the others are about ready to depart from Hisui Island and ready to continue their journey. As it turns out, the Pokemon who has tagged along with them wants to tag along.

"So you all are willing to tag along with us?" Mew asks.

"Yeah," Zo happily says and jumps into Mew's arms.

Pikachu and Eevee climb on Mew's shoulder and are excited to be with Zo. Then, the Shiny Hisuian Lilligant joins up with Mew.

Then the Red Hisuian Zorua, Unova Zoroark, Hisuian Growlithe, Voltorb, and the normal Shiny Lilligant join up with Jen as well. The red Hisuian Zorua snuggles her cheek against Jen's.

The Red Hisuian Zorua happily says, "Yes. We all want to come with you."
Zoroark nods her head in reply.

"Alright everyone, let's go!" Mew says.

Everyone cheers. Mew and Jen return their new Pokemon friends in their Pokeball. Then Mew calls out Lapras and everyone sails away from the island. Mew and the others wave goodbye to everyone on the island. Not only did they have a good time on the island, they also received new Pokemon companions to tag along with them. And now, they continue on their journey through the Orange Islands.

Chapter 38: Episode 34: The Pokemon Water War

After their time at the Hisui Island, Mew and her friends travel across the sea of the Orange Island and decide to take a detour and do some big city exploring on an island known as Ascorbia Island. Mew and her friends are at the docks after getting off of Lapras.

"I bet you're pretty tired, Lapras. You deserve a rest," Mew says, and calls Lapras back into his Pokeball.

Misty turns around to see a town on the island, "Looks like there are nice places to see."

"I sure hope so. And some nice places to eat, too," Tomo says.

Then Togpei happily says, "Toge! Togepiiii!" (Don't forget me! I'm hungry, too!)

"Pichu Pichu!" (Me too!) Pichu happily adds.

"Sounds like you're not the only hungry one here," Misty says.

Tracey looks at the guide paper and says, "Hey, maybe we should go look at the art museum."

"Sounds nice, but I'm starting to get hungry myself," Mew says.

"Me too!" Jen says.

Soon, the Pokemon cheer, saying that they want to eat.

Suddenly, the group hears screaming and turns their heads to see people running to something in a panic. What really catches their attention is when someone mentions 'Fire.'

Misty exclaims, "Fire?!"

"Let's go!" Mew says.

And so, Mew and her friends rush to follow the crowd.

Up ahead, a crowd of people gather in front of a burning warehouse and Officer Jenny is there to keep everyone away as she blows her whistle.

Jenny calls out, "Please, everybody! Please stay back! This is a dangerous situation and we don't want anyone hurt!"

Mew and the others soon arrive on the scene.

"Look at those flames!" Tracey says in shock.

"I can't just watch the whole warehouse burn down. Here, you take Togepi and Pichu!" Misty says, and hands both Pokemon to Tracey.

But Tracey advises, "You can't go, Misty! It's not safe! You'll get hurt!"

"You just watch me!" Misty says, and rushes to the warehouse.

"Maybe I can help, too!" Mew says.

Then Pikachu says, "Pikachu!" ("We all can!)

"Eevee!" (I agree!) Eevee says.

"I'll go too!" Tomo says.

"Me too!" Mew says.

And with that, Mew, Tomo, and Jen rush to follow Misty.

Tracey calls out, "Be careful, you guys."

The four trainers rush past Officer Jenny as she talks to the citizens, "I'm warning you for the last time, sir…"

However, Jenny soon notices Mew and the others go past her and stop in front of the burning building.

Misty calls out, "Staryu! Buizel! Go!"

Then Mew calls out, "Squirtle! Wartortle! I choose you!"

Then Tomo calls out, "Sealeo! Slowpoke! We're counting on you!"

"Go Amaura!" Jen calls out.

Soon, all Pokemon come out of their Pokeballs.

Then Mew, Misty, and Tomo call out, "Use Water Gun!"

And all the Pokemon use Water Gun.

Then Jen calls out, "Amaura, use Water Pulse!"

And Amura begins to use the attack.

All four trainers begin to spray as much water to put out the fire.

Mew calls out, "Hang in there, Squirtle and Wartortle!

"Keep it up, Staryu and Buizel! Misty calls out.

Then Tomo says, "You're doing great Slowpoke and Sealeo."

"You too Amaura!" Jen calls out.

All the Pokemon do their best to put out the fire, but there doesn't seem to be enough to put them out.

Jenny is well aware of it, "It just isn't enough! The next warehouse could be next!"

Suddenly, as the flames start to spread to the next warehouse, sirens are heard and a jeep soon drives in with a pack of Wartortle in the back of the driver. The man coming out of the jeep has tan shin, dark hair and wears a fire helmet with an orange bodysuit.

Soon, some of the debris is falling towards Mew and the others.

Tracey cries out, "Guys! Look out!"

Mew and the others turn to see the burning debris is falling right towards them. Before the debris can hit them, a group of Wartortle leap in and save their lives. Squirtle and Wartole look up and are amazed to see that they've been saved by another Wartortle wearing a yellow bandana around its neck.

"A Wartortle?" Mew says, surprised.

Then brings out her Pokedex.

Dexter says, "Wartortle, the Turtle Pokémon, and the evolved form of Squirtle. A Water Type. A highly sought-after Pokémon because its long fur-covered tail is said to bring good luck."

The man runs over and asks, "Is everyone all right?"

"Uh huh," Tomo and Jen reply.

Then Misty says, "I'll be okay."

"Yes. We're fine," Mew says.

Just then, the fireman blows the whistle, and the Wartortle with the bandana instructs the others. Soon, all the Wartortle then work together to douse the flame in a coordinating display.

"Wow, what amazing teamwork," Tracey says, amazed.

The Pokemon happily cheers with excitement. However, Squritle watches the team intently, especially their leader. Soon, the fire has been put out, but the warehouse is destroyed.
