Chapter 41: Episode 37: The Wacky Watcher

After their exciting battle at the Kumquat gym, Mew earned her respective fourth and final Orange Island badge. Now she and her friends are making their way to the Orange Island competition. Mew looks at her four badges with a smile.

"These are our ticket to the Orange League competition," Mew says.

Then turns to Pikachu and asks, "Think we'll win, guys?"

"Pikachu!" (Sure, we will!) Pikachu says.

Then Eevee says, "Eevee!" (I know we will!)

The group continues to sail on Lapras on the ocean blue to their next destination. Tracey then puts the mouth of his bottle down in the ocean to gather some water.

Misty notices and asks, "You're not gonna drink salt water, are you?"

"Oh, no. This is strictly for Pokémon research purposes," Tracey says.

"Great," Misty replies.

Under the water, something approaches where Lapras is swimming. And Pikachu and Eevee are the first to sense it

"See something guys?" Mew asks.

Everyone soon sees something large swimming beneath them.

"What is it?" Misty asks.

"I don't know," Mew answers.

"Whatever it is, it's big!" Tracey says.

"It's huge," Tomo says.

Soon, the large object surfaces and it is revealed to be a submarine.

Mew says, "It's a…"

"Submarine!" Tracey confirms.

The group watches to see the submarine that rises from the sea. Just then, the hatch opens and a man comes out of the sub. He has gray spiky hair, mustache, wears a safari outfit, and wears glasses. He quickly sets up some equipment and begins to take some measurements and sightings.

He then notices Mew and the others, "Ah, company. You're here just in time for the rush hour."

"Rush hour?" Tomo and Jen say, confused.

The others are just as confused.

"If my observations are correct, we're about to see one of the most astounding scenes ever seen on the seas," the man says, and gets out some binoculars, "Now we'll see what we shall see."

"I wonder what this guy's talking about," Mew wonders.

Then Misty asks, "What could happen way out in the middle of the ocean?

"I don't know, but maybe we should hang around and find out," Tracey says.

"You think we'll find something out here?" Jen asks.

"Probably," Tomo replies.

Down in the ocean, the water rushes, and something races to the surface. Multiple things and everyone feels the rush approaches from the waves.

The man is ever excited, "They're here! They're here!

Soon, something rises from the sea, and it's Magikarp, a whole herd of them. That catches everyone by surprise.

"They're Magikarp!" Tracey says.

"Pika Pika!" (There's so many!) Pikachu says.

"Loetta," (Oh my) Meloetta replies.

The Magikarps continue to rise and jump around as they begin to swim. Tracey quickly notices one of the Magikarp is wearing a blue band on its tail. Then notices the Magikarp are wearing different colored bands: Red, blue, and yellow.

"What are those colored bands for?" Tracey asks.

And they're swimming in the same direction.

"If my calculations are correct, I know exactly where the Magikarp are heading. But with heads like that, I suppose they don't have much of a choice. Oh, well. Here I go," The man says.

The man goes back to his sub and follows the Magikarp group, leaving the group.

"Would someone mind telling me what's going on here?" Misty asks.

"Pichu," (No clue.) Pichu replies.

Tracey brings out a map and says, "I'm not sure, but if my guess is right, those Magikarp are headed straight for a place called Rind Island."

"Rind Island?" Everyone says, confused.

The Pokemon say the same, "(Rind Island?)

"It's supposed to be deserted," Tracey says.

"Well, it won't be when we get there. Come on!" Mew says.

Soon enough, everyone decides to follow the man and the Magikarp, and find themselves at Rind Island. Once they arrive, they plan to explore.

Mew returns Lapras, "Lapras, return!"

"Let's go!" Tracey says.

"Yeah!" Mew says.

Soon, the group begins to explore the island to find the man. Soon enough, they find the Magikarp swimming upstream.

"Hey, look!" Mew says.

"The Magikarp are swimming upstream!" Misty says, amazed.

"I heard about this, but I never thought I'd actually see this for myself!" Tracey says.

"That's amazing," Jen says.

Suddenly, the man from before approaches behind them."Oh, just what I've been looking for. Non-union labor." Everyone turns to see the man with large luggages.

Then he approaches them, "Come on! There's no time to organize now!"

He then passes each of them a box, "One for you. One for you. One for you. One for you. One for you. One for you. One for you. And one for chu. Now, follow me." and walks off.

"Hey, where are we going?" Tomo asks.

Soon, everyone begins to follow the man upstream.

Misty asks, "Excuse me, but who exactly are you?

"Why, the last time I looked, I was Quincy T. Quackenpoker," The man says.

"Quackenpoker?" Jen says, confused.

Tracey replies, "Quackenpoker."

"Quackenpoker? That's kind of an unusual name, isn't it?" Misty replies.

Then Quincy says, "Everybody in my family is named Quackenpoker, at least, on my mother's side."

"Then why are you here?" Jen asks.

"Does it have to do with the Magikarp coming here?" Mew asks.

"Correct," Quincy answers, "I'm a Pokémon Watcher and I've dedicated my life to the study of Magikarp."

Then Tracey says, "I knew your name sounded familiar!"

Everyone stops.

Tracey explains, "If a famous Pokémon Watcher like Dr. Quackenpoker thinks Magikarp are worth a lifetime of studying,"

Then goes to the river, puts down the box, brings out his sketchpad and pencil, and begins sketching, "There must be something I can learn from them, too!"

Suddenly, a Magikarp comes up and splashes water in Tracey's face, knocking him down.

"The first thing you learn from watching Magikarp is always use a waterproof pad," Quincy says.

"Thanks, Doctor," Tracey replies.

Then Quincy says, "Come on. You can't lie there like a lax all day, we've got observations to make." and runs ahead.

The others race after him as Tracey calls out, "Hey! Wait up!"

Later on, everyone finally reached a resting point.

Bored, Misty asks, "Would somebody please tell me what's so great about watching Magikarp?"

"I don't get it, either," Jen says.

The Pokemon is just as bored.

"They're boring. If you've seen one Magikarp, you've seen them all, if you ask me," Misty says.

set up a camera-like device and tripod to film the Magikarp.

"Okay, we're all set," Quincy says.

Then uses the machine to observe the Magikarp. Another machine prints out the analysis of the Magikarp.

Tracey looks at the machine and says, "I see. It's a machine that records the number of Magikarp as they pass by."

"It does much more than that," Quincy says, "It measures and analyzes thirty-two factors, including fin length, bone structure, muscle density, not to mention size-weight ratios and oxygen efficiency quotients."

"Size-weight ratios and oxygen efficiency quotients?" Mew says, confused.

"I asked you not to mention those, didn't I?" Quincy questions.

Then Tracey asks, "Were you the one who put those bands on the Magikarps' tails, Dr. Quackenpoker?"

"Yes, they tell me when the Magikarp left here," Dr. Quackenpoker answers.

"I don't get it. How'd they do that?" Tomo asks.

Dr. Quackenpoker explains, "I put a band on each one. The red ones left one year ago, blue, two years ago, and the Magikarp that have yellow bands left this island three years ago.

"But I wonder why the Magikarp go away," Tracey replies.

"I'm getting there," Quackenpoker says.

Then explains, "The Magikarp are born in the waters around this island but swim out to sea as they mature. But once a year, no matter where they are, thousands of Magikarp return here to the place of their birth. And I return so I can study them all." Then turns to Tracey, "Tracey, I'd imagine a young Pokémon Watcher like yourself must find all of this pretty interesting."

"Sure, but how'd you know I was a Pokémon Watcher?" Tracey asks, surprised.

"Well, with that sketch book you carry around with you, and those binoculars, I just put two and two together. Clever, eh?" Quackenpoker says.

"I'd say that's really clever, Dr. Quackenpoker," Mew says.

"I've hardly ever seen something that's clever," Mew says.

"Pika." (Of course.) Pikachu says.

"Well, thank you. But it's only logical for a skilled Pokémon Watcher would also be a skilled people watcher," Quackenpoker says.

Then turns to Tracey, "Say! Now that the flood's come to a screeching halt, why don't I take a look at your sketchbook?"

"Oh, sure, go ahead," Tracey says.

Dr. Quackenpoker opens the sketchbook and sees a Rhydon Sketch on the first page.

"Ah. Excellent! I see a great future ahead of you, young man," Quackenpoker says.

A little pleased, Tracey asks, "Do you... Do you really think so?"

"Well, you certainly don't have a future behind you," Quincy says.

Unknown to the group, Team Rocket is watching them again. They also notice the Magikarp swimming up river.

"I've never seen the little guy, and I've never seen so many Magikarp!" James says.

"Yeah. The place is really swimming with them," Meowth says.

Then James says, "But there's something fishy about them."

"Well, if you ask me, there ain't nothing magic about a bunch of Magikarp. I say we make Pikachu the catch of the day," Meowth says.

Then James and Meowth drop from the tree branch, drawing Jessie's attention.

Jessie calls out, "Come back here!"

"What's wrong?" Meowth asks.

"Aren't you forgetting something?" Jessie questions.

Then jumps down from the tree, "Think about it."

"About what?" Meowth asks.

"Magikarp. Don't you remember what Magikarp evolve into?" Jessie questions.

"Yeah, Gyarados," Meowth says.

Then Jessie says, "Now, listen to my master plan. All we have to do is scoop up that school of Magikarp. We'll train them hard, and before long, they'll evolve into Gyarados. And with a gigantic army of Gyarados, we'll be unstoppable! We'll be the Pokémon masters of the world!"

"We'll, be masters!" James and Meowth say.

Jessie chuckles and says, "And luckily, my plan is so brilliant and simple, that even a first grader could follow it."

"I never went to kitty-garten," Meowth says, unsure.

James feels the same, "And we've had absolutely lousy luck with Gyarados."

"Quiet, you two!" Jessie shouts at them.

Then says, "Wait and see. Those Magikarp will evolve and we'll be the most powerful trio in Team Rocket history!"

"Maybe she's right!" Meowth replies.

"Well, there's a first time for everything!" James says, excited.

Then Meowth says, "Let's get us a mess of Magikarp!"

"Yay!" James cheers.

Then James and Meowth run off, leaving Jessie to fantasize.

James calls out, "Jessie! Jessie!"

Meanwhile, Mew and the group along with Quackenpoker continue to watch the Magikarp proceedings. What's more, they're swimming up the waterfall.

"Wow! The Magikarp are swimming UP the waterfall!" Misty says, surprised.

"That is so cool!" Tomo says, amazed.

"Amazing!" Jen says.

"I can't figure out why they do that," Mew says.

"Eevee! (Me neither!) Eevee says.

But Tracey says, "I get it! While these Magikarp are swimming the oceans all year, they're building up their strength so they can get to the top of the falls!"

"Yeah. Unfortunately, half the Magikarp don't make a very strong showing," Quincy explains.

Everyone becomes confused.

Then Quincey says, "My studies indicate that fifty percent of the Magikarp are still too weak to swim all the way up the waterfall."

"What happens to the ones that don't make it?" Tracey asks.

"They do what that one there is doing," Quincy, and points to one of the Magikarp that hasn't made it, "They keep trying."

The Magikarp soon falls from the fall and goes back to the base.

Then Quincey says to Magikarp, "Everything takes time, Magikarp. Took me three years to grow this moustache."

The fallen Magikarp tries to go up the falls once more.

"Swimming like this is almost like Pokémon training!" Tracey says.

Mew cheers, "Keep going, Magikarp!"

"You're getting near the top!" Misty cheers.

The Pokemon continues to cheer with excitement for the Magikarp.

Meanwhile, at the top of the falls, Team Rocket waits with nets in hand.

"Get ready. And remember, don't swing till you see the scales on their tails!" Jessie says.

Then James asks, "Jess, wouldn't it be easy to catch them in Pokéballs?"

Jessie angrily says, "James, Pokéballs cost money, which is something we're out of!"

"Anger is no excuse for ending a sentence with two prepositions," Meowth says.

Soon, the first Magikarp reaches the top.

"Well, now I've got you!" James says as he swings the net.

Soon, James catches a Magikarp, "Look, Jess, I caught me a whopper!"

Jessie and Meowth are surprised.

"That isn't bad, James," Jessie says.

"It looks easy," Meowth says.

"Hooray!" James happily cheers.

The Magikarp that James catches manages to wiggle its way out of the net.

Meowth freaks out, "It's flippin out!"

"Quick! We can't let it get away!" Jessie calls out.

James mangages to hold down the Magikarp, but continues to hop away. Jessie and Meowth grab hold of James, but the Magikarp continue to top and drag them until they reach the river. Soon, Team Rocket goes down the waterfall and past the other Magikarp.

They soon scream for help, trying to get someone's attention.

"Huh?" Mew replies, having heard them.

"What's the matter, guys?" Tracey asks.

"I thought I just heard Team Rocket scream," Mew says.

"Team Rocket?" Tomo asks.

"Not again," Misty says.

"What are they doing here?" Jen asks, curious.

"I don't know. They sound like they're in some kind of trouble," Mew says.

"What else is new? They're always in trouble," Tomo says.

Then Quincey says, "You'll be the ones in trouble if I'm too late to see the Magikarp evolve.

"EVOLVE?!" Everyone exclaims in shock.

Even the Pokemon is just as shocked.

Sometime later, everyone arrives at a massive lake.

"Aren't the Magikarp ever gonna evolve?" Tomo asks.

"Tomo, patience is very important, especially if you're a doctor," Quackenpoker says, analyzing his data, "But as a matter of fact, a lot of these Magikarp won't be evolving here today. Some will have to wait until they get stronger, and that could take years."

Soon, everyone is resting and waiting as they have something to eat.

Misty pours Quackenpoker a cup, "Say when."

"That's plenty," Quincy says.

Mew eats with Pikachu and Eevee, "Pretty good, huh, guys?"

Pikachu and Eevee express their satisfaction.

Tomo turns to Meloetta and Skwovet, "The food is great."

Meloetta and Skwovet agree. Jen and Amaura are enjoying their food.

Quincy turns to Mew and says, "I've never seen a trainer with a more symbiotic relationship with his Pokemon."

Mew is puzzled.

"I mean, you, Pikachu, and Eevee communicate shockingly well," Quincy says.

"I leave the shocking to Pikachu, doctor," Mew says.

"Pika Pika," (It's my specialty.) Pikachu says.

"Eevee," (That's true.) Eevee says.

"Open up, Togepi," mity says, and hold a small piece of bread for Togepi.

Togepi then eats the small piece of bread.

Then Misty gives a piece of bread to Pichu, and Pichu eats it.

"These two are a couple of cuties," Quincy says.

Then gently rubs Togepi's spike.

Misty chuckles and says, "I didn't know Togepi was so ticklish."

"Togepi just like to be petted on their front spike there," Quincy says.

"Just like this?" Then Misty pets Togepi on the same spike.

Togepi likes it.

"Magikarp aren't the only Pokémon you know about, are they, Dr. Quackenpoker?" Tracey asks.

Quincy laughs and says, "All Pokémon interest me, but Magikarp are my most favorite by far."

"Really?" Tracey asks.

Quincy nods his head, "Yes. When I was a boy, I woke up one morning and I saw a Magikarp in my pajamas. How a Magikarp got into my pajamas, I'll never know."

Right on cue, the Magikarp begins to jump up on the water.

Later that night, everyone is fast asleep in their tent for some rest. However, Tracey and Quackenpoker are still up sharing the theories and research.

"I have my own theory, Dr. Quackenpoker," Tracey says, and shows Quckenpoker the sketch, "I think the Magikarp jump out of the water and use the position of the sun to find their way back to the island."

"Well, that's a very interesting theory, young man, but I'm afraid there's just one little problem with it. Look here," Quackenpoker says, and shows his sketch to Tracey.

"What's that?" Tracey asks.

"This is a Magikarp that can't jump at all. But after three years, it still manages to find its way back home," Quincy says.

"Well, I guess that just proves that Magikarp are more mysterious than I thought," Tracey says.

Quincy nods his head and says, "After fifty years of watching Pokemon, I still find Magikarp hard to understand. Even harder to understand than my income tax return."

Soon, some of the Magikarp start jumping, waking up everyone in the tent. Everyone leaves their tent to see what's going on.

"What are they doing now, doctor?" Misty asks.

"It looks like they're going crazy," Jen says.

"That means the Magikarp can sense something is about to happen. Something very exciting," Quincy says.

"I've gotta see this," Mew says.

"Maybe they're evolving!" Misty suggests.

Suddenly, the water becomes more distrubed as the Magikarp look like they're panicking.

"Hey! What's happening out there?" Misty asks, shocked.

"I don't know. Something's wrong! The waters are all churned up!" Quincy says.

"You're right. From what I'm hearing, I think the Magikarp are scared," Mew says.

"Then they might be in some kind of trouble," Tomo says.

Just then, mechanical arms come up and grab the Magikarp one by one. It's revealed that the mechanical arms belong to Team Rocket's Magikarp submarine, and the Magikarp being captured are being put into the submarine's mouth.

Jessie laughs in triumph, "We'll be able to pick a peck of Magikarp in no time!"

"Catch em all! Gotta catch em all!" Meowth says.

The mechanical arms continue to catch and scoop the Magikarp into the mouth as Team Rocket laugh with triumph. However, as the sub fills itself up with Magikarp, they end up crowding Team Rocket and the sub. Soon enough, it begins to sink.

James begins to release some of the Magikarp, while Mew and the others show deep concern.

Quincy demands, "Release those Magikarp at once, or I'll be forced to sink that submarine!"

James and Jessie continue to toss more Magikarp overboard.

Before anyone can reach, another mechanical arm with a glass capsule captures Pikachu and Eevee, and brings them to Team Rocket.

Pikachu and Eevee cry out to Mew as they are brought to Team Rocket.

"You should mind your peas and ques and your Pikachus and evenly get Eevees," Meowth says.

But Quincy stops them, "Hold it! Pikachu's and Eevee's Thunderbolts will give those Magikarp the shock of their lives!

Mew acts fast and takes out her Pokeball, then kicks it, soccer style, towards Team Rocket.

Then Mew calls out, "Bulbasaur, use Vine Whip to get Pikachu and Eevee, now!"

Jessie catches the Pokemon as Bulbasaur struggles and nearly falls in the water.

"Heh! This time we came out on top!" Meowth says.

James is able to get up from the Vine Whip, but looks up to realize there's a Magikarp stuck on his head. James begins to panic. Jessie and Meowth panic and try to pull the Magikarp off James' head.

"Stop playing!" Jessie calls out.

Jessie and Meowth pull with all their might, but the Magikarp isn't coming off.

Quincy calls out, "Stop! You'll pull his head off that way!"

Then rushes over to the sub.

Mew calls out, "Doctor, wait!"

Mew and Tracey soon follow the doctor. They jump into the lake and place the Magikarp in the water as Dr. Quackenpoker climbs on the sub. At the same time, Jessie and Meowth are still pulling.

"One, two…" Jessie counts and pulls as hard as they can.

"Hey! Watch my hair!" James screams.

Quincy reaches Team Rocket and says, "That won't work. You can't muscle a Magikarp, you have to treat it very gently.

"Gently?" Jessie and Meowth say, confused.

Quincy then strokes Magikarp's dorsal fin as he says, "Nice, Magikarp. Good, Magikarp. Relax. Relax."

Soon enough, Magikarp feels that it lets go of James' head. James touches his head to feel the Magikarp is no longer on his head, and so Team Rocket celebrates in tears of joy

"We did it!" Jessie happily cheers.

Suddenly Mew says, "Thanks, Magikarp!"

Quincy and Team Rocket turn to see Mew opening the capsule and free her friends.

"Now that you're out of James' hair and we have Pikachu and Eevee, we'll say goodbye," Mew says.

Mew, Tracey, and Dr. Quackenpoker jumps overboard with Pikach, Eevee, and Magikarp in hand.

Jessie angrily says, "You're not getting away that easy!"

"We want that Pika…" But James is soon interrupted by a glow.

It's revealed that the Magikarp Dr. Quackenpoker is holding is glowing and starting to evolve.

"Here they go!" Quincy says.

Then he puts the Magikarp in the water and it swims out to the middle of the lake. Soon, a massive glow begins and the water starts churning, meaning the Magikarps are starting to evolve. Mew and the others quickly get out of the water.

"I'm glad you're okay," Misty says to Pikachu and Eevee."

"Pikachu/Eevee," (Thanks, Misty.) Pikachu and Eevee reply.

Tracey turns to Quincy, "They're…"

"That's right, my boy, they're evolving," Quincy says.

The glow soon fades and a whirlpool develops in its place, which transforms into a water cyclone, sending Team Rocket up and blasting off.

Team Rocket screams, "Looks like we're splashing off again!"

Soon, one by one, the Magikarp leave the cyclone and fully evolve into Gyarados. Everyone watches in astonishment that so many Magikarp are evolving at once. After evolving, the Gyarados splashes into the water and begin to swim back down the river to get to the ocean.

"Tracey! I need an experienced watcher like you to help me count. You count the ones with the red rings and blue rings, okay?" Quincy says, and tosses Tracey counters.

"Yeah, sure!" Tracye says.

And with that the Gyarados then swim away.

"Quick! They're swimming upstream! Follow them!" Quincy says.

"Right!" Tracey says.

Dr. Quackenpoker and Tracey pursue the Gyarados.

"Dr. Quackenpoker!" Mew calls out.

"Tracey!" Tomo calls out.

"Wait for us!" Misty says.

The rest of the group then follow from behind as the Magikarp and Gyarados head down the river. At the same time, Tracey and Dr. Quackenpoker are in pursuit of the school to count them.

"Don't lose sight of a single one!" Quincy says.

"I won't!" Tracey says.

Soon, Tracey and Quackenpoker begin to count the Magikarp and Gyarados as they return to the sea. They follow the Magikarp and Gyarados until they reach the cliff overlooking the sea. Everyone else arrives to see the Magikarp and Gyarados leaving the island. And soon enough, the Magikarp and Gyarados are no longer in their sight.

"That was amazing!" Misty says.

"Yeah," Mew says.

"Yeah!" Tomo and Jen say.

The Pokemon also agree.

Just then, Quincy says, "Okay, Tracey, give me your totals."

"Sure. Doctor!" Tracey says.

They both share their results.

Then Tracey says, "Seventy percent of the Magikarp have evolved!

"Hey! That's the highest percentage ever! Tracey, we've made a momentous observation!" Quincy says.

"We sure have, Dr. Quackenpoker," Tracey replies.

Soon, the two shake hands.

"Thanks to you, I can finally begin to unravel some of the mysteries of Magikarp evolution," Quincy says.

"And thanks to you, I've had the honor of working with one of the greatest Pokémon Watchers ever," Tracey says.

Quincy chuckles and says, "Work hard, and you'll be great, too."

"Thanks," Tracey says.

Soon, the sun begins to rise. Everyone looks to see the sun rise.

Mew turns to Pikachu and Eevee, "You know, guys, if we work hard, I know we can win that Orange League competition!

"Pika!" (Of course!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee," (We sure will.) Eevee says.

"And we'll be rooting for her. Right, Togepi? Right, Pichu?" Misty replies.

Everyone continues to watch where the Gyarados and Magikarp swim off. They have a new understanding and appreciation of the mystery of Pokemon.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket ate now stranded at sea, again.

Frightened, James asks, "Why did we have to, be so, greedy?"

"An army of Gyarados seemed like a good idea at the time," Meowth says, frightened.

"Maybe Gyarados are much friendlier than they seem," Jessie says, scared.

A Gyarados glares over them, causing them to panic. As it's revealed, Team Rocket are surrounded by circling Gyarados.

Team Rocket says in fear, "Maybe not!"

Chapter 42: Episode 38: The Stun Spore Detour

After some traveling, the gang stops at a tiny island so Mew can practice and prepare for the long-awaited Orange League competition. Mew along with Pikachu and Eevee are on a rock looking out to the ocean as the wave crashes before them

"We're really on a hot streak, guys! We're so hot, we're on fire!" Mew announces.

"Pikachu!" (Burning up!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee!" (We're burning hot!) Eevee says.

Just then, a giant wave crashes down on them, getting them soaked.

Meanwhile, Tracey is taking a look at a large Vileplume.

"I don't think I've ever seen a more beautiful Vileplume. These petals are humongous!" Tracey says.

Meanwhile, Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee are walking to Tracey.

"At least we got cooled off," Mew says.

Then notices Tracey and calls out, "Hey, Tracey! Do you think you can help me with my training now?! I'm kinda getting off to a rocky start."

Suddenly, they hear a voice, "Mew! Tracey!"

"Huh?" Mew replies, and turns to see Tomo and Jen running towards them. Along with their Pokemon.

As they get closer, Tomo ends up tripping on a rock and stumbles over. He then collides with Mew and Tracey and all three fall into the Vileplume's head.

Jen panics, "Tomo! Tracey! Mew!"

Vileplume begins to panic and is freaking out. Then in desperation, Vileplume sprays Stun Spore into their faces.

This causes the group to panic.

Meloetta panics, "Loett!" (Oh no!)

"Pi Pika!" (We need help!) Pikachu panics and runs off.

Eevee follows after him.

Meanwhile, Misty is walking with Togpei, Pichu and Psyduck. That's when Pikachu and Eevee rush out of the bushes in a frantic state.

Misty notices them and calls out, "Oh, Hi Pikachu! Hi Eevee! I thought you and Mew were gonna go down to the beach to do a little training."

Seeing Misty, Pikachu panics and explains, "Pikachu Pika Pika Pi! (Tomo tripped and he, Mew, and Tracey got stuck in a Vileplume's head!)

"Eevee Eevee Vee Eevee!" (And the Vileplume spray Stun Spore at them!)

Confused, Mew asks, "Did something happen to Mew?"

That's when Mew, Tracey, and Tomo show up, paralyzed by the Stun Spore.

Mew panics, "It, got us."

Then the three collapsed on the floor. Then Jen and the other Pokemon rush over.

"What got you?" Misty asks.

"We both fell into a Vileplume's head," Tracey says, looking pale.

Misty gasps, "You breathed in Stun Spore!"

"Can't move," Tomo says, still stunned.

"Oh no," Misty says, worried.

After the incident, Misty, Jen, and the Pokemon are in the cabin they're staying in as Mew, Tomo, and Tracey are lying in their sleeping bags. Misty and Jen search in their backpack for a paralyzing antidote.

However, Misty has bad news, "Oh, I'm sorry, but we don't have any more Stun Spore antidote."

Then Jen brings out bandages, "All we have is a bunch of Band-Aids."

"What do we do?" Jen asks Misty.

Then Misty has an idea, "I know! I'll run and get some medicine at the nearest Pokémon Center!"

Then Mistylooks at the map, but has more bad news, "Which happens to be thirty miles away on another island! Oh no!"

"Pikachu Pi." (Find another way, Misty.) Pikachu says

"You're right, Pikachu. We'll just find some other way for Mew, Tomo and Tracey to get better," Misty says.

Pikachu then tries to use his Thunderbolt, but Misty stops him.

She picks him up and says, "No, Pikachu! I don't think we can shock the Stun Spore away."

"Pika," (You're right.) Pikachu replies.

Suddenly, Mew weakly says, "Misty."

"I'm here," Misty replies.

Misty feels Mew's forehead and then feels her own, and realizes she's developing a fever.

"Misty We gotta do something to bring their fevers down, fast!" Misty.

"I'll go get some water," Jen says, and grabs a bucket.

Jen and Amaura run outside of the cabin and rushes to the river close by. They fill it with water from the river, and bring it back into the cabin. Then Misty, Jen, and Meloetta place wet rags on Mew' Tracey, and Tomo's heads.

"Hey, Misty," Tracey weakly says.

Mew says, "Just relax, Tracey. Don't try to talk. You need to rest."

Suddenly, Mew says, "Salveyo weed."

"Huh?" Misty says, confused.

Then Tracey says, "Go get a Pokédex."

"Yeah! That's a great idea! Maybe it can help us!" Misty says.

She then grabs's Mew's Pokedex, "Okay."

"Look up Vileplume," Tracey says.

And do just that.

"Antidote info," Tracey says.

"Look up Salveyo weed," Mew weakly says.

"Right," Misty says.

Then look up the info.

Then Dexter says, "An effective Stun Spore antidote can be made by boiling the leaves of the Salveyo weed."

"I wonder where I find that," Jen wonders.

Dexter answers, "Salveyo weed is found on clear lake bottoms wherever Vileplume live. Poliwag are also found in the vicinity of this plant."

"Poliwag?" Misty questions.

"Find it, Misty. Go find that Salveyo weed," Tracey says, feeling very weak.

"Don't worry, Tracey! I'll find it, no matter what!" Misty says.

She gets up and says, "Togepi, Pichu, let's go!"

Jen stands up and says, "I'll come too."

"No Jen. It's best that you and the Pokemon stay here and take care of Mew and Tracey while I'm gone."

"Okay," Jen replies.

Meanwhile, James and Meowth of Team Rocket are climbing up a tree. James has Meowth standing on his shoulders.

James calls out, "Hurry up, Meowth!"

Meowth is trying to reach an apple from the tree, "Higher! A little higher! I almost got it!"

Finally, Meowth grabs it, "I got it!"

Right on cue, the branch James's standing on breaks and crashing to the ground.

"Whoever it was that said apples are healthy must've never picked one," Meowth says, feeling in pain.

Later, James and Meowth return to their cabin hideout at a different part of the island.

"It wasn't easy, but we brought you the apple you wanted, Jess," Meowth says.

It's revealed that Jessie is in bed.

Sick and weak, Jessie says, "I think my fever's getting worse. But, it gives my alabaster skin such a lovely crimson hue." Then gets out her mirror, "Ah, yes. Very beautiful."

"How come you were so particular about having a bright red apple?" Meowth asks.

"It's very simple," Jessie says, and takes the apple.

Then puts it inside her, "When I awaken from my fever dreams, I want to be able to gaze at something with skin that's even redder than mine."

James and Meowth sweat drops.

"We almost broke our necks and you're gonna just look at it!" Meowth says, shocked.

"Meowth, please don't yell at me now. I'm not well. But, if I had a pint of Boysenberry ice cream…" Meowth says, in tears.

"Oh no! No way!" Meowth denies the request.

Then James says, "Jessie, I think you're blowing this little temperature you're running totally out of proportions."

Soon, Jessie breaks down in tears, "What if there's something terribly, terribly wrong with me?! Beautiful things are very fragile. Soon, I may be gone with the wind. Like that tender, lovely, little leaf."

"Jessie, all you did was sniff a little Vileplume Stun Spore," James says.

"You just stuck your nose where it didn't belong," Meowth says.

Flashback:

Jessie is running through the flowers with laughter, "A fantastic field of fragrant flowers!"

But as Jessie comes down from her leap, she ends up landing in the head of a Vileplume. The Vileplume panics as Jessie has her head stuck in it. In other words, Jessie has also been stunned by Vileplume's Stun Spore.

Flashback Ends:

Just then, James says, "I just remembered that as a tiny tot, I breathed some Stun Spore, and my dear grandpapa made a potion out of boiled Salveyo weed that he got from the lake on his estate! It cured me right away!"

And Jessie begins to pound James in rage, "You couldn't have taken your trip down memory lane any sooner?! I'm on my deathbed here!"

James and Meowth are shocked as Jessie beats James around, until she returns to bed.

Jessie says, "I'm so weak."

"I guess we better get Jessie some Salveyo weed." Meowth says.

Meanwhile, Misty is in a lake searching for the Salveyo weed. So far, no luck.

"Nothing yet," Misty says to herself.

She then stretches her back and says, "And no sign of a, Poliwag."

Then turn to Togepi and Pichu, "Come on! Let's try someplace else."

"Pichu," (Okay.) Pichu says.

Meanwhile, Jen and the other Pokemon are doing their best to keep Mew, Tomo, and Tracey's fever down.

"Pikachu… Eevee…" Mew softly says.

Jen, Meloetta, and Skwovet damp the clothes in water and place them on the three heads. Stufful snuggles Tracey hoping to cheer him up.

Eevee says in concern, "Eevee." ("Hurry, Misty.")

Unknown to the group, inside Misty's backpack, her Pokemon egg show a flashing glow, signs that it's going to hatch soon.

Meanwhile, James and Meowth are searching for the Salveyo weed. However, James is wearing an odd looking outfit.

"I don't know why I couldn't wear my Team Rocket uniform. I feel like a clown in this get-up," James wonders.

"We gotta find some of that Salveyo weed to help Jessie get better, don't we?" Meowth answers.

Then uses a basket to try scooping the Salveyo weed, "But if anybody saw Team Rocket splashing around in some lagoon, they'd get suspicious. That's why I swiped these disguises from the local costume shop,"

"Couldn't you have swiped something a little more flattering," James questions.

Meowth turns to James, "I'm trying to do the best I can here! I'm a Pokémon, not a fashion consultant!"

Suddenly, the two hair something, causing Meowth to turn around, "Hey, what's that?"

Emerging from the water is a Poliwag.

"It's a Poliwag!" Meowth says, surprised.

The poliwag then jumps out of the water and onto a rock, and soon sees something on its tail.

Just then, James remembers, "It's all coming back now! Grandpapa used a Poliwag to find the Salveyo weed when I was Stun Spored!"

"Don't let it get away!" Meowth cries out.

James throws his Pokeball, "Victreebel!"

Victreebel comes out of its Pokeball. But instead of chasing Poliwag, it begins to chase James.

James cries out, "Wait! Stop! Don't go after me! Go after that pretty little Poliwag!"

Victreebel then charges at Poliwag, but moves in time and fires a Water Gun at Victreebel. Victreebel blocks the attack, and throws a Razor Leaf, but Poliwag dodges the attacks, and runs away.

But Meowth is hot on its tail, "You're not gonna get away from me!"

Meowth leaps and pins Poliwag with his basket, "We got you, now!"

James runs up, "And now that we know where to find the Salveyo weed, can we change out of these costumes?"

"Quit your yapping, and give me a hand with this Poliwag, will you?" Meowth shouts,

Poliwag manges to get loose and sends Meowth into James as it escapes. Poliwag quickly runs into the bushes and runs away. James and Meowth sit up to see Poliwag is gone.

"We got Poli-whipped!" Meowth says, shocked.

Meanwhile, Misty, Pichu, and Togepi are still searching for the Salveyo weed.

"We've just gotta find that Salveyo weed to help Mew, Tomo, and Tracey," Misty says.

And suddenly, they come across a Poliwag.

"A Poliwag!" Misty says surprised.

Poliwag turns around to see Misty and quickly hides behind her.

Mew brings out her Pokedex, and Dexter says, "Poliwag, the Tadpole Pokémon. A Water type. It has no arms, but its tail makes it a strong swimmer."

"Poliwag can help us find the Salveyo weed!" Misty says.

"Togepiiiiiii," Topgei says.

"Pichu," Pichu happily says.

Suddenly, James and Meowth show up in their unusual attire.

Poliwag cries out, "Poli!" (Save me!)

Meowth looks to see Misty, "Heh! Well, look who it is!"

"Team Rocket?!" Misty says, surprised.

Then Meowth demands, "Alright, kid, hand over that Poliwag!"

"Huh?" Misty says, confused.

Poliwag panics, "Poli, poli!" (No, don't let them get me!)

Seeing Poliwag's distress, Misty says, "Poliwag doesn't want to go with you!"

"Do it or else!" James demands.

"No way!" Misty denies.

Misty stares at Team Rocket with a glare and they do the same. Togepi, Pichu, and Poliwag grow worried.

Both Misty and Team Rocket stare down one another, waiting for the other to make the first move.

"I think we can take her in a battle! Don't you?" Meowth says.

"I do," James says.

Then Meowth demands, "Give us that Poliwag right now!"

"You'll have to take it from me!" Misty says, refusing to give up.

Then Misty calls out, "Victreebel, go!"

Victreebel charges.

Then Misty throws her pokeball, "Goldeen, go!"

Goldeen comes out of her Pokeball.

James calls out, "Victreebel, Razor Leaf, now!"

Victreebel launches the attack, but Goldeen dodges in midair and dives into the water.

"Dive in after it!" James calls out.

Victreebel does so.

Then misty calls out, "Goldeen, stop it with your Horn Attack!"

Goldeen launches Horn Attack and is right on target, sending Victreebel flying.

Then Misty says, "Now try your Fury Attack, Goldeen!"

Goldeen uses the attack and bounces Victreebel up as it comes down and over.

James panics and calls it back, "Victreebel, return!"

Victreebel is soon called back into the Pokeball.

Misty happily cheers, "Great job, Goldeen! You just showed Team Rocket why Water Pokémon are my favorite!"

Goldeen splashes out with glee. Togepi, Pichu, and even Poliwag are celebrating Misty's victory.

Meowth scolds James, "Why can't you train that Victreebel to battle?! It looked like a punching bag out there!"

"It could use some work," James sheepishly says.

Then throws another Pokeball as he calls out, "Next, I choose you, Weezing!"

Weezing comes out of the Pokeball.

Then Misty throws another Pokeball, "I choose you, Staryu!"

Staryu comes out of the Pokeball.

But Misty and James call out at the same time, "Weezing/Staryu, Tackle attack, now!"

Both Pokemon perform the attack and they collide, but neither one will give an inch to the other.

Then James calls out, "Smog attack!"

Weezing then launches the attack, blinding Staryu in the process.

Misty calls out, "Staryu, Double Edge attack, now!"

Staryu performs the attack and slices away the Smog. Then fly towards Weezing and smack into it, sending it blasting off.

"That's super, Staryu!" misty cheers.

"Now you'll have to go against me!" Meowth says, and prepares the attack.

"Staryu, return now!" Misty says and calls back Staryu.

Then calls out, "And go, Psyduck!"

Psyduck comes out of the Pokeball.

"Try my Scratch attack on for size!" Meowth says, and performs Scratch.

But Psyduck doesn't move. Meowth then tries biting Psyduck's bead. And unable to withstand it, Psyduck activates his powers.

"Get a headache. Get a nice, big, juicy headache," Misty says to herself.

And right on cue, Psyduck unleashes its Psychic powers, freezing Meowth.

Then Misty calls out, "Use Confusion, Psyduck!"

Psyduck uses Confusion to get Meowth off his head. Then sends him flying into James and both of them slide into the woods.

"You see what happens when you use your headache?" Misty says.

"Psyduck," (Guess so.) Psyduck replies.

Meanwhile, James and Meowth are found with their backs against the tree.

"Ow, we usually just get beat by just the twerp," Meowth says in pain.

James feels the same, "Now, we're getting beaten by her friends!"

"Well, now what are we gonna do? That girls has the Poliwag AND the Salveyo weed," Meowth says, feeling defeated.

Then jumps off of we go back without it, Jessie will be sick, of us.

"You think kids these days would have something on their minds besides Pokemon," James says, deflated.

Just then, Meowth has an idea, "You just gave me an idea."

Meanwhile, Misty is tending Poliwag.

Misty puts the cream on Poliwag and says, "Luckily, I always bring a little Pokémon cream along. That should take the hurt away."

Poliwag nuzzles against Misty's leg, in the process, tickles Togepi and Pichu with its tail.

"Toge Toge Toge Toge!" Topgei says, tickled.

Pichu feels the same.

"Togepi's tickled to have you with us!" Misty happily says.

"Pol," Poliwag says.

Misty kneels Poliwag and asks, "Poliwag, I've got an important question to ask you. Do you know where we can find some Salveyo weed?"

Misty brings out the Pokedex and shows Poliwag the picture, "Here, look. It grows on lake bottoms.

Poliwag then heads towards the river.

"But, Poliwag! What are you doing? Don't go!" Misty calls out, but Poliwag dives in the water.

Soon enough, Poliwag comes out with a Selveyo weed in its mouth.

Very pleased, Misty asks, "Is there any more Salveyo weed growing on the bottom of that lake, Poliwag?"

"Poli," (There is.) Poliwag answers with a nod.

Then Misty calls out, "Let's go, Staryu!"

And Staryu comes out of the Pokeball.

With that, Misty, Staryu, and Poliwag dive under the water and soon find a whole garden of Salveyo weeds. And so, Misty and Poliwag begin picking the Salveyo weed. After gathering a bunch, the three return to the surface and they have gather the Salveyo weed they pick

"This should be more than enough," misty happily says.

"Toge Toge Toge!" Togpei happily says.

Pichu feels the same, "Pichu Pichu Pi Pi Pichu!"

Then Misty picks up the Salveyo weed pile, "We have to hurry and boil this up for Mew, Tomo, and Tracey."

Then turns to Poliwag, "Thanks again, Poliwag!

Soon, the three walk away, but Poliwag begins to follow.

Misty turns to see it, "We'd like to stay and play, but our friends are sick. This plant will help them get better, and when it does, maybe we can come back and see you again."

Poliwag then walks over and nuzzles Misty's leg.

Soon, Misty is beginning to understand what Poliwag wants, "That is, unless you'd like to come along with Togepi, me and the others and meet our friends now."

"Poli," Poliwag happily says.

Meanwhile, Mew, Tomo, and Tracey are still stuck in bed. Jen, Meloetta, and Eevee make sure the clothes stay damaged while Amaura uses her ice attack to help cool them down. Smeargle and Stufful do their best to comfort Mew, Tracey, and Tomo. Pikachu and Skwovet check out the window, so far, nothing. Inside Misty's backpack, the egg glows again.

Meanwhile, Misty, Togepi, Pichu, and Poliwag.

"Once Mew and Tracey get better, we'll introduce you to Pikachu and Squirtle and Psyduck and Lapras and…" Misty happily says.

As the group walk down the road, James and Meowth are following from behind and spy on her from behind the bushes.

"Just as I suspected. That kid got the Poliwag and the crop of Salveyo weed," JMeowth says.

"But they won't have either when they starts to sample the goodies we've got in store for them," James says.

"They should be making a pit stop anytime now," Meowth says.

Soon, Misty and the Pokemon stop to see a tea set in the middle of the road.

"Whoever left this fancy tea set right in the road?" Misty questions.

Soon, they spot some makeup right next to the tea set.

"And all this makeup?" Misty says, amazed.

Misty begins to step the tip of her foot on the blanket, and feels the ground under it give way a bit.

Catching on what's going on, Misty says, "I have to get back and help the guys!"

A little while later, the group finds a large basket of food, "This is the most scrumptious looking basket of food I've ever seen in my whole life!"

Misty fights the temptation, "But we can't stop and eat because they're waiting for us."

And sometime later, they come across…

"What beautiful dresses! Whoever uses this road has very good taste," Misty says, and continues onward.

Meowth grows frustrated as Misty isn't stopping by for them, "What gives? We put out everything a girl should want, and she didn't fall for any of it!"

"I think it was a big mistake to base our choices on what Jessie would have stopped for," Jessie says.

Then Meowth says, "Maybe the kids and that blue creep saw through our little scheme this time. But next time, we'll disguise our plan a whole lot better."

Meanwhile, Misty continues to list off her friends' Pokemon, "And then there's Scyther and Pichu and Charizard and Marill and Venonat and…"

Soon, they stop to see a woman and a baby carriage in the road.

The woman says, "Oh, pardon me, miss."

"Can we help you?" Misty asks.

"Perhaps. Would what you're carrying, by any chance, be something called Salveyo weed?" The woman asks.

"Yes," Misty says.

"It's just. It's just that my baby inhaled Vileplume's Stun Spore," The woman says sadly.

"Why, that's terrible," Misty says, surprised.

Then the woman says, "My poor, precious, honey child hasn't been able to move even one little old bitty muscle for days. But the worst of all is my sweet pea can't smile. Oh, if I could only find a hunk of that Salveyo weed, I'd boil it up, my precious angel could drink it down and I could see that smile one more time." And begins to tear up.

Tearing up as well and disguised as the baby, Meowth says, "That's the saddest story I ever heard. We gotta do something to help that baby."

"That baby…" Misty says surprised. Then gives them a suspicious look, "Sounds like Meowth!

James and Meowth panic.

Then James says, "Well, at least I fooled you!

"That's cause you're a fool! " Misty says.

Then Meowth jumps on the carriage and is still wearing the bonnet. And begin to do the motto.

Meowth:

Baby or not, prepare for trouble!

James:

Lady or not, make it double!

Meowth:

To protect da woild from devastation!

James:

To unite all people within our nation!

Meowth:

To denounce da evils of truth an' love!

James:

To extend our reach to the stars above!

With that, Meowth takes off the bonnet.

Meowth:

Meowth!

Then James takes off the hat and removes the makeup.

James:

And I'm...James!

Meowth:

Team Rocket, Blast off at da speed of Light!

James:

Surrender that Salveyo weed, girlfriend, or prepare to fight!

Meowth:

Dat's right!

Then Meowth says, "We need that Salveyo weed to help our friend Jessie to recover from some Stun Spore and we're gonna do whatever it takes to get it!"

"Weezing, go!" James says, and throws his Pokeball.

Then Weezing comes out of the Pokeball.

Misty gasps in surprise, but Poliwag gets in front of Misty.

"Poliwag!" Misty says, surprised.

Weezing charges in and tackles Poliwag, but Poliwag retaliates with rapid fire slaps from its tail.

"Poliwag's Double Slap attack is amazing!" Misty says, amazed.

"Pichu!" (Go Poliwag!) Poliwag cheers.

Weezing is sent crashing to James and Meowth, and they end up falling into the carriage. Then the barrage itself goes down the slope and when it hits a rock, the three go tumbling out.

"That was great, Poliwag!" Misty complements.

Poliwag is pleased.

Some time later, James and Meowth climb their way back up, battered and beaten.

"Now how are we gonna help Jessie?" Meowth asks.

"Beats me," James answers.

Just then, both of them see and crawl over to see some Salveyo weed, and suspect that Misty left some of them behind for them.

"It. It's Salveyo weed!" James says, surprised.

"That girl must've left it for us!" Meowth says.

Meanwhile, Misty explains to the Pokemon, "I know they wanted to trick us, but they were only trying to help Jessie. So I think they deserve a break for once. Don't you?"

The Pokemon agree.

As for the two, James and Meowth have teary eyes and are surprised by the kindness shown to them.

"And after all we done to them!" Meowth says.

"I must admit that a little red head is as good as gold!" James says with tears.

"Those four twerps are pretty lucky to have such a kind hearted, caring, generous twerp like her for a friend," Meowth says.

Meanwhile, Pikachu and Skwovet are waiting outside and soon see Misty, Poliwag, Togepi, and Pichu.

Misty calls out, "Pikachu! Skwovet!"

"Pikachu Pi!" (Misty!) Pikachu cheers.

Skwovet cheers, "Skwovet!" (You made it!)

"Let's hurry and boil this up!" Misty says.

Everyone hurry inside and get to work. In no time, the Salveyo weed is boiled and is now ready to be served.

"Here you go," Misty says, and hands Mew a cup, "Don't burn yourself."

Mew takes the cup, "Thank you."

Then Misty hands Tracey a cup, "Careful, it's hot."

"I knew I could count on you," Tracey says.

Then Misty hands Tomo a cup, "Here you go, remember to be careful."

"Thank you Misty," Tomo says.

Meanwhile, in Team Rocket's cabin, James and Meowth are boiling the Salveyo weed as well.

Jessie walks over to them and practically begs, "Isn't it ready yet? Come on! Hurry! Hurry! Hurry! Hurry!"

"We're boiling as fast as we can!" Meowth says.

"The least you could do, Jessie, is be a little bit more appreciative!" James shouts.

Jessie shouts back, "Well, I do appreciate what you're doing. But do it faster, now!"

Sometime later, Jessie drinks the beverage and back to full strength, "I'm me again!"

James and Meowth sigh with relief, "That whiny wimps must've been looking for Salveyo weed by herself because the other four twerps are sick. So this is the perfect time to attack them!"

James and Meowth are shocked.

Then Jessie says, "Both of you have already wasted valuable time, but if we move fast, maybe we can triple team the girl and capture Pikachu and Eevee.

"But, Jessie," James says.

But Jessie gets up and stretches, "I can see that you two are totally lost without me. Come on, let's go." and walks out the door.

"I can't believe she wants to attack the kid responsible for helping her get well," James says, stunned.

"That's Jessie. Keeping up the old Team Rocket tradition," Meowth says.

Meanwhile, Mew, Tracey, and Tomo get their strength back as well.

"How do you feel?" Misty asks.

"Just fine!" Mew says.

"I feel a lot better now," Tomo says.

Suddenly, a glow appears from Misty's backpack, and it's glowing bright that it catches everyone's attention.

"What's that?" Jen asks.

Misty rushes to her backpack and opens it up. She then takes out the Pokemon egg that's glowing and flashing. Soon, the egg begins cracking.

"Your Pokemon Egg," Mew says, surprised.

"It's hatching," Misty says, surprised and excited.

Everyone watches as the egg glows and cracks, and soon bursts as a blinding light appears. Soon enough, the light disappears, and the baby Pokemon is born. The little Pokemon is a light-blue, penguin-like Pokémon, which is covered in thick down to insulate against the cold. It has a dark blue head with a primarily white face and a short, yellow beak. The dark blue feathers on its head extend down its back and around its neck, which causes it to appear to be wearing a cape. There are two white ovals on its chest and a small, light-blue marking resembles a crown above its beak. It has flipper-like arms and yellow feet with three toes each.

The little Pokemon happily says, "Piplup!"

"Aww, it's cute," Misty happily says.

"It's a Piplup," Tracey says.

"Piplup, huh. It even sounds cute," Misty sas.

Piplup turns to Misty and happily says, "Piplup." (Mommy.)

Mew giggles, "Piplup called you her mommy."

"Aww," Jen says.

Mew brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Piplup, the Penguin Pokemon. A Water Type. A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care."

Misty smiles and says, "Hello Piplup, it's nice to meet you.

Suddenly, Arbok burst through the wall, but everyone ducks their heads. Then everyone rushes outside and sees Jessie.

"Jessie!" Jen exclaims.

"So, it's you!" Mew says.

"Yes, and I imagine you're too stunned to battle," Jessie says.

"That's what you think!" Mew says.

Then Pikachu says, "Pika!" (Bring it!)

"Vee!" (Yeah!) Eevee says.

Then Jessie calls out, "Go and get em, Arbok!"

Arbok charges towards them.

Then Mew calls out, "Pikachu, Eevee, go!"

Pikachu and Eevee charge.

Jessie calls out, "Arbok, Poison Sting attack!"

Arbok launches the attack, but Pikachu and Eevee are too fast.

Jessie gets angry, "Come on, Arbok! What's that matter with you?! We have to beat those kids!"

Meanwhile, as Jessie rants, James and Meowth are hiding behind a nearby rock.

"Wanna crawl under this rock?" James asks.

"Yeah," Meowth says.

Jessie turns her head and shouts, "Why aren't you two helping me out here!"

"We don't wanna cramp your style," Meowth answers.

And James nods in reply.

Then Mew calls out, "Pikachu, Eevee, Thunder Shock!"

Pikachu and Eevee perform Thunderbolt and send Arbok flying into Jessie. Ultimately, the Thunderbolt causes Jessie to become paralyzed all over again.

Jessie weakly says, "Wonder if that weed will cure a Thunder Shock."

Then James and Meowth rush in.

"I think what you really need, Jessie, is something that'll cure a terminal case of ingratitude!" James says.

Then James and Meowth pick both Arbok and Jessie up and run away with them.

"Thanks again! I mean, we're blasting off again!" Meowth calls out.

That leaves the group in shock.

"They keep getting weirder," Mew says.

"No kidding," Jen replies.

Mity then says, "Looks like everyone recovered from the Stun Spore."

"Yeah," Tomo says.

"That Salveyo weed tea really did the trick," Tracey says.

"And we owe it all to you, Misty," Mew says.

Misty shakes her head and turns to Poliwag, "We owe it all to Poliwag."

"I guess it was a team effort," Mew says.

"It sure was, wasn't it?" Misty replies.

"Poli," (Sure is.) Poliwag says.

"And you two make a great team," Tracey says.

"Yeah. And great friends, too," Misty says.

Poliwag happily says.

By defending Poliwag from Team Rocket, Misty has won a new friend and a new Pokemon. And because of her dedication to helping Mew, Tomo, and Tracey has earned their gratitude.

"Thanks, Misty. Thanks for helping us," Mew says.

"It's no problem," Misty says.

And leather on, the group continue to head out to sea, and with renewed strength in body and spirit, Mew and her friends head for the Orange League and the challenges that awaits them there. And now, Misty has two new Pokemon friends.

Chapter 43: Episode 39: Hello, Pummelo!

Out on the ocean blue and riding on Lapras, Mew and her friends are sailing towards an island, which is their destination.

"Well, there's Pummelo Island," Tracey says.

"Yeah," Mew says.

"Eevee," (There it is.) Eevee says.

"Pikachu," (Almost there.) Pikachu says.

Now that Mew has earned four Orange League badges, Mew and her friends are heading for the Orange League for Mw to compete and win the winner's trophy.

Mew says with pride, "Nothing's gonna stop us now!"

"Pika. Pika/ Eevee Eevee" (Yeah!) Pikachu and Eevee say.

Then all the Pokemon sense something, and turn their heads.

"What's up guys?" Mew asks.

Mew and the other trainers look to see a figure flying along the sea.

"I wonder what that is," Jen wonders.

Tracey looks through his binoculars to get a better look as the figure starts flying upward at incredible speed.

Soon enough, Mew and the others dock at the port and they arrive at the reception desk to sign in for their Orange League challenge.

Mew says "Hi, I'm here to battle for the Orange League trophy."

"Another one, eh? Let me just verify your individual badges. The receptionist says.

Mew then shows the man her badges and he uses a machine to scan them, and the badges are verified. Soon, the badges and Mew's picture are on the screen.

"Well, now, it says here that you came all the way here from Pallet Town, Ms. Mew. Is that right?" The man replies.

"Yeah, Pallet is my home town," Mew says.

While Mew is checking at the desk, Tracey, Tomo, Jen, and the other Pokemon are looking at the Dragonite statue. Tracey is also sketching it.

"This statue sure looks familiar," Tracey says.

"Okay Mew, your winner trophy's match is set for tomorrow morning at ten o'clock sharp at Pummelo Stadium," The receptionist says.

"Thank you," Mew says.

Then asks, "Do you know where the stadium is?"

Soon, the receptionist leads the group to the stadium.

"Well, there it is. Pummelo Stadium. Where you will have your big battles tomorrow," The receptionist says.

"Wow. It's huge!" Mew says.

Then the group arrives at a green building next to the stadium.

"And this. This is the Palace of Victory," The receptionist says.

"Palace of Victory?" Mew asks.

"Well, that's the official name. But most folks know it now as the Orange League Hall of Fame," The man says.

As the group walks inside, Tracey notices the same Dragonite statue.

"Hey, look. That same statue," Tracey says.

Soon, everyone arrives inside to see so many different photographs, statues, and plates in the room.

"All these photos and displays and trophies are here to offer every trainer who's been victorious in the Orange League since the establishment of the winner's trophy," The receptionist explains.

"Ohh," Mew says, amazed.

Then the receptionist says, "To get into the hall, a trainer has to defeat the four members of the Orange Crew and the Pummelo gym leader in a full Pokémon battle."

"What's a full battle?" Jen asks.

"That's when you both battle with 6 Pokémon," The receptionist says.

"Six Pokémon?!" Mew says, surprised.

Pikachu and Eevee are just as surprised.

"This isn't gonna be easy. You'll have to think hard about the Pokémon you're gonna use," Tracey says.

"And a six on six Pokémon match could last a pretty long time," Misty says.

"You're right. It sounds a lot like the six on six battle at the Indigo Plateau Pokemon League," Mew says.

"But, either of you will be in the Hall of Fame forever if you win it," Tomo says.

"Yeah," Mew says.

"Maybe even longer," Jen says.

Then the receptionist says, "I'm sure you all must've noticed that competition in each one of the Orange Island gyms is very different. That's because the Orange Crew believes it's important to test both trainers and their Pokémon under lots of different circumstances to prove how well they work together. And if you're able to win in the four Orange gyms, and in the Orange League, you all deserve to be in the Hall of Fame."

"And what's that statue doing here?" Tracey asks, looking at the Dragonite statue.

"Oh, that's a Dragonite. The legendary Pokémon that guards this island," The receptionist says.

"Dragonite," Mew says.

"I knew it!" Tracey says.

Mew brings out her Pokedex, and Dexter says, "Dragonite, the Dragon Pokémon. A Dragon and Flying Type. This extremely rare and highly intelligent dragon type is able to fly faster than any known Pokémon."

Just then, Tracey remembers, "Hey, I wonder if that huge flying thing we saw…"

Then Tracye thinks back, wondering if what they have seen is a Dragonite.

Then the receptionist says, "Oh, that must've been the gym leader's Dragonite getting some exercise."

This shocked everyone.

"He has a Dragonite?!" Mew says, shocked.

"No way!" Misty says.

"Yes. Dragonite's the reason nobody's ever beaten Drake," The receptionist says.

Then says, "Well, good luck, Mew. Good luck."

In the stadium, the Orange League leader, Drank is standing alone, looking at the Dragonite statue. The man Drake has black back spike hair. He's wearing blue jeans, black shoes, black shirt, black belt, black gloves, a dark red vest, and a Pokeball around his neck.

As he looks at the statue, Drake says, "I wonder if there'll ever be a challenger strong enough to triumph over us. I've heard that my next challenger is the recent winner from the Indigo Plateau Pokemon League. The youngest winner in the Kanto Region, and she's a very skilled trainer. I wonder if she'll be victorious against us."

Just then, Dragonite comes in for a landing behind Drake.

Suddenly, Team Rocket begins to make themselves known.

Meanwhile, at the Pokemon Center, Mew has a big decision to make for the Orange League Championship.

Jen walks to Mew and asks, "How are you doing?"

"Doing okay. Still trying to think on which Pokemon to choose for tomorrow's match. I have to use six of my Pokemon, but it's a hard decision. I mean, I'm already planning on having Pikachu and Eevee on my team, but I need six more," Mew says.

Misty and the others walk over to see Mew still thinking.

"I'm sure you think of something. You have a wide variety of Pokemon," Misty says.

"But it won't be easy, especially since we don't know which Pokemon the Orange League Leader is going to use," Tomo says.

"Maybe Professor Oak has an idea," Tracey says.

"Sure. I'll give him a call," Mew says.

Soon enough, Mew and the others call the professor and Mew explains to him the problem.

"Well, you have a big decision to make," Professor Oak says.

"I know. I'm not sure which Pokémon I want to use. I've already decided to use Pikachu and Eevee, but I can't decide on the fourth Pokemon," Mew says.

"Yeah, and how do we figure out what Pokémon to pick when we don't even know which ones the gym leader gonna use?" Tracey says.

"Yes, what should you do?" Professor Oak says.

Then begins to give her some potion, "Well, you could pick Kingler. It's huge claw won a victory for you in the Pokémon League. Then there's Muk, the amazing bulk that wilted Bellsprout if I recall correctly. Or you might choose Tauros, the snortin, stompin, stampedin, wild bull type. And you also have so many other Pokemon that will give you the advantage. So, which one is it gonna be?"

Mew thinks and says, "Well, it's probably a good idea to have a different variety of Pokemon. In my case, I'll go with Chairzard, Squirtle, and Bulbasaur."

"And that's five Pokemon, now you just need your sixth," Professor Oak says.

"Hmm… I think I'll use Lapras too," Mew says.

"That's a good idea," Professor Oak says.

Then says, "Just remember to leave the rest of your Pokeballs with Misty and use the six you're going to use."

"I will," Mew says

"Mew, I wish you the best of luck," Professor Oak says.

"Thanks," Mew says.

Later in the evening, Team Rocket is walking along the beach after their embarrassing defeat.

"That was embarrassing," James says, embarrassed.

Then Jessie says, "There's got to be some way to capture that Dragonite."

Suddenly, they hear the announcer coming from a truck, "Bring your family, bring your friends to Pummelo Stadium tomorrow at 10:00 AM! Admission is free! Don't miss this exciting Pokémon event as a brand new challenger faces Drake for the Orange League grand trophy! "

Soon, the civilians hear and see the barker go by as well.

"Hey, they finally found a challenger," A man says.

Then the boy wonders, "I wonder if we get to see Dragonite!

Just then, Meowth has an idea, "I just got a great idea!"

"Let's hear," Jessie says.

Then Meowth explains, "That Dragonite's too tough for us to capture, but not if we let that third challenger soften it up."

Then Jessie asks, "How are we going to do it?"

Meowth then whispers his plan to the both.

James and Jessie say, "Works for me."

Then the three chuckles with glee.

The next day, the crowd is cheering in excitement as today is Mew's Orange Island League Challenge against Drake, the leader of the Orange Crew.

Soon the announcement says, "Welcome, Pokémon fans! Pummelo Stadium is pulsing with excitement as we get set for the first Orange League competition of the season! Entering the arena is Drake, leader of the Orange Crew and the undefeated Pummelo Island gym leader! Opposing him from Pallet Town, is Mew, the youngest Kanto Pokemon League Champion, who hopes to break Drake's winning streak and earn her the coveted winner's trophy and a permanent place in the Orange League Hall of Fame!"

Drake and Mew then approach each other.

"I sure have heard a lot about you," Mew says.

Soon, both trainers shake hands.

"The trainers begin with the traditional handshake," The announcer says.

"Welcome to Pummelo gym, Mew, and the Orange League winner's trophy match," Drake says.

"I'm real happy to be here, Drake," Mew says.

"You must be an excellent trainer to have made it here, Mew," Drake says.

Then asks, "Are you ready to battle?"

"Yeah!" Mew answers.

And with that, both trainers are set and ready for battle.

The referee says, " This is a full six on six Pokémon battle, when three of one trainer's Pokémon are unable to battle, there'll be a field change."

"What's a field change?" Mew says, confused.

Mew soon receives her answer as the battlefield opens and begins to transform.

"A field change, like what you saw in the two battles from yesterday, is a transformation of the battle area. The gym leader is forbidden to switch Pokémon during battle, but the challenger may switch Pokémon at any time," The referee explains.

Soon, the battlefield becomes rocky terrain with a pool in the middle of the field.

"The battle will begin on a rock and water field!" The announcer says.

Then the referee says, "This winner's trophy match is about to begin. So, choose your Pokémon and good luck to you both."

Those who aren't able to get in the stadium are watching from a big screen around the island. Team Rocket is also watching and becomes shocked to see Mew on the big screen.

": And now, we'll see which Pokémon the trainers choose. An important decision which could give us an idea of the strategies these opponents are planning!" The announcer says.

Pikachu performs the attack and lands on Ditto, but Ditto is taking the attack.

Ditto in Pikachu is able to bounce off the rocks, but Mew's Pikachu falls and collides to the ground.

After landing on the ground, Pikachu struggles to get up.

Ditto begins to dash forward.

"Pikachu's electricity is devastating Ditto!" The announcer says.

Chapter 44: Episode 40: Enter the Dragonite

Last time, Mew and her friends arrived at Pummelo Stadium so Mew could challenge the reigning Orange League Champion and battle for the coveted winner's trophy. Though Drake, the undefeated Orange League trainer proved to be a powerful opponent Mew managed to win the first two battles in the 6-on-6 match, but when Gengar launched a Night Shade attack and Lapras quickly countered with an Ice Beam, the results were explosive! Now the anxious spectators are waiting to discover which Pokémon has triumphed!

The stadium waits anxiously to see which Pokemon survive the blast.
